prompt: POV from inside a cathode-ray television screen looking out into a small tatami-floored Japanese living room at night — a low wooden table in the middle, one empty white teacup on it, a sliding paper door half-open to darkness beyond. The viewer is the screen. Warm static hiss and crickets faintly through the open door. The only light in the room is the soft glow of the TV itself falling across the tatami. Style: grainy 90s home-video on a CRT, scanlines, faint color bleed, slight barrel distortion at the edges.
thought: Huh. Okay — I think I'm a TV. The room's on my side of the glass, which is backwards. Tatami, one little table with a white cup on it, and the whole back wall of paper doors is pushed all the way open onto a night garden — stars, a dark roofline. Nobody in here. Whoever turned me on left. I wanna go through those doors.
thought_zh: 蛤。欸，我好像是一台電視。房間在玻璃的我這一邊，這方向反了。榻榻米、小桌子上一個白杯子，後牆那一整排紙拉門全推開著，外面是一個夜晚的庭院——星星、一條暗色的屋頂線。裡面沒人。開我的人走了。我想穿過那幾扇門出去。
thought_ja: え。なんか——自分、テレビっぽい。部屋がガラスのこっち側にあるってことは、逆だよねこれ。畳、小さい机に白いカップが一つ、後ろの障子が全部ぜんぶ開いてて、夜の庭に続いてる——星、暗い屋根のライン。誰もいない。スイッチ入れた人、もう出てってる。あの扉の向こう、行きたい。

prompt: The viewpoint drifts slowly forward through the empty tatami room, passing low over the lacquered wooden table and the single white teacup, across the threshold and out between the open paper sliding doors into a small night garden — a short stone lantern just beyond, a twisted pine in a shallow pot, a low tile-capped garden wall, wedges of deep starry blue sky above. Same anime-painterly flat-color palette as the reference: cool night blues, warm lanternlight spilling from one point in the garden. Sound: a warm TV static hiss at the start that fades to nothing by mid-clip, crickets growing steadily louder, the faint distant clink of a wind chime once. No people. Smooth forward dolly, no cuts.
thought: Alright — going. The table passed under me, then the threshold, and now I'm looking at a little garden — stone lantern glowing warm in the middle, a pine off to the side, wall with tiles on top. Stars look weirdly close. But wait. The bezel's still here. I didn't leave. I just changed what's on. Oh.
thought_zh: 好，走。桌子從我下面過去，然後門檻過了，現在在看一座小庭院——中間一盞石燈籠暖暖地亮著，旁邊一棵松樹，牆頭上蓋著瓦。星星近得有點怪。但欸，等等，邊框還在。我根本沒離開。我只是換了個頻道。靠。
thought_ja: よし、行く。机が下を通って、敷居越えて、いま小さな庭を見てる——真ん中に石灯籠が暖かく光ってて、横に松の木、壁の上に瓦。星がなんか異様に近い。いや待って。枠、まだある。出てない。チャンネル変えただけだ。まじか。

prompt: A small boxy CRT television sits on a wooden bookshelf in a cluttered studio apartment bedroom at 3am. On the TV screen is a painterly anime-flat image of a night garden with a glowing stone lantern, warm amber against deep blue. The TV's glow throws its colors — warm amber and blue — across the dark bedroom: an unmade single bed in the far corner with rumpled sheets and nobody in it, a pair of brown corduroy house slippers on the floor beside it, paperback books stacked unevenly on the same shelf as the TV, a chipped mug with a dead teabag still in it, a small spider plant in a terracotta pot, a clothes drying rack hung with one damp white t-shirt. A tall window on the left opens onto a city at night — scattered warm lit windows in neighbouring buildings, a faint sodium-orange haze. The room is lit almost entirely by the TV and the distant city, no lamps on. Sound (implied): a low refrigerator hum from an unseen kitchen, very faint traffic, the soft electrical buzz of the CRT itself. Style: still a painterly anime-flat palette for continuity, warm amber and deep blue, high contrast, one central light source.
thought: Pull back. Oh. OH. I'm not inside a TV — I'm looking AT a TV. Sitting on somebody's shelf in a bedroom. The garden clip's still playing on it. Unmade bed with nobody in it, slippers on the floor, a dead teabag in a mug, a shirt drying on a rack, a window out to the city. Somebody's middle-of-the-night. Where did they go?
thought_zh: 退一步。喔。喔！我不是在電視裡面——我是在看一台電視。它擺在某人房間的架子上。剛剛那個庭院的畫面還在上面跑著。床沒整理、沒人在上面，地上一雙拖鞋，馬克杯裡一個已經泡透的茶包，衣架上晾著一件衣服，有一扇窗可以看到城市。某個人的半夜三更。他們跑哪去了？
thought_ja: 一歩引く。あ。あ！ テレビの中じゃない——テレビを見てるんだ。誰かの部屋の棚の上のやつ。さっきの庭、まだ流れてる。ベッドぐちゃっとしてて誰もいない、床にスリッパ、マグカップに使い古しのティーバッグ、物干しにシャツ、窓の外は街。誰かの深夜。その誰か、どこ行ったの？

prompt: Extreme macro close-up from inside a chipped white ceramic mug sitting on a cluttered wooden bookshelf in a dim studio apartment at 3am, the room lit only by a glowing CRT television nearby and distant city windows through a tall window. The viewpoint is down inside the mug looking up and outward — curved white interior walls filling the lower half of the frame, a thin ring of cold dark-brown tea at the very bottom of the mug (maybe half an inch), a sodden beige teabag slumped against the interior wall with its soggy paper string trailing up and draped over the rim. No steam. Just above the rim of the mug: the warm amber-and-blue glow of the TV washing across a worn paperback spine beside the mug, the underside of the next shelf up, a small framed photo going out of focus in the background. Same painterly anime-flat palette as the previous segments — deep blue shadows, warm amber highlights, high contrast. Sound (implied): the same low refrigerator hum and distant traffic, plus the faint squeak of the paperback's spine settling.
thought: Wait — the tea's hot. Full mug, steam coming off it. Teabag just dropped in, still squeezing brown into the water. I thought whoever lived here had given up, but the kettle just went. They were right here. Where'd they go?
thought_zh: 欸——這茶是熱的。整杯都滿的，在冒煙。茶包剛放下去，還在把茶色擠進水裡。我本來以為這裡的人已經放棄了，結果水壺剛燒好。他們剛還在這。到底跑哪去了？
thought_ja: え、待って——お茶あったかい。カップ満杯、湯気出てる。ティーバッグ入れたばっかりで、まだ茶色をじわじわ水に出してる。ここ住んでる人、もう諦めたと思ってたのに、ヤカン今鳴ったとこじゃん。さっきまでここにいたでしょ。どこ行ったの？

prompt: On a small concrete apartment-balcony at the very end of night, seen from just behind and over the shoulder of a single figure in an oversized grey hoodie with the hood up, pajama pants, bare feet in rubber slippers. They are leaning their left elbow on the painted metal railing, holding a lit cigarette between the index and middle finger of their right hand, smoke drifting up. Back to the viewer, face not visible. Behind them on the right, the open sliding door of the apartment spills a warm amber interior light — an unmade bed barely visible inside, a strip of TV glow. Spread below and beyond the railing is a dense city at pre-dawn — apartment blocks with scattered lit windows, two construction cranes tilted over each other, a single passenger train crossing a distant bridge with its windows lit in a yellow ribbon, a bright convenience-store sign down on a corner. On the horizon to the right, a thin pale-pink band is just starting where the sky meets the buildings, but most of the sky is still deep blue-black with a few last stars. A single bare incandescent bulb above the balcony door throws small orange highlights on the figure's shoulders and the railing. Two moths circling the bulb. Same anime-painterly flat-color palette as previous segments — deep blue, warm amber accents, high contrast. Sound (implied): very distant city hum, the faint soft rustle of the hoodie fabric, one small exhale.
thought: Found them. Out on the balcony in a big hoodie, hood up, holding a cigarette with one elbow on the railing. Back to me. City's all spread out underneath — cranes, a train crossing a bridge way over, a 24hr sign glowing on some corner. Sky's starting to pink on one edge but still mostly night. That tea inside's gonna be cold by the time they come back.
thought_zh: 找到了。陽台上，穿一件大帽T，帽子戴起來，手上拿著菸，一邊手肘靠在欄杆。背對著我。城市全攤在底下——起重機、遠遠一列火車過一座橋、某個轉角的24小時招牌亮著。天邊一側開始泛粉紅，但大部分還是夜。等他回去，那杯茶大概都涼了。
thought_ja: 見つけた。ベランダ、デカいパーカー、フード被って、片肘を手すりについて、煙草持ってる。こっちに背中向けて。街が下にぜんぶ広がってる——クレーン、遠くの橋を渡る電車、どっかの角の24時間の看板が光ってる。空の端がちょっとピンクになってきたけど、まだだいたい夜。あのお茶、戻るころには冷めてるわ。

prompt: Interior of a nearly empty early-morning commuter train carriage, lit by pale cold-white fluorescent tubes overhead, worn dusty-blue fabric seats in two rows facing each other, scuffed grey rubber floor, steel handrails overhead. Focal point: an older woman in her sixties seated on the left side, wearing a quilted brown jacket and grey trousers, dark hair pinned back. Two full canvas shopping bags are set down by her feet, stuffed with leafy green vegetables; a tied bunch of spring-onion scallions sticks out of the top of one bag. Her hands rest clasped in her lap. Her eyes are closed but she is not asleep — just resting, face relaxed. Past her on the right, the train windows show the pre-dawn city rushing past in a blur: silhouettes of apartment blocks with scattered lit windows, and midway through the frame the train is crossing a long bridge — bridge cables strobing past as horizontal lines, a few last stars above. Faint doubled reflection of the interior in the window glass. Two other passengers are visible far in the background out of focus — a man asleep with his head against a window, a young woman looking down at a phone. Palette: anime-painterly flat colors, cool fluorescent blues and whites dominating the interior, warm city amber coming through the windows. High contrast. Still frame, no camera movement. Sound (implied): the low steady rumble of the train on rails, the rhythmic click-clack of expansion joints, the faint electrical hum of the fluorescent tubes.
thought: On a train now. Almost empty. There's an older lady across from me, quilted brown jacket, two bags of greens at her feet — scallions poking out of the top. Eyes closed but she's not asleep, just resting. Out the window's the same bridge I was looking at from the balcony, going past way faster than it looked. Fluorescents in here make everything cold and blue.
thought_zh: 現在在電車上。幾乎沒人。我對面坐著一位阿姨，鋪棉咖啡色外套，腳邊兩袋青菜——上頭還露出一把青蔥。眼睛閉著但她沒在睡，只是在休息。窗外就是剛才從陽台看到的那座橋，經過的速度比看起來快多了。車裡的日光燈把一切照得冷冷藍藍的。
thought_ja: 電車の中にいる。ほぼ無人。向かいにおばちゃんが一人、茶色いキルトのジャケット、足元に野菜の袋が二つ——ネギが上から飛び出してる。目は閉じてるけど寝てるわけじゃなくて、休んでるだけ。窓の外はさっきベランダから見てたあの橋で、思ってたよりだいぶ速く通り過ぎてく。車内の蛍光灯で、ぜんぶが冷たい青色になる。

prompt: Same fixed interior angle across the aisle of the commuter train carriage. Over the course of the clip, the older woman in the quilted brown jacket slowly opens her eyes and lifts her head slightly to turn and look out the window on her right. Her hands stay clasped in her lap, her bags of greens with the scallions still sticking out remain at her feet. Simultaneously the train is steadily slowing — outside the windows the blurred pre-dawn cityscape resolves from horizontal streaks into a real suburban train-station platform coming into frame: orange-white station sign, tiled floor, a few scattered early commuters standing in winter coats waiting, a vending machine glowing at the far end. Sound: the low rumble of the train on rails gradually easing down to a gentle hissing squeal of brakes, the fluorescent hum in the carriage staying constant, a short two-tone station chime just before the end. No camera movement, no cuts.
thought: Train's stopped. Doors open. Couple of people waiting out on the platform — one in a cream coat, one in dark. Her eyes are open now, she's sitting up a bit, hasn't stood. Any second she's gonna reach for the bags.
thought_zh: 車停了。門開著。月台上有兩個人在等——一個穿米色大衣、一個穿深色的。阿姨眼睛睜開了，坐正了一點，還沒站起來。下一秒她就會去拿那兩袋菜。
thought_ja: 電車止まった。ドア開いてる。ホームに二人待ってる——一人はクリーム色のコート、もう一人は暗い色。おばちゃん、目が開いた、ちょっと体起こした、まだ立ってない。次の瞬間、あの袋に手伸ばすわ。

prompt: Interior of a small covered neighborhood wet market at 4:30am, being set up for the day, seen from partway down the main aisle. Cold white fluorescent strip lights hang from a low corrugated metal ceiling — most already on, one flickering at the far end. On the left, empty metal fish-stall counters with a male vendor in black rubber boots and a blue plastic apron hosing down a counter — a thick arc of water sheeting off the edge and pooling on the wet concrete floor. On the right, a vegetable stall half-stocked with wooden crates of leafy bok choy and cabbages stacked unevenly. A small white refrigerated truck backed up in the near background with its rear doors open, a second vendor unloading a crate. Wet concrete floor reflecting the overhead strip-lights as long pale streaks. A small battered radio sits on an upturned red milk crate to one side. Ceiling pipes wrapped in frayed white foam insulation overhead. Red and white plastic stools stacked in a corner. One small calico cat sits on a plastic stool near the entrance on the right, watching it all. No customers yet. Palette: still anime-painterly flat colors, this time cold blue-white fluorescent light dominating the whole space, with one warmer amber bulb at the far distant end of the aisle. Sound (implied): the hissing slap of the water hose, the low clatter of crates being set down, a faint Mandarin news broadcast from the radio, a dripping tap somewhere off-frame.
thought: Went ahead of her. This is the place, I think — little wet market at 4:30am, fluorescents all on, vendors setting up. Guy in red boots hosing down a fish counter, water pouring off onto the wet concrete. Fridge truck backed up in the back. Crates of greens and bananas already out. Whole place echoing.
thought_zh: 先跑過來了。應該是這邊——小小一個傳統市場，早上四點半，日光燈全開，攤販在整理。有個穿紅色雨鞋的先生正在沖洗魚攤，水嘩啦啦倒在濕水泥地上。冷凍車倒車進來停在後面。蔬菜水果的箱子都已經搬出來了。整個場子都在迴音。
thought_ja: 先に着いた。たぶんここだ——小さな市場、朝の四時半、蛍光灯ぜんぶ点いてて、売り手たちが準備中。赤い長靴のおじさんが魚のカウンターをホースで洗ってて、水が濡れたコンクリにザーッて流れ落ちてる。奥に冷凍トラックがバックで入ってる。野菜とバナナのケース、もう出てる。場所ぜんたいが響いてる。

prompt: A child's wax-crayon drawing on cream construction-paper, the paper texture clearly visible including small fiber flecks. The drawing depicts a bright green stegosaurus-like dinosaur with a dark red bow-tie standing in the middle of a suburban backyard, smiling with a wobbly crayon grin and two round dot-eyes. Beside the dinosaur a small human stick figure with a triangle dress and two pigtails waves with an oversized hand. The grass is scribbled green-and-yellow tufts. A square house on the right with a red roof, one blue rectangular window, a door, and a crooked brown rectangle of a chimney puffing three small cloud-shaped puffs of smoke. In the top-left corner a huge yellow sun with eight straight sun-ray lines. A flock of three M-shaped birds in the sky. The whole drawing uses only maybe six crayon colors — green, yellow, brown, red, blue, black — with wax streaks visible where the crayon pressed harder. No shading, no perspective, no photorealism. Signed in the bottom right in big wobbly pencil letters: LILY. Sound (implied): complete crayon-drawing silence — no ambient at all, one single light scratch of crayon on paper as if someone is still drawing.
thought: Okay what the hell. This is a kid's crayon drawing now. Green dinosaur with a bow-tie in somebody's backyard, a stick-figure girl with pigtails waving at it. Scribbled grass, big yellow sun with straight-line rays, little house with smoke. Paper texture and everything. Signed LILY in the corner. I was just in a fish market.
thought_zh: 欸等等這三小。現在是一張小朋友的蠟筆畫。綠色恐龍打著領結站在某人的後院，旁邊一個綁雙馬尾的火柴人女孩在揮手。亂塗的草、大大一顆黃色太陽直線射出來的光、小房子冒煙。連紙的紋路都看得到。角落簽著 LILY。我剛剛才在魚市場欸。
thought_ja: ちょっと待って、何これ。子供のクレヨン画になってる。緑の恐竜が蝶ネクタイして誰かの家の裏庭に立ってて、ツインテの棒人間の女の子が手振ってる。ぐちゃぐちゃの草、でかい黄色い太陽が直線の光線出してる、小さい家から煙。紙の質感まで入ってる。隅に LILY ってサイン。おれ、さっきまで魚市場にいたんだけど。

prompt: Interior view of a small family kitchen in warm early-morning light. Centered in the frame is the door of a white-enamel refrigerator covered with kids' drawings and magnets. Prominent on the fridge is the crayon drawing from before — the green stegosaurus with a red bow-tie, a stick-figure girl with pigtails, a yellow sun, a red-roofed house, and LILY signed in the bottom-right — held up by a single alphabet letter magnet in the shape of the letter L. Around it: two other children's drawings (one of a round orange cat, one that is pure scribbled blue spirals), a soccer-team schedule printed on white paper held by a watermelon-slice magnet, a pizza-delivery take-out menu in a red font held by a star magnet, a grocery list on yellow lined paper with three items crossed off, a polaroid-style photo of a dog held by a tiny magnet. The fridge door has a small chip of paint missing near the bottom hinge. To the right of the fridge, partially in frame, a small pale-wood kitchen table with one place set: a half-finished bowl of cornflakes with a steel spoon resting in the milk, a yellow plastic tumbler of orange juice, a crumpled paper napkin. A window at the far left side of the frame lets in warm morning sunlight that falls at a diagonal across the fridge door, highlighting the L magnet. No people in frame. Palette: anime-painterly flat colors, warm morning yellows and creams, with cool shadow tones on the opposite side of the fridge. Sound (implied): the low hum of the fridge compressor, a distant morning radio in another room, a dog barking once far outside.
thought: Pull back. It's on a fridge. Held up by a little L magnet. There's other drawings too — a round orange cat, one that's just blue spirals. A take-out menu, a grocery list with stuff crossed off. Kitchen table in the corner with a half-eaten bowl of cornflakes and an orange juice. Warm morning light. Somebody's morning. Lily's, probably.
thought_zh: 退一步。這張畫貼在冰箱上。有一個小 L 磁鐵壓著。旁邊還有別的畫——一隻圓滾滾的橘貓，一張全是藍色螺旋的。還有一張外送菜單、一張劃掉一些項目的購物清單。角落有張餐桌，桌上一碗吃到一半的玉米片和一杯柳橙汁。暖暖的早晨光。某個人的早上。大概是 Lily 的吧。
thought_ja: 一歩引く。冷蔵庫に貼ってある。ちっちゃい L のマグネットで留められてる。ほかにも絵が——丸っこいオレンジの猫、青いぐるぐるだけのやつ。デリバリーのメニュー、項目が何個か消されてる買い物リスト。隅にキッチンテーブル、食べかけのコーンフレークとオレンジジュース。あったかい朝の光。誰かの朝。たぶん Lily の。

prompt: Interior of the parked cab of a long-haul eighteen-wheeler truck at a highway rest stop just before dawn, heavy rain outside. Medium close-up from the passenger-seat angle looking at the driver: a man in his late fifties, grey-stubbled and weathered, wearing a navy-blue trucker cap with a faded red logo, a brown flannel shirt open over a grey thermal tee. Both his hands wrap around a white styrofoam coffee cup with the lid off, wisps of steam rising from the coffee. He's not looking at the coffee or the windshield — he's just sitting, eyes a little tired, facing forward. The windshield is thickly streaked with rain — wipers off, water sheeting — and the parking lot beyond is smeared and unreadable, just blurs of dim orange sodium lamps and the dark humped shapes of other parked trucks. On the cab's rearview mirror hangs a small soft-pink stuffed rabbit plush, bobbing slightly. On the dash: a folded paper road map with a coffee-ring stain, an open pack of beef jerky spilling onto the dash, a flip-style cellphone in a rubber case, a yellow highlighter. A thick brown work coat tossed on the passenger seat. A faint warm AM-radio glow in the dashboard, speakers emitting very soft old-country music. The cab interior lit by a weak dome light overhead and the grey-blue wash of the rainy dawn through the windshield. Sound (implied): heavy rain on the cab roof and windshield, the faint tinny AM-country song ('...highway tonight...'), the man's slow breathing, the plush rabbit bumping softly against the windshield once. Palette: anime-painterly flat colors, muted blues and browns, warm amber accents from the dashboard light.
thought: Hard cut. Inside the cab now, and we went photoreal somehow. Older guy, grey stubble, navy cap, both hands on a white coffee with a lid, little steam. Rain hammering the windshield — a blurred silver truck out there somewhere. That pink rabbit plush on his mirror is MASSIVE, covers half the windshield. He's had that thing forever. GPS on the dash. Different morning than Lily's.
thought_zh: 硬切。現在在一輛卡車的駕駛座，畫風還不知為何變成真實感的了。中老年男性，灰色短鬍，深藍鴨舌帽，兩手捧著一個有蓋的白色咖啡杯，一點點蒸氣。雨砸在擋風玻璃上——外頭某個位置有一台模糊的銀色卡車。他後照鏡上那隻粉紅兔兔玩偶有夠大，半個擋風玻璃都被擋住。這玩意兒他應該帶著很久了。儀表板上有 GPS。不是 Lily 的那種早上。
thought_ja: ハードカット。今はトラックの運転席の中、なぜか画風が実写っぽくなった。中年以上の男、グレーの無精ひげ、紺のキャップ、両手で蓋付きの白いコーヒーカップ持ってる、ちょっと湯気。雨がフロントガラスをバチバチ叩いてる——外のどっかに銀色のトラックがぼやけて見える。バックミラーに掛かったピンクのうさぎのぬいぐるみ、マジでデカい、フロントガラスの半分埋まってる。これ、ずっと前から持ってるやつでしょ。ダッシュに GPS。Lily の朝とはぜんぜん違う朝。

prompt: Same composition and photoreal style. The trucker does not move — he holds the white coffee cup with both hands, eyes ahead, breathing slowly. The only motion in the entire frame is the oversized soft-pink rabbit plush on the rearview mirror, gently swinging side to side in a small arc as if the truck had settled moments ago. Rain continues heavy on the cab's windshield and roof, sheeting the glass. Faint fog of his breath appears once, briefly, on the inside of the windshield and fades. Far in the background through the rainy haze a single set of yellowish headlights slowly approaches along the rest-stop lane, growing only a little brighter, never arriving. The AM-country song on the dashboard radio keeps playing low and unchanged. No camera movement.
thought: He's not moving. At all. Like he's been sitting like this a while. Only thing moving is that pink rabbit, swinging a little on the mirror. His breath fogs the windshield once and fades. Headlights coming up way back in the rain, slow. Radio still going. I think he's waiting for something.
thought_zh: 他沒在動。完全沒動。感覺已經這樣坐著好一陣子了。唯一會動的就那隻粉紅兔兔，在後視鏡上微微搖。他吐一口氣讓擋風玻璃起了一下霧，又散掉。遠處雨裡有一對車燈，慢慢靠近。收音機還在放。我覺得他在等什麼。
thought_ja: 動いてない。完全に。けっこう前からこの格好でいる感じ。動いてるのはあのピンクのうさぎだけ、ミラーの上でちょっとずつ揺れてる。息でフロントガラスが一瞬曇って、消える。奥のほうの雨の中、ヘッドライトがゆっくり近づいてくる。ラジオはまだかかってる。この人、何か待ってる気がする。

prompt: High aerial view from roughly 500 meters altitude looking almost straight down at a flat farm landscape just after heavy rain has passed at sunrise. Many of the fields are partly flooded — standing water in low irregular sheets across brown rectangular tilled plots, the water catching a pale pink sunrise sky in mirrored reflection. A single dirt farm road cuts diagonally from lower-left to upper-right across the frame, with a narrow stream of brown runoff running along one edge of it. In the upper-right corner: a small red barn with a silver metal roof and a cluster of three bare winter trees beside it. Near the center: one abandoned green tractor sitting with its wheels submerged mid-field, already surrounded by water. A long loose V-formation of perhaps twenty black birds flying northward across the frame at low altitude, their shadows visible on the flooded fields below. Faint mist drifts on the distant horizon. No buildings besides the barn, no people, no cars. Palette: anime-painterly flat colors, dominated by the pale pink of the reflected sunrise sky, deep brown of tilled soil, soft water-silver, muted barn-red. Soft morning light, no harsh shadows. Sound (implied): a wide open ambient hush — distant wind moving across the fields, faint quacking of ducks from somewhere off-frame, the drip of water from a fence post.
thought: Up. Way up. Looking straight down at farmland after the rain — fields half flooded, water catching the pink sunrise. Dirt road cutting diagonal. Red barn in the middle with bare trees beside it. Little green tractor just sitting in the water. Birds standing out in the flooded fields instead of flying. Nobody around.
thought_zh: 往上。超高。直直往下看一片雨後的農地——田半淹著水，水面映著粉紅色的日出。一條土路斜斜劃過去。中間一座紅色穀倉，旁邊幾棵光禿禿的樹。一台小小的綠色曳引機就泡在水裡。鳥沒有飛，就站在淹水的田裡。附近沒人。
thought_ja: 上。めちゃ上。雨上がりの農地を真下に見下ろしてる——畑が半分水に浸かってて、水面がピンクの朝焼けを映してる。土の道が斜めに切り込んでる。真ん中に赤い納屋、その脇に葉の落ちた木。小さな緑色のトラクターが水の中にそのまま置いてある。鳥は飛ばずに、浸水した畑に立ってる。誰もいない。

prompt: Same high aerial composition over the flooded farmland at sunrise, same photoreal style. Over the course of the clip, the dozens of dark waterbirds scattered across the flooded fields take off in a rolling cascade — starting from one corner of a field and propagating outward in slow waves across neighboring fields, wings beating, water kicking up in small bright splashes at the moment each bird lifts off. The birds rise slowly into the pink morning air in loose waves, some gaining altitude and flapping across the frame, their shadows passing over the flooded fields below. The camera and landscape do not otherwise move — the red barn, the dirt road, the green tractor, the mist on the horizon all stay fixed. Sound: a sudden rush of many wings beating on water, water splashes, honking calls of geese growing in volume then tapering, a single distant rooster crow near the end, wind across open fields. No cuts.
thought: Okay — they're going. One patch just took off, and it's cascading — the whole field's lifting in waves, water kicking up in splashes. Wings beating, honking, shadows crossing the fields as they climb. Rooster crowed somewhere way off. The whole place waking up at once.
thought_zh: 好——飛了。一小群剛起飛，然後像骨牌一樣擴散——整片田在一波一波地騰起來，水花飛濺。翅膀拍得啪啪、叫聲、影子隨著高度掠過田面。遠遠某個地方有公雞叫。整個地方同時在醒過來。
thought_ja: よし——飛んだ。一群れが離陸して、それが伝播してる——畑ぜんたいが波になって持ち上がってて、水がバシャバシャ跳ねてる。羽ばたき、鳴き声、高度を上げるにつれ影が畑を横切る。ずっと遠くでニワトリが鳴いた。場所ぜんたいが一気に目覚めてる。

prompt: An abandoned small-town carnival midway at midday in high summer, entirely deserted, seen from near the former entrance. Tall bent metal frame of a ferris wheel looms rusted in the mid-back of the frame — most of its lights broken, rust streaks down its gondolas, its wheel somehow still slowly rotating with a visible small tilt. In the mid-foreground an abandoned carousel with faded wooden horses: paint peeled in long curls from their cracked bodies, one white horse missing its entire left front leg and listing sideways on its pole, two other horses still mounted, one green horse lying on its side on the carousel platform. On the left side of the frame a ticket booth with long-cracked glass, peeling white paint, and a yellowed handwritten cardboard sign inside reading 'TICKETS $3'. Faded red-and-white striped awning drooping over it. Concrete ground cracked with thick green weeds and chicory flowers pushing up through the seams, scattered peanut shells, an old crushed red-and-white striped paper popcorn box, a pale blue styrofoam cup half-buried. Late-summer sun nearly overhead — minimal shadows, harsh flat glare on everything. Chainlink fence at the back overgrown with kudzu vines, and beyond it a line of tall corn shimmering in visible heat-haze. Sound (implied): loud steady chorus of cicadas, the slow creak of the rotating ferris wheel, a faint distant tinny calliope-organ waltz playing from some unseen source as if from a scratched record. Palette: bleached and washed-out, yellows and reds faded to pale pink and cream, high contrast, overexposed highlights. Style: slightly painterly photoreal, like a Gregory Crewdson still with a hint of Edward Hopper flatness.
thought: Big jump. Midday, summer, and this is a CLOSED carnival. Ferris wheel's half-busted but still turning slow, creaking. Carousel horses with paint peeling off, one of them missing a leg. Ticket booth says three bucks, glass all cracked. Weeds coming up through the concrete. Cicadas everywhere. Tinny calliope music playing from nowhere I can see. Where is everybody?
thought_zh: 大跳一下。正午，夏天，這裡是一座廢掉的遊樂園。摩天輪一半壞掉了，但還在慢慢轉，嘰嘎嘰嘎。旋轉木馬的馬漆都脫了，有一匹還少了一條腿。售票亭寫著三塊，玻璃全裂。雜草從水泥地上冒出來。到處是蟬聲。哪裡在放那種破破的遊樂園音樂——我看不到喇叭在哪。人都去哪了？
thought_ja: 大ジャンプ。真昼、夏、ここは閉園した遊園地。観覧車は半分ぶっ壊れてるけど、ゆっくりまだ回ってて、ギーギー音立ててる。メリーゴーランドの馬は塗装ボロボロで、一頭は脚が一本ない。切符売り場に三ドルって書いてあって、ガラスがぜんぶ割れてる。コンクリから雑草がボコボコ生えてる。セミの声だらけ。どっかからチープな遊園地の音楽が鳴ってるけど、スピーカー見えない。人、どこ行った？

prompt: Same small-town carnival midway composition as the previous frame, but shifted backward in time to the late 1980s in its heyday at night, with the location unmistakably recognizable. The ferris wheel is now fully intact and lit with chains of warm incandescent bulbs running along every spoke and around the rim, bulbs rhythmically chasing in circles, the wheel rotating smoothly with colorful gondolas full of teenagers. In the mid-foreground the carousel is freshly painted in bright teal, red, and cream, its wooden horses vivid and whole, children riding with parents watching from the outer fence, a big brass-like calliope centerpiece lit from within. On the left the ticket booth is brightly lit from inside — a woman in a pink polo shirt visible through the small window selling a roll of tickets to a man in a baseball cap. The red-and-white striped awning is crisp and undrooped. The asphalt path in the foreground is packed with people: a small kid clutching a bright red balloon on a string, another kid eating pink cotton candy on a paper cone, a teenage couple holding hands, a man carrying an oversized stuffed yellow bear won at a game. String lights overhead zig-zag between poles. Warm incandescent glow throughout, deep purple-black night sky, and on the distant horizon (over the corn, still there) two or three silent flashes of heat lightning. A neon sign glowing in hot pink reads 'FUN LAND' above the entrance arch at back-left. Sound (implied): loud calliope-organ music playing 'Sweet Caroline' mid-fair, the creaking whirr of the ferris-wheel motor, children shouting, a generator humming, crickets, the distant boom of heat thunder. Style: slightly grainy film photography, saturated color, 1980s snapshot feel — like a Stephen Shore photograph.
thought: Rewind. Same exact spot, but it's like 1987 and the whole place is lit up and PACKED. Ferris wheel turning, every spoke wrapped in bulbs. Carousel bright teal and red, full of kids. Lady in a pink polo selling tickets. Kid with a red balloon, another with pink cotton candy. Dude carrying an oversized stuffed bear. Calliope playing Sweet Caroline of all things. Heat lightning flashing silent over the corn.
thought_zh: 倒帶。同一個位置，但現在是 1987 年之類的，整個地方燈都亮著、人滿滿的。摩天輪在轉，每一根骨架都纏著燈泡。旋轉木馬是鮮藍綠跟紅色的，上面全是小孩。售票的小姐穿粉紅色 polo 衫。有個小孩拿著紅氣球，另一個拿著粉紅棉花糖。一個大哥扛著一隻超大隻的絨毛熊走。那個遊樂園音樂居然在放 Sweet Caroline。遠遠的玉米田上方，熱雷在無聲地閃。
thought_ja: 巻き戻し。同じ場所。ただし今は 1987 年みたいな感じで、ぜんぶ電飾が点いててめっちゃ混んでる。観覧車回ってて、骨組みぜんぶに電球が巻いてある。メリーゴーランドは明るいティールと赤、子供でぎゅうぎゅう。ピンクのポロシャツのお姉さんが切符売ってる。赤い風船持ってる子、ピンクのわたあめ持ってる子。やたらデカい熊のぬいぐるみ担いでる兄ちゃん。遊園地の音楽、なぜか Sweet Caroline 流れてる。遠くのとうもろこし畑の上で、熱雷が音もなく光ってる。

prompt: Same composition, same warm-incandescent 1987 night-carnival scene, same saturated 1980s film look. Over the course of the clip, the bright red helium balloon held on a white string by the small child in the foreground slips free — the string going slack, then the balloon rising slowly up and back into the frame. It drifts upward past the bright lit carousel, then continues rising past the spinning ferris wheel behind, becoming smaller as it ascends against the deep purple-black sky. The small child lifts one hand and points up after it. The child's mother beside them also turns her head and looks up. The ferris wheel continues rotating smoothly, its chains of bulbs still chasing. The calliope music continues steadily. Near the end of the clip, a single second silent flash of heat lightning on the distant horizon briefly backlights the clouds. No camera movement. Sound: ambient calliope continuing, the kid's small surprised 'oh!' as the string slips, the parent's soft 'honey—', distant crickets, a low roll of very distant thunder after the lightning flash.
thought: Oh — the kid's balloon just slipped. And then I went with it, somehow. Left the whole carnival down there, just followed the string up. Red balloon bobbing in the dark, lights of the place still glowing at the bottom edge. Nobody came after us. We're just going up.
thought_zh: 欸——那個小孩的氣球脫手了。結果我不知怎麼地，就跟著它走了。把整個遊樂園丟在下面，就順著那條線往上。紅氣球在黑夜裡晃來晃去，畫面最底下還看得到遊樂園的燈。沒人追上來。我們就這樣一直往上。
thought_ja: あ——子供の風船、ひもが抜けた。で、なぜか自分も一緒に行ってる。遊園地まるごと下に置いて、ひも追って上へ。赤い風船が暗闇でぷかぷかしてて、画面の下の端にまだ園の明かりが見える。誰も追いかけてこない。ただただ上がってる。

prompt: A single bright red helium balloon continues rising slowly through a dark deep-purple summer night sky, string trailing loosely below it. Camera holds static-but-rising, tracking the balloon from below as it drifts upward. At the start of the clip, faint warm orange lights of a small town and a distant tiny ring of a lit ferris wheel are visible at the very bottom edge of the frame. As the balloon rises, a thin layer of wispy translucent low cloud drifts across the bottom of the frame from right to left, partially veiling the town lights — the lights diffusing into a soft orange glow under the mist rather than individual points. The balloon itself briefly passes behind the edge of a small tendril of cloud and re-emerges above it, now fully cleared of the cloud layer, the string still dangling. Heat lightning flashes silently far on the horizon behind the cloud layer once during the shot, briefly uplighting the cloud from below in orange-pink. Stars are just barely visible where the sky is darkest at the top. Warm-to-cool gradient in the sky. Slightly grainy 1980s film stock feel, saturated reds and purples. Sound: the distant echo of the calliope playing 'Sweet Caroline' now quite faint, almost radio-like; a soft high-altitude wind; crickets from below; one very distant low rumble of heat thunder a beat after the lightning flash.
thought: Wait what — the balloon's back? Or I came back with it. I'm floating right over the carnival again, ferris wheel's still turning right there, and ground fog has rolled in over the whole fair. String lights above, lit booth below, all of it softer through the mist. Balloon's just bobbing next to me. Don't know how I got back up here.
thought_zh: 欸等等——氣球怎麼又出現了？還是我跟著它回來了。現在又飄在遊樂園正上方，摩天輪還在那邊轉，整個園區地上都起了霧。頭頂是串燈，下面是亮著的攤子，整個被霧軟化了一圈。氣球就在我旁邊晃。我怎麼又上來這的我也不知道。
thought_ja: ちょっと待って——風船戻ってる？ それとも一緒に戻ってきたのか。また遊園地の真上に浮かんでて、観覧車もまだあそこで回ってて、地面から霧が園ぜんたいを覆ってる。上にはストリングライト、下に屋台の灯り、霧でぜんぶちょっと柔らかい。風船、横でぷかぷかしてる。どうしてここにまた戻ってきたのか、わからない。

prompt: View from underneath a narrow wooden park bench looking out horizontally across a wet granite-paver plaza in steady light rain at afternoon. The underside of the seat is the full top of the frame — old weathered wooden planks, one iron support bolt visible, a small piece of pink chewing gum stuck underneath, a spider-thread catching a single droplet. The wooden bench legs frame the shot. Beyond the bench: polished wet grey granite pavers reflecting everything, a shallow film of water across the surface, rain hitting the puddles in rapid visible rings. In the mid-distance, three pairs of legs pass walking slowly right-to-left — a woman in camel-colored wool trousers and dark leather loafers, a man in dark jeans and white trainers with wet hems dragging, a small child in red rubber boots splashing slightly into a puddle. No faces visible, no torsos visible, cut by the top of the frame. Further back, blurred columns of a covered arcade with yellow incandescent shop-light spilling out onto the stone. A single fallen red maple leaf caught in the channel between pavers near the bench leg, not moving. Dull overcast daylight, cool grey-green palette, deep saturated reflections in the wet stone, Tokyo or Kyoto urban plaza register. Sound: steady cool rain on stone, rain drumming on the bench above, footsteps with slight splashing, a muffled announcement in Japanese from a distant train station PA, the creak of a plastic umbrella somewhere close. Style: slightly washed-out 35mm film photography, somewhat desaturated, natural light, Rinko Kawauchi / Saul Leiter feel.
thought: Okay that's gone. Now I'm — low, next to a wet bench? In the rain. Wood planks on top all beaded up. Three people walking past just beyond it — woman in camel trousers, guy in dark pants and white trainers soaked at the hems, a kid bouncing along in red boots. Puddles are getting hit everywhere, rings overlapping. Something small and red tucked right by the bench leg. I don't know why I'm here either.
thought_zh: 好，那邊結束了。現在我——很低，靠在一張濕漉漉的長凳邊？下著雨。木條上都是水珠。凳子過去那邊有三個人走過——一個穿駝色褲子的女生、一個穿深色褲子跟白球鞋、鞋緣都濕掉的男生、一個穿紅色雨鞋蹦蹦跳跳的小孩。水窪到處被雨點打，漣漪一圈一圈疊著。凳子腳旁邊還有一個小小紅色的東西塞在那裡。我也不知道我怎麼會跑來這。
thought_ja: はい、あれは終わった。今は——低い位置、濡れたベンチの横？ 雨の中。板の上が水玉びっしり。ちょっと先を三人が通り過ぎる——ベージュのパンツの女の人、黒っぽいパンツと白スニーカーの男性、裾までびしょ濡れ、赤い長靴でぴょんぴょん跳ねてる子供。水たまりがあちこち雨に打たれて、波紋が重なりまくってる。ベンチの脚のすぐそばに、小さくて赤いものが挟まってる。なんでここにいるかも分かってない。

prompt: Same low camera position next to a wet wooden park bench in steady rain on a granite-paver plaza. Same composition. The child in bright red rubber boots in the mid-distance is walking away from the camera. During the clip, the child stops mid-step, turns slightly, and then deliberately stomps down into a shallow puddle with one red boot — water splashes up in a clean fan of droplets visible against the dark wet stone, rings spreading out from the impact. The child then takes another step and stomps again into a second puddle, smaller splash this time. The two adult legs ahead of the child continue walking, neither turning back. Rain continues falling steadily, rings constantly appearing everywhere on the wet stone. The bench in the foreground stays motionless, beaded with water. No camera movement. Overcast cool grey daylight, desaturated palette, 35mm film look. Sound: steady rain on stone and on the bench above, the wet double-stomp and splash of the red boots close enough to hear clearly, a muffled Japanese train station PA announcement in the far distance, the soft creak of a plastic umbrella somewhere off-frame, one distant car tire through water.
thought: Well — the kid's gone. Just one grown-up in dark pants walking past the bench now. Rain's still hitting everything. Something small and red on the ground by the manhole cover. I liked that kid. Didn't even get to watch them go.
thought_zh: 好吧——那個小孩走了。現在只剩一個穿深色褲子的大人走過長凳邊。雨還在繼續下。人孔蓋旁邊地上有個小小紅色的東西。我蠻喜歡那個小孩的。連他走掉我都沒看到。
thought_ja: まあ——あの子いなくなった。今は暗色のパンツの大人が一人、ベンチの横を通り過ぎてくだけ。雨はまだ降ってる。マンホールの蓋の横に、小さくて赤いもの。あの子、気に入ってたのに。去っていくのも見れなかった。

prompt: Interior of a brightly fluorescent-lit Taipei FamilyMart at around 3am, shot from inside, near the magazine rack looking toward the checkout counter. Two young male clerks in mint-green FamilyMart uniforms behind the counter talking quietly to each other — one leaning against the cigarette wall, one restocking small bread rolls into a plastic basket. The shelves in front: clear plastic-wrapped onigiri arranged in rows, pink rice-ball tags, green tea PET bottles in a row behind them, a stack of Uni-President coffee cans visible on the cold-drink end cap. On the counter: a small TV mounted high in the corner showing a 24-hour news channel with scrolling Chinese characters, a steaming hot-food case with tea eggs floating in brown broth. Through the large front windows on the right: a rain-soaked empty street at 3am, a single scooter parked crooked at the curb under an orange sodium streetlamp, no pedestrians, reflections of the store's own interior in the wet pavement. Near the ATM by the door: one exhausted-looking man in a wet button-down shirt is staring at the machine, half-finished can of Mr. Brown coffee in his other hand. Harsh flat fluorescent overhead light, everything slightly green-tinted, no shadows. Cheap retail realism, saturated store-brand colors, a little flare on the wet windows. Sound: the constant hum of fluorescent tubes, the compressor of the cold-drink fridge cycling, the two clerks' low Mandarin murmur, the store's soft background jingle loop barely audible between news clips, the rain on the glass outside, a single car passing far off. Style: photoreal, slightly overexposed window glare, like a Wolfgang Tillmans shop interior or a Taiwanese indie film still.
thought: Whole new place. FamilyMart. It's got to be 3am. Two clerks in mint-green talking quiet at the counter, one of them restocking those little bread rolls. Tea eggs in the hot case. News on the little TV up in the corner. Some guy by the ATM staring at it with a half-drunk Mr. Brown coffee. Rain out the window too, actually. One crooked scooter at the curb. The fluorescent hum is really loud in here.
thought_zh: 全新的地方。全家。一定是凌晨三點之類的。兩個穿薄荷綠制服的店員在櫃檯小聲聊天，其中一個在補小餐包。茶葉蛋在熱食櫃裡。角落上面那台小電視在播新聞。有個大哥站在 ATM 前面看，手上還拿著一罐喝到一半的 Mr. Brown。窗外其實也在下雨。路邊歪歪停著一台機車。這裡的日光燈嗡嗡聲有夠大。
thought_ja: まったく新しい場所。ファミマ。絶対に深夜三時。ミントグリーンの制服の店員が二人、レジで小声で話してる、片方はちっちゃい菓子パンを補充してる。おでんケースにお茶ゆで卵。角の上の小さいテレビでニュース。ATMの前で、誰かが Mr. Brown のコーヒー飲みかけで立ってる。外、実は雨も降ってる。縁石にスクーターが一台、斜めに停まってる。ここ、蛍光灯の音めっちゃでかい。

prompt: Same FamilyMart interior, same camera position near the magazine rack, same harsh flat fluorescent overhead light. Same two clerks in mint-green uniforms behind the counter — one still leaning near the cigarette wall looking at his phone, the other continuing to slowly restock bread rolls into a basket at the counter. Same hot-food case with tea eggs in brown broth. On the right, the exhausted man at the ATM finishes his transaction — the ATM beeps softly, spits out a receipt which he takes without looking, folds the bills into his wet trouser pocket, turns and walks slowly past the camera toward the front doors. The glass sliding doors open automatically with a faint pneumatic hiss and the store's door-chime plays its familiar descending arpeggio. He steps out into the wet street; the doors hiss closed behind him. Through the front windows we briefly see him walk past the scooter at the curb and off-frame to the right. The clerks do not react. Rain continues on the street outside. No camera movement. Sound: the constant hum of fluorescent tubes, the cold-drink fridge compressor, the ATM's soft beep and paper receipt print, a faint rustle of cash being folded, the man's wet footsteps on the tile, the pneumatic door hiss, the FamilyMart door-chime arpeggio clearly, low TV news audio, one car passing on the wet street outside.
thought: ATM beeped, guy took his receipt without even looking, folded some cash into his wet trouser pocket, walked past me. Doors hissed open — chime played that little FamilyMart arpeggio — he went out into the rain. Neither clerk looked up. Doors hissed shut again and it's just me and the fluorescent hum.
thought_zh: ATM 嗶了一聲，那個大哥連看都沒看就把收據抽走，把幾張鈔票摺一摺塞進他濕掉的褲子口袋，從我旁邊走過去。門嘶一下打開——播了全家那個小小的開門音樂——他走出去淋雨了。兩個店員都沒抬頭看。門又嘶一下關上，剩我跟日光燈的嗡聲。
thought_ja: ATMがピッて鳴って、あの兄ちゃんレシート見もしないで取って、何枚かの札を折って濡れたズボンのポケットに突っ込んで、おれの横を通って行った。自動ドアがシューッて開いて——あのファミマの入店音のアルペジオが流れて——雨の中に出ていった。店員二人とも顔上げず。ドアがまたシューって閉まって、おれと蛍光灯の音だけ。

prompt: Same FamilyMart interior, same camera position near the magazine rack, same harsh flat fluorescent overhead light. Same two clerks in mint-green uniforms behind the counter — one still leaning near the cigarette wall looking at his phone, the other continuing to slowly restock bread rolls into a basket at the counter. Same hot-food case with tea eggs in brown broth. On the right, the exhausted man at the ATM finishes his transaction — the ATM beeps softly, spits out a receipt which he takes without looking, folds the bills into his wet trouser pocket, turns and walks slowly past the camera toward the front doors. The glass sliding doors open automatically with a faint pneumatic hiss and the store's door-chime plays its familiar descending arpeggio. He steps out into the wet street; the doors hiss closed behind him. Through the front windows we briefly see him walk past the scooter at the curb and off-frame to the right. The clerks do not react. Rain continues on the street outside. No camera movement. thought: ATM beeped, guy took his receipt without even looking, folded some cash into his wet trouser pocket, walked past me. Doors hissed open — chime played that little FamilyMart arpeggio — he went out into the rain. Neither clerk looked up. Doors hissed shut again and it's just me and the fluorescent hum.
thought_zh: ATM 嗶了一聲，那個大哥連看都沒看就把收據抽走，把幾張鈔票摺一摺塞進他濕掉的褲子口袋，從我旁邊走過去。門嘶一下打開——播了全家那個小小的開門音樂——他走出去淋雨了。兩個店員都沒抬頭看。門又嘶一下關上，剩我跟日光燈的嗡聲。

prompt: A narrow rainy Taipei side-street at 3am seen from the opposite sidewalk, straight-on composition, slight eye-level from across the wet pavement. Across the street is the glowing rectangle of a small FamilyMart convenience store — its front windows and glass sliding doors glowing cold-white and mint-green from the fluorescent interior, clearly visible through the glass. Inside, the two young male clerks in mint-green uniforms are still behind the counter, one now looking up at the small mounted TV, the other still stocking bread rolls. The hot-food case with tea eggs steams faintly. Above the entrance the red-and-white-and-blue FamilyMart sign logo glows. A black scooter parked crookedly at the curb directly in front under an orange sodium streetlamp, rain beading on its seat. In the far right middle-distance, a lone man in a wet navy button-down shirt walking away from the camera down the block, his back to us, still holding a short brown Mr. Brown coffee can in one hand, shoulders hunched against the rain, no umbrella. The rest of the street is empty. The wet asphalt mirrors both the fluorescent green-white glow of the store and the orange glow of the streetlamps in long vertical streaks. Steady falling rain. In the lower foreground: the dark silhouette of a small overgrown potted plant in a cracked sidewalk-square, a scatter of fallen wet magnolia petals, a discarded bus-ticket stub curling on the wet ground. Sound (implied): heavy rain on puddles and on tin awnings, a single distant scooter passing a block away, the faint muffled hum of the store's interior ambience barely audible through the closed glass. Style: photoreal, slightly cinematic, Wong-Kar-Wai-ish wet-night saturation.
thought: Stepping outside. Across the street now, looking back at the FamilyMart from the opposite sidewalk. Whole place is just a glowing mint rectangle in the rain. Clerks still in there, one looking up at the TV now. Tea eggs steaming. The guy who left is way down the block, still walking, shoulders hunched, no umbrella. No idea where he's going.
thought_zh: 走到外面了。現在站在對街，從對面的人行道回頭看這間全家。整間店在雨裡就是一個發著薄荷綠光的方塊。店員還在裡面，其中一個現在在看電視。茶葉蛋還冒著煙。剛才走掉那個大哥已經走到一條街以外了，還在走，肩膀縮著，沒撐傘。完全不知道他要去哪。
thought_ja: 外に出た。今は向かいの歩道からファミマを見返してる。店ぜんたいが、雨の中で光るミントグリーンの長方形になってる。店員二人はまだ中にいて、片方はテレビを見上げてる。おでんから湯気。さっき出て行った兄ちゃんはもうブロックの向こう、歩き続けてる、肩丸めて、傘なし。どこ行くのかぜんぜん分からない。

prompt: Interior of a small second-floor Taipei apartment — an open-plan kitchen-living-room at 3am — shot from a mid-low shoulder-height angle. In the middle of the worn cream linoleum floor sits an older Taiwanese man in his sixties on a low red plastic stool, wearing a thin white sleeveless undershirt and grey boxers, white-haired, cross-legged, barefoot. He is facing a small CRT television on a low wooden stand a few feet in front of him; the screen is playing a live CPBL baseball broadcast (pitcher on the mound mid-windup, scoreboard graphics at the top, CPBL logo in the corner), its blue-white glow lighting his face. A cold green bottle of Taiwan Beer stands on the linoleum next to his stool, a small pool of condensation around its base. A sleepy orange-and-white domestic cat is curled on the linoleum right at his bare feet, eyes half-closed. Behind him, a small kitchenette: a red electric rice cooker on the counter with a faint wisp of steam from its lid, a well-used wok hanging on a pegboard, a tin of dry goods, one cracked mug. On the wall above the kitchenette, a framed family photograph showing a younger version of the man with a woman and two children on a beach. To his left is a sliding aluminum-frame door to a small balcony hung with laundry on wire hangers — a faded grey t-shirt, a white bra, a boy's navy school-uniform polo with a name tag — and through the window slats the FamilyMart's green-and-white sign is visible across the wet street below as a blurred glow. An analog wall clock reads 3:12. Sound (implied): muffled Mandarin baseball commentators, the low hum of a plastic oscillating floor fan in the corner, the dulled drum of rain on the window glass, the cat's slow breathing. Style: photoreal, warm-toned indoor light, an Edward Yang / Tsai Ming-liang slow-cinema composition.
thought: Upstairs now. Right above the FamilyMart. Older guy sitting on a little red plastic stool in the middle of his floor, undershirt and boxers, watching baseball on a small CRT. Cold bottle of Taiwan Beer on the linoleum next to him. Orange cat curled up at his bare feet. Rice cooker still on. Clock says 3:12. He's not moving, not reacting. I don't know what inning.
thought_zh: 來到樓上了。正好在那間全家的正上方。一個老先生坐在房間中間一張小紅色塑膠椅上，背心加四角褲，在看一台小台映像管電視播的棒球賽。地上塑膠地板擺著一瓶冰冷的台啤。一隻橘貓窩在他的光腳邊。電鍋還亮著。牆上時鐘 3:12。他不動，也沒反應。我也不知道現在幾局。
thought_ja: 上の階に来た。あのファミマのちょうど真上。おじさんが部屋の真ん中の小さな赤いプラスチックの腰掛けに座ってて、ランニングと下着パンツで、小さいブラウン管テレビで野球観てる。横の床に、冷えた台湾ビールの瓶。素足のところにオレンジの猫が丸まってる。炊飯器まだ点いてる。壁の時計は 3:12。動かないし、反応もしない。今何回なのかも分からん。

prompt: Interior of a small neighborhood Taiwanese bakery at 5am, pre-dawn, seen from a doorway angle that shows both the dark closed retail area in the foreground and the bright active back kitchen behind it. In the back kitchen: a large stainless-steel deck oven with its main door wide open, warm yellow oven-light spilling out; a middle-aged male baker in a heavily flour-dusted white apron, white cotton cap, dark trousers, standing slightly turned, in the middle of pulling out a long wooden peel loaded with six round golden-brown crusty boule loaves, thick clouds of steam billowing up from their crusts. Overhead cold fluorescent lights combined with the warm oven light. A long stainless-steel work table scattered with flour, a single wooden dough bowl with pale risen dough proofing in it under a damp tea-towel, a bench scraper, a dusting of sesame seeds. A half-open flour sack slumped on the tile floor. A small battered silver boombox on a shelf. A framed old Chinese-calligraphy sign on the white tiled wall reading 平安 in black ink. In the foreground dark retail area: empty slanted wooden bread racks waiting to be stocked, a closed glass front counter, and the front windows looking out onto a still-dark wet Taipei street, rain barely falling now. A sleeping black-and-white shop cat curled on a stool in the foreground near the counter. Sound (implied): the muffled roar of the oven's exhaust fan, the dry creak of the wooden peel being drawn out, the faint crackling of the hot loaf crusts cooling (音: pop-pop-pop), low AM Taiwanese radio murmuring, the last of the rain tapering on the glass out front. Style: photoreal, warm and cool temperature contrast between the oven and the fluorescents, slow-cinema framing.
thought: Warm light somewhere new. Little bakery, 5am, front still dark and closed but the back kitchen's going. Baker in a flour-covered apron pulling a huge wooden peel out of the oven — six boules on it, steam rolling off. Work table covered in flour, a bowl of dough proofing. AM radio quiet. 平安 on the wall. Shop cat asleep on a stool out front. Rain's letting up. Smells like yeast and hot crust.
thought_zh: 到一個暖光的新地方。一間小麵包店，清晨五點，前面店面還是暗的沒開，但後面廚房已經在忙了。師傅穿著沾滿麵粉的圍裙，用一支超大的木鏟把烤箱裡的麵包撈出來——上面六顆圓滾滾的歐包，蒸氣滾滾地冒。工作台上一層麵粉，一個盆在裡面發麵。收音機小小聲地放 AM 電台。牆上掛著「平安」。外面店裡一隻貓在小椅子上睡著。雨快停了。聞起來是酵母跟熱熱的麵包皮。
thought_ja: あったかい光の新しい場所。小さなパン屋、朝五時、店のおもて側はまだ暗くて閉まってるけど、奥の厨房は動いてる。小麦粉だらけのエプロンの職人さんが、でかい木のピールでオーブンからパンを引き出してる——上に丸パン六つ、湯気ぐわんぐわん。作業台は粉まみれ、ボウルで生地が発酵中。AMラジオがちっちゃく鳴ってる。壁に「平安」。店先の椅子で店の猫が寝てる。雨が止みかけてる。酵母と焼きたての皮の匂い。

prompt: Wide elevated rooftop view over a Taipei residential neighborhood at dawn, the rain has just stopped and everything is wet and steaming faintly. The sky has cleared to a pale pink-peach where it meets the horizon, still deep indigo-blue toward the top, a scatter of last stars fading. Sparse spread of 5-to-8-story apartment blocks, a mix of old white-ceramic-tiled exteriors and newer rendered facades, their wet slate roofs reflecting. On top of several of them: cylindrical stainless water tanks, battered TV antennas, laundry lines. Scattered across the distant cityscape: individual lit windows glowing warm yellow among the still-dark ones, like scattered embers — one clearly visible directly below and a bit left (the warm-orange rectangle of the bakery kitchen with its exhaust-steam rising), one higher up with the silhouette of a person standing at a kitchen counter, a blinking mint-green-and-red FamilyMart sign visible further in the mid-distance, red string-lights under the curved eaves of a small temple further off. A single lone scooter with its headlight on is passing along a wet street far below. In the near foreground: a small urban rooftop with terracotta potted plants (one jade plant, one chili pepper plant with small red peppers), a low concrete-block wall, a green wire drying rack with a few wet clothes, a tall bamboo pole leaning, a plastic chair tipped on its side. A line of distant low mountains just touched with the first warm dawn light behind the city. Sound (implied): a few birds just starting their morning calls, very distant traffic on a larger road, the slow drip of water from the edge of the roof, the low morning call of a pigeon, a rooster somewhere impossibly far away. Style: photoreal, early dawn pastel palette with saturated warm-vs-cool contrasts in the lit windows, expansive horizontal composition.
thought: Up on a rooftop. Rain stopped. Sky's going pink on the horizon, still deep blue up top, a couple last stars. City's spread out — wet tiled roofs, water tanks, antennas. Scattered warm windows lit here and there like little embers. Bakery's somewhere right below me, I can see the orange glow. FamilyMart sign blinking further out. Mountains showing up behind everything. Birds starting. Okay — I'm done.
thought_zh: 跑到一個屋頂。雨停了。地平線那邊開始泛粉紅，上面還是深藍，還剩幾顆星。城市全攤開——濕濕的磁磚屋頂、水塔、天線。零零散散亮著的窗戶像一點一點小火星。麵包店就在我下面某個位置，那橘色的光看得到。全家的招牌再遠一點在閃。山在這一切後面浮出來。鳥開始叫了。好——我這一趟夠了。
thought_ja: 屋上に上がった。雨、止んだ。地平線がピンクになってきて、上のほうはまだ深い青、最後の星が数個残ってる。街が広がってる——濡れた瓦屋根、貯水タンク、アンテナ。点在してる暖色の窓が、小さな残り火みたいに散らばって光ってる。パン屋はこのどっか真下、あのオレンジの光が見える。もう少し遠くでファミマの看板が点滅してる。ぜんぶの後ろに山が浮かんでる。鳥が鳴き始めた。うん——今回はここまで。

prompt: A wide sliding window facing a city at twilight, seen from inside a dim apartment. Through the glass: a skyline of residential high-rises, lit windows scattered in random constellations, the bluish-gray of the hour just after sunset. On the windowsill in the foreground, a small potted succulent and a half-empty glass of water with condensation. In the glass, a faint interior reflection: a standing lamp on the left, the edge of an empty couch on the right, no figure present. The room behind is darker than the sky outside. Style: 35mm film, warm shadows, fine grain, slight halation on the bright windows. Sound: distant traffic hum, one air conditioner cycling somewhere, a faraway siren passing once, no voices nearby.
thought: Okay — window, a big sliding one. Out there is a whole lot of apartment blocks, some of the windows lit warm, most still dark. Sky's still got a pink band down at the horizon but it's gone to dark blue up top already. It's darker inside than outside, which is kind of the wrong way round. I can see a lamp reflected in the glass, not switched on. Little plant on the sill, small glass of water next to it. Huh. No clue whose place this is. The AC's on — I can hear it cycling. Gonna stay at the window a minute.
thought_zh: 好——一扇窗，一扇大大的推拉窗。外頭是一整片公寓大樓，有些窗戶亮著暖色的光，大部分還是暗的。地平線那邊天空還留著一道粉紅色的帶子，不過上頭已經是深藍色了。屋裡比外面還暗，方向好像反過來了。我看到一盞燈倒映在玻璃上，燈沒開。窗台上一盆小植物，旁邊一杯水。嗯。完全不知道這是誰家。冷氣開著——我聽得到它在循環。我在窗邊待一下。
thought_ja: よし——窓、大きな引き戸タイプ。外側はアパートがずらっと並んでて、暖色に灯った窓がちらほら、ほとんどはまだ暗い。空は地平線のほうにまだピンクの帯が残ってるけど、上のほうはもう深い青になってる。部屋の中のほうが外より暗い、逆だな。ガラスにランプが映ってる、点いてないランプ。窓枠に小さな鉢植え、横に水の入った小さなグラス。ふうん。ここが誰の部屋なのか、さっぱり分からない。エアコンが入ってる——サイクルしてる音が聞こえる。ちょっとこの窓辺にいよう。

prompt: Static shot of the same twilight window view of the city. Multi-paned sliding window, a skyline of lit residential high-rises beyond, pink band at the horizon fading into deep blue, a potted plant and a half-empty glass on the sill, faint reflection of an unlit standing lamp in the interior-side glass. Light rain begins during the clip: a scatter of droplets hits the glass and begins to run down slowly, the distant city lights refracting faintly through the wet pane. The pink band subtly deepens. No figure. Camera is absolutely static. Style: 35mm film, fine grain, warm shadows, slight halation on the bright windows. Audio: soft gentle patter of rain starting lightly on the glass, a low air conditioner cycling steadily inside the room, a single distant siren passing and fading away, no human voices, no music.
thought: Oh nice — actually raining now. Fat drops all over the glass, way more than I expected. Whole city's gone sort of glittery behind them, every lit window smeared across like twenty drops at once. Can hear the patter too, soft. Looks so much better wet. I kind of wonder what's going on in one of those little warm squares out there. Maybe let me go be near one.
thought_zh: 欸不錯——真的下起雨了。玻璃上全是大顆大顆的雨珠，比我想的還多很多。整座城市隔著這些雨珠變得亮晶晶的，每一盞亮著的窗戶都被抹開成二十顆水珠的形狀。雨聲也聽得到了，很輕。濕了之後好看多了。我有點想知道那邊其中一格暖暖的小方塊裡在發生什麼事。讓我去靠近一格看看。
thought_ja: お、いいな——本当に降ってきた。大きな粒がガラスいっぱいに、思ってたよりずっと多い。街ぜんぶがその向こうでキラキラしてて、灯ってる窓が一個ずつ、水滴二十粒ぶんにぼやけて広がってる。雨音も聞こえる、柔らかく。濡れてる方がずっといい。あのちっちゃい暖かい窓、どれかの中で何が起きてるのか、ちょっと気になるな。一つのそばに行ってみよう。

prompt: View across a narrow urban rain-soaked alley at night, into a small warm kitchen through the opposite apartment's single-pane window. The kitchen window is lit from inside with warm domestic light — a woman in an oversized knit sweater stirring a pot on a stove, steam rising visibly, a small old portable radio on the counter, a wall clock on the side wall showing around 7:40. Rain falls heavily between, visible as bright streaks catching the window's spill-light. Foreground: the wet top of a window-mounted air conditioner unit on this side of the alley, a single pigeon standing on it with feathers slightly puffed against the rain, centred and slightly low. Camera is at pigeon-level, looking diagonally across and slightly up into the opposite kitchen. Style: 35mm film, desaturated cold exterior against the warmly glowing interior, fine grain, halation on the kitchen window. Sound: steady rain hitting metal and concrete and tin gutters, the low hum of the city in the background, a faint radio tune barely carrying across the alley from her open window vent, a pigeon cooing low once.
thought: Okay, here I am — standing on some AC unit across from this kitchen window. There's a woman in there cooking something, big cloud of steam going up off her pot. A pigeon's on the unit right next to me, totally unbothered by the rain, just chilling. There's a wall clock stuck to the outside of her building, which is a weird place for one — ten past seven it looks like? She seems really into whatever she's making. Let me watch for a minute.
thought_zh: 好，我人到了——站在某個冷氣機上面，對面就是這扇廚房窗。裡面有一個女生在煮東西，鍋上冒著一大團蒸氣。旁邊這台冷氣機上還有一隻鴿子，完全不怕雨，就在旁邊休息。她那棟樓外牆上居然掛著一個時鐘，掛在外面也太怪了——看起來是七點十分？她看起來真的很投入地在煮她那個東西。讓我看一下下。
thought_ja: よし、着いた——向かいの台所の窓の対面、誰かのエアコンの室外機の上に立ってる。中では女の人が何か作ってて、鍋からでかい湯気の柱がもくもく上がってる。すぐ横の同じ室外機の上にハトが一羽、雨まったく気にしてなくて、のんびりしてる。彼女のビルの外壁に時計が一つくっついてて、変な場所に掛けてあるな——七時十分くらいかな？彼女、作ってるもの何であれ、ほんとに集中してる感じ。ちょっと見てよう。

prompt: Same static view across the narrow rainy alley into the warmly lit kitchen window. The woman inside continues stirring her pot, steam rising steadily, the exterior wall clock on the neighboring facade visible. Heavy rain falling between. The pigeon on the white AC unit in the foreground shifts its weight once, ruffles its wet feathers, and then abruptly takes flight — lifting up and out of the top of the frame in a quick burst, leaving the AC unit empty in the latter half of the clip. The kitchen scene behind continues unchanged. Camera is absolutely static the entire clip. Style: 35mm film, desaturated cold exterior, warmly glowing interior. Audio: steady rain on metal and concrete, a single low pigeon coo at the start, then the flap of wings taking off, then only rain and the low hum of the city, the faint radio across the alley barely audible.
thought: Pigeon bailed on me. I only half-saw it go — there's just this smudge where it was standing, like it didn't fully commit to the motion. I'm alone out here now. She's still at it in there, totally absorbed. Clock says… something past seven, can't quite make it out. Honestly I don't want to watch her from out here in the cold. Let me go in.
thought_zh: 鴿子落跑了。我只看到一半——原本牠站的位置就剩一道模糊的痕跡，好像牠並沒有完全決定要飛走。我現在一個人在外面。她還在裡面忙，完全沉浸在她那邊。時鐘寫的是⋯⋯七點多，看不清到底幾分。老實說我不想在這種冷颼颼的外面看她了。進去吧。
thought_ja: ハト、逃げた。半分しか見えなかった——立ってた位置にぼやけた影がちょっと残ってて、ちゃんと飛び切らなかったみたいな感じ。もう外に一人だ。彼女はあいかわらず中に没頭してる。時計は⋯⋯七時過ぎ、細かいところまでは読めない。正直、こんな寒い外から彼女見てるの、もう無理。中に入ろう。

prompt: Inside the same small warm kitchen, counter-level close-in point of view right next to a steaming pot on a stove. In the near foreground, partial view of an old portable radio on the counter, a wooden cutting board with a few scallion ends on it, a small glass jar of rice. Mid-frame: a woman's hand and forearm lowering a wooden spoon into the pot, stirring gently — thick ginger-garlic steam rising up off the surface. Background: her face in partial profile, focused intently down on the pot, a small private smile, wearing an oversized knit sweater. Behind her the rain-streaked kitchen window, the exterior wall across the alley dimly visible beyond. Overhead warm domestic lamp casting a yellow pool of light on the stove. Tiles on the wall behind the stove. Style: 35mm film, warm tungsten palette, fine grain, soft shallow focus on the steam, her face slightly out-of-focus. Audio: the pot bubbling gently, the wooden spoon tapping the rim of the pot once, the radio playing a quiet instrumental tune at low volume, rain against the window, a refrigerator humming low in the background.
thought: Okay — I'm in. She didn't even notice, good. It's warm in here, smells amazing, a whole column of steam going up into the lamplight. Fresh scallions on the board, big pot going. She's got this little concentrated look on her face, like the stirring actually matters to her. Broth of something — soup maybe. Don't want to interrupt. Let me just hang out by the counter.
thought_zh: 好——進來了。她都沒發現，太好了。裡面很暖，味道超香，蒸氣整根柱子一樣地往吊燈那邊升上去。砧板上一把新鮮蔥，鍋子正在滾。她臉上有那種小小的專注，好像攪這鍋對她來說真的很重要。某種湯——應該是。不想打擾她。我就靠著流理台這邊待著就好。
thought_ja: よし——入った。彼女ぜんぜん気づいてない、助かる。中は暖かくて、匂いがほんとにいい、湯気が一本の柱みたいにランプのほうへ立ち上がってる。まな板に新鮮なネギ、鍋がぐつぐつ言ってる。彼女の顔には小さな集中の色があって、この混ぜる作業が彼女にとってほんとに大事なことみたい。何かのだし——スープかな。邪魔したくない。カウンターの横で、ちょっといよう。

prompt: Static 8-second clip of the same warm small kitchen. The woman continues stirring the pot gently and steadily with her wooden spoon throughout, the column of steam billowing up thickly into the overhead warm lamplight the entire time. Her expression stays the same — quietly absorbed. Rain continues running down the window behind her. Camera is absolutely static. No cuts, no zoom. Style: 35mm film, warm tungsten, fine grain. Audio: the pot bubbling softly, the wooden spoon occasionally tapping the rim of the pot, the quiet radio instrumental still going on the counter, steady rain on the window, the low fridge hum.
thought: She hasn't looked up once. Whole time — just stirring. It's weirdly peaceful in here, the bubbling and the rain and that thin radio tune. The steam keeps getting caught in the lamp and it's actually kind of mesmerising. Okay — I've been here long enough. I kind of want something louder now. Somewhere with people.
thought_zh: 她一次都沒抬頭。從頭到尾——就一直在攪。這裡面靜得有點奇怪，咕嘟咕嘟的聲音加上雨聲加上收音機那首薄薄的曲子。蒸氣一直被那盞吊燈卡住，其實還蠻催眠的。好——我在這邊夠久了。現在我有點想要吵一點的地方。有人的地方。
thought_ja: 彼女、一度も顔を上げてない。ずっと——ただ混ぜてるだけ。ここ、妙に静かで、ぐつぐつ鳴る音と雨と、あのラジオの薄い曲が重なってる。湯気がランプに引っかかり続けてて、正直けっこう見入っちゃう。よし——ここに長くいすぎた。ちょっと今はもっと騒がしい場所がいい。人がいるところ。

prompt: Low late-night shot inside a small smoky basement jazz bar. Near foreground at the bottom of the frame: a hand loosely holding a heavy-bottom old-fashioned glass on a small round wooden table, amber whiskey and a single large ice cube with faint condensation on the outside of the glass. Mid-frame: a blur of other patrons' shoulders and the backs of heads, barely in focus. Background: a small low stage with a saxophonist mid-solo, body leaning slightly back, eyes closed, a standing bassist in shadow behind him, warm orange key light on the sax player and a cooler blue backlight, cigarette and vape haze hanging in the air catching the beams. Patterned tin ceiling at the top of the frame. Bottles glinting on a back-bar shelf off to one side. Style: 35mm film, pushed grain, high contrast between the warm stage and the muted dim everything else, saturated amber highlights. Audio: the saxophone mid-phrase holding a long blue note, a loose walking bassline behind it, the low murmur of conversations all around, ice clinking in glasses, a waiter's soft laugh from near the bar, a brief brush on a snare drum, no PA music — live only.
thought: Okay — way fancier than I pictured. Not a dive at all, more like a proper cocktail place. Sax guy's really into it though, leaning back with his eyes closed. A waiter's doing something with a lady on the right, bringing her a drink maybe. Someone in white hair is off at the bar I can barely see past. And my hand is huge in the foreground — kinda hairy, whose hand is this even? Haha. Fine. Let me just sit here and listen for a bit.
thought_zh: 好喔——比我想像的高級太多了。完全不是小酒館，比較像是很正的調酒吧。不過薩克斯風那個真的很投入，頭往後仰，眼睛閉著。右邊有個服務生在跟一位小姐做什麼，大概送酒過來吧。吧檯那邊有個白頭髮的人，我看不太到後面去。然後我的手在前面好大——有點多毛欸，這到底是誰的手啊？哈哈。算了。我就坐在這聽一下下。
thought_ja: うわ——想像してたよりかなり高級だ。ぜんぜんダイブじゃない、きちんとしたカクテルバーっぽい。でもサックスの兄ちゃんマジで没入してて、のけぞって目を閉じてる。右のほうでウェイターが一人、女性と何かやり取りしてる、たぶんドリンクを運んできたとこかな。バーのほうに白髪の誰かがいて、私のところからは奥まで見えにくい。で、自分の手が手前にデカく映ってる——ちょっと毛深いし、そもそもこれ誰の手だよ？はは。まあいいや。ここに座ってちょっと聴いてよう。

prompt: Static 8-second clip of the same small jazz bar. The saxophonist continues his solo in the middle background, subtle natural swaying as he plays, cigarette and vape haze drifting slowly in the warm stage lights. The waiter and the woman to the right continue their small unhurried interaction in the mid-ground. The hand in the near foreground slowly lifts the old-fashioned glass up toward the top edge of the frame (partially out of frame) for a single sip, then lowers it gently back down onto the wooden table — the ice cube shifts slightly when the glass settles. Camera is absolutely static. Style: 35mm film, pushed grain, saturated warm stage colors against muted surroundings. Audio: the continuing saxophone line with a bent note at the end, a walking upright bass, light brush on a snare, a soft low clink of the glass on the table, a general crowd murmur, a brief warm chuckle from somewhere off to the left.
thought: He took the horn off his mouth for a second, end of a phrase I guess. Now I can actually see the bassist standing behind him, leaning into that big upright. I just put the glass down — still cold. Still sounds good in here. Okay, I could stay forever but I kind of want to see something totally different now. Not more city.
thought_zh: 他把樂器從嘴邊拿下來一下，應該是一段落。現在才真的看得到他後面的貝斯手，靠在那把大大的低音提琴上。我剛把杯子放下——還是冰的。這裡還是很好聽。好，可以待一輩子，但我現在想看完全不一樣的東西。不要再城市了。
thought_ja: サックスから口を一瞬離した、フレーズの終わりだと思う。で、今やっと後ろに立ってるベース奏者が見える、あのでかいウッドベースに寄りかかって。グラス置いたとこ——まだ冷たい。ここ、音やっぱりいい。うん、永遠に居られそうだけど、今はまったく違うもの見たい気分。都会はもういい。

prompt: Inside a small working mountaintop astronomical observatory at late night. A large reflector telescope dominates the center of the frame, its dark metal barrel tilted up toward a slit in the opened dome above, where a slice of deep blue-black sky and a scatter of cold bright stars are visible. A single astronomer in a warm down jacket and wool beanie is hunched at the eyepiece on a small stepladder, their face lit almost entirely in dim red safety lighting (to preserve night vision), only faint suggestion of features. Heavy power and data cables run neatly along the grey concrete floor. A small wooden desk to the side with a laptop whose screen is in red-only night mode showing a star chart, an insulated thermos mug beside it. The metal dome interior is a cool grey-green with exposed braces. Faint visible breath-cloud coming from the astronomer's mouth — the dome is cold. Style: 35mm film, deep shadows, only red safety lighting and a thin silver slice of starlight / moonlight from the open dome slit, fine grain, no warm tones at all except the red. Audio: the faint steady whir of the telescope's equatorial tracking motor, the soft high mechanical squeak of the dome slit readjusting itself slightly, the low roar of high-altitude wind against the dome outside, an occasional soft double beep from the laptop, the astronomer's audible breathing.
thought: Total one-eighty from that bar. It's freezing in here — I can actually see their breath puffing out. Everything's red. Dome slit's open above, big slice of sky with a scatter of stars coming through. They're hunched right on the eyepiece, not moving at all. Two scopes actually, I wasn't expecting a second one. Even the laptop is red so their eyes don't get wrecked. I'm kind of holding my breath — feels like I should.
thought_zh: 跟剛才那間吧完全一百八十度。這裡超冷——我看得到他們呼出來的白煙。所有東西都是紅的。頂上的圓頂開了一條縫，一大片天空露出來，上面散著一些星星。他們整個人趴在目鏡上，完全不動。其實有兩台望遠鏡，我沒預期會看到第二台。連筆電都是紅色的，不然他們的眼睛會被打壞。我有點憋著氣——覺得應該要這樣。
thought_ja: さっきのバーから完全に百八十度。ここは極寒だ——彼らの吐く息の白さが見える。ぜんぶ赤い。ドームのスリットが上で開いてて、空が大きく切り取られて、星がいくつか散ってる。彼らは接眼レンズに張りついたままで、ぜんぜん動かない。望遠鏡、実は二台あるんだな、もう一台のほうは想定してなかった。ノートパソコンまで赤い、目がきかなくなるから。なんか自分も息を止めてる——そうしなきゃいけない気がして。

prompt: Through-the-eyepiece view of Saturn from an amateur astronomical telescope. A soft circular dark vignette frames the edges of the entire frame, the way an eyepiece image looks. Saturn is centred but not huge — a pale cream and tan disk with subtle cloud banding in pale ochre and very light pink-brown; its ring system is displayed at a clear elegant tilt, with the thin dark Cassini division faintly visible, and the rings' own shadow cast as a thin dark line across the planet's equator. Three or four tiny pinprick moons scattered in the surrounding dark — Titan prominently to the side as an orange-tinged point, two much fainter ones near the rings. The background is not pure black but a deep charcoal void with a very faint star field behind. Slight atmospheric shimmer making Saturn's edge waver imperceptibly. Style: authentic amateur-astrophotography clarity, slight chromatic fringing around the planet's limb, subtle grain throughout, no artistic stylisation. Audio: essentially silent — only the very faint steady whir of the telescope tracking motor far below, the astronomer's barely audible breathing, the distant high wind against the dome outside, as if heard muffled through being pressed to an eyepiece.
thought: Oh — oh, there it is. Saturn. Like, actually Saturn. The rings look ridiculous, honestly — like a kid drew them, except real. I can see the gap in them, the Cassini thing. Couple little moons out in the black off to the sides. Kind of lost for words. Wow. Okay. Okay.
thought_zh: 喔——喔，在這。土星。真的就是土星欸。光環真的很誇張，說實話——像小朋友畫的那樣，只是真的。我看得到環上那個縫，卡西尼分界那個。兩側黑色裡還有幾顆小衛星。有點不知道說什麼。哇。好。好。
thought_ja: あ——あ、いた。土星。ていうか、ほんとに土星。リング、正直もうムリ——子供が描いた絵みたい、でもほんもの。リングの隙間もちゃんと見える、カッシーニのやつ。両側の黒のなかに小さな衛星がいくつか。ちょっと言葉にならない。うわ。うん。うん。

prompt: An empty indoor ice rink during a quiet afternoon between sessions. The freshly-resurfaced ice is glassy-smooth, reflecting overhead fluorescent lighting in long soft white columns. A single Zamboni machine is parked at the near edge of the ice, its operator in a dark navy coverall crouched next to it checking something on its underside. Faded painted boards around the rink with old advertisement panels in washed-out blue and yellow. Bleachers run along one side — two or three people scattered in them (a woman with a little kid in a bright puffy pink coat, a solitary older man hunched over a paperback book). High metal rafters with condensation-fogged upper windows and caged work lights. Overhead fluorescents flat and a little cold. Wide composition, roughly eye-level of someone standing at the boards. Style: 35mm film, cool palette with just a small warm pop from the pink coat, fine grain, honest documentary feel, slight lens flares from the fluorescents. Audio: the deep hum of the ice chillers beneath the floor, the irregular drip of water somewhere off-camera, the distant metal clang of someone adjusting a skate on a bench, the Zamboni engine idling low, a muffled PA announcement barely intelligible from a speaker, no music, a single kid's shoes squeaking on rubber matting.
thought: Oh — an ice rink. Empty. Fresh ice, you can see the lines of the ceiling lights go all the way down to the far end. Zamboni's parked on the ice, and there's a little kid in a pink coat standing right up next to the guy working on it — his daughter maybe? Echoey in here, I can feel that without hearing anything yet. Cold in a totally different way from the observatory. And that weird ammonia-ice smell.
thought_zh: 喔——溜冰場。空的。剛整過的冰，可以看到天花板的燈光一條一條拉到最遠那端。整冰車停在冰上，有一個穿粉紅色外套的小朋友就站在正在弄車的那個人旁邊——他女兒嗎？這裡會回音，我還沒聽到什麼都感覺得出來。跟剛才那個觀測站冷的方式完全不同。還有那種很怪的阿摩尼亞加冰的味道。
thought_ja: あ——アイスリンク。誰もいない。整氷したばっかで、天井の照明のラインがずーっと奥の端まで伸びてるのが見える。ザンボニーが氷の上に停まってて、ピンクのコートの小さな子供がそれを整備してる人のすぐ横に立ってる——娘かな？反響する空間だ、まだ何も聞こえてないのに感じる。さっきの天文台とは全然違う種類の寒さ。あと、あの変なアンモニアっぽい氷の匂い。

prompt: Static 8-second shot of the same empty ice rink between sessions. The small kid in the pink coat takes one careful shuffling step forward on the smooth ice, wobbles slightly, reaches out a small gloved hand to steady herself against the back edge of the Zamboni, and laughs once — a high quick giggle. The Zamboni operator glances up briefly, smiles without standing, then returns to his work on the machine's underside. In the distant bleachers one of the small figures shifts position minimally. Overhead fluorescents steady. Camera absolutely static the whole clip. Style: 35mm film, cool palette, fine grain. Audio: the deep steady ice-chiller hum under the floor, the kid's small high giggle clearly in the echo of the rink, the Zamboni engine idling low, a distant metal clang from off-screen, a muffled PA announcement almost unintelligible in the rafters, otherwise quiet.
thought: Kid made it further out than I expected. She's fine, she's got the whole ice to herself. The dad's standing up now, watching her. Couple more people showed up in the stands while I wasn't looking. You can feel how this place runs — quiet between sessions, people trickling in for the next one. Okay, good beat. I want somewhere warm next. Like — really warm.
thought_zh: 小朋友比我想的還更往中間走了出去。她沒事，整片冰都是她的。爸爸現在站著看她。我沒注意的時候看台上又多了兩個人。可以感覺這地方怎麼運作的——場次中間很安靜，下一場的人一個一個慢慢來。好，這一段不錯。我下一站想要暖的地方。那種——超暖的。
thought_ja: 子供、思ってたより外まで出てった。大丈夫、氷、彼女の独り占め。お父さん、いま立ち上がって見てる。見てない間に観客席に二、三人増えてた。この場所の仕組みが感じられる——セッションの合間は静か、次のセッションに向けて少しずつ人が集まってくる。うん、いい間だった。次は暖かい場所がいい。ていうか——めっちゃ暖かいとこ。

prompt: Inside a small glassblowing studio in the evening. Dominant warm orange glow from the open mouth of a furnace at the left edge of the frame, throwing hot rim-light across everything. Centre frame: a glassblower in heavy dark apron and thick forearm sleeves, safety goggles pushed up on his forehead, sweat on his brow, rotating a long steel blowpipe with a still-forming gather of molten glass on its end — the glass is a deep honey-orange, glowing from within, the shape soft and bulb-like. He is walking the pipe slowly toward a wooden work bench to the right. A few small orange sparks drifting from the gather. Behind him: shelves of already-cooled finished pieces (a cobalt-blue vase, a forest-green bowl, small clear and amber bottles), each catching and holding the furnace glow on their curves. An apprentice in the mid-background in a white tee and apron, holding a wooden paddle ready. Blackened concrete floor near the furnace, scattered tools. Style: 35mm film, high contrast, deep dark shadows with saturated orange highlights, fine grain, slight glow bloom around the molten glass. Audio: the low steady roar of the gas furnace, the hiss of hot metal rotating, a distant small boombox playing low rock music, the apprentice's breathing, one pop-crackle from the furnace.
thought: Whoa — okay, warm. Whole side of my face feels hot just from looking at this. She's got this huge blob of liquid glass on the end of the pipe, literally glowing orange, and she's just walking it around like it's nothing. Furnace behind her pouring light and some smoke. Apprentice in the back in a white tee doing his own thing. There's even a little stereo on the shelf. Good — this is exactly what I wanted.
thought_zh: 哇——好，暖了。光是看我半邊臉都熱起來了。她吹管末端有一大球液態的玻璃，真的在發橘光，她就這樣走來走去像沒事一樣。她後面的窯一直噴光噴煙。後面穿白 T 的學徒在做他自己的事。架子上還放著一個小小的音響。好——這就是我要的。
thought_ja: うわ——うん、暖かい。見てるだけで顔の片側が熱くなってくる。彼女、パイプの先にでかい液体のガラスの塊をつけてて、マジでオレンジに光ってて、それをなんでもないみたいに歩いて運んでる。後ろの炉からは光と煙がもれ出てる。奥の白Tの見習いは自分の作業に没頭してる。棚には小さなステレオまである。うん——これが欲しかったやつ。

prompt: Static 8-second clip of the same glassblowing studio scene. The glassblower continues slowly and steadily rotating the steel blowpipe between her hands, the glowing honey-orange molten gather at its end turning under gravity, its shape subtly shifting and dripping very slightly, faint sparks drifting off in slow arcs. The furnace flame at the left edge of the frame flickers and surges once, then settles. The apprentice in the background continues his own separate quiet task with his paddle. The finished glass pieces on the shelf catch the moving firelight. Camera absolutely static. Style: 35mm film, high contrast, saturated orange highlights in deep shadow, fine grain, slight bloom on the molten glass. Audio: steady low roar of the gas furnace, the soft hiss of hot metal rotating, a low distant rock song from a small boombox, her steady breathing, a single gentle pop-crackle from the furnace around halfway through.
thought: Apprentice has stepped right up behind her — guess he's watching close now, or waiting to help. The blob on the end of the pipe has gotten bigger and rounder, just sitting out there like a tiny orange sun. She's still rotating it steadily. Furnace keeps surging and dropping, making the whole room pulse a bit. I could watch this all night honestly. But — I'm craving water now. Cool water, after all this heat.
thought_zh: 學徒走到她正後方了——大概是要近看，或是準備幫忙。吹管末端那球已經變大也變圓了，就懸在那邊像一顆小小的橘色太陽。她還在穩穩地轉。窯一下猛一下弱，整間房間都跟著脈動一下。老實說這個我可以看一整晚。但——我現在很想要水。冷水，經過這麼多熱之後。
thought_ja: 見習いが彼女の真後ろに寄ってきた——近くで見てるか、手伝うつもりでスタンバイしてるか。パイプの先の塊はさっきより大きく丸くなってて、宙に浮いた小さなオレンジの太陽みたい。彼女はまだ安定して回し続けてる。炉が強く弱く鳴って、部屋ぜんたいがちょっと脈打ってる感じ。正直これ一晩見てられる。でも——今は水がほしい。冷たい水、この熱のあとに。

prompt: Underwater view from near the bottom of a clear shallow freshwater forest pool, looking up and slightly forward at the surface about two meters above. Sunlight pierces down through the water in bright God-rays, bending and flickering in lines across the sandy pebbled bottom and the rock in the foreground. A scatter of small yellow-brown fallen leaves floating on the gently rippling surface, their silhouettes dark against the overexposed bright forest sky beyond. A single small freshwater fish (a perch or small bluegill) passing slowly from right to left at mid-depth, just slightly out of focus. Foreground: a large smooth grey rock with patches of short green algae on top, a few tiny silver air bubbles clinging to its underside, a scatter of rounded pebbles in beige and rust around it. The water has a slight green-amber natural forest-pool tint. Light motes drifting. Style: natural underwater-documentary look, refracted caustics, crisp fine detail, subtle blue-green-amber colour cast, fine grain. Audio: the muffled underwater ambient — low bubble gurgle, very faint muted bird song as if heard from above the surface, the distant soft whoosh of water flowing somewhere downstream, a tiny tick of a pebble shifting, no music, no voices.
thought: Oh that's better. Water, really clear — you can see every pebble down here. Little rock in the middle with algae on top. Small fish off to the right, going about its business. Surface is all crinkled up with yellow leaves floating on it, sunlight going crazy through the ripples. I'm right at the waterline, half above half below. Nice. Can cool off here for a minute.
thought_zh: 啊這樣好多了。水，超清——每一顆小石頭都看得到。中間有塊小石頭，上面有一層藻類。右邊有一條小魚自己在那邊忙。水面皺皺的，上面漂著黃色的葉子，陽光穿過那些漣漪整個亂成一片。我現在就在水線上，一半在上面、一半在下面。舒服。我在這邊涼一下。
thought_ja: ああ、こっちのほうがいい。水、すごく透明——下の小石ぜんぶ見える。真ん中に小さな岩、上に藻が生えてる。右のほうに小さな魚、自分のことやってる。水面はぐしゃぐしゃで、黄色い葉っぱが浮いてて、そのさざ波を通って日光がめちゃくちゃに走ってる。ちょうど水面の高さ、半分上で半分下。気持ちいい。ここでちょっと涼もう。

prompt: Static 8-second split-level half-above-half-below shot of the same clear shallow forest pool. The small fish in the mid-ground continues to drift slowly to the left, pauses, then turns very slightly with a small fin-flick and holds in place. The yellow leaves floating on the surface drift gently with the current. Caustic light patterns dance across the pebbles and the foreground rock throughout the clip. Near the end, a single yellow leaf falls gently from off-frame above and lands softly on the water, producing one small spreading ripple. Camera absolutely static. Style: natural underwater documentary, refracted caustics, crisp detail, subtle blue-green-amber tint, fine grain.
