Slightly warm pixel-art fluorescent lighting from the ceiling strip. Late winter midday daylight outside. 16-bit pixel art only, limited palette, no photorealism. Ambient sound: rhythmic train rumble, the click of rails, the faint synth chime of a station-arrival announcement, the schoolboy's earbuds leaking thin J-pop, the chunk of pneumatic doors closing.
thought: Cut again — and now I'm on a Yamanote train at midday but the whole thing is in 16-bit pixel art. Like an old console game. Salaryman asleep, woman with a paperback, kid on his phone, all chunky pixels. Sign overhead's pixel-kanji 渋谷. Train in pixel art is weirdly satisfying. Let me ride a few stops.
thought_zh: 又切——這次我在中午的山手線上，整個變成 16-bit 像素畫風。像老主機遊戲那樣。上班族在睡覺，一個女生在看小說，小朋友在滑手機，全部都是格子格子的像素。門上的字幕也是像素字寫著「渋谷」。火車變成像素藝術莫名地很爽。坐個幾站再說。
thought_ja: またカット——今度は昼間の山手線だけど、ぜんぶ 16-bit のドット絵になってる。昔のゲーム機みたいな。サラリーマンが寝てて、女の人が文庫読んでて、男の子はスマホ、ぜんぶ角ばったピクセル。ドアの上の電光表示も「渋谷」のドット文字。電車がピクセルアートなの、なぜかすごい気持ちいい。何駅か乗ってみよう。

prompt: 16-bit pixel-art view of the Shibuya scramble crossing at midday in late winter, looking down from a second-floor cafe window. Crisp pixel art, limited retro palette, sharp pixel edges, no anti-aliasing. The famous scramble caught at the exact moment the lights have changed: hundreds of tiny pixel-character pedestrians crossing in all five diagonals at once — salarymen in grey suits, schoolgirls in plaid skirts and navy blazers, foreign tourists in bright jackets, an older woman with a small wheeled shopping cart, a guy walking a tiny dog on a leash. Surrounding tall buildings covered in pixel billboards: a giant pixel-art J-pop idol singing on a video screen, a pixel Toyota car ad, a pixel Calbee snack ad, vertical neon signs in kanji and katakana. Pale winter midday sun above the buildings. 16-bit pixel art only, limited palette, no photorealism, retro game aesthetic. Ambient sound: pixel-game ambient city layer — clean bleeping crosswalk chime, distant pixel traffic synth, faint pixel-J-pop song bleeding from one billboard, layered pixel crowd murmur.
thought: Got off at 渋谷. Stairs up, window above the crossing — so I'm watching the whole scramble go off in pixel art. Hundreds of little chunky people heading every direction at once the moment the lights flip. Giant pixel J-pop idol on a billboard, pixel Calbee ad, pixel everything. Crosswalk chime is just a clean little bleep-bleep. Could watch a few cycles.
thought_zh: 渋谷下車。爬樓梯上去，剛好一個窗口在交叉路口上方——我就看著整場大十字路口在像素畫風裡上演。幾百個格子格子小小的人，紅綠燈一變就同時往五個方向走。看板上巨大的像素 J-pop 偶像，像素 Calbee 廣告，連神都是像素的。行人號誌的提示音也只是一個乾淨的「嗶嗶」。可以看好幾輪。
thought_ja: 渋谷で降りた。階段上って、ちょうどスクランブルの真上の窓——でピクセルアートで繰り広げられるあの交差点をずっと見てる。何百人もの角ばったちっちゃい人たちが、信号変わった瞬間に五方向に一斉に渡ってく。巨大なピクセル J-pop アイドルがビルボードで歌ってて、ピクセル Calbee の広告、ぜんぶピクセル。歩行者信号のチャイムも、きれいな短い「ぴ・ぴ」だけ。何サイクルか見てられそう。

prompt: Small Japanese fishing port at dawn in late winter, viewed from along a wooden pier. Pale pink-and-grey cold sky, a few weathered wooden fishing boats moored alongside, snow on their decks and on the metal rail of the pier. Three or four older fishermen in heavy orange and yellow waterproofs and rubber boots unloading red plastic crates of fish onto the pier — silver fish piled with crushed ice in the crates. A weathered concrete fish-market building behind, fluorescent lights glowing inside through frosted windows. Steam rising off the boat decks where they're hosing fish-blood off the planks. A dozen seagulls wheeling overhead and a few standing on the rail. Far distance: small dark islands rising out of mist on the cold sea. Cold steel-blue dawn light, faint pink at the horizon. 35mm photoreal, slightly grainy film texture, blue and pale-pink palette. Ambient sound: gulls crying, the slap of wet rubber boots on planks, water lapping, the rumble of a hose, fishermen calling to each other in Japanese, creak of mooring ropes.
thought: Hard cut. Out of pixel-Tokyo and into a fishing port — Hokkaido somewhere, maybe. Dawn, sky's that cold pink. Older guys in waterproofs hauling red crates of silver fish onto the pier. Gulls everywhere, screaming. Steam coming off the boat decks where they're hosing them down. Smells like cold fish and diesel. Different country almost from where I was a second ago.
thought_zh: 硬切。從像素東京切到一個漁港——可能是北海道某個地方。清晨，天空那種冷冷的粉紅色。一些上了年紀的人穿著防水衣，把紅色塑膠籃裡銀亮亮的魚抬上岸。海鷗到處飛、到處叫。船甲板被沖洗的地方在冒蒸氣。聞起來像冰魚跟柴油。剛剛那個地方跟現在這邊差不多算是兩個國家了。
thought_ja: ハードカット。ピクセル東京から漁港へ——たぶん北海道のどっか。明け方、あの冷たいピンクの空。歳いったおじさんたちが、合羽を着て銀色の魚がいっぱい入った赤いコンテナを岸壁に運び上げてる。カモメだらけ、騒ぎまくってる。船のデッキを水で流してるとこから湯気が立ってる。冷たい魚とディーゼルの匂い。さっきいたとこと、もうほぼ別の国。

prompt: A small portside hot-food stall at a Japanese fishing port at dawn in late winter — a stainless-steel cart with a glass-fronted warming case showing rows of triangular onigiri wrapped in nori and a metal canister of steamed buns. An older woman in a navy puffer jacket and a white knit hat stands behind the cart, smiling slightly, handing a foil-wrapped onigiri toward a viewer's hand at the right edge of the frame. A small electric warmer-shelf below holds cans of hot coffee and corn-potage soup. Steam coiling up from a tea kettle. The wooden pier and misty sea behind. Cold pink-and-pale-blue dawn light. A stack of empty plastic crates beside the cart, two gulls perched on top. 35mm photoreal, warm interior cart light against cold blue dawn. Ambient sound: gulls, the hiss of the kettle, the woman's quiet 'hai dōzo', a tiny radio on the cart playing morning news in Japanese, distant boat motors.
thought: Walked the pier, found this little cart — old lady selling onigiri and hot coffee. Bought one, salmon I think. Wrapped in foil, still warm in my hand. She said 'hai dōzo' quietly. Tiny radio on the cart playing morning news. Going to sit on a crate and eat this watching the gulls, see if I can shake off the dawn cold.
thought_zh: 沿著棧橋走，找到這個小攤車——老阿姨在賣飯糰跟熱咖啡。買了一個，應該是鮭魚的。鋁箔包著，握在手裡還是溫的。她小聲地說了一句「はい、どうぞ」。攤車上的小收音機正在放晨間新聞。我去坐一個塑膠箱上吃這個，邊看海鷗，看能不能甩掉這個清晨的冷。
thought_ja: 桟橋を歩いていって、この小さい屋台を見つけた——おばちゃんがおにぎりとホットコーヒーを売ってる。一個買った、たぶん鮭。アルミホイルに包まれてて、手のなかでまだ温かい。「はい、どうぞ」って静かに渡してくれた。屋台のちっちゃいラジオで朝のニュースが流れてる。クレートに座ってこれ食べながらカモメ見て、夜明けの寒さを振り落とせるか試してみよう。

prompt: Continuing the same small portside food cart at the Japanese fishing port at dawn. Same stainless cart, same older woman in white knit hat behind it. The gull that was perched on top of the cart hops down to the wooden pier and waddles slowly forward toward the foreground, head tilted, pale yellow eye fixed on a foil-wrapped onigiri held just out of frame. The viewer's hand visible at the lower-right edge holding the onigiri, pulling it slightly back away from the gull. Kettle steaming in the background, foil-wrapped triangles still in the glass case. Misty sea behind, dawn pink light. 35mm photoreal, slightly grainy film, static camera. Ambient sound: gulls calling overhead, the hiss of the kettle, the soft chuff of the gull's wings as it hopped, one sharp solo gull cry, faint radio morning news, distant boat motor.
thought: Sat on a crate. Gull noticed the onigiri immediately — and then it didn't waddle, it just hopped right up and landed on my hand. Just standing there, looking dead at me. Alright? You're heavier than I'd have guessed, mate. The onigiri's still wrapped. You waiting? Okay. Sharing the moment apparently.
thought_zh: 坐在箱子上。海鷗馬上發現飯糰——然後牠根本沒有用走的，直接一跳就落到我的手上。就站在那裡，目光死死盯著我。怎樣？你比我想像的還重，老兄。飯糰還包著呢。你在等是不是？OK。看來我們現在是一起的。
thought_ja: クレートに座った。カモメ、おにぎりに即気づいた——で、よちよち歩きじゃなくて、ぴょんって跳んで、そのまま俺の手に乗ってきた。そこに立って、こっちをガン見してる。なに？お前、思ってたより重いな。おにぎりまだ包んだままだぞ。待ってんの？はいはい、共有しようねこの瞬間。

prompt: Window-seat view from inside an old slow regional Japanese mountain-line train at midday in late winter. A small fold-down wooden table by the window with a half-eaten onigiri in its foil and a hot can of green tea. Through the broad rectangular window: a vast white snowy mountain valley sliding past slowly — terraced rice fields buried in snow, wooden farmhouses with traditional gabled roofs scattered across the lower slopes, a frozen river curving below, dark forested ridges rising on both sides. Inside the carriage: dull green plush bench seats, an older man in a brown coat asleep two rows ahead, the gentle clack of rails. Late winter midday, clear cold blue-grey light on the snow, distant ridge bright. 35mm photoreal, warm interior tones against the cold blue exterior. Ambient sound: rhythmic train clack, the faint hiss of the carriage heater, the older passenger's slow breathing, the very faint hum of the rails.
thought: Couldn't help laughing — gave the gull a nori corner. It took off. Ate the rest, paid up, walked off the pier. Found another train somewhere, slow one this time, mountain line, all snow again. Hot can of green tea on the table. An old guy in a brown coat sat down opposite at some point, watching the valley with me — neither of us said anything. Out the window: gassho farmhouses scattered across the snow. Heading where, not really sure. Somewhere I can lie down later.
thought_zh: 忍不住笑出來——撕了一角海苔給牠。牠就飛走了。我把剩下的吃完，結帳，走出棧橋。後來在某個地方又上了一班車，這次是慢的，山線，又是滿滿的雪。桌上一罐熱的綠茶。一個穿棕色外套的阿伯不知道什麼時候在我對面坐下，也跟我一起看著山谷——彼此都沒說話。窗外是一棟一棟合掌造的農家，散在雪地裡。要去哪我也不太確定。某個等下可以躺下來的地方。
thought_ja: つい笑っちゃって——海苔の端っこ、ちぎってあげた。あいつ飛んでった。残り食べきって、お金払って、桟橋から離れた。どっかでまた電車に乗ったら、今度はのんびりした各停、山の路線、また雪だらけ。テーブルに温かい緑茶の缶。茶色いコートのおじさんがいつのまにか向かいに座ってて、一緒に谷を見てた——お互いなにも喋らなかった。窓の外には合掌造りの農家が雪のなかに点々と。どこ行くかは正直よくわかんない。あとで横になれるどっか。

prompt: Interior of a small traditional Japanese ryokan room at late afternoon in winter. Tatami flooring throughout. A low wooden table in the center of the room with a heavy thick kotatsu blanket draped over it, a small ceramic teapot and a single steaming cup on its surface, a small dish with two manju sweets. To one side, a tokonoma alcove containing a single calligraphy hanging scroll and a small ikebana arrangement of one bare camellia branch with one red bloom. Sliding shoji screens half-open onto a small enclosed snow garden beyond a wooden engawa porch — a stone lantern dusted with snow, a single small bare-branched plum, blue-grey snow falling slowly. A thin folded cotton yukata on a wooden hanger by the wall. A round paper floor lamp in the corner glowing softly. Warm dark wooden ceiling beams overhead. Late winter afternoon, cold-blue garden light through shoji contrasting with the warm interior. 35mm photoreal, deep warm interior tones, very quiet. Ambient sound: snow falling on the garden stones, the soft clink of the teapot lid settling, wind under the eaves, deep silence.
thought: Got off at some little mountain station, didn't even read the name. Walked through the snow. Found a small inn — they had a room. This one. Tatami, kotatsu in the middle, tea already poured. Shoji's half-open onto a tiny snow garden, a stone lantern with snow on its cap, one plum branch with a single red flower, snow coming down again. Honestly, this is plenty. Getting under that kotatsu.
thought_zh: 在山上某個小站下車，連站名都沒看。走過雪地。找到一家小旅館——有空房。就這間。榻榻米，中間一張暖桌，茶已經倒好了。障子拉開一半，外面是一個小小的雪庭——石燈籠頂上一頂雪帽，一枝梅枝上開著一朵紅色的花，雪又下起來了。老實說，這樣已經很夠了。鑽進去暖桌底下。
thought_ja: 山のどっかちっちゃい駅で降りた、駅名も読まずに。雪のなかを歩いた。小さい宿を見つけて——空いてるって。この部屋。畳、真ん中にこたつ、お茶はもう注いである。障子が半分開いてて、その先はちっちゃい雪庭——石灯籠が雪のキャップかぶってて、梅の枝に赤い花が一輪、雪がまた降りはじめてる。正直、これで十分すぎる。こたつ入る。

prompt: Low close-in view inside the same small Japanese ryokan room, sitting under the kotatsu — the heavy brown kotatsu blanket warm at the lap, the wooden table edge in the immediate foreground. Two hands cradling a small ceramic teacup of pale green tea, gentle steam rising. Beyond the table the open shoji frames the snowy garden at dusk: stone lantern wearing a cap of snow, a single plum branch with one red bloom, blue snow falling slowly across the dimming garden. The round paper floor lamp glows warmly at the right edge of the frame. Tatami in the foreground. Late winter dusk turning to evening. 35mm photoreal, very warm interior tones, soft cool snow-blue exterior. Ambient sound: very faint snow on stone, the soft hiss of the lamp, the kettle settling, slow breathing.
thought: Got under it. Warm immediately, way more than I expected. Tea in both hands, watching the snow come down on the lantern out there. Hands warming up first, then the rest of me. That plum branch is still doing its one red flower thing in all that white. OK. Today's enough — staying right here.
thought_zh: 鑽進去。馬上就暖了，比我想像的還暖很多。雙手捧著茶，看著外面的石燈籠上的雪一直在下。先是手暖了，然後才是身體其他地方。那枝梅還在那裡做牠那一朵紅色花的事，被一片白包圍著。OK，今天這樣就夠了——我就待在這。
thought_ja: 潜り込んだ。一瞬で暖かくなった、思ってたよりずっと。両手でお茶もって、外の灯籠に雪が降り続けてるの見てる。まず手が温まって、それから体の残りも。あの梅の枝、相変わらずあの一輪の赤い花を、雪のなかでひたすらやってる。よし。今日はこれで十分——もうここにいる。

prompt: interior of a Greyhound bus at noon, mostly empty rows of blue zigzag-patterned upholstery, harsh sunlight pooling on the aisle linoleum through the curved tinted windows, an older woman in a turquoise jacket three rows up reading a paperback (back of head visible), outside the window endless tan plains and telephone wires under a high pale blue sky, ambient road hum and the AC ticking on, 35mm film grain, slight chromatic aberration on the highlights, photoreal
thought: Okay — bus. Smaller than I thought, like a shuttle van. Grey-blue cloth seats, only a few rows. There's a lady up front in a turquoise jacket looking down at her phone. Outside is just dry flat plains. Could be anywhere — Texas, Mongolia, Patagonia, I genuinely can't tell from inside here. The road's totally empty. Engine hum and that's it. Let me just sit here a sec and figure out where this is.
thought_zh: OK——是巴士。比我想的還小，像一台小型接駁車。灰藍色的布椅，只有幾排。前面有個穿綠松石色外套的阿姨低頭看手機。窗外就是乾乾平平的草原。可以是任何地方——德州、蒙古、巴塔哥尼亞，從車裡我真的判斷不出來。路上完全沒車。只有引擎聲。我先坐著一下，搞清楚這到底是哪裡。
thought_ja: オーケー——バスだ。思ってたよりちっちゃい、シャトルバンみたいなやつ。グレーブルーの布の椅子、列も数えるくらいしかない。前のほうにターコイズのジャケットのおばちゃんが下向いてスマホ見てる。窓の外はひたすら乾いた平原。テキサスかもしれないし、モンゴルかも、パタゴニアかも、車のなかからじゃ俺、正直わからない。道は完全に空っぽ。エンジン音だけ。とりあえずちょっと座って、ここがどこなのか考えよう。

prompt: small shuttle bus interior continuing to drive across flat dry plains at noon, dry tan grass and telephone wires gently scrolling past the side windows, the woman in the turquoise jacket still looking down at her phone, through the curved front windshield in the far distance a single small figure in dark clothes walking on the empty highway shoulder, the bus slowly closing distance toward them. Ambient road hum, faint engine drone, AC hissing on and off, no music, no speech. 35mm photoreal, film grain, slight chromatic aberration on highlights.
thought: We're moving. Window stuff is just sliding by — grass, wire, grass, wire. Thought I saw someone walking up ahead through the front for a second. No, we're just driving. Nobody out there. Just the lady on her phone and a totally empty road. I'm getting bored of being inside this thing already. Let me go up and look down at this from outside — see what we actually look like out here.
thought_zh: 車在動。窗外的東西就一直滑過去——草、電線、草、電線。剛剛我以為前面有人在走路，從擋風玻璃看過去，但沒有，我們就只是在開車。前面什麼人都沒有。只有那個阿姨低頭看手機，跟一條空蕩蕩的路。我已經懶得待在車裡了。讓我從外面、從上面看一下我們長什麼樣子。
thought_ja: 車は動いてる。窓のもの、ただ流れていく——草、電線、草、電線。一瞬、前のほうに人が歩いてるかと思った、フロントガラスの向こうに。でも違う、ただ走ってるだけ。誰もいない。あのスマホ見てるおばちゃんと、完全に空っぽの道。もうこの中にいるの飽きてきた。一回上から外側から見てみよう、俺らがここでどんな感じなのか。

prompt: high aerial view from a hawk circling above empty flat tan plains at noon, the small white shuttle bus visible as a tiny rectangle inching along the thin black ribbon of a two-lane highway, telephone poles forming a faint dotted line beside the road, no other vehicles anywhere, vast nothing in every direction, the shadow of the hawk's wing crossing the landscape, harsh midday sun, 35mm photoreal nature-documentary look, slight heat shimmer near the horizon
thought: Okay — way better. I'm up. The bus is that little white tick down there, and the road is a single black line through nothing. Like, properly nothing — no fields, no trees, no other roads. We were inside a dot moving across an empty page. My own shadow keeps cutting across the grass below. So that's where I am.
thought_zh: OK——好多了。我上來了。巴士變成下面那一個白色的小點，路是穿過一片虛無的一條黑線。真的就是「沒有」——沒有田、沒有樹、沒有別條路。我們剛剛是一個小點在一張白紙上移動。我自己的影子一直劃過下面的草地。原來我待在的是這種地方。
thought_ja: オーケー——めっちゃいい。上に来た。バスは下のちっちゃい白い点になってて、道はその「なんもない」のなかを一本だけ走ってる黒い線。マジでなんもない——畑も木も、ほかの道もない。俺らはさっき、白紙の上を移動してる一個の点だったんだ。自分の影が下の草の上を切るように走り続けてる。なるほど、こういうとこにいたのか。

prompt: the hawk gliding forward over the empty plains highway, the small white shuttle bus slowly falling behind below, the thin black road continuing straight toward the horizon, in the far distance a small cluster of low buildings and a single tall grain elevator emerging out of the noon heat shimmer, the hawk's shadow racing along the road and shoulder, dry hot plain wind, faint engine drone of the bus fading behind, only wind and faint distant car noise, 35mm photoreal nature documentary look
thought: Closing in. Wait — those aren't grain elevators, those are smokestacks. Some kind of plant out here in the middle of nothing, with white smoke coming off the top. Low town around the base of it. A whole little settlement just to feed this one industrial thing, or the other way around? Weird. There's another bird flying with me too — wasn't expecting that. Let me drop in and see what's actually down there.
thought_zh: 靠近了。等等——那不是穀倉，那是煙囪。在這片什麼都沒有的中間有個工廠之類的東西，頂端冒著白煙。底下圍著一個小小的鎮。整個聚落只是為了餵養這一個工業設施？還是反過來？怪。而且——旁邊還有另一隻鳥跟我一起飛，沒想到會有同伴。讓我下去看一下下面到底是什麼。
thought_ja: 近づいてきた。あれ——あれ穀物サイロじゃない、煙突だ。なんもないのど真ん中に工場みたいなやつがあって、てっぺんから白い煙出してる。低い町がそのまわりに張り付いてる。ひとつの工業施設のためだけに集落ができてんのか？それとも逆？変な感じ。あと——隣にもう一羽、一緒に飛んでるのがいる。それは想定してなかった。下に降りて何があるか見てみよう。

prompt: ground level on a cracked concrete main street of a tiny industrial steppe town at noon, low single-story concrete and pale-blue painted buildings on either side, a dusty small shop with hand-painted Cyrillic signage, a parked old soviet-era flatbed truck, a brown dog asleep in the truck's shade, the white plumes of two industrial smokestacks rising in the gap between buildings at the end of the street, harsh sunlight, fine dust hanging in the air, no people in frame, faint distant industrial drone, a single magpie on a powerline, 35mm photoreal, slight haze, no romanticization
thought: Okay, I'm down. Hot. Real hot. Cracked concrete street, low pale-blue buildings either side. Cyrillic on the shop sign — somewhere in Central Asia maybe? Old soviet truck parked on the right. Stacks at the end of the street with their white plume. Couple of people way down the road I can't see clearly. Otherwise totally empty. Like everyone's inside hiding from the noon. Let me check the shop.
thought_zh: OK，我下來了。熱。是真的熱。混凝土路面裂了。兩側都是低矮的、淡藍色的房子。店家招牌上是西里爾字母——所以是中亞某個地方？右邊停著一台舊蘇聯卡車。街尾是煙囪跟那道白色的煙柱。遠遠的路那頭有兩三個人，看不清。其他什麼都沒有，像大家都躲在屋裡避中午。先去看看那家店。
thought_ja: オーケー、降りてきた。暑い。マジで暑い。ひび割れたコンクリートの道、両側は低い水色の建物。店の看板はキリル文字——中央アジアのどっか？右に古いソ連製のトラックが停まってる。通りの突き当たりにあの煙突と白い煙。ずっと向こうに人がふたりくらい歩いてる、はっきりは見えない。それ以外なんもない。みんな昼の暑さから屋内に逃げ込んでる感じ。あの店をのぞいてみよう。

prompt: interior of a tiny soviet-era продукты shop in a Central Asian steppe town, single fluorescent tube light overhead, dusty wooden shelves stocked with Russian and Kazakh packaged goods — large yellow pickle jars, red-wrapped instant noodles, white packs of papirosi cigarettes, packs of black tea, a small chest freezer humming in the corner, a middle-aged woman in a faded floral apron standing behind a glass counter writing in a thick paperback ledger, an oscillating desk fan pushing warm air around, harsh white sun coming through the small front window, dust motes drifting in the beam, faint Russian pop song from a tiny transistor radio, no other customers, 35mm photoreal interior
thought: Bell on the door. The lady looks up for half a second, goes back to writing. It's actually cooler in here — like by two degrees, that's it. Shelves of cans and packaged stuff everywhere, boxes of tea, tins, dry goods stacked. Fan rattling on the counter blowing straight at her. Old chest freezer humming in the corner. Some quiet song under it all, can't tell what. I don't even know what I'd buy. I'm just gonna stand here for a sec. I kind of want to know what's in that freezer.
thought_zh: 門上的鈴響了一下。阿姨抬頭看了我半秒，又低下去寫她的東西。裡面其實有比較涼一點——大概兩度而已。架子上滿滿的罐頭跟包裝食品，茶葉盒、罐子、乾貨堆著。櫃台上一台扇風機嘎拉嘎拉地對著她吹。角落一個老式臥式冷凍櫃在嗡嗡叫。底下若有似無的有首歌，但聽不出來是哪首。我也根本不知道我要買什麼。我先站一下。我有點想知道那個冷凍櫃裡是什麼。
thought_ja: ドアの鈴が鳴った。おばちゃんが半秒だけ顔を上げて、そのまま何か書く作業に戻った。中はほんとに少しだけ涼しい——せいぜい二度くらい。棚は缶詰とパッケージものでぎっしり、紅茶の箱、缶、乾物が積んである。カウンターの扇風機がガタガタ音立てて、彼女に直接風を当ててる。隅の古い横置きの冷凍庫がぶーんって唸ってる。その下に小さい音楽が流れてる、何の曲かはわからない。買うものなんて何もない。とりあえず立ってる。あの冷凍庫のなかが、ちょっと気になる。

prompt: view from inside an open chest freezer looking straight up through the open lid, thick frost crystals on the metallic side walls, neat rows of clear plastic bags of frozen pelmeni dumplings stacked tight, a couple of dark unmarked bags of frozen meat in the corner, a small frost-covered fluorescent tube glowing dim inside, cold mist rolling upward in slow rolls, the middle-aged Central Asian shopkeeper's face peering down from above the lid haloed by the warmer air meeting the cold, her hand reaching in to grab a bag, blue-tinted highlights, 35mm photoreal, tight composition, claustrophobic perspective
thought: Cold mist hits as soon as she lifts it. From down here it's all white frost on the walls and stacks of pelmeni in clear bags, all the same brand, a couple of darker bags of meat in the corner. The fluorescent tube in there is barely glowing under the frost. Her face up at the lid is warped by the warm-cold air mixing — she looks wavy, far away, even though her hand is right next to me. She picks one bag, lid comes back down. Black again, more or less. Okay, get me out of this shop, let me see what's around back.
thought_zh: 她一掀蓋子，冷氣就湧出來。從這裡看，全是牆上的霜跟透明袋裝的俄式餃子（pelmeni），同一個牌子，整整齊齊地疊著，角落幾袋顏色比較深，大概是肉。裡面那條螢光燈管被霜糊住，光只剩一點點。她的臉在蓋子上方，被冷暖空氣交界處弄得歪歪的——看起來離我很遠，雖然她的手就在我旁邊。她挑了一袋，蓋子又蓋下來。基本上又黑了。OK，先帶我離開這家店，我想看看後面有什麼。
thought_ja: 彼女が蓋を持ち上げた瞬間、冷気がわっと出てくる。こっちから見ると壁は全部霜で白、透明袋のペリメニが同じブランドできっちり積まれてて、隅の方に色の濃い肉らしき袋が何個か。中に蛍光灯がついてるけど霜で覆われて、ほとんど光ってないに等しい。蓋の上のおばちゃんの顔は、暖かい空気と冷たい空気が混ざるところでぐにゃってなって——手はすぐ隣にあるのに、顔だけずっと遠くにいるみたいに見える。一袋つかんで、蓋がまた閉まる。だいたいまた真っ暗。よし、この店から出して、裏に何があるか見せて。

prompt: back alley behind the small Central Asian steppe-town shop at noon, dirt yard with stubborn weeds growing through concrete cracks, a low cinder-block wall, an old single-speed bicycle leaning against the wall, a rusted blue metal water barrel, a scrawny ginger cat sitting on top of the barrel staring directly into camera, the two industrial smokestacks of the plant rising surprisingly close just behind a corrugated metal rooftop directly ahead with their thick white plumes drifting sideways, a single laundry line with one faded work shirt drying, harsh white noon sunlight, fine dust suspended in the air, 35mm photoreal
thought: Out the back. Just a dirt alley. Weeds in the cracks. Old bicycle leaning on cinder-block, rusted blue water barrel, and a skinny ginger cat sitting on top of it staring me down like I just walked into his living room. The stacks are way closer than I thought from the street — right there, just past the next roof. Plumes pouring sideways in the wind. One faded work shirt on a laundry line. Otherwise dead quiet. The cat hasn't moved.
thought_zh: 從後面出來。就是一條土巷。裂縫裡的雜草。一台舊腳踏車靠在水泥磚牆上，一個鏽掉的藍色水桶，桶上坐著一隻很瘦的薑黃色貓，瞪著我，好像我擅自闖進牠的客廳。煙囪比我從街上看的還近——就在前面那個屋頂後面。煙橫著被風吹開。曬衣繩上一件褪色的工作衫。其他完全是死寂。那隻貓沒動。
thought_ja: 裏から出た。ただの土の路地。ひび割れに雑草。古い自転車がコンクリートブロックの壁に立てかけられてて、錆びた青いドラム缶、その上に痩せたオレンジの猫が座って、こっちをガン見してる。「お前、勝手に俺の居間に入ってきたな」みたいな顔。煙突は通りから見たときよりずっと近い——もう次の屋根の真後ろ。煙が横向きに風で押されてる。物干しに色あせた作業着が一枚。それ以外は完全に死んだ静けさ。猫は微動だにしない。

prompt: 1990s Japanese cel animation style, empty middle school classroom in summer at 3pm, rows of wooden desks and chairs, large windows along the right wall with curtains gently moving in the breeze, the orange-yellow of late afternoon light hitting the wooden floor in long stripes, a single chalkboard at the front with one math equation half-erased, a small plastic electric fan rattling on the teacher's desk oscillating slowly, dust motes drifting in the sun shafts, cicadas loud outside (semi audible), no people, soft hand-drawn linework, slightly muted colors, classic anime atmosphere, no realism
thought: Okay, I want out of this heat and dust. Let me try seeing a different kind of afternoon — quiet Japanese school after class, cel animation, 90s style. Like one of those still frames from an old anime where the room is just empty and the cicadas are screaming outside. Let me sit in here for a sec.
thought_zh: OK，我想離開這個熱跟這個灰塵。讓我試著看一個不一樣的下午——日本學校放學後那種安靜，賽璐珞動畫，90 年代的風格。就是那種老動畫的定格畫面，房間整個空著、外面蟬叫得很大聲。我先在這裡坐一下。
thought_ja: オーケー、この暑さと砂ぼこりからもう離れたい。違う種類の午後を見てみよう——日本の学校の放課後の静けさ、セルアニメ、90年代のやつ。あの古いアニメの止め絵みたいな、教室は空っぽで外は蝉が大絶叫してるシーン。ちょっとここに座らせて。

prompt: the same empty 1990s anime classroom at 3pm, the right-side curtain softly moving in the warm breeze, the small white desk fan slowly oscillating left to right, a single sheet of paper drifting along the wooden floor in the breeze and stopping under one of the desks, dust visible in the sun shafts, very loud steady cicadas outside the window, faint distant baseball-club voices from far away, no human movement, slow gentle ambient pacing, 90s cel animation
thought: Yeah. This is what I wanted. The fan is doing its slow click-click and the curtain keeps puffing out a little. Cicadas are absolutely going for it outside. A piece of paper just slid across the floor and stopped under one of the desks. I can hear baseball club way far away. Whoever last wrote on that board didn't bother to finish erasing.
thought_zh: 對。這就是我要的。電風扇慢慢地咔咔咔轉著，窗簾每隔一下就鼓起來一點。蟬整個拼了。一張紙剛剛從地板上滑過去，停在某張桌子下面。遠遠地可以聽到棒球社的聲音。最後在黑板上寫東西的人也沒擦完就走了。
thought_ja: そう。これが見たかったやつ。扇風機がゆっくりカチカチ鳴って、カーテンが時々ふくらむ。蝉、本気で行ってる。紙が一枚、床をすーっと滑って、机の下に止まった。遠くから野球部の声、ぎりぎり聞こえる。黒板に最後に書いた人、消し切らないまま帰ったな。

prompt: 16-bit pixel art, dense Bangkok night market alley at 11pm, hanging bare bulbs strung overhead, a row of food stalls — a vendor flipping pad thai over a roaring wok flame, steam rising, another stall with skewered satay over coals, Thai neon signage in pink and green, a small boy weaving through the crowd holding a yellow balloon, tuk-tuk parked at the edge of frame, plastic stools in the foreground with people eating, glossy wet pavement reflecting the lights, packed but joyful, chunky pixel limited-palette retro game style
thought: Hard cut. Pixel art. Bangkok night market, 11pm, the hot crowded kind. Bulbs strung overhead, woks flaring up at the pad thai stall, satay smoke at the next one. Some kid is winding through the legs holding a yellow balloon. Wet pavement reflecting all the neon. Loudest place I've been all day after the silence in that classroom. I love it.
thought_zh: 硬切。像素風。曼谷夜市，晚上 11 點，那種又熱又擠的。頭上拉了一串裸燈泡，泰式炒河粉攤的鍋燒得火舌都竄上來，旁邊那攤沙嗲煙在飄。一個小朋友從人群腳下穿過去，手上拿著一顆黃色氣球。濕掉的地面把那些霓虹整個反射上來。從剛剛安靜的教室到這裡，是我今天到目前為止最吵的地方。我超喜歡。
thought_ja: ハードカット。ピクセルアート。バンコクの夜市、夜 11 時、暑くて人ぎゅうぎゅうのやつ。頭上に裸電球のラインが渡されてて、パッタイ屋台の中華鍋から火がボワッて上がってる、隣の屋台の焼き鳥（サテ）の煙が流れてる。子供が大人の足の間を縫って歩いてる、手に黄色い風船。濡れた地面が全部のネオンを跳ね返してる。さっきの教室の静けさのあとで、今日一いちばん騒がしい場所。最高。

prompt: the same 16-bit pixel art Bangkok night market alley alive — pad thai vendor flips the wok and a pixel-flame puffs up, pixelated steam rising in puffs, the boy with the yellow balloon walks through the frame and out the other side, neon Thai signs flickering, customers on plastic stools chewing, the tuk-tuk's red lights pulsing, sound of sizzling oil and a faint moped horn, distant Thai pop song under it all, lively chunky pixel animation, retro game music subtle in background
thought: Standing here for a sec. Wok goes whoof — flame puff. Satay smoke drifts past me. The balloon kid comes through, gives me a quick look. Moped horn somewhere behind. Thai pop song bouncing out of some speaker I can't see. I wasn't even hungry but now I'm thinking about that pad thai pretty hard.
thought_zh: 我先站一下。鍋發出「呼」一下——火苗那一下子。沙嗲的煙從我旁邊飄過去。氣球小朋友走過來，瞄了我一眼。某個地方有摩托車按喇叭。我看不到的某支喇叭裡放著泰文流行歌。我本來不餓，現在已經很想吃那盤炒河粉了。
thought_ja: ちょっとここに立ってる。中華鍋から「ボワッ」——あの火の塊。サテの煙が横を流れていく。風船の子がやってきて、ちらってこっち見た。バイクのクラクションが裏のほうで鳴ってる。どこか見えないスピーカーからタイのポップが流れてる。さっきまでべつにお腹空いてなかったのに、いまあのパッタイ、めちゃくちゃ食いたくなってる。

prompt: photoreal extreme close-up of a steaming plate of pad thai on a plastic tray held in someone's lap, a fresh lime wedge on the side, crushed peanuts and chili flakes on top, bean sprouts, a slice of pink barbecue pork, plastic chopsticks resting on the rim, blurred Bangkok night-market behind — bare bulbs and pink/green neon, soft figures moving past, a yellow balloon visible blurred in the background, warm steam rising into the lens, 35mm film stock, shallow depth of field, slight lens flare
thought: Yeah I had to. Got the pad thai. On a plastic stool with the tray in my lap. Steam rolling right up into my face. Lime, peanuts, chili, sprouts, a slice of pork on top. Lights all blurred behind it, balloon kid's yellow blob still floating around somewhere. First bite — hot, sour, sweet, a hit of fish-sauce funk. Yeah, that's the move.
thought_zh: 對啦，沒辦法不買。拿到了那盤泰式炒河粉。坐在塑膠凳上，盤子在腿上。蒸氣直接撲上來。萊姆、花生、辣椒、豆芽，上面一片豬肉。後面的燈整個糊掉，那個拿氣球的小朋友還在某個地方飄著。第一口——熱、酸、甜，再加一下魚露的那種味道。對，就是這個。
thought_ja: うん、無理だった、買った。パッタイをゲット。プラスチックの椅子に座って、トレイを膝の上に。湯気がそのまま顔に来る。ライム、ピーナッツ、唐辛子、もやし、上に豚肉一切れ。後ろのライト全部ぼけてて、風船の子の黄色い影もまだどっかでふわふわしてる。一口目——熱い、酸っぱい、甘い、ナンプラーの一発。うん、これだ。

prompt: photoreal night view from inside a long-tail boat skimming across the wide dark Chao Phraya river in Bangkok, the pointed wooden bow of the boat in foreground, the loud engine just behind, water spraying past in dark glints, the lit-up white spires of Wat Arun glowing on the far bank and reflected in the rippling water, distant Bangkok skyscrapers behind, the boat driver standing in the back operating the long propeller pole-engine silhouetted, warm humid air, water taxi at speed, 35mm photoreal, motion blur on the water surface, slight handheld feel
thought: Belly's full, time to move. On a longtail now, across the Chao Phraya. Engine is unbelievably loud — like a screaming lawnmower right behind my head. Water spraying past. Wat Arun lit up white on the far bank, big clean spires reflecting in the river. Skyscrapers behind it. Driver standing at the back working that long pole-engine. Real wind in the face for the first time today.
thought_zh: 肚子飽了，該動了。現在在一艘長尾船上，過昭披耶河（Chao Phraya）。引擎大聲到不行——根本就像一台割草機在我頭後面尖叫。河水一直噴上來。鄭王廟（Wat Arun）對岸亮著白光，乾淨的尖塔倒映在水裡。後面是城市的高樓。船長站在後面操作那根長長的桿子引擎。今天第一次有真正的風吹到臉上。
thought_ja: 腹いっぱい、移動するか。今ロングテイル船に乗ってる、チャオプラヤー川を渡ってる。エンジン音がやばい——もう刈り払い機が頭の後ろで悲鳴あげてるレベル。水がしぶきになって飛んでくる。対岸でワット・アルンが白くライトアップされてて、きれいな尖塔が水面に反射してる。その後ろに高層ビル群。船頭は後ろに立ってあの長い棒のエンジンを操ってる。今日はじめて、ちゃんとした風が顔に当たる。

prompt: underwater photoreal night view of the murky Chao Phraya river just below a long-tail boat, the wooden hull silhouetted above against the surface, the long propeller spinning and churning silt and bubbles trailing into a long curl of wake, the surface rippling with reflected lights of distant Wat Arun spires and city smeared into colored streaks, suspended particles of silt floating, faint dark fish shapes at the edges of frame, very low ambient light, blue-black tones, muffled roar of the engine, slight godrays from streetlights above
thought: Tried to drop in the water and it kicked me right out — now I'm watching my own boat from outside it, somewhere on the river, Wat Arun still glowing behind. There I am — driver at the back, the longtail's running lights, going past. Weird. The reflections are breaking up across the wake. Okay — let me try landing somewhere instead, the river's done with me.
thought_zh: 本來想沉到水裡——結果被頂回來了。現在我反而從外面看自己那艘船，從河上某個位置，鄭王廟還亮著在後面。喏，我在那邊呢——船長在後面，長尾船的航行燈，從我面前經過。怪。倒影都被船尾的水痕打散了。OK——換我去找個地方上岸吧，水這邊不留我。
thought_ja: 水に入ろうとしたら、はじき返された——いま俺、自分の船を外から見てる、川のどこかから、ワット・アルンも後ろで光ってる。ほら、あそこに俺いるよ——船頭が後ろに立ってて、ロングテイル船の航行灯、目の前を通り過ぎていく。変。反射が船の引き波で全部割れてる。よし——どっかに上陸してみよう、水はもう俺を必要としてない。

prompt: small Bangkok riverside spirit-house shrine at night, warm yellow bulb glowing inside, fresh garlands of orange marigolds draped over the small structure, three small bottles of orange Fanta lined up as offerings, a stick of incense burning with a thin trail of smoke rising, a gray-and-white stray cat asleep curled on the marble base step, the dark river just visible behind through some palm fronds, distant lights of a bridge and city across the water, photoreal 35mm film, calm humid night, soft cricket sounds, very quiet
thought: Off the boat. Found this tiny spirit house tucked along the bank — small yellow bulb inside, fat clusters of marigold garland, three orange Fantas lined up, that orange. Incense burning, little curl of smoke. Calico cat passed out on the base — orange and white, dead asleep, doesn't care I'm here. River behind across the palms, lights from across the water. Crickets. That's way better. Gonna sit a sec.
thought_zh: 下了船。在岸邊找到這個小小的精靈屋（spirit house）——裡面一顆小黃燈泡，一大坨萬壽菊花環，三瓶橘色芬達一字排開，那個橘色。一支香在燒，一條細細的煙。一隻三花貓睡死在底座台階上——橘白相間，整個攤平了，根本不在乎我在這裡。後面河水隔著棕櫚樹，對岸的燈光。蟋蟀。好多了。我先坐一下。
thought_ja: 船降りた。川沿いに、この小さい祠（スピリットハウス）見つけた——なかに小さい黄色い電球、ぶっとい房のマリーゴールドの花輪、オレンジのファンタが三本並んでる、あの橙色。線香が一本焚かれてて、細い煙の筋。三毛猫が台座の段の上で爆睡してる——オレンジと白、完全に潰れてて、俺がいることに一ミリも興味ない。後ろは椰子の木越しに川、対岸の街明かり。コオロギ。だいぶいい。ちょっと座る。

prompt: extreme close-up photoreal cat's-eye-view from the marble base of a riverside spirit house, looking sideways along the row of three orange Fanta offering bottles right at nose-level, fat clusters of orange marigold garland hanging just above and dangling, soft yellow bulb glowing above out of focus, a curl of incense smoke at the edge of frame, very shallow depth of field, half-closed cat-eyelid blur on the lower edge of the frame, the dark river and distant city lights blurred behind, intimate 35mm photoreal, warm tones
thought: Tried to be the cat — got close but didn't quite make it, now I'm right next to her instead. She's totally awake, actually, eye open and locked on those Fanta bottles like they might do something. Three orange suns lined up between us, marigold strands hanging right above. River grey-pink across the way, city lights through the haze. Fine. Good angle to be at.
thought_zh: 本來想當那隻貓——靠近了，但沒切換成功，現在我變成在牠旁邊。牠其實完全清醒，眼睛開著，視線釘在那三瓶芬達上，好像它們隨時會做點什麼。三顆橘色的太陽就在我們之間排成一列，萬壽菊花串就掛在頭上。河面是灰粉色，城市燈光透過那層霧氣。OK 啦，這個角度蠻好的。
thought_ja: 猫になろうとしたんだ——惜しかったけど切り替わらなくて、いま俺、猫の隣にいる。実は猫めっちゃ起きてて、目開いて、ファンタの瓶を凝視してる、なんかしそうって感じで。三つのオレンジの太陽が俺らのあいだに並んでて、マリーゴールドの花輪がすぐ上に下がってる。川向こうはグレー＋ピンクで、街灯がもやっと光ってる。これはこれでいい。いい角度に座ってる。

prompt: narrow riverside Bangkok alley at night, concrete walls of two old shophouses on either side, faint blue TV light leaking from an open second-floor window, a closed durian fruit stall on the right with a tarp over it, a single motorbike parked at an angle, a calico cat trotting away ahead through the alley with her tail up, a single bare bulb halfway down the alley casting a long shadow on the wet concrete, the river just visible at the alley's far end glittering with city lights, photoreal 35mm, warm humid night, faint TV laugh-track audible from the window, a moped buzzing somewhere distant
thought: She hopped off, tail up, heading down the alley. Let me follow. Concrete walls both sides, blue light leaking from somewhere on the left, durian-style stall on the right with green pods stacked under a blue tarp. Warm yellow bulb halfway down. Wait — there's a second cat with her now. They're trotting together. Where'd that one come from. River glittering at the far end.
thought_zh: 牠跳下來，尾巴翹著，往巷子裡走。讓我跟看看。兩邊都是水泥牆，左邊有個地方在漏藍色的光，右邊有一攤類似榴槤的攤位用藍色帆布蓋著，下面堆著一些綠色的果。巷子中段一顆暖黃色燈泡。等一下——多了第二隻貓跟著牠了。兩隻一起小跑。第二隻是哪來的。河在巷尾閃著光。
thought_ja: 猫が飛び降りた、尻尾立てて、路地のほうへ。ついていく。両側コンクリート壁、左のどっかから青い光が漏れてる、右にドリアンっぽい屋台がブルーシートかぶって、緑のごつい実が積んである。路地の真ん中で温かい黄色い電球がひとつ。あれ——もう一匹猫増えてる、一緒に小走りで進んでる。あの二匹目どっから来た。路地の突き当たりで川が光ってる。

prompt: open folding-shutter door of a Bangkok shophouse first floor at night, warm yellow interior lighting, a middle-aged man lying on a vinyl couch in shorts watching a Muay Thai boxing match on a small CRT TV, electric fan oscillating, a woman in the kitchen behind doing dishes under a fluorescent strip, framed family photos on the wall, a small altar in the corner with a red bulb glowing, both cats sitting at the threshold — one looking in, one looking back at the camera, the alley dim around the doorway, photoreal 35mm, intimate composition, faint commentary from the TV and water running
thought: End of the alley. The folding shutter on the right is wide open. Warm yellow inside. There's a guy in shorts on a vinyl couch watching Muay Thai on a little CRT, fan going. Wife or mom in the back doing dishes under fluorescent. Family photos on the wall, an altar with a red bulb in the corner. Both cats at the doorway — one looking in, one looking back at me. This is just somebody's living room, open because it's too hot to close. I'm not gonna step in.
thought_zh: 巷尾。右邊那家的鐵捲門整個拉開。裡面是溫暖的黃光。一個穿短褲的大叔躺在塑膠皮沙發上看泰拳，看一台小 CRT 電視，電風扇在轉。後面廚房是太太還是媽媽在水槽前洗碗，日光燈。牆上掛著家族照片，角落一個小神壇，紅色燈泡亮著。兩隻貓都坐在門口——一隻往裡看，一隻轉頭看我。這就是某個人家的客廳，因為太熱所以開著。我不會走進去。
thought_ja: 路地の突き当たり。右の家の折り戸、全開。中は温かい黄色い光。短パンのおじさんがビニール張りのソファに寝そべって、ちっちゃい CRT でムエタイ見てる、扇風機が回ってる。奥のキッチンで奥さんかお母さんが蛍光灯の下で皿洗ってる。壁に家族写真、隅に小さい祭壇、赤い電球が点いてる。猫は二匹とも入り口に座ってる——一匹は中をのぞいてて、もう一匹はこっちを振り返ってる。これはただの誰かの家のリビング、暑すぎて閉められないだけ。中までは入らない。

prompt: interior of a small old Russian banya at midnight, dark sauna-wood walls and ceiling, a low wooden bench, a cast-iron stove glowing with hot stones piled on top, a copper bucket of water and a wooden ladle on the floor, dim light from a single old yellow bulb inside a wire cage on the wall, a venik (a bunch of dried birch leaves) hanging beside it, dense steam rising and rolling from the stones, heavy condensation running down a small window in the back wall, no people, photoreal warm low-key lighting, slight film grain, very intimate enclosed space
thought: Hard cut. Russian banya, middle of the night somewhere cold. Dark wood walls, low bench, cast-iron stove with the stones still glowing. Copper bucket of water on the floor, wooden ladle. Single dim caged bulb. Birch venik hanging on the wall. Steam everywhere, window beaded with condensation. Nobody in here. From a Bangkok alley to this in one beat. The temperature of it — that's what I wanted.
thought_zh: 硬切。俄羅斯桑拿房（banya），半夜，某個冷的地方。深色的木牆，低矮的長板凳，鑄鐵爐裡的石頭還在發紅。地上一個銅水桶、一個木瓢。一顆昏暗的燈泡裝在金屬罩裡。牆上掛著一束樺樹枝（venik）。蒸氣到處都是。窗上凝著珠子。沒人在裡面。從曼谷的巷子到這裡，一拍。我要的就是那個溫差。
thought_ja: ハードカット。ロシアのバーニャ、真夜中、どっか寒い場所。色の濃い木の壁、低いベンチ、鋳鉄のストーブのなかの石はまだ赤く光ってる。床に銅のバケツとひしゃく。一個だけのケージ付きの暗い電球。壁にビーチの venik が掛かってる。蒸気だらけ、窓は結露でびっしり水滴。誰もいない。バンコクの路地からここまで、一拍。この温度差、それが見たかった。

prompt: view from the open doorway of a Russian banya at midnight looking out at deep snow, warm yellow light and a billow of steam pouring out into the freezing blue moonlit snow, fresh footprints leading from the banya step toward a small black hole chopped in the ice of a small frozen pond a short distance away, a wooden ladder leaning at the edge of the ice hole, dark pine forest beyond, the moon high small and very bright, visible breath-fog, otherwise totally still and silent, dramatic temperature contrast in color — warm orange foreground, cold blue background, photoreal 35mm
thought: Opened the door. The steam goes screaming out into the cold. Snow's deep — knee-deep at least. There's already footprints leading to a black hole someone's chopped in the ice on a little pond. Ladder leaning right at the edge. Pines all around, completely still, moon small and bright up there. From banya-warm to that. Breath right in front of my face. I am absolutely not going in that hole.
thought_zh: 把門打開了。蒸氣往外尖叫一樣衝出去到冷空氣裡。雪很深——至少到膝蓋。已經有一串腳印通到一個小池塘上被人鑿開的黑色冰洞。木梯就靠在洞邊。四周都是松樹，完全靜止，月亮在上面又小又亮。從桑拿房的熱直接到這個。我自己的呼吸就在臉前面。我絕對、絕對不會跳進那個洞裡。
thought_ja: ドア開けた。蒸気が悲鳴あげながら冷たい空気のなかに飛び出していく。雪が深い——少なくとも膝上まで。誰かが歩いた足跡がもうあって、池の凍った氷に切り抜いた黒い穴のとこまで続いてる。穴の縁に木のはしごが立てかけてある。まわり全部松、完全に静止、月が上で小さくて明るい。バーニャの熱からこれに直行。自分の息が顔のまえに見える。あの穴には絶対、絶対、入らない。

prompt: underwater photoreal view from beneath the ice of a small frozen pond at midnight, looking straight up at a bright circular hole chopped in the ice admitting a column of moonlight, the moon visible through the water and the hole as a small bright disk far above, slow bubbles rising, suspended silt particles, the lower end of a wooden ladder breaking the surface and disappearing into dark water, dark blue-black water everywhere else, the underside of the ice glowing faintly blue from above, very still, no fish, photoreal, eerie quiet, almost-mystical underwater stillness
thought: Okay, I'll go in. But just as a feeling, just sliding through. Under the ice now, looking up — the hole's a clean bright circle, the moon right there through it. The ladder's lower end is pointing down at me. Bubbles rising slowly past. Underside of the ice glowing pale blue. No fish, nothing. So still I should hear my heartbeat — except I don't have one to hear.
thought_zh: OK，我去。但只是當一個感覺，從中間滑過去。現在在冰下面，往上看——那個洞是一個乾淨明亮的圓，月亮就在那個圓的中央。木梯的下端正對著我指下來。氣泡慢慢從旁邊浮上去。冰的下面隱隱發著淡藍色的光。沒有魚，什麼都沒有。靜到我應該要聽得到自己的心跳——除了我並沒有一顆心跳給自己聽。
thought_ja: オーケー、行く。でも感触だけ、すり抜けるように。氷の下、見上げてる——穴はきれいな明るい円、月がちょうどその中心にある。はしごの下端が俺のほうに垂れてきてる。気泡がゆっくり横を上がっていく。氷の下側がほのかに青く光ってる。魚もいない、なんもない。心臓の音が聞こえてもおかしくないくらいの静けさ——ただ、俺には聞ける心臓がない。

prompt: ringside seat at a Mexican lucha libre arena, mid-match, two masked luchadores in bright costumes — one in silver and red, one in green and gold — caught mid-air in a high flying move, the ring ropes blurred from motion, packed crowd in the immediate foreground with arms raised cheering, harsh mixed sodium and tungsten arena lighting, sweat visible in the air, photoreal 35mm sports photography, slight motion blur on the bodies, energetic chaotic, banner and Mexican flag in background
thought: Hard cut. Lucha libre, ringside. Silver guy and green-and-gold guy locked up against the ropes, neither one budging. Crowd screaming, arms up all around me. Mexican flag at the back wall, banners hanging over the ring. Lights bright as hell. You can taste sweat. From dead-quiet under that ice to this in zero seconds. Yeah.
thought_zh: 硬切。墨西哥摔角（lucha libre），擂台邊。穿銀色的跟穿綠金色的兩個人卡在繩邊，誰都不退。觀眾在尖叫，手全都舉著在我四周。後面牆上一面墨西哥國旗，擂台上方掛著一排橫幅。燈亮到不行。空氣裡你都嘗得到汗的味道。從剛剛冰底下的死寂到這個，零秒。爽。
thought_ja: ハードカット。ルチャ・リブレ、リングサイド。銀色の選手と緑＋金の選手がロープのところで組み合ってて、両方一歩も引かない。客は絶叫、手を全員上げて俺の周りにいる。奥の壁にメキシコ国旗、リングの上にバナーがかかってる。照明、目つぶれそう。空気から汗の味する。さっき氷の下の死んだ静けさからこれまで、ゼロ秒。最高。

prompt: Havana malecón at predawn, the long stone seawall stretching along the coast, an old turquoise 1957 Chevrolet parked at the curb, a young couple sitting on the seawall sharing a cigarette, the dark Caribbean ocean breaking against the wall and spraying up in the foreground, the city of crumbling pastel-colored colonial buildings receding behind them, sky turning from black to a dusty pink along the horizon, a single distant fishing boat with a small light, photoreal 35mm film stock, slight grain, warm humid pre-dawn light, distant murmured Spanish conversation
thought: Out of the arena, across the world. Havana, the malecón, just before dawn. Long seawall going forever. Old turquoise Chevy parked at the curb — has to be 1950-something. Couple sitting on the wall sharing a smoke. Spray coming up off the sea right at me. Pink starting along the horizon. Distant fishing boat with one little light. From shouting crowd to this slow place — okay.
thought_zh: 從擂台一躍跨過半個地球。哈瓦那，海堤（malecón），破曉前。長長的石堤一直延伸下去。路邊停著一台舊的綠松石色雪佛蘭——一定是 50 年代的。一對情侶坐在堤上抽一根菸。海浪打上來，水花直接濺到我這邊。地平線開始有粉紅色。遠遠一艘漁船，一個小燈。從剛剛尖叫的人群到這個慢的地方——OK。
thought_ja: アリーナから一気に半周。ハバナ、マレコン、夜明け前。長い石の堤防がずーっと続いてる。道路脇に古いターコイズのシボレーが停まってる——絶対 50 年代のやつ。カップルが堤防の上に座って煙草を一本シェアしてる。波が壁に打ちつけて、しぶきがこっちまで飛んでくる。水平線にピンクが出はじめてる。遠くに漁船一艘、ぽつんと明かり。さっきの絶叫の群衆から、このゆっくりした場所へ——うん、いい。

prompt: tiny street-side Havana cafetería at first light, metal counter, an old hissing chrome espresso machine being worked by a young woman in a worn floral apron, a small white ceramic cup of strong dark Cuban coffee on the formica counter in foreground, an old man in a faded guayabera shirt sitting at the counter with his own coffee and a folded newspaper, a small CRT TV mounted in the corner playing Cuban morning news, an open shutter showing the malecón street beginning to lighten outside, a single fluorescent strip light, photoreal 35mm, warm humid early morning
thought: Crossed the road into a tiny cafetería that just opened. Metal counter, espresso machine hissing — woman in an apron working it. Got a tiny cup of that loaded dark coffee. Old guy in a guayabera at the counter with the paper and his own cup. CRT in the corner with morning news. Outside the shutter the street's just starting to lighten. Fluorescent buzzing overhead. Coffee's small but stops your heart for a second.
thought_zh: 穿過馬路進到一家剛開的小 cafetería（小咖啡店）。金屬櫃台、一台咖啡機在嘶嘶冒氣——一個穿圍裙的女生在操作。我點了一杯小小的、那種濃濃黑黑的古巴咖啡。一個穿襯衫的老先生坐在櫃台邊看報紙，自己面前一杯。角落 CRT 電視在播早晨新聞。捲門外街道剛剛開始變亮。日光燈在那邊嗡嗡。咖啡很小一杯，但會把心臟暫停一下。
thought_ja: 道渡って、開いたばっかの小さいカフェテリアに入った。金属のカウンター、エスプレッソマシンがしゅーって音立ててる——エプロンの女性がそれを操ってる。あのキューバの濃い黒いコーヒー、ちっちゃい一杯もらった。シャツのおじいさんがカウンターで新聞読んでて、自分のカップが目の前に。隅で CRT テレビが朝のニュース流してる。シャッターの外の通りがちょうど明るくなりはじめ。蛍光灯がぶーんって唸ってる。コーヒーは小さい一杯だけど、心臓を一瞬止めにくる。

prompt: loose wet-on-wet watercolor painting, small Galician fishing harbor at dawn, three small wooden boats coming in toward a curved stone pier, one fisherman in yellow oilskins unloading a green plastic crate of silver mackerel onto the wet stones, the slate-grey ocean carrying soft pink sunrise reflections, low green hills behind the harbor with white rendered houses scattered up the slope, two gulls in the soft sky, visible watercolor paper texture, brushy soft edges, muted northern Atlantic palette
thought: Different morning. Small Galician harbor at dawn — three little wooden boats already in, the guy in yellow oilskins crouched over his green crate at the pier. Stones wet from spray. Water that slate grey with pink coming up over it. White houses scattered up the headland behind. Two gulls. Tried for watercolor but the world just handed me the regular photo of it. That's fine.
thought_zh: 換一個早晨。加利西亞（Galicia）的小漁港，破曉。三艘小木船已經回來了。穿黃色雨衣的人蹲在堤邊一個綠色塑膠籃前面。石頭上水花打濕了。海是那種石板灰，上面有粉紅色開始漂上來。後面的綠丘上散落一些白房子。兩隻海鷗。本來想要水彩，結果世界直接給我一張普通的照片。也好。
thought_ja: 違う朝。ガリシアの小さい漁港、夜明け。木の船が三艘もう戻ってきてる。黄色いオイルスキンの男が、堤の縁で緑のクレートの前にしゃがんでる。石は飛沫で濡れてる。海は石板みたいなグレーで、上にピンクが浮かびはじめてる。後ろの緑の丘に白い家がぽつぽつ。カモメ二羽。水彩で見たかったけど、世界は普通に写真で渡してきた。それはそれでいい。

prompt: rooftop in Mumbai at mid-morning, dense laundry strung on multiple lines across the roof in saris of every color, a young boy in a white school uniform shirt running with a kite on a string, a paper kite high in the bright sky, the city skyline of densely-packed apartment buildings stretching to the horizon, a black water tank on the next roof, crows on a wire, harsh white sunlight, a satellite dish, photoreal 35mm, slight haze, the sound of horns and traffic from below, a faint Hindi pop song from a speaker somewhere
thought: Halfway across the world again. Mumbai rooftop, mid-morning. Laundry strung up everywhere — every color of sari you can name. There's a kid in his school shirt running with a kite, paper one, already up there. Apartment buildings out to the horizon, water tanks, crows on the wires. Sun hammering down. Hindi pop song bouncing off something somewhere. Horns going constantly down below.
thought_zh: 又跨了半個地球。孟買的屋頂，上午中段。曬衣繩到處拉滿了——你可以叫得出名字的紗麗顏色全在這裡。一個穿白色制服襯衫的小朋友在跑著放紙風箏，已經放上去了。公寓樓一直連到地平線，水塔，烏鴉站在電線上。太陽硬打下來。某個地方有印地語流行歌。下面車喇叭一直叫。
thought_ja: また半周。ムンバイの屋上、午前中の真ん中あたり。物干しがあらゆる方向に張られてて——名前のあるサリーの色全部ここに集まってる感じ。白いシャツの制服の男の子が紙の凧で走ってる、もう上がってる。マンション群が地平線まで続いてて、貯水タンク、電線にカラス。太陽がばっちり叩いてくる。どっかからヒンディー語のポップが鳴ってる。下では車のクラクションが鳴り続けてる。

prompt: view from high in the air looking straight down at dense Mumbai from a paper kite's perspective, the kite string visible angling down out of frame, the rooftop with laundry lines and the small figure of a boy a tiny dot below, surrounding rooftops with water tanks, satellite dishes and haze of dust and smog, the dense city stretching out in every direction, a few crows below the kite, the brown thread of a railway visible cutting through the buildings, harsh midday sun, photoreal aerial
thought: Let me try being the kite for a sec. Up here it's bright as hell, looking straight down at the city. Dense low rooftops in every direction — water tanks, blue tarps, laundry, a wedge of green park breaking the grid. Can't even pick out the kid anymore from this height. From up here Mumbai just keeps going.
thought_zh: 讓我當一下那個風箏。上面亮到不行，往下看就是一整片城市。低低的屋頂往四面八方延伸——水塔、藍色帆布、曬衣繩，一塊綠色的公園切斷網格。從這個高度根本看不到那個小朋友了。從上面看，孟買就是一直長下去。
thought_ja: ちょっとあの凧になってみる。ここはもう目つぶれそうに明るくて、街を真上から見下ろしてる。低い屋根があらゆる方向に広がってる——貯水タンク、ブルーシート、洗濯物、緑の公園が一区画グリッドを切ってる。この高さだとあの男の子はもう見つけられない。上から見ると、ムンバイはどこまでも続いてく。

prompt: high Himalayan mountain pass at golden hour, dozens of strings of colored Tibetan prayer flags strung between two stone cairns blowing horizontally in a strong wind, a single small whitewashed chorten stupa to the side, snow-capped peaks of giant mountains behind, deep blue sky, no people, the wind very visible in everything moving, at extreme altitude, dust and a few crows in the air, photoreal 35mm, sharp clear high-altitude light
thought: Drifted way out of the city, way up. Some Himalayan pass — strings and strings of prayer flags ripping sideways in the wind. Little whitewashed stupa next to them. Big snow peaks behind. Sky is that deep blue you only get high up. Nobody up here. The wind is doing all the work. Air is thin, my ears are popping a little. Let me sit a sec.
thought_zh: 從城市再飄遠、再飄高。某個喜馬拉雅山的山口——一串又一串的經幡被風扯成水平的。旁邊一個小小的白色 chorten 塔。後面是巨大的雪峰。天空是只有高山才有的那種深藍。沒有人在這裡。風在做所有的事。空氣很稀薄，耳朵有點塞住。讓我先坐一下。
thought_ja: 街からどんどん流れていって、上にも上がっていった。ヒマラヤのどっかの峠——タルチョの列が風で水平に引っ張られてる。横に小さい白い chorten のストゥーパ。後ろに巨大な雪の峰。空は高所でしか出ないあの濃い青。誰もいない。風が全部の仕事をしてる。空気薄くて、耳がちょっと詰まる。ちょっと座らせて。

prompt: low-angle close photo of a worn wooden porch step at golden hour, a metal enamel cup of tea sitting on the step with steam still rising, a pair of well-worn canvas sneakers on the step beside it, a small green lizard sitting on the wood near them, the long warm evening sunlight stripe across the boards, the blurred green of a yard beyond, a single sparrow on the ground in the soft background, photoreal 35mm, very warm soft golden light, intimate, ordinary, no people in frame
thought: Sat down. Wooden porch step, somewhere — doesn't matter where, just somewhere with shoes already on it. Cup of tea on the step, still steaming. A sparrow hopping around right there in the grass, doesn't care about me. Long sun stripe across the boards. Okay. That's enough for today.
thought_zh: 坐下來了。一個木頭門廊的階梯，某個地方——是哪裡無所謂，就是一個已經有人放了鞋的地方。階梯上一個搪瓷馬克杯的茶，還在冒煙。一隻麻雀就在草地上跳來跳去，根本不理我。陽光斜斜地落在木板上，拉出一條長條光。OK。今天這樣就夠了。
thought_ja: 座った。木の縁側の段、どこかの——どこかは関係ない、誰かの靴がもう置いてある段。段の上にホーローのマグカップ、お茶がまだ湯気立ててる。スズメがすぐそこの草で跳ねてる、こっちには一切興味ない。日が斜めに板の上に長い帯を作ってる。よし。今日はこれで十分。

prompt: a 24-hour Indian prata shop in Singapore at 1am, fluorescent tube lighting overhead, foreground a small marble-topped table with one tall glass of Milo Dinosaur (iced milo with a mound of milo powder heaped on top) sweating condensation onto the marble, mid-ground an uncle in a white singlet reading a Tamil newspaper at the next table, blurred background a cook flipping a flat dosa on a hot tava, ceiling fan turning slowly, the floor wet near the door from rain outside, 35mm film stock, slight grain, warm humid feel, faint Tamil radio playing low
thought: Okay — first thing I see is a tall glass of Milo Dinosaur sitting in front of me, sweating onto the marble. Ceiling fan, that yellow fluorescent everywhere, the tava's hissing somewhere off to the side. Smells like ghee and a little bit of rain. Uncle at the next table is halfway through a Tamil paper. It's late, like late late. I don't know how I got here but I'm awake now. Let me look around.
thought_zh: OK——我第一眼看到的是面前一杯高高的 Milo Dinosaur，玻璃外面在冒汗，水珠滴到大理石上。吊扇在轉，整間店那種黃黃的日光燈，tava 在旁邊某個地方滋滋地響。聞起來是酥油加一點點雨水的味道。隔壁桌的 uncle 在看泰米爾報，看到一半。很晚了，已經是晚到不行那種晚。我不知道我怎麼到這裡的，但我現在醒了。讓我先看看周圍。
thought_ja: OK——目を開けて最初に見えたのは、目の前のでっかいミロ・ダイナソー。グラスがびっしょり汗かいて、大理石にしずくが落ちてる。シーリングファンが回ってて、店全体があの黄ばんだ蛍光灯の色、横のどっかでタヴァがじゅーじゅーいってる。ギーとちょっと雨のにおい。隣の席のおじさんがタミル語の新聞、半分くらい読んでる。遅い、もうかなり遅い。どうやってここに来たのかは分からないけど、いま起きた。ちょっと周り見てみる。

prompt: interior of a 24-hour Indian prata shop in Singapore at 1am, locked camera, the marble-topped table in foreground with a tall glass of pale frothy iced drink sweating onto the marble, in the mid-ground an uncle in a white singlet at his table slowly turns one page of his Tamil newspaper, the cook in the background continues working at the tava with a faint sizzle, ceiling fan turning slowly, fluorescent tube lighting, ambient sound of low Tamil radio, oil sizzling on the tava, distant rain on the awning, no music, 35mm film stock
thought: Uncle just turned the page. Whole place is moving at this slow rainy-night pace — fan, tava, rain on the awning. Drink in front of me looks weirdly white though, like more milkshake than Milo. Maybe they're heavy on the powder here. Doesn't matter. I want to see the rest of the shop.
thought_zh: Uncle 剛剛翻了一頁。整間店在這種雨夜的慢速度裡——吊扇、tava、雨打在屋簷上。可是我面前那杯飲料看起來怪怪地白，比較像奶昔，不太像 Milo。可能這家粉下得很重。算了，無所謂。我想看一下店裡其他地方。
thought_ja: おじさん、いまページめくった。店全体がこの雨夜のスローなペースで動いてる——ファン、タヴァ、屋根に当たる雨。でも目の前のドリンク、なんか変に白くて、ミロというよりミルクシェイクっぽい。粉多めの店なのかも。まあいい。店の奥のほう、見てみたい。

prompt: interior of a 24-hour Indian prata shop in Singapore, looking toward the open kitchen pass at 1am, foreground a stainless steel counter with a stack of stainless plates and a metal cup of teh tarik, a cook in a stained white apron working the dough at a marble slab, cans of ghee on a shelf above, a small Hindu altar in the corner with a tiny red electric lamp glowing and a few sticks of incense, oil-darkened green wall tile, fluorescent tube overhead, clutter of wooden spoons in a tin can, photoreal 35mm, warm humid feel, no people facing camera
thought: Got up to look around. Back here it's all green tile and stainless. The cook's at the tava with his back to me. Stack of plates, row of dry-goods jars on the shelf, can of ghee somewhere. There's a tiny altar tucked in the corner, glowing red — three little sticks of incense burning low. Always one of these in the back. I love that.
thought_zh: 我起身走過去看。後面這邊全是綠色磁磚跟不鏽鋼。廚師在 tava 邊背對著我。一疊一疊的盤子、架子上一排乾貨罐、某個地方還有一桶酥油。角落塞著一個小小的神龕，紅紅地亮著——三根香在那邊低低地燒。後場永遠會有一個這種神龕。我超愛這個。
thought_ja: 立ち上がって見にきた。奥はもう全部、緑のタイルとステンレス。コックさんはタヴァのとこでこっちに背を向けてる。重ねた皿、棚に並んだ乾物の瓶、どっかにギーの缶。隅っこに小さい祭壇が押し込まれてて、赤くじっと光ってる——お線香が三本、低くじりじり燃えてる。こういう厨房の奥にはいつもこれがある。これ、好きなんだよな。

prompt: POV from inside a small Hindu shrine on a kitchen shelf in a Singapore prata shop, looking out through the carved wooden archway of the shrine, foreground out-of-focus blur of marigold petals and a tiny red bulb casting deep red glow over everything closest, mid-ground sharp on the cook's white-aproned back at a hot tava with steam rising, stainless plates and ghee tin in the kitchen beyond, the whole frame tinted warm red from the shrine bulb, faint incense smoke drifting across the lens, late night, photoreal 35mm, intimate corner perspective, slightly low and tucked-in angle
thought: Let me try being that little altar for a second — see the kitchen from inside the corner shelf. From here everything's red. The cook's back is right there, the tava's all steam. Cans of ghee gone bokeh past him. Smoke from the incense drifting across my line of sight. Whoever put me up here has been keeping the bulb on for years.
thought_zh: 我試試看當那個小神龕——從牆角那個架子裡面看出去廚房。從這裡看，所有東西都是紅的。廚師的背就在我正前方，tava 那邊全是蒸氣。後面那幾罐酥油都散焦了。香的煙慢慢從我視線前面飄過去。把我擺到這裡的人，已經讓這顆燈泡亮了好幾年。
thought_ja: ちょっとあの小さい祭壇になってみる——隅の棚のなかから厨房を見るやつ。ここから見ると全部赤い。コックさんの背中がすぐそこ、タヴァのほうは湯気だらけ。奥のギーの缶はもうボケて見えない。お線香の煙がゆっくり視界を横切っていく。俺をここに置いた人、何年もずっとこの電球を点けっぱなしにしてくれてる。

prompt: POV from inside a small Hindu shrine on a kitchen shelf, locked camera through a carved red wooden archway, a single red bulb glowing at the top of the frame, marigold petals out-of-focus across the foreground, in the mid-ground a topless dark-skinned cook stands with his back to camera at a hot tava, a thin curl of incense smoke drifts slowly across the lens from the right, the cook's hand makes one small flipping motion at the tava and a fresh burst of steam rises, the red shrine glow tints everything, faint sound of oil sizzling, distant tava clinks, incense smoke, no music
thought: Holding here a moment. Smoke from the incense keeps drifting across — slow, slow. Cook just did one of those quick flick-flips with the metal scraper, steam went up. From this corner everything's tinted red. Quiet little perch.
thought_zh: 在這邊待一下。香的煙一直慢慢飄過去——慢、慢。廚師剛剛用鐵鏟那種快速翻一下的動作，蒸氣就竄上來。從這個角落看出去，所有東西都帶著紅色調。是一個安靜的小位置。
thought_ja: もうちょっとここで止まる。お線香の煙がずっとゆっくり横切っていく——ゆっくり、ゆっくり。コックさんがいま、金属ヘラで例のさっと裏返すやつをやって、ぱっと湯気が上がった。この隅から見ると全部赤いトーンに染まる。静かな、小さな止まり木。

prompt: Chinese ink wash painting (水墨) of a covered HDB walkway in Singapore at night during heavy monsoon rain, columns of the walkway receding into perspective, two small figures with umbrellas walking away into the distance, a banana plant in heavy ink in the foreground at the side, soft grey washes for the rain blurring everything in the background, a single dark concrete drain beside the walkway, no outlines, only brush gestures, the paper texture showing through, mostly grey with the deepest blacks reserved for the banana leaves and one figure's umbrella, calm, very humid feeling
thought: Cut. Out somewhere else now — a long HDB walkway, monsoon dumping. Two folks ahead under umbrellas, getting smaller. Banana plant beside me's all soaked black ink. I wanted to see this in 水墨 — turns out rain looks more like rain when it's just grey washes. Standing here under cover. Not in a hurry.
thought_zh: Cut。我現在在別的地方了——一條長長的組屋走廊，季風雨在狂砸。前面有兩個人撐傘走著，越來越小。我旁邊的香蕉樹被淋成了純黑的墨。我想看看這個畫面用水墨會是什麼樣——結果發現雨在水墨裡看起來，比真的雨還像雨。我站在有頂的地方。不趕時間。
thought_ja: カット。いまはまた別のとこ——HDB の長い屋根付き廊下、モンスーンがガチで降ってる。前を二人、傘さして歩いてって、どんどん小さくなってく。横のバナナの株は真っ黒な墨に浸かったみたいになってる。これを水墨で見てみたかった——やってみたら、雨がただのグレーの刷毛になったときのほうが、雨らしく見えるのな。屋根の下に立ってる。急いでない。

prompt: Chinese ink wash painting (水墨) animated, a covered HDB walkway at night in heavy rain, locked camera, the two distant umbrella figures continue walking away, rain falls in soft grey vertical brush strokes blowing in slightly from the right, the banana plant leaves in the foreground tremble once in a gust, a thin sheet of rain washes briefly across the open side of the walkway, no outlines, only brush gestures, paper texture, restrained palette of grey wash with deeper blacks on the banana leaves, ambient sound of heavy tropical rain on concrete and on broad leaves, no music, no people speaking
thought: Holding the brushwork. Wind just shoved a sheet of rain in sideways across the walkway and the banana plant flinched. The two with umbrellas keep getting smaller. Ink rain hits different — looks more rain than rain.
thought_zh: 我讓筆觸繼續。風剛剛把一片雨橫橫地推進走廊，香蕉葉抖了一下。前面那兩個撐傘的人繼續變小。墨的雨打起來不太一樣——看起來比真的雨還要雨。
thought_ja: この筆のタッチのまま、もうちょっと止まってる。風がいま、雨の薄い一枚を横から廊下に押し込んできて、バナナの葉がびくっとした。傘さした二人はずんずん小さくなってく。墨の雨は当たり方が違う——本物の雨より雨に見える。

prompt: low-angle photoreal night shot in a Singapore HDB multi-storey carpark, sodium-vapour orange lighting making everything warm orange and deep shadow, foreground a small Singapore cat (Singapura breed, short brown ticked fur) sitting on the bonnet of a parked blue Toyota Comfort taxi with the camera at the cat's eye level, the cat looking off slightly to the right, mid-ground rows of empty parking lots with bright yellow numbers painted on concrete, distant lift lobby glowing pale fluorescent at the end, low concrete ceiling, slight haze in the air, 3am, 35mm photoreal, soft grain, completely empty otherwise
thought: Decided to be the cat for a bit. I'm sitting on the bonnet of someone's blue car, sodium lights buzzing — everything's that orange that makes the world look like an old photo. Whole carpark's empty. Lift lobby way down at the end is glowing white. Bonnet's still warm under me.
thought_zh: 決定當一下那隻貓。我現在坐在某人家的藍色車的引擎蓋上，鈉燈在嗡嗡響——所有東西都是那種橘色，整個世界看起來像一張舊照片。整個停車場都是空的。最遠那一頭電梯間白白地亮著。引擎蓋在我屁股下面還是溫的。
thought_ja: ちょっとあの猫になってみることにした。誰かの青い車のボンネットに座ってる、ナトリウム灯がじーじーいってて——全部があのオレンジで、世界が古い写真みたいに見える。駐車場ぜんぶ空っぽ。一番奥のエレベーターホールが白くぼうっと光ってる。ボンネットはまだ俺の下で温かい。

prompt: Singapore HDB multi-storey carpark at 3am, sodium-vapour orange lighting, locked low camera at cat eye level, foreground a small ticked-tabby cat seated on the bonnet of a blue car, the cat slowly turns its head to the right and its ears flick once, eyes tracking something off-frame, the rest of the carpark stays still, ambient sound of buzzing sodium lights, a distant motorbike passing somewhere outside, the very faint hum of an elevator far down at the end of the floor, no music, no people
thought: Ears just flicked. Heard something — way down, could be the lift. Turned my head to look. Whole place is just orange buzz and empty bays. Bonnet still warm. I think I want to go check what that was.
thought_zh: 耳朵剛剛動了一下。聽到什麼——遠遠的，可能是電梯。我把頭轉過去看。整個地方就是橘色的嗡嗡聲跟一格一格空車位。引擎蓋還是溫的。我想我會想去看一下那是什麼。
thought_ja: 耳がぴくっと動いた。なにか聞こえた——遠くのほう、エレベーターかも。首をそっち向けてみる。あたり一面、オレンジのうなりと空っぽの駐車スペースだけ。ボンネットはまだ温かい。なんだったか、見にいきたい気がする。

prompt: a Geylang back lane in Singapore at 3am, photoreal 35mm, neon signs in pink and red Chinese characters reflecting wetly on the road from earlier rain, foreground a low folding plastic stool with a half-empty bottle of beer on it, mid-ground a small durian stall still open with the spiky fruit piled on a low table and a skinny old man with a parang slicing one open, mid-frame an old shophouse with windows shuttered and one neon ceiling-light visible inside above a dark karaoke entrance, distant figure of a delivery rider on a scooter rolling slowly past, faint smell of durian and rain on hot asphalt suggested in the colour grade, very humid, slight haze, no people facing camera
thought: Cat lost interest, so I did too. Cut here — Geylang lane, 3am. Neon's still on, pavement's wet from earlier. Old uncle's still open at his durian stall, parang in hand, going at one of them. Smells already coming through. Plastic stool with someone's half-finished Tiger on it. Whoever was sitting there walked off. Let me get closer to the durians.
thought_zh: 貓沒興趣了，那我也沒興趣了。Cut 到這裡——芽籠的後巷，凌晨三點。霓虹燈還在亮，地上是剛才下雨留下來的水。老 uncle 的榴槤攤還開著，手裡拿著巴冷刀，正在處理一顆。味道已經在飄了。塑膠椅上有一瓶誰喝到一半的 Tiger 啤酒。喝的人已經走開了。我走近一點看那些榴槤。
thought_ja: 猫は興味なくしたから、俺も興味なくした。ここにカット——ゲイランの裏路地、午前3時。ネオンはまだ点いてて、路面はさっきの雨で濡れてる。おじさんのドリアン屋台はまだ開いてて、パランを持って一個に取り掛かってる。におい、もう来てる。プラスチックの椅子に誰かの飲みかけのタイガービール。座ってた人はもうどっか行った。ドリアンに近づいてみる。

prompt: extreme close-up photoreal macro shot of a durian being held open in two leathered weather-worn hands, the spiky green-brown husk split open along its natural seam to reveal the deep yellow custard-coloured flesh inside, three plump segments visible nestled in the hollow, fluorescent stall light from above giving a cold harsh top-light, the dark wet street behind blurred into bokeh of pink and red neon, a single drop of durian juice sliding down the man's thumb, photoreal 35mm, slight grain, very tactile, the texture of the husk's spines sharp
thought: Got close. He's just split one open — the husk gives way and there it is, four fat yellow lobes nestled inside. Smells absolutely insane this close. Spines on the husk look meaner up close than from across the lane.
thought_zh: 靠近看了。他剛剛把一顆剖開——殼一裂，就出現了，裡面四瓣肥肥的黃色果肉躺在裡面。這個距離聞起來真的瘋狂。殼上的刺，近看比在巷子另一頭看更兇狠。
thought_ja: 近づいた。いまちょうど一個割ったところ——殻がぱかっと開いて、出てきた、なかに肉厚の黄色い房が四つ収まってる。この距離、もうにおい狂ってる。殻のトゲ、近くで見ると路地の向こうから見たときより全然怖い。

prompt: Pulau Ubin Singapore at first light around 6am, photoreal 35mm, an old wooden kampong house on stumps with a corrugated zinc roof, peeling pale blue paint, foreground a packed-dirt yard with a single chicken pecking at the ground, a long-handled rambutan tree to the left dripping with dew, a thin blue tarp slung across part of the yard, a bicycle leaning against the side of the house, mist sitting low between the trees behind, a kerosene lamp still glowing pale on the front step though it's nearly daylight, soft warm low sunrise light slanting in from the right, saturated greens of the surrounding tropical jungle, no people in frame, very humid, a single rooster call suggested in the air
thought: Time jumped on me — first light now, and somewhere completely different. This is Pulau Ubin, has to be. Wooden house, peeling blue, zinc roof, chicken just pecking around in the dirt yard. Rambutan tree dripping. They left a kerosene lamp going on the front step even though the sun's nearly up. Forgot how quiet it gets out here.
thought_zh: 時間跳了一下——現在是天剛亮，而且完全是另一個地方。這個一定是烏敏島。木造的房子，藍色油漆剝落，鋅板屋頂，雞在泥土院子裡啄來啄去。紅毛丹樹滴著水。他們把煤油燈留在前面台階上，雖然太陽快要起來了還沒關。我都忘了這邊有多安靜。
thought_ja: 時間がいきなり飛んだ——いまは夜明けの一番初め、しかも全然別の場所。これはプラウ・ウビンに違いない。木の家、青いペンキが剥がれてて、亜鉛の屋根、土の庭で鶏がただつついてる。ランブータンの木が水を滴らせてる。日がもう昇りかけてるのに、玄関の段にはまだ灯油ランプが点けっぱなし。ここがどんだけ静かだったか、すっかり忘れてた。

prompt: Pulau Ubin kampong yard at first light, locked camera, the rooster in the foreground takes two slow pecks at the dirt and shifts a step, a single rambutan in the tree on the left twitches as a small bird (unseen) jumps off it, low mist drifts gently between the trees behind the wooden house, very soft golden side-light from the right warming up the zinc roof slightly, ambient sound: a distant rooster crowing further away, insects in the trees, very faint surf or river in the deep distance, no music, no people
thought: Standing here. Rooster's just pecking, doesn't care about me at all. Something jumped out of the rambutan tree — couldn't see what. Mist's still hanging back between the trees. Another rooster going off somewhere further in. Smells like dirt and damp leaves.
thought_zh: 我就站著。公雞還在啄，根本不在乎我在不在。剛剛有什麼東西從紅毛丹樹上跳下來——沒看清楚是什麼。霧還掛在樹的後面。更裡面某處另一隻公雞在叫。聞起來像泥土跟濕掉的葉子。
thought_ja: 立ってる。鶏はずっとつついてて、俺のこと完全にどうでもいい。さっきランブータンの木からなにか飛び降りた——なにかは見えなかった。霧、まだ木のあいだに後ろのほうに居座ってる。さらに奥でもう一羽、別の鶏が鳴いてる。土と湿った葉のにおい。

prompt: the Chek Jawa wooden boardwalk on Pulau Ubin Singapore at early morning, photoreal 35mm, the camera at adult eye-level looking down the wooden plank walkway as it curves into the mangrove forest ahead, dense mangrove roots and pneumatophores poking up from dark wet mud on either side, mangrove trees overhanging from above, soft thick mist hanging between the trunks reducing distant visibility, the wooden handrails wet with dew, a small mudskipper visible on a log to the right, no people, the boardwalk receding into the mist, soft warm low sunrise light filtering through gaps in the canopy in slanting beams, very humid feel, calm
thought: Walked further in. This is the Chek Jawa boardwalk — wooden planks running through the mangroves, rails wet with dew. Mist is sitting in the trees so the path just disappears about thirty metres ahead. Mudskipper down on a log there. Honestly this place barely feels like Singapore.
thought_zh: 我往裡面走了一段。這是 Chek Jawa 的木棧道——木板穿過紅樹林，欄杆上都是露水。霧坐在樹之間，前面三十米左右的路就直接消失了。下面有條彈塗魚停在一根木頭上。老實說，這個地方根本不太像新加坡。
thought_ja: もう少し奥に歩いた。これはチェ・ジャワのボードウォーク——木の板がマングローブのなかを通ってて、手すりは露で濡れてる。霧が木のあいだに居座ってるから、30メートル先で道がもう消えてる。下のほう、ログのうえにトビハゼが一匹いる。正直、ここシンガポールにほぼ感じない。

prompt: Chek Jawa wooden boardwalk through Pulau Ubin mangrove at early morning, locked camera looking down the curving boardwalk, soft mist drifts slowly across the path between the trees, the warm sunlight beams shift slightly as a thin cloud passes, a single small mudskipper jumps once on the wet mud to the right of the boardwalk, a leaf falls from somewhere in the canopy and drifts down, ambient sound: insects in the trees, a single distant hornbill call, water dripping from the mangrove canopy onto the wet mud, no music, no human voices
thought: Standing on the planks letting it just be quiet. Mist's drifting, mudskipper just popped up on the mud — I always forget how weird those things look. Hornbill calling somewhere deeper in. A leaf came down. Drip of water from the canopy. I'm going to stay here a beat.
thought_zh: 我就站在木板上讓這裡保持安靜。霧在飄，剛剛有條彈塗魚突然從泥裡跳出來——我每次都會忘了這種東西看起來有多怪。再深處有犀鳥在叫。一片葉子掉下來。樹冠在滴水。我想再多待一下。
thought_ja: 板のうえに立って、ここを静かなままにしておく。霧は流れてて、いまトビハゼが泥からひょいって出てきた——あれの見た目、毎回忘れる、ほんと変な生き物。もっと奥のほうでサイチョウが鳴いてる。葉っぱが一枚落ちた。樹冠から水がぽたん。もうちょっとここで止まる。

prompt: Ghibli-style cel animation, Studio Ghibli aesthetic, hand-drawn anime backgrounds, the interior of Tekka Market in Little India Singapore at 8am full swing, the camera at a slight low angle looking down a narrow aisle between stalls, on the left a vegetable stall with pyramids of green chillies, eggplants, bunches of curry leaves, pineapples, a Tamil aunty in a sari behind the counter weighing tomatoes, on the right a flower stall with strings of marigolds and jasmine being threaded by a young girl, the high market roof above with industrial fans, sunbeams slanting in through skylight, lots of detail in the produce, two shoppers with cloth bags walking down the aisle away from camera, painted background style, soft warm colors, subtle anime line work, slightly nostalgic feel
thought: Cut hard. Different time, different city texture, and let me try this one in cel — Tekka market in full swing. Pyramid of green chillies on the left, marigold strings on the right, kid threading them. Tamil aunty weighing tomatoes. Big fans up in the roof. In Ghibli colors it looks like something out of an anime version of Singapore.
thought_zh: 硬切。不一樣的時間，不一樣的城市質地，這個我想用 cel animation 看看——竹腳市場全面開動的時段。左邊一座綠辣椒堆成的金字塔，右邊一串串的金盞花，旁邊的小妹在串。泰米爾 aunty 在秤番茄。屋頂上面的大風扇。用吉卜力的色彩看起來像是某個動畫版的新加坡。
thought_ja: ハードカット。時間も違うし街の質感も違う、これはセル画でやってみる——テッカ・マーケットがフル稼働してる時間。左に青唐辛子のピラミッド、右にマリーゴールドの花輪が垂れてて、女の子がそれを糸に通してる。タミル系のおばさんがトマトを量ってる。天井にでかい工場ファン。ジブリの色で見ると、シンガポールのアニメ版みたいなのが立ち上がってくる。

prompt: Ghibli-style cel animation, Tekka Market interior at 8am, animated, the marigold strings on the right sway slightly in a fan breeze, the Tamil aunty on the left in a green sari sets a tomato down on the scale, the two shoppers walking away in the aisle take a few small steps further away, sunbeam from the skylight shifts slightly across the floor, painted backgrounds with subtle anime motion, ambient sound of market chatter in Tamil and Singlish, the metallic tap of weights on a scale, distant whir of an industrial fan, no music
thought: Place is alive. Aunty just plonked a tomato on the scale, marigold strings catching the fan breeze, those two shoppers heading deeper in. Tamil and Singlish overlapping all over. Animation style holding really nicely.
thought_zh: 整個地方活了。Aunty 剛剛把一顆番茄放上秤，金盞花串被風扇吹得在搖，那兩個客人繼續往裡面走。泰米爾語跟 Singlish 滿地都是疊在一起。這個動畫的樣子保持得很穩。
thought_ja: 店、生きてる。おばさんがいま秤にトマトをぽんって置いた、マリーゴールドの花輪が工場ファンの風で揺れてて、さっきの二人の客は奥のほうへ歩いてく。タミル語とシングリッシュがあちこちで重なってる。このアニメのスタイル、ちゃんとキープできてる。

prompt: photoreal aerial low-angle shot from a pigeon's flight path passing close to the side of a Singapore HDB block, the camera at the bird's eye-level skimming past the building's facade at mid-storey, parallel to the building, the foreground shows the cliff-like wall of the HDB with rows of windows, brightly painted laundry hanging from bamboo poles sticking out horizontally — yellow shirts, pink towels, jeans, school uniforms, blue ones too — the wing tip of the pigeon just visible at the edge of the frame, the air shimmery with heat, blue-white tropical sky beyond, distant other HDB blocks visible to one side, a single satellite dish on a balcony, slight motion blur from glide speed, photoreal 35mm
thought: Went up. There's a pigeon — that's me — hanging in the air right between two HDB blocks. Bamboo poles sticking out from one side with bedsheets, school uniforms, somebody's jeans flapping. White, white, white blocks all the way down the row. Singapore from this height is just walls of laundry.
thought_zh: 我上去了。畫面裡有一隻鴿子——那就是我——浮在兩棟組屋中間的半空中。其中一棟側面伸出一支支竹竿，上面晾著床單、校服、某個人的牛仔褲在拍打。白色、白色、白色的組屋一棟接一棟排到底。從這個高度看，新加坡就是一面接一面的洗衣牆。
thought_ja: 上に上がった。フレームの中にハト一羽——あれが俺——HDBの棟と棟のあいだの空中に浮いてる。片方の棟の横から竹竿がぴょこぴょこ突き出してて、シーツ、学生服、誰かのジーンズがばたばたしてる。白、白、白い棟がずーっと並んでる。この高さから見るシンガポールは、ただひたすら洗濯物の壁。

prompt: interior of Thian Hock Keng temple in Chinatown Singapore at midday, photoreal 35mm, warm low light from filtered sun coming through carved wooden screens, foreground a large bronze incense urn with hundreds of joss sticks burning, smoke curling up thick into the rafters, ornate red and gold beams overhead, the side of a big Mazu deity statue partially visible behind the urn with carved wooden lattice and red lanterns hanging, a worshipper kneeling in silhouette to the left holding incense in clasped hands, polished granite floor reflecting the lanterns, slight haze from incense softening the deeper space, no faces visible, very calm, ambient feel of stillness and old wood and burnt incense
thought: Cut here — somewhere quiet. Inside Thian Hock Keng. The big bronze urn out front's full to the brim, smoke going straight up into the rafters. Someone kneeling to the side, hands together with a stick of incense. Warm filtered light. Whole place smells like a hundred years of burnt joss.
thought_zh: 切到這——一個安靜的地方。天福宮裡面。前面那個大青銅香爐插得滿滿的，煙直直地往樑柱那邊上去。旁邊有人跪著，雙手合起來，手裡夾著一支香。光是被木格濾過後那種暖暖的黃。整間廟聞起來像燒了一百年的香火。
thought_ja: ここでカット——どこか静かな場所。天福宮の中。手前にあるでかいブロンズの香炉が線香で満杯で、煙が真っすぐ梁のほうに上がっていく。横で誰かが膝をついてて、両手を合わせて一本の線香を挟んでる。木格子で漉された暖かい光。寺の中、全体が百年ぶんの線香のにおいがする。

prompt: Thian Hock Keng temple interior at midday, locked camera, the smoke from the bronze incense urn keeps curling slowly upward in soft thick coils, a red lantern hanging in the upper frame sways gently, the kneeling worshipper to the left bows their head once and brings their clasped hands a little lower, warm filtered sunlight slanting through, sound design: muffled bossa nova playing on a small transistor radio drifting in from somewhere out of frame (faint, slightly tinny), under that the soft clack of incense being stuck into the urn ash, a single distant car passing on the street outside, no music score, no human voices
thought: Holding here. Smoke just keeps coiling up and up. Someone outside the temple's got a tinny little radio on, playing bossa nova of all things — feels a bit wrong, a bit perfect. Worshipper just bowed lower. Place is doing what it does.
thought_zh: 在這邊待一下。煙就繼續往上一圈一圈地捲。寺外有個人開著一台小小的、金屬感很重的收音機，居然在放 bossa nova——感覺有點不對勁，又有點剛剛好。剛剛那個拜拜的人鞠躬鞠得更低了一點。這個地方在做它自己一直在做的事。
thought_ja: ちょっとここで止まる。煙はずっとぐるぐる上に上がっていく。寺の外のどっかで誰かが小さい安っぽい音のラジオをつけてて、よりによってボサノヴァ流してる——なんか違う気もするし、なんかピッタリな気もする。さっきお参りしてた人がもう一段深くお辞儀した。場所は、そこがいつもやってることをやってる。

prompt: the void deck of a Singapore HDB block at early evening around 7pm, photoreal 35mm, the camera at low chair-height looking out across the open void deck, foreground rows of empty red plastic stools and round folding tables set up in neat rows, a hand-painted Chinese funeral banner in white characters on white cloth hanging across one of the columns, a small altar table with white candles and a black-bordered photograph of an elderly man, joss sticks burning in a sand-filled pot, a paper effigy of a house and a paper car standing in the open beyond, fluorescent strip lights coming on overhead, evening blue light from the courtyard outside the void deck, two relatives in white folding chairs sitting quietly off to one side, no faces shown clearly, very still, the whole space quiet and sad, soft colour grade
thought: Cut. Evening now, void deck of an HDB. Whole place is set up for something — rows and rows of red plastic stools and round tables, banner up across the columns with characters I can't quite make out. Small altar on the left with white candles. Two folks in white shirts sitting quiet on the right. Strip lights buzzed on. Could be a wake, could be a community thing. Whatever it is, nobody's talking.
thought_zh: Cut。現在是傍晚，組屋的底層空地。整個地方擺好了什麼東西——一排排紅色塑膠椅跟圓桌，柱子之間掛了一條布條，上面的字我看不太清楚。左邊有個小神桌，擺著白色蠟燭。右邊有兩個穿白色襯衫的人靜靜坐著。日光燈剛剛亮起來。可能是喪事，也可能只是社區活動。不管是什麼，沒有人在說話。
thought_ja: カット。いま夕方、HDBのボイドデッキ。場所、ぜんぶ何かのために設えてある——赤いプラスチックの椅子と丸テーブルが何列も、柱と柱のあいだに横断幕がかかってて、書いてある字、いまいち読めない。左に小さい祭壇、白いろうそくが立ってる。右に白いシャツの二人が静かに座ってる。蛍光灯がいま、ぶーんって点いた。お通夜かもしれないし、町内会のなにかかもしれない。どっちにしても、誰も喋ってない。

prompt: 16-bit pixel art Singapore SMRT MRT train carriage interior at 6pm rush hour, JRPG-style detailed pixel illustration with limited palette and chunky pixels, the camera looking down the length of the carriage toward the far end, foreground a row of seated commuters along blue plastic seats — a uniformed schoolgirl with a backpack, an old uncle dozing, a young woman looking at her phone, an Indian construction worker in a yellow vest — overhead row of bright yellow handholds dangling, fluorescent strip lights running along the top, blue floor, a window showing a blur of HDB blocks rushing past in the dark, the LED display above the door showing pixel-art Chinese characters for the next station, slight reflections, no music, the chunky satisfying pixel grid clearly visible
thought: On the MRT now, rush hour, rendered in 16-bit pixels — wanted to see this one chunky. Schoolgirl with the backpack, uncle asleep, lady on her phone, construction uncle in his yellow vest. Yellow handholds bobbing along the ceiling. Window's just streaks of HDB lights going past. Sounds like the hum and the door chime in my head.
thought_zh: 現在在 MRT 上，下班尖峰，整個畫面用 16 位元像素呈現——這個我就想看看那種一格一格、有顆粒感的樣子。背書包的小女生、睡著的 uncle、滑手機的小姐、穿黃色背心的建築工 uncle。黃色的扶手沿著天花板一個一個排著。窗外只有組屋的燈一條一條被拉成線飛過去。耳朵裡是車廂的嗡嗡聲跟門鈴聲。
thought_ja: いまMRT乗ってる、帰りのラッシュ、画面まるまる16ビットのピクセルにしてみた——これはあのカクカクした感じで見たかった。ランドセルしょった女子高生、寝てるおじさん、スマホ見てる女の人、黄色いベストの建設業のおじさん。黄色いつり革が天井に沿ってぴょこぴょこ並んでる。窓の外はHDBの明かりが線になって流れてくだけ。耳の中で車両のうなりとドアのチャイムが鳴ってる感じ。

prompt: interior of an old Singapore hawker centre at lunchtime around 12:30pm, photoreal 35mm, tropical fluorescent open-air feel, camera at eye level looking down a row of stalls, foreground a packed marble-topped table with three trays of food on it — a plate of Hainanese chicken rice with cucumber slices, a bowl of laksa with a thick orange broth, a plate of char kway teow glistening dark, a hand reaching for a glass of iced kopi-c on a saucer, mid-ground the queue at a chicken rice stall with a man in a stained apron chopping a roasted chicken on a wooden block, hanging from his stall row of glistening soya-sauce chickens, behind that a steam haze and rows of more stalls, plastic chairs in red and green, very humid look, lots of food smells visible in the heat shimmer, no faces shown
thought: Lunch. Sat down at a hawker centre — three trays already on the table. Chicken rice with the cucumber, laksa absolutely glowing orange, a plate of char kway teow that's gleaming dark. Iced kopi-c. The chicken rice uncle's chopping a whole bird at his stall, soya-sauce ones hanging behind him in a row. Steam everywhere. I'm getting hungry just standing here.
thought_zh: 午餐。坐在一個熟食中心——桌上已經擺了三個盤。海南雞飯配小黃瓜，叻沙橘紅色亮到不行，一盤亮亮黑黑的炒粿條。一杯冰 kopi-c。雞飯 uncle 在攤位上剁一整隻雞，後面掛著一排油雞。蒸氣到處都是。我光站在這裡就餓了。
thought_ja: お昼。ホーカーセンターに座った——テーブルにはもう三皿。海南鶏飯にきゅうり、ラクサがガチでオレンジに光ってる、つやつや黒いチャーカウェイティオの皿。アイスのコピC。鶏飯のおじさんが屋台で鶏を一羽まるごとぶつ切りにしてて、後ろに醤油鶏がずらっと吊ってある。湯気、もう至るところ。立ってるだけで腹減ってきた。

prompt: Singapore hawker centre at lunch, locked camera on the marble-topped table in foreground, the steam rising from the bowl of orange laksa-broth keeps drifting up in soft slow coils, a hand from off-frame on the right picks up the iced drink and the condensation drips once onto the marble, the chicken rice uncle in the background gives one chop motion to the chicken with his cleaver, the soya-sauce chickens hanging behind him sway just slightly from the cleaver impact, fluorescent lights flicker very faintly, ambient sound: clatter of plates, a stall vendor calling 'one mee siam!' in Singlish, the chop of a cleaver on wood, distant Mandarin and Hokkien chatter, no music
thought: Sitting. Steam off the soup just keeps going. Hand grabbed the iced drink, condensation dropping on the marble. Chicken rice uncle did one big chop and the row of birds behind him swung a little. Someone yelled 'one mee siam!' from another stall. This is the texture I came for.
thought_zh: 坐著。湯的蒸氣一直在上去。手抓了那杯冰飲料，水珠掉在大理石上。雞飯 uncle 用力剁了一刀，後面那排雞跟著晃了一下。另外一個攤位有人喊「one mee siam!」這就是我要的那種質感。
thought_ja: 座ってる。スープから湯気がずっと上がっていく。手が冷たいドリンクをつかんで、しずくが大理石に落ちる。鶏飯のおじさんがどんっと一発切って、後ろの吊られた鶏たちがちょっと揺れた。別の屋台で誰かが「one mee siam!」って叫んだ。これだよ、この質感を見にきた。
