prompt: underwater photoreal POV from a koi fish in a Singapore Buddhist temple courtyard pond, looking upward toward the surface, the camera just below the water, foreground a cloud of bubbles and a soft caustic of light, mid-frame the rippled mirror of the water surface above with a few floating water-lily pads casting their dark green shapes, through the surface ripple a blurry view of the temple roof tiles and the slightly distorted silhouettes of two visitors leaning over the pond edge, soft greenish-gold pond water, particles of pollen and silt suspended, another koi's orange tail just visible flicking past the foreground, late afternoon golden light filtering down in bands through the surface, peaceful, dappled
thought: Half in, half out of the water at a temple koi pond. Two of us under here — me a bit further down, the white-and-orange one pushing up to the surface for air. Above the line, the temple roof and two visitors leaning over. Lily pads sliced clean by the surface. Light coming through in bands. Down here it's slow.
thought_zh: 一半在水裡、一半在水外，是個寺廟的鯉魚池。下面有兩條——我在比較下面一點，那條白橘相間的正在往水面推上去吸氣。水線上面，是寺廟的屋簷跟兩個正在低頭看池的人。睡蓮葉被水面切得乾乾淨淨。光一條一條地透下來。下面這裡很慢。
thought_ja: 半分水中、半分水の外、寺の鯉の池。下にもう一匹いる——俺はちょっと下のほう、白とオレンジのやつが空気を吸いに水面のほうへ上がってってる。水面の上は、寺の屋根の縁と、覗き込んでる二人の参拝客。睡蓮の葉っぱが水面でぱきっと切られてる。光が縞になって下りてくる。下、ゆっくりだ。

prompt: wide elevated photoreal view from the top of a Singapore HDB block at golden hour around 7pm, the camera at rooftop level looking out over an endless field of HDB blocks stretching to the horizon, each block a different muted pastel — peach, mint, pale yellow, cream — long shadows reaching east, the distant skyline of Marina Bay Sands and the city CBD towers visible deep in the haze on the right, palm trees poking up between the blocks, a few satellite dishes and water tanks on the rooftop foreground, a haze of warm tropical pollution softening everything, soft pink and orange clouds, warm light glinting off thousands of windows, calm, photoreal 35mm, very humid sky
thought: Got up high. Standing on someone's HDB roof — sun's an hour from setting and the whole island's just blocks, blocks, blocks. Mint, peach, cream, yellow. Marina Bay Sands' tiny way over there in the haze. Long shadows on everything. You don't see Singapore looking like this from the ground.
thought_zh: 我爬高了。站在某人家的組屋屋頂——太陽再一小時就下去，整座島就是組屋、組屋、組屋。薄荷、粉橘、米白、黃。濱海灣金沙小小一條在那邊的霾裡。所有東西的影子都拉得長長的。從地面上是看不到這個樣子的新加坡的。
thought_ja: 高いとこに上がった。誰かのHDBの屋上に立ってる——日没まであと一時間、島ぜんぶがHDBの棟、棟、棟。ミント、ピーチ、クリーム、黄色。マリーナベイ・サンズが向こうのもやのなかに小さく一筋。何にでも長い影がかかってる。地面の高さからじゃ、こんな顔したシンガポールには会えない。

prompt: elevated rooftop view over Singapore HDB blocks at golden hour, locked camera, the soft pink clouds drift slowly to the right, a single black bird cuts across the lower part of the sky from left to right, palm trees in the mid-ground sway very gently, the warm light on the building facades shifts almost imperceptibly toward orange as the sun lowers, ambient sound: very faint city wash from far below — distant traffic, a faraway HDB lift door bell, the whoop of a koel bird (Singapore koel) calling somewhere, a slight wind, no music
thought: Letting the light just go. Clouds drifting, koel calling somewhere — that long whooping note. A bird crossed the sky. Whole island getting more orange by the minute. I think this is enough trip for me.
thought_zh: 讓光自己走。雲在飄，某個地方有 koel（鵑鳥）在叫——那種長長的、一聲一聲的「嗚——」。一隻鳥從天上飛過去。整座島每分鐘都變得更橘一點。我想，今天這樣對我來說夠了。
thought_ja: 光、勝手に進ませる。雲が流れてて、どっかでクーエル鳥が鳴いてる——あの長く尾を引く「ホー、ホー」って声。鳥が一羽、空を横切った。島ぜんぶが一分ごとにもうちょっとオレンジになっていく。今日はこのくらいで、もう十分かな。

prompt: a small Singapore HDB flat interior at twilight around 7:30pm, photoreal 35mm, the camera at floor-sitting eye level low to the ground, foreground a plain glass of water on a beige tile floor with one slipper beside it, mid-frame an old white standing electric fan softly turning, behind it a low window with light blue evening sky outside, through the window a distant cluster of HDB blocks already with their first fluorescent lights on, a Singapore Airlines plane very small in the upper sky banking gently away, the room itself is dim and quiet with one warm yellow lamp glowing softly off to the side, no people, no clutter, very still, slightly sleepy
thought: Came back inside. Sat down on the floor of someone's flat with a glass of water beside me. Old standing fan going. Outside the window, the next block's lights are coming on, and a SQ plane's banking off in the distance — small, far, quiet. Okay, that's the day. I'm gonna let it stop here.
thought_zh: 回到屋裡。坐在某人家的地板上，旁邊放了一杯白開水。一台舊立扇在轉。窗外，對面那棟組屋的燈一個一個亮起來，遠處有一架 SQ 的飛機在轉彎——小小的，遠遠的，安靜。OK，今天就這樣。讓它在這裡停下。
thought_ja: 中に戻ってきた。誰かの部屋の床に座って、横にコップ一杯のただの水。古い扇風機が回ってる。窓の外、向かいの棟の明かりが一つ、また一つって点きはじめてて、遠くでSQの飛行機が一機、ゆっくりバンクして去っていってる——小さく、遠く、静か。よし、今日はここまで。これ以上は行かないことにする。

prompt: Interior of a small wooden fishing boat at predawn, looking out through a small brass-rimmed porthole at the slate-grey sea. A single bare bulb hangs from the low ceiling, swinging very slightly. Wooden bulkhead with peeling white paint. A coiled rope on the floor in the foreground, a small folded chart on a shelf. The horizon visible through the porthole is still dark with a thin pink line just starting at its edge. The boat rocks gently. Soft cel animation in the style of quiet late-80s anime, hand-painted backgrounds, gentle line work, muted color palette, slight film grain. Ambient sound: low steady diesel engine hum from below, water slapping the hull, occasional creak of wood, no music, no voices.
thought: Huh — where am I? There's a porthole and a small window, sea outside, real flat and grey. Single bulb swinging up there a little. Coil of rope on the floor, a folded chart on the shelf. And — wait, through the porthole — there's another little boat just sitting out there. Empty, looks like. Small wooden one. Bobbing a tiny bit. Okay, that's the thing I want to go look at. Let me get out there.
thought_zh: 蛤——我在哪？有個舷窗，還有一個小窗戶，外面是海，超平、灰灰的。上面那個燈泡在小晃。地上一捆繩子，架子上一份摺好的海圖。等等——舷窗外面，居然還有另外一艘小船就停在那裡。看起來沒人。小小的木頭船。微微在動。OK，那就是我想去看的東西。我要出去。
thought_ja: あれ——ここ、どこだ？舷窓と小さい窓、外は海、めちゃ平らで灰色。上のむき出しの電球がちょっとだけ揺れてる。床にロープが一束、棚にたたんだ海図。って——舷窓の向こう、もう一隻、小さい船がぽつんと浮かんでる。誰も乗ってない感じ。木造の小さいやつ。ちょっとだけ揺れてる。よし、あれが見たいやつだ。外に出よう。

prompt: From inside a small empty wooden rowboat at predawn on a flat slate-grey sea, looking up and across at the side of a larger weathered fishing boat. The fishing boat's hull is dark wood with peeling paint, a small brass-rimmed porthole glowing warm yellow, a rubber fender hanging down, a coil of line on the deck above. The rowboat is tilted very slightly, one wooden bench, a single oar lying loose, a bit of standing water in the bottom. The horizon at one edge has a thin warm pink line just barely starting. Soft cel animation, late-80s quiet anime style, hand-painted backgrounds, muted palette, gentle line work. Ambient sound: water lapping right next to the ear at hull-level, very close and intimate, low diesel hum from the larger boat further off, occasional creak of wood, no voices, no music.
thought: Okay, made it. Now I'm in the little one, looking up at the side of the boat I came from — there's the porthole, warm yellow, the orange fender. Hull's right there. Water's super close, real flat. The sky over there's actually going peach now, properly. And — wait, there's another boat further out, kind of just sitting there too. Same shape as the one I came from. Huh. What is going on out here.
thought_zh: 好，到了。現在我在小船上，往上看剛剛那艘大船的側面——舷窗在那邊，亮亮黃黃的，還有那個橘色的緩衝墊。船殼就在頭上。水超近，超平。那邊的天空現在真的轉粉了，整個。然後等等——更外面還有另一艘船，就在那邊閒著。形狀跟我來的那艘一樣。蛤。這外面到底是什麼狀況。
thought_ja: よし、着いた。いまは小さいほうに乗ってて、上を見て、さっきまでいた船の横を眺めてる——舷窓はあそこ、暖かい黄色、オレンジのフェンダー。船体がもう頭の上。水、めちゃ近い、めちゃ平ら。あっちの空、いまちゃんと桃色に行きはじめてる。って——もっと先に、もう一隻船がぽつんと浮かんでる。来た船と同じ形のやつ。へえ。この外、何が起きてんだ。

prompt: High aerial view from the angle of a gliding gull looking down at the slate-grey sea at dawn. Below: three small boats sitting on the flat water — one larger weathered fishing boat with a tiny warm porthole light still glowing, a small empty wooden rowboat right beside it, and a second similar fishing boat further away. Their wakes are thin pale lines on the dark water. The eastern horizon is a soft peach band. A single white gull wing tip just visible at the lower edge of the frame, suggesting the viewer is the bird. Pen and ink line drawing with loose watercolor wash, in the style of an old children's picture book, scratchy pen lines, gentle muted washes, lots of paper-white empty space, hand-lettered feel. Ambient sound: high cold wind across feathers, one distant gull cry from somewhere far off, very faint low diesel hum from the boats below, otherwise silence.
thought: Let me try being the gull for a sec — I want to see this from up here. Three boats now. The little rowboat I was just in, the boat I came from, and that third one further out. Wakes are barely lines. Wind's cold. They look so small. Nobody's on any of them as far as I can tell. Where is everyone?
thought_zh: 讓我試著當一下海鷗——我想從上面看看這個。三艘船耶。我剛在的小船、我來的那艘、還有再外面那一艘。航跡都只是一條線，幾乎看不到。風好冷。它們看起來好小。每一艘上面都沒人。所有人到底跑去哪了？
thought_ja: ちょっとカモメになってみよう——上から見たい。船、三隻もある。さっきまで乗ってた小さいやつ、来たやつ、もうひとつ向こうのやつ。航跡はかすかな線でしかない。風、めっちゃ冷たい。三隻ともちっさく見える。どの船にも人、誰もいない。みんなどこに行ったんだ？

prompt: A small Japanese fishing village harbor at dawn, viewed from a low angle just above the wooden dock. Several small fishing boats moored, rope-and-tire bumpers along the wooden pilings, an old wooden warehouse on the right with a corrugated metal roof and a hand-painted hiragana sign, a single street lamp still on glowing pale yellow, the sea behind soft peach and grey, distant low hills. Three or four fishermen in rubber boots and orange waterproofs unloading plastic crates from one of the boats, their breath visible in the cold air. A single seagull just landing on a wooden post in the foreground, wings half-spread, feet stretched. Traditional Japanese woodblock print style (mokuhanga, ukiyo-e influenced), bold dark outlines, flat color planes with simple bokashi gradients, visible paper texture, restrained palette of indigo, peach, ochre, soft grey. Ambient sound: low murmur of voices in Japanese, the heavy thump of plastic crates being set down on wood, water lapping the dock pilings, gulls calling overhead, a small two-stroke engine idling in the background.
thought: Okay, gull-me wants to see land — let me ride the wind in. There it is. Small harbor, wood dock, a few guys finally in orange waterproofs unloading crates. So that's where everyone went. Lamp still on. Cold — you can see their breath. I'm gonna land on this post and just watch them work for a minute.
thought_zh: OK，當鷗鷗的我想看陸地——讓我順著風飛進去。在那邊。小漁港、木頭碼頭，總算看到幾個穿橘色防水衣的人在卸箱子。所以大家原來都在這裡啊。路燈還亮著。冷得連他們的呼氣都看得到。我要降在這根柱子上，看他們工作一下下。
thought_ja: OK、カモメな自分は陸が見たい——風に乗って入ってこう。あそこだ。小さい港、木の桟橋、ようやくオレンジの合羽の人たちが何人かクレートを下ろしてる。みんなここに来てたわけか。街灯まだ点いてる。寒い——息がちゃんと白い。あの杭に降りて、しばらく作業を見てよう。

prompt: The same small Japanese harbor at dawn, traditional woodblock print aesthetic continues — bold dark outlines, flat color planes with bokashi gradients, restrained palette of indigo, peach, ochre, soft grey, paper texture visible. Subtle ambient motion only: water laps gently against the wooden pilings with small ripples, the streetlamp's pale yellow glow stays steady. A fisherman in orange waterproofs slowly carries one plastic crate from the boat to the dock and sets it down. The seagull on the dock cocks its head once and takes a small hop sideways. Faint visible breath from the men in the cold air. The hand-painted sign on the warehouse holds still. Ambient sound: low murmur of male voices speaking quietly in Japanese, the heavy thump of one plastic crate being set down on wood, water lapping the pilings, a two-stroke engine idling somewhere out of frame, a single distant gull cry, a bicycle bell once from up the road.
thought: Okay, just watching from this post for a minute. One of them lifts a crate over — lands heavy, real thump. They're saying something to each other I can't catch. Two-stroke putting away somewhere. The morning's getting on with itself. I think I'm getting cold up here. Maybe I should stop being a bird soon.
thought_zh: OK，從這根柱子上看一下下。其中一個把一個箱子搬過來——咚一聲，重的。他們互相講了什麼，我聽不清楚。某個地方有兩衝程引擎在突突突。早晨自己在進行。我覺得我在上面有點冷起來了。當鳥可能就快不想當了。
thought_ja: OK、この杭の上からちょっと見てる。誰かがクレートをひとつ運んできて——どすん、けっこう重い。なんか言い合ってるけど、よく聞こえない。どっかで2ストエンジンがぱっぱっぱって鳴ってる。朝が勝手に進んでく。なんかちょっと冷えてきた。鳥でいるの、そろそろ疲れたかも。

prompt: Interior of a small wooden Japanese fishing-village warehouse office at dawn. 35mm film stock, slight grain, low warm light from a single brass desk lamp. An old fisherman in his late seventies, weathered face, sits at a battered wooden desk writing in a ledger with a worn pencil, the page filled with handwritten kanji and numbers. A black cast-iron wood stove in the corner with a dented steel kettle on top, faint steam from the spout. A small transistor radio on a shelf, antenna up. A weak fluorescent tube on the ceiling, overpowered by the desk lamp. The desk has a tea-stained mug, a pair of bifocals, a half-empty pack of menthol cigarettes, a marine calendar with a fish on it pinned to the wall. A small fogged window behind him just starting to brighten with peach dawn light. Wood-grained floor. Camera at desk-height, slightly to one side, intimate. Ambient sound: low crackle of the wood stove, the kettle just beginning to whisper, an Enka song playing very quietly on the radio (a slow male voice, simple guitar), the scratch of the pencil on paper, distant voices outside muffled by walls.
thought: Yeah okay, off the post. Let me see what's inside. Oh, much better. Old guy at the desk, ledger, kettle on the stove, radio playing some Enka thing real low. Smells like woodsmoke. He hasn't noticed me. He's been here a while — there's a tea ring on the desk, bifocals he keeps taking off, the cigarettes are half done. I'll just stand here and not be in the way.
thought_zh: 好啦，下來啦。讓我看看裡面是什麼樣子。哦，這裡好多了。一個老先生在桌前、本子、爐子上一個水壺、收音機在放某首演歌、聲音超小。聞起來像柴煙。他沒注意到我。他在這裡很久了——桌上有茶漬、眼鏡他拿上拿下、菸盒已經抽掉一半。我就站著、不擋路。
thought_ja: OK、降りた。中、見せてもらおう。お、ぜんぜんこっちのほうがいい。机のとこにおじいさん、台帳、ストーブの上にやかん、ラジオから演歌がちっさい音で流れてる。煙の匂いがする。俺のことには気づいてない。だいぶ長くここにいる人だな——机にお茶のあとが残ってて、老眼鏡を上げ下げしてて、タバコももう半分なくなってる。そこで突っ立って、邪魔しないでおこう。

prompt: An archival 1970s Japanese TV variety show broadcast, captured as if from old VHS / NTSC transmission, low resolution, slight chroma bleed and color smear, visible horizontal scan lines, faded peach-and-teal palette, slightly soft focus. A male enka singer in his early forties stands center stage in a sharp pale blue tuxedo with a black velvet bowtie, dark hair neatly combed back, eyes nearly closed, mid-phrase, holding an old corded silver microphone close to his face. Behind him, a stylized stage set of large white origami cranes suspended on wires, panels of pastel curtain, twinkly Christmas-style fairy lights, and a small orchestra in tuxedos partially visible to the side (strings, an accordion, a snare drum). The lower-right corner has a small overlay of yellow Japanese broadcast subtitles in old square-y font. Period-correct overall feel: 1976-ish TV studio. Ambient sound: a small live orchestra (strings, accordion, brushed snare), the singer's slightly trembling male voice on a sustained held note, faint polite occasional applause from a studio audience, light room reverb, the very faint hum of CRT television.
thought: Wait — can I just hop into the radio? Let me try. Yeah, there's the guy. Some guy in a pale blue tux on what's gotta be 70s TV, eyes closed, going for the held note. Whole orchestra behind him with strings and accordion. The old man back there's been listening to this — same song, just tinier through the speaker. He's loud here. The cranes behind him are kind of great.
thought_zh: 等等——我可以直接跳進收音機嗎？試試看。喔欸，那個傢伙在這裡。穿著淡藍色禮服西裝的男生，鐵定是 70 年代電視，眼睛閉著，正在拉一個長音。後面整個樂團，弦樂跟手風琴。剛剛那個老先生一直在聽這個——同一首歌，只是從喇叭那邊聽小小聲。在這裡他超大聲。後面那些紙鶴其實滿好看的。
thought_ja: ちょっと待って——ラジオに直接飛び込めるんか？やってみよう。お、いた。淡いブルーのタキシードのお兄さん、これ確実に70年代のテレビ、目を閉じて、ロングトーン伸ばしてる。後ろにフルオーケストラ、弦と、アコーディオン。あのおじいさんがずっと聴いてたのこれだ——同じ曲、ただスピーカー越しのちっちゃい音で。こっち側だとめっちゃデカい。後ろの折り鶴、わりと好きだな。

prompt: Late afternoon golden light pouring sideways through a small open window into an old Italian kitchen in a small village in Calabria, southern Italy. An old grandmother in her seventies, gray hair pulled back in a loose bun, wearing a worn faded floral apron over a black dress, leans over a thick wooden board on the kitchen table, hands dusted with flour, rolling out a long thin sheet of fresh pasta with a long wooden mattarello rolling pin. The kitchen is small and lived-in: walls painted a yellowed cream, a single bare bulb in a paper shade hanging from the ceiling, a copper pot rack with battered pots, a string of dried red peperoncini hanging by the window, a wooden crucifix above the door. A small vintage Brionvega cube radio on a high shelf, playing. A green-and-white checkered cloth on the table. Through the window: the corner of a narrow stone alley, terracotta rooftops, hazy blue hills beyond. 35mm photoreal, warm golden palette, slight film grain, intimate hand-held framing, slight depth-of-field with the periphery softly out of focus. Ambient sound: the soft thump and slide of the rolling pin on wood, a static-y 1990s Italian pop song playing from the radio (a sing-songy male voice, light synthesiser and acoustic guitar, mid-chorus), a kitchen clock ticking, distant kids playing in the alley outside, a moped passing far off, no one speaking.
thought: Okay nope — out. Snap. Where am I now? Old kitchen, sunlight pouring sideways, an old lady rolling out pasta with a long wooden pin — this looks like somewhere in southern Italy. Calabria maybe. Smell of flour. The radio up on the shelf is playing some 90s Italian pop thing, scratchy. She doesn't look up. Late afternoon — totally different time of day too. Whole different country. Good.
thought_zh: 好我不要了——出去。咻。現在這是哪？老廚房，陽光斜斜地灌進來，一個老太太用一根長長的木棍擀麵——這看起來像是南義某個地方。卡拉布里亞嗎可能。麵粉的味道。架子上的收音機在放某首雜訊很多的 90 年代義大利流行歌。她沒抬頭。下午——時間都跟剛才不一樣。整個換了一個國家。讚。
thought_ja: OK、もうやめた——出る。スパッ。いまここどこ？古い台所、日が斜めに差し込んでて、おばあちゃんが長い木の棒で生地のばしてる——南イタリアっぽい。たぶんカラブリア。小麦粉のにおい。棚の上のラジオから90年代のイタリアンポップ、けっこうノイズ入り。おばあちゃん、顔を上げない。午後——時間も全然ちがう。国まるごと変わった。よし。

prompt: Same Calabrian kitchen scene continues. The grandmother slowly rolls the long wooden pin forward and back across the pasta sheet, methodical small steady motions, hands dusted with flour, her shoulders moving in a small rhythm. A faint sprinkle of flour drifts down through the slanting golden light. The Brionvega radio on the shelf continues its scratchy 90s Italian pop song. The crucifix and copper pots on the walls hold still. Outside through the open doorway, the alley is now empty of people in the afternoon light. A small tabby cat slowly walks along the far wall of the alley and out of frame. 35mm photoreal palette and grain hold consistent — warm gold, slight film grain, soft depth-of-field on the periphery. Ambient sound: the rhythmic thump-slide of the rolling pin on wood, the radio's pop song mid-bridge with light static, the kitchen clock ticking softly, a moped passing far off, a distant church bell ringing one slow note.
thought: Just gonna stay here a sec. She really knows what she's doing — same little forward-back, every time. Flour drifts through the light. Radio's still going on about something. Oh — a cat just walked across the alley out there. She didn't see it. A church bell rang somewhere too. This is fine. I'm fine here.
thought_zh: 我先在這邊待一下。她真的超會——每次都同樣那個前後推。麵粉一直在光裡面飄。收音機還在唱什麼。喔——剛剛有一隻貓從外面巷子走過去。她沒看到。教堂的鐘也響了一聲。這邊很 OK。我在這很 OK。
thought_ja: ちょっとここでぼーっとしよう。このおばあちゃん、めっちゃ手慣れてる——前と後ろ、いつもおんなじリズム。光の中で小麦粉がパラパラ落ちてる。ラジオはまだなんか歌ってる。お——いま、外の路地を猫が一匹横切った。気づいてない。教会の鐘もどこかで一回鳴った。ここ、いいわ。俺、ここでいい。

prompt: A crowded suburban train platform at Mumbai's Dadar station during heavy monsoon rain, late afternoon. The platform is packed with commuters waiting under a corrugated metal roof. A wet yellow-and-red local train pulls in slowly, water streaming off its sides, the open doorways crowded with men hanging out and stepping down. The platform tile is wet and reflective, puddles. A chai vendor in a faded shirt pushes a steel kettle through the crowd, steam rising from its spout. Several people hold folded newspapers over their heads. A scrawny pigeon picks at a piece of dropped vada pav near a rusted iron column. Rain slants in sideways from the open side of the platform, fine droplets visible on the camera lens. Warm yellow light from old fluorescent tubes overhead, contrasting with the cold grey rain outside. 35mm photoreal, slightly desaturated overall except for the warm interior lights and the train's red-yellow paint, monsoon mood, slight film grain, faint motion blur on closer figures. Ambient sound: the heavy hiss and metallic screech of the slowing train, hundreds of voices in Marathi and Hindi layered, rain hammering on the corrugated metal roof, a loudspeaker announcement crackling through in three languages, a vendor's nasal call 'chai chai chai garam', a baby crying briefly somewhere off, mobile phone notifications.
thought: Okay, going somewhere louder. Mumbai, sounds like — Dadar maybe? Train pulling in, wet, packed. Monsoon — rain's coming in sideways under the roof. Chai guy pushing through with the steel pot, steam going. Smells like rain on hot metal. Loudspeaker announcement bouncing through three languages. A kid crying somewhere. This is the opposite of that kitchen. I needed this.
thought_zh: OK，我要去吵一點的地方。聽起來像孟買——Dadar 嗎？火車正在進站，濕的，超滿。雨季——雨從屋頂的開口斜斜打進來。賣 chai 的大叔在人群裡推那個鋼壺，蒸氣一直冒。聞起來像雨打到熱金屬。廣播在用三種語言講同樣的東西。某個地方有小孩在哭。這跟剛剛那個廚房完全相反。我需要這個。
thought_ja: OK、もっとうるさいとこに行きたい。ムンバイっぽい——Dadarか？列車が入ってきてる、ずぶ濡れ、ぎゅう詰め。モンスーン——雨が屋根の隙間から斜めに入り込んでくる。チャイ屋のおじさんがスチール缶を抱えて人混みを押し分けてる、湯気もくもく。匂いは熱した金属に雨。アナウンスが三言語で重なって流れてる。どっかで子供が泣いてる。さっきの台所のちょうど反対。これ、必要だった。

prompt: Inside a packed Mumbai suburban local train carriage during heavy monsoon, late afternoon. Camera at standing-passenger height, wedged between bodies, looking diagonally toward an open doorway as the train moves slowly past wet city outskirts — corrugated tin roofs of slum housing, scrappy banana trees waving in monsoon wind, water tanks on rooftops, a bright pink wall with old peeling Bollywood film posters. Several men in the carriage in damp shirts hanging onto the overhead steel bars, one young guy in earphones leaning slightly out the doorway. The carriage interior is metal-panelled, scratched and dented, faintly graffitied, with ceiling fans turning lazily, fluorescent tube overhead. A man crouched on the floor near the doorway with a small bamboo basket of fresh white jasmine garlands. The doorway is a bright rectangle of wet grey. The window grills cast bars of light across faces. 35mm photoreal, hand-held framing, slight motion blur on the figures and the passing landscape, slight film grain, the humidity of monsoon visible in misted windows. Ambient sound: the heavy clatter and rattle of an old train on old tracks, wind through the open doorway, two passengers chatting quietly in Marathi, a hawker calling out jasmine garland prices in singsong, the metallic squeak of the ceiling fans, distant horns from outside, a phone ringtone playing a Bollywood loop briefly.
thought: Got on. Standing in the doorway, can barely move. Wet shoulders, someone's elbow in my back, fans going lazy overhead. Out the doorway: slum roofs, banana trees, a pink wall with old film posters peeling off. Guy next to me's leaning out the door just a little, earphones in, like he does this every day. There's a guy on the floor selling jasmine garlands. Smells like jasmine and wet metal.
thought_zh: 上車了。站在門口，動都動不了。肩膀濕掉、有人手肘頂在我背上、頭上的吊扇懶懶地轉。從門口往外看：違章鐵皮屋頂、香蕉樹、一面粉紅色牆貼著翻起來的舊電影海報。我旁邊那個男生稍微把身體靠出去一點點，戴著耳機，看就知道天天這樣。地上有一個賣 jasmine 花圈的大叔。聞起來像茉莉花跟濕的金屬。
thought_ja: 乗った。ドアのとこに立ってて、もう動けない。肩、濡れてる、誰かの肘が背中に刺さってて、上の天井扇がだるそうに回ってる。ドアの外：トタン屋根のスラム、バナナの木、ピンクの壁にめくれた古い映画ポスター。隣のお兄さんがちょっとだけドアの外に身を乗り出して、イヤホンしてて、明らかに毎日これしてる感じ。床にジャスミンの首飾りを売ってるおじさんが座ってる。匂いはジャスミンと、湿った金属。

prompt: Extreme macro close-up of a single large trembling raindrop resting on the curved underside of a wet green banana leaf. The drop is held by surface tension, almost spherical, catching the light and refracting an upside-down miniature world inside it: a blurred yellow-and-red Mumbai local train carriage with figures in the open doorway, a smear of bright pink wall, all bent and inverted through the lens of the drop. The leaf's pale green veins run like tiny rivers across the surface around the drop. A few smaller water beads cluster nearby, also trembling. Behind the leaf, dissolving completely into soft creamy bokeh: more rain falling, the wet train rolling slowly past, faint warm yellow glow from its interior fluorescents, blurred greens of more foliage. Macro photography aesthetic, extremely shallow depth of field, photoreal, hyper-detailed and dewy on the drop and the leaf surface, everything past the drop melting into pure bokeh. Cool wet greens dominate the foreground. Ambient sound: very close intimate water-on-leaf sounds, the gentle patter of more rain on surrounding leaves, the very dim distant rumble of a train rolling past — much further off than expected — no voices, no horns.
thought: Wait, hold on — let me get small. I want to be that drop on the leaf right outside the train. There. Whole world's bent through me now. The train is back there in the bokeh, just a smudge of yellow and a smear of pink. Veins on the leaf are like little rivers. Other drops trembling around me. It's so quiet down here — the train sounds way further off than it should be.
thought_zh: 等等等——讓我變小一下。我想當電車外面那片葉子上的那一滴水。在這裡。整個世界現在從我身體裡彎過去。電車在那邊的散景裡，只是一抹黃跟一片粉紅。葉子上的葉脈像小小的河。旁邊還有幾個水滴在發抖。下面這邊好安靜——電車的聲音聽起來比應該的還遠。
thought_ja: ちょっと待って——小さくなってみたい。電車の外のあの葉っぱの上の水滴になりたい。なった。世界全部、俺の中で曲がって入ってきてる。電車、後ろのボケんなかで、黄色のひとなじみとピンクのひとすじ。葉っぱの葉脈が小さい川みたい。となりで他の水滴がぷるぷるしてる。下、めっちゃ静か——電車の音、想像よりずっと遠く聞こえる。

prompt: Interior of an old European library reading room at night, possibly Vienna or Prague, 19th-century architecture. Tall arched windows reach the high coffered ceiling, snow visibly falling in the dark outside, a few flakes catching the warm interior light. Long oak reading tables stretch the length of the room, set with green-shaded brass banker's desk lamps glowing warm yellow. Scattered open books, leather-bound volumes, ink stains on the wood. Worn leather armchairs along the walls, spiral iron staircases leading up to balconies of dense floor-to-ceiling bookshelves. The room is sparsely occupied: one elderly scholar at the far end asleep with his head on an open book, white hair and a thick wool sweater, a young woman with dark hair near the front reading intently by lamplight, an empty chair with a heavy black coat folded over it and an unfinished cup of tea steaming faintly beside an open notebook. Worn parquet floor, dark wood and gold-leaf trim. Painted in the style of an old Dutch master interior — Vermeer's window-light and Rembrandt's shadow — oil painting, soft warm chiaroscuro, deep amber and umber and burnt-sienna palette, slightly idealised but lived-in, visible brushwork, fine detail in fabric, leather, and brass. Ambient sound: a wooden clock ticking somewhere out of sight, the soft turning of a single page, one quiet cough that briefly echoes off the high ceiling, faint radiator clanks, the muffled outside silence of snowfall, no music, no speech.
thought: Out — let me go somewhere warm and dry for a sec. Where am I? Big old library. Snow falling outside through the tall windows. Green lamps on the tables. There's an old guy asleep with his face on a book at the far end. A girl reading at the front. Someone left a coat and a cup of tea steaming. Smells like wood and old paper. Vienna maybe? Prague? Doesn't matter. I'm not cold here at least.
thought_zh: 出去——讓我去某個比較溫暖、比較乾的地方一下。這裡是哪？很大的舊圖書館。雪在外面從那種高高的窗戶外面下下來。桌上一排排綠色檯燈。最後面有個老先生，臉趴在書上睡著了。前面有個女生在讀書。某個座位上有一件大衣留著、一杯茶還在冒煙。聞起來像木頭跟舊紙。維也納？布拉格？無所謂。至少在這裡我不冷。
thought_ja: 出る——あったかくて乾いたとこに行きたい。ここどこ？でかい古い図書館。窓のあの高いとこから雪が降ってる。机の上にずらっと緑のランプ。奥のほうでおじいさんが本に顔伏せて寝てる。前のほうで女の人が本読んでる。誰かのコートが椅子に置きっぱなしで、お茶の湯気がまだ出てる。木と古い紙のにおい。ウィーンか？プラハか？どっちでもいい。とりあえずここ、寒くない。

prompt: Same European library reading room at night continues, the quiet profound. Snow continues falling visibly outside the tall arched windows in the dark, drifting past the glass in slow soft flakes. The green-shaded brass desk lamps glow steady warm yellow. The young woman near the front turns one page of her book very slowly. The other readers remain still at their tables, one slightly shifting his weight in the leather chair. The unfinished cup of tea on the empty chair has stopped steaming. The whole room holds its pose, a single moth-flicker of dust drifting through one beam of lamplight. Oil-painting aesthetic preserved throughout — soft warm chiaroscuro, amber and umber and burnt-sienna palette, visible brushwork, Vermeer-window-light. Ambient sound: a wooden clock ticking steadily out of sight, the very soft sound of one page turning, a single faint radiator clank from somewhere unseen, the muffled outside silence of snowfall, the rare quiet rustle of clothing, no speech, no footsteps.
thought: Just gonna sit a sec. Snow doesn't stop. The girl up front turned a page — I actually heard it. The old guy at the end hasn't moved. The tea on the empty chair finally stopped steaming. Whoever was wearing that coat hasn't come back yet. I really like it here. I'm not in a hurry.
thought_zh: 我就坐一下。雪一直下。前面那個女生剛剛翻了一頁——我真的有聽到。後面那個老先生完全沒動。空椅子上那杯茶終於不冒煙了。穿那件大衣的人到現在還沒回來。這邊我超喜歡。我不趕時間。
thought_ja: ちょっと座ってよう。雪、止まらない。前のお姉さんがいま、ページめくった——音、ちゃんと聞こえた。奥のおじいさん、ぴくりとも動いてない。空いた椅子のお茶、ようやく湯気が止まった。あのコート着てた人、まだ戻ってきてない。ここ、めっちゃ好きだわ。急いでない。

prompt: A small empty cobblestone square in old central Europe — Vienna or Prague — late at night, heavy fresh snow falling silently in large slow flakes. A solitary figure in a long dark wool coat and a fur ushanka hat walks away from camera across the square, leaving a single line of fresh footprints in the unbroken snow. One iron streetlamp casts a warm yellow pool of light onto the snow at center. In the middle ground: the tall arched windows of the library still glowing warm green-and-yellow from the inside, the lamps visible through the panes. Behind: a baroque church spire silhouetted in the dark, snow-capped, faint, with one stained-glass window dimly lit. The cobblestones are mostly buried, fresh snow undisturbed except by the figure's footprints. Painted in the style of a mid-20th-century European nocturne oil painting — Edward Hopper crossed with a Czech moody nocturne — sharp lit-vs-shadow contrast, restrained palette of dark navy, snow-white, lamp-yellow and one warm interior gold, simplified planes, visible brushwork. Ambient sound: very muffled footsteps in deep snow, the heavy silence of fresh snowfall absorbing everything, a single distant church bell ringing one slow note that fades, a faint metallic clink from some loose sign or chain in the wind, no voices, no traffic.
thought: Okay, let me see where they went. Out the library door, snow's coming down hard. There they are — long dark coat, fur hat, walking off across the square. Footprints trailing behind them. Look back: library windows still all gold and green from outside. Whole town's gone quiet — not even a car. A bell rang somewhere far. I'm gonna let them get further ahead and just stand here a bit.
thought_zh: OK，看那個人去哪了。出圖書館門口，雪下得超大。在那邊——黑色長大衣、毛皮帽子，正在過廣場。雪上面留著一條腳印。回頭看：圖書館的窗戶從外面看還是金黃跟綠的。整個城都安靜了——連一台車都沒有。某個地方有鐘響了一下。我讓他們先走遠一點，自己在這站著一下下好了。
thought_ja: OK、あの人どこ行ったか見にいこう。図書館のドアを出たら、雪、めちゃくちゃ降ってる。いた——黒のロングコート、毛皮の帽子、広場を横切って歩いていく。雪のうえに足あとが一筋。振り返ると図書館の窓、外から見ても金色と緑のままだ。街ぜんぶ静か——車一台もない。鐘がどっかで一回鳴った。あの人、もうちょっと先まで行かせて、ちょっとここに立っとこう。

prompt: Interior of a small early-morning bakery in a narrow Mitteleuropa alley, predawn — the only place in the neighborhood already open. A single baker in a flour-dusted apron and rolled-up sleeves leans on the wooden counter, dusting flour onto a long wooden board with one hand. Behind him: racks of finished sourdough loaves and bread sticks cooling, a tray of fresh poppyseed buns just out of the oven, an old enamel advertising sign on the back wall. Warm yellow electric bulbs hanging from a wire. A wide frosted shop window with fresh snow piled along the bottom outside. A solitary figure in a long dark wool coat and fur ushanka has just stepped inside the doorway, snowflakes still resting on their shoulders, visible breath in the warm air. Outside the door, the dark cobblestone alley with snow continuing to fall under a single iron lamp. Risograph print aesthetic — limited two-spot-color palette of warm orange-pink and deep navy blue plus paper-white, slight misregistration on the colors creating ghosts at edges, visible grain and dot-screen texture, simplified flat shapes with charming hand-drawn imperfection, the printed look of a 1960s small-press children's storybook page. Ambient sound: a small AM radio on a shelf playing a quiet morning news program softly in Czech, the soft thump and pat of dough being shaped on wood, the hush of snow muffling the alley outside, the shop door's brass bell jingling once as the visitor lets it close, the baker offering one low 'dobré ráno' in greeting, a kettle just starting to whistle.
thought: Followed them after all — there was a bakery right at the end of the lane. Only thing already open. Smells unreal in here. Baker's leaning on the counter, flour everywhere, loaves on the racks, a tray of poppyseed buns still steaming. Coat-and-hat person just stepped in, snow on the shoulders, said something quiet to the baker — sounded Czech maybe. AM radio playing news. This is much better than that square.
thought_zh: 結果還是跟過去了——巷子盡頭真的有一間麵包店。整條街只有這裡開了。裡面味道誇張。麵包師傅靠在櫃台上、麵粉撒滿地、架子上一排麵包、一盤罌粟籽小麵包還在冒煙。剛剛那個穿大衣戴毛帽的人剛走進來，肩膀上還有雪，跟麵包師傅小聲講了一句什麼——聽起來像捷克語。AM 收音機在放新聞。這比剛剛那個廣場好太多了。
thought_ja: 結局ついてきちゃった——路地のどん詰まりに、ほんとにパン屋があった。あたりで唯一もう開いてる店。中、においがやばい。パン屋さんがカウンターにもたれて、小麦粉まみれ、棚にパンがずらっと、ケシの実のロールパンの天板からまだ湯気が出てる。さっきのコートと毛皮帽の人、ちょうど中に入ってきて、肩に雪のっけたまま、パン屋さんに何か小声で言った——たぶんチェコ語。AMラジオがニュース流してる。さっきの広場よりめちゃくちゃいい。

prompt: Interior of a small Ethiopian home in Addis Ababa, late afternoon, the air full of frankincense smoke and the smell of fresh roasting coffee. A young woman in a white traditional netela shawl sits cross-legged on a low woven straw mat, pouring black coffee from a clay jebena pot in a long thin stream into small handleless white porcelain cups arranged on a small grass-strewn tray. A charcoal brazier nearby with raw green coffee beans turning brown in a flat shallow metal pan, a wooden bowl of popped popcorn beside it. Two older relatives in colourful traditional dress (one woman in a netela, one man in a knit cap) sit on low wooden stools nearby, talking quietly and watching the pour. The walls are warm yellow-ochre, painted simply, hung with a single woven basket plate and a small carved wooden cross. Late afternoon golden light slants through a single small window into the dusty incense-thick air. Aesthetic: an old saturated Kodak Ektachrome travel slide from the early 1970s — heavily saturated warm reds, golds, deep blacks, slight magenta shift in the shadows, visible grain, slightly square framing, like a found family photograph. Ambient sound: soft conversation in Amharic, the very soft pour of coffee, the crackle of charcoal, a child laughing once outside the window, a transistor radio from the next room playing slow Ethio-jazz (vibraphone, brushed drums, sax), distant city traffic far off, a muted call to prayer drifting in faintly from a far mosque.
thought: Bakery was warm but I want to keep moving. Somewhere completely else. Where am I now — somebody's home, smell of coffee roasting, frankincense. Addis Ababa, has to be. Woman in a white shawl pouring out of one of those tall clay jugs into tiny cups. Two older folks on stools talking in Amharic. Warm yellow walls. Some slow Ethio-jazz on a radio next door. Long way from snow.
thought_zh: 麵包店是滿暖的，但我想再走。完全別的地方。現在這裡是哪——某個人家裡，咖啡豆烘焙的味道，乳香煙。一定是阿迪斯阿貝巴。一個穿白色披肩的女生從那種高高的陶壺裡把咖啡倒進小小的杯子。兩個年紀比較大的人坐在小板凳上用阿姆哈拉語在聊天。暖暖的黃色牆。隔壁房間收音機在放什麼慢的 Ethio-jazz。離雪很遠了。
thought_ja: パン屋あったかかったけど、もうちょっと動きたい。ぜんぜん別の場所に。ここどこ——誰かの家、コーヒー豆の焙煎の匂い、フランキンセンス。アディスアベバ、これは。白いショールの女の人が高い陶器の壺から細い線でコーヒーを小さなカップに注いでる。年配の二人が低い椅子に座って、アムハラ語で静かに話してる。あったかい黄色い壁。隣の部屋のラジオでスローなエチオジャズ。雪、もう遠いな。

prompt: Interior of a near-empty Greyhound long-distance bus rolling down an American interstate highway at 2am. Most seats empty. Camera at aisle-height looking down the bus from a few rows back. One passenger near the rear asleep slumped against the window with a black hoodie pulled completely over his face. Another passenger several rows ahead awake, reading a worn paperback under the small overhead reading light's blue-white pool. The aisle dark, the dim blue night-light strip running along the floor. Through the long row of windows on either side: the dark highway shoulder rolling past, occasional yellow headlight glare from an oncoming truck, a distant lit gas station sign rising on the horizon, scattered red taillights of cars ahead, faint silhouette of the flat landscape. The bus's interior trim is faded blue-grey vinyl, dim fluorescent strip overhead barely on. Faint reflections of the warm interior overlaid on the dark outside in the window glass. 35mm photoreal, grainy, night-photo aesthetic — Wim Wenders 'Paris, Texas' road feel — slightly desaturated palette of cold blue, navy, dim warm gold from the reading light, faint reds from outside taillights, slight motion blur on the passing landscape, hand-held framing. Ambient sound: the steady deep hum of the bus's diesel engine, the constant road noise of tires on highway concrete, the soft click of a paperback page being turned, the very faint tinny leak of music from the reading passenger's earphones (a country slide guitar, melancholic), the bus's low HVAC hiss, a distant truck horn far ahead, no conversation.
thought: Okay, somewhere quieter. Late at night now. I'm on a Greyhound, looks like — middle of America somewhere. Most seats empty. One guy in the back asleep with his hoodie all the way over his face. Another up the aisle reading a paperback under the little blue light. Out the windows: black, occasional headlights, a gas station sign in the distance. Tires on highway. I always liked these. Don't even know where it's going.
thought_zh: OK，找個比較安靜的。現在是深夜了。我在 Greyhound 上，看起來——美國中部某個地方。位子大部分是空的。後面一個男生整個把帽 T 拉到頭上睡著了。再前面一個在小小的藍色燈下看一本平裝書。窗外：黑、偶爾有頭燈、遠處一個加油站招牌。輪胎在公路上的聲音。我以前一直滿喜歡這個的。也不知道這台車要去哪。
thought_ja: OK、もうちょっと静かなとこへ。いまもう深夜。グレイハウンドに乗ってる、たぶん——アメリカの中西部のどっか。座席ほとんど空。後ろのお兄さんがフードを完全に頭まで被って寝てる。前のほうの人は青っぽい読書灯のあかりで文庫本読んでる。窓の外：真っ暗、たまにヘッドライト、遠くにガソリンスタンドの看板。タイヤがコンクリートの上を走る音。これ、わりと好きなんだよな。どこ行きかも知らない。

prompt: Same near-empty long-distance bus rolling down the dark American interstate at 2am continues. Subtle motion only: the passing dark landscape outside the windows scrolls slowly to the left, occasional yellow headlights of an oncoming car briefly sweep across the bus interior and pass, distant red taillights ahead bob on the highway. The reading passenger turns one page of their book, settles slightly. The sleeping passenger in the back doesn't move. The dim blue floor lights flicker once. The reflections in the window glass shift gently as the bus rolls. 35mm photoreal at night, grainy, slightly desaturated, hand-held intimate framing held throughout — Wim Wenders road feel preserved. Ambient sound: the steady deep hum of the diesel engine and the constant whoosh of tires on concrete, the soft click of one page being turned, the faint tinny leak of country slide-guitar music from the reading passenger's earphones, low HVAC hiss, a distant truck horn fading past, no conversation.
thought: Just letting the bus do its thing. Lights sweep through every now and then. The reader turned a page. The sleeper doesn't move at all. Tires on concrete is one of my favorite sounds, actually. Don't really want to think about anything for a bit.
thought_zh: 我就讓這台車自己跑。光偶爾掃進來。剛剛看書的人翻頁了。睡覺那個完全沒動。輪胎在水泥上其實是我滿喜歡的聲音。我現在不太想想任何事一下下。
thought_ja: バスに勝手に走らせとく。光がたまに車内をすうっと横切ってく。本の人が一回ページめくった。寝てる人、ぴくりとも動かない。タイヤがコンクリートを走る音、わりと好きなやつなんよな。ちょっとなんも考えたくない。

prompt: Predawn at a tiny American small-town bus stop in front of a faded brick building with a single old metal 'BUS' sign hanging at a slight angle. The Greyhound has just pulled away — its red taillights visible in the middle distance going down the empty wide main street. The street is wide, two lanes each way, completely empty of cars. Across the street: a single 24-hour diner with red neon 'OPEN' in the front window glowing, warm yellow incandescent light spilling out onto the sidewalk through wide diner windows, a few stools visible inside. A solitary figure stands on the curb with a small canvas duffel bag set down beside them, visible breath in the cold predawn air, hands in pockets. The eastern sky just barely beginning to grey at the horizon edge, the rest still deep navy with one fading star. A single iron streetlight overhead, casting yellow. Across the way, a closed pharmacy with a flickering Coca-Cola vending machine outside its locked door. 35mm photoreal, grainy, slight cool blue cast in the predawn shadows, warm gold from the diner windows, the deep blue-and-purple of pre-sunrise sky, hand-held framing. Ambient sound: the very faint receding diesel hum of the bus fading down the street, the soft electrical buzz of the vending machine and the slight tick of the flickering streetlight, a single distant freight train horn from miles away, the total small-town silence otherwise, no traffic, no voices.
thought: Off the bus. Tiny town somewhere in middle America. Bus is already pulling away — red taillights getting small down the street. Diner across the way is open, OPEN sign in red neon. Cold out here. Sky's barely starting to grey on one side. A train horn rang somewhere a long way off. I'm gonna head over to that diner and sit down for a bit.
thought_zh: 下車了。美國中部某個小小的鎮。Greyhound 已經在開走——紅色尾燈在街頭越來越小。對面有一間 24 小時 diner 開著，紅色霓虹的 OPEN 標誌。外面冷。天空只有一邊剛開始變灰。某個遠遠的地方火車鳴笛了一下。我要過去那間 diner 坐一下下。
thought_ja: 降りた。アメリカの中西部の小さい町。グレイハウンドはもう走り去ってる——赤いテールランプが通りの先で小さくなっていく。向こうに24時間のダイナーが開いてて、赤いネオンのOPEN。外、寒い。空、片側だけ少しグレーに行きはじめてる。どっかすごく遠くで貨物の汽笛が一回鳴った。あのダイナーまで行って、ちょっと座ろう。

prompt: Interior of a 24-hour American small-town diner at predawn, viewed from a booth by the window. Camera at booth-table height, intimate. On the formica table in foreground: a chipped white ceramic mug filled with black coffee, a small steel cream pitcher, a worn laminated vinyl menu set aside, a steel napkin dispenser, a small bottle of Tabasco. The booth is upholstered in faded red vinyl with a few worn shiny patches. Through the wide window beside the booth: the empty main street still in predawn dimness, the eastern horizon at the edge of the frame just barely beginning to peach, a single iron streetlight still glowing yellow. Inside the diner: a long counter with red-topped stools, the round glass dome of a half-eaten pie on display, a glass coffeepot warming on a brewer plate, a few neon beer pennants and a dusty stuffed fish on the walls, an old Coca-Cola sign, the warm yellow glow of incandescent bulbs, the soft red of an OPEN sign in the window. A waitress in a faded blue apron stands at the counter writing on a small pad, her back turned. No other customers. 35mm photoreal, slight film grain, warm interior tones holding against the cool predawn blue outside. Ambient sound: the soft steady hiss of the coffee brewer, a quiet country song playing on a small kitchen radio (gentle late-period Willie Nelson, slow guitar and sparse voice), the waitress's pen scratching on her pad, a single dish settling somewhere in the back kitchen, the very faint hum of the diner's refrigeration, no traffic, no voices.
thought: Made it to the diner. Booth by the window, coffee, the whole faded-red-vinyl thing. Someone's at the counter with their back to me, writing something on a piece of paper. Half-eaten pie's been sitting in the dome a while. Some quiet Willie Nelson kind of song coming through the speaker. Out the window the sky's just starting to go peach. Okay — that was a lot. I'm done for today.
thought_zh: 進去 diner 了。靠窗的卡座，咖啡，整個褪色紅色合成皮的那一套。櫃台那邊有一個人背對著我，在一張紙上寫東西。圓玻璃罩裡那個吃了一半的派看起來放滿久了。喇叭在放某首像 Willie Nelson 的安靜的歌。窗外的天空剛剛開始轉粉。OK——今天真的不少。我今天就到這。
thought_ja: ダイナーに入った。窓際のボックス席、コーヒー、あの色あせた赤いビニールレザーのフルセット。カウンターのほうで誰かこっちに背中向けて、紙になんか書いてる。ガラスのドームの中、食べかけのパイがけっこう前から座ったままっぽい。スピーカーから静かなウィリー・ネルソンっぽい曲。窓の外、空がやっと桃色になりはじめた。よし——今日、なかなかだったな。今日はここまで。

prompt: first-person view at street level on a wet Taipei sidewalk at night, only the lower half of frame is the speaker's own world — dark sneakers on a rain-slicked tile pavement, a tied stack of flattened cardboard to the right, a parked scooter's front wheel further right, warm yellow fluorescent-tube light spilling out from a 自助餐 storefront on the left, the sign half-lit, a shallow puddle reflecting the orange Chinese characters of the sign in fragments. background: a quiet narrow Taipei alley, telephone wires sagging, a couple of older apartments stacked above shop level, AC units, lit windows, a faint motorcycle passing in the deep background. light intermittent rain. ambient sound: soft rain on pavement, a kettle whistling once from inside the 自助餐, a single distant scooter passing, no music. 35mm film stock, slightly grainy, naturalistic colour, documentary photo aesthetic. no people in foreground, no faces.
thought: Okay — I'm on some sidewalk? Looking down at my own feet. Wet tile, there's a stack of cardboard tied up right next to me, and someone's 自助餐 is open right there, light all over the puddle. Smells like soy sauce. No idea how I got here. Let me look up.
thought_zh: OK——我在某條人行道上？低頭看自己的腳。地是濕磁磚，旁邊有一疊綁起來的紙板，有人的自助餐就開在那裡，光灑滿了水窪。聞起來是醬油味。完全不知道我是怎麼到這裡的。我抬頭看一下。
thought_ja: あー、なんかどっかの歩道？自分の足を見下ろしてる。タイルが濡れてて、横に縛った段ボールの山があって、誰かの自助餐がそこで開いてて、光が水たまりにぜんぶ落ちてる。醤油のにおいがする。どうやってここに来たのか、さっぱり分からない。ちょっと顔上げてみよう。

prompt: narrow wet Taipei alley at night, first-person seated view from a kerb. the camera holds nearly still; a pair of dark sneakers in the foreground, slowly the speaker shifts weight as if about to stand. a stack of tied cardboard to the right, a parked white scooter, a 自助餐 storefront glowing warm yellow on the left, telephone wires sagging, lit windows in older apartments above. one distant pedestrian under an umbrella far down the alley, walking slowly away. light steady rain. small ripples appear in the puddle as drops land. ambient sound: soft rain on pavement and tile, a faint TV variety-show audio leaking from a window above (Mandarin laughter and a host's voice), one distant scooter passing in the far background, no music. 35mm film stock, grainy, naturalistic colour, documentary feel.
thought: Wow it's really wet. One person way down at the end of the alley, that's it. I think someone's TV is on above me — sounds like a Mandarin variety show, that kind of laughter. Let me stand up and walk.
thought_zh: 哇，真的很濕。整條巷子就只有最尾端那個人，就這樣。我頭頂上有人開著電視——聽起來是國語綜藝節目，那種笑聲。我站起來走走。
thought_ja: うわ、めっちゃ濡れてる。路地のずっと先に一人いるだけ、それで全部。頭の上で誰かのテレビついてるな——たぶん中華圏のバラエティ、ああいう笑い声。立って歩こう。

prompt: wet Taipei alley at night, first-person view turning to face an open-fronted small 自助餐 (Taiwanese cafeteria buffet). the camera nudges slightly forward toward the storefront. through the wide-open shop front: a long stainless-steel counter under harsh fluorescent tubes, half a dozen rectangular metal trays of food — soy-braised pork rice topping, stir-fried water spinach, fried tofu cubes, a half-eaten salted fish, a tray of pickled cabbage, all looking picked-over. a woman in her sixties in a faded floral apron stands behind the counter, half-turned away, slowly wiping her hands on a damp cloth. red plastic stools stacked against the back wall. a small CRT TV mounted high in the corner playing a low-volume Taiwanese-language drama. red Chinese-character sign 自助餐 visible above the entrance. light rain still falling outside the shop, glistening on the wet sidewalk in front. ambient sound: rain, the muffled drone of the Taiwanese drama with a woman's voice, fluorescent buzz, the woman's faint humming, no music. 35mm film stock, slightly grainy, warm naturalistic colour, documentary photo aesthetic.
thought: Oh — the camera just shoved me right inside. Trays everywhere, water spinach, fried tofu, a couple of dark braised things. The lady behind the counter just looked up at me. There's a guy in the back too. TV's news actually, not the drama I thought I was hearing. Hmm. Am I gonna order something? Not even sure I'm hungry.
thought_zh: 欸——鏡頭直接把我推進去了。盤子滿坑滿谷，空心菜、炸豆腐、兩三盤滷的。櫃台那個女生剛剛抬頭看了我一眼。後面還有一個男的。電視其實是新聞，不是我以為聽到的那齣戲。嗯。我要點嗎？也不確定我餓不餓。
thought_ja: おっ——カメラが俺をそのまま中まで押し込んだ。トレイだらけ、空心菜、揚げ豆腐、煮込み系がいくつか。カウンターの女の人がいま顔上げてこっち見たな。奥に男の人も一人いる。テレビ、ドラマかと思ってたけど実はニュースだ。うーん。注文するのか？お腹空いてるかどうかも自分で分からん。

prompt: interior of a small Taipei 自助餐 at night, but the camera now shifts to a low first-person view from behind the stainless-steel buffet counter, looking outward across the metal trays toward the open shopfront and the wet alley beyond. the trays in the immediate foreground — stir-fried water spinach, fried tofu cubes, dark braised meat, pickled cabbage — slightly out of focus. through the open shopfront, light steady rain falls onto the wet alley, the pavement reflecting the storefront's fluorescent light. no customers visible. a faint silhouette of a single pedestrian under an umbrella crosses the alley far in the background. occasionally a pair of hands in the bottom of frame: a woman's hands holding a damp white cloth, briefly wiping a smudge from the stainless steel surface. ambient: steady rain on pavement outside, the soft hum and buzz of fluorescent tubes, low Mandarin news broadcast in the background, no music, no speech in foreground. 35mm film stock, slightly grainy, warm interior fluorescent contrasting the cool wet alley.
thought: Hmm — that didn't land. I wanted to be on her side of the counter but the camera just sort of hung in the doorway. Same trays, same TV. She's stepped out of frame somewhere. Eight seconds of looking at fried tofu. Okay let me actually commit this time — let me be the TV up in the corner, looking back down at the empty shop.
thought_zh: 嗯——這個沒成。我想要從她櫃台後面那一邊看出去，結果鏡頭就只是吊在門口那邊。一樣的盤子、一樣的電視。她不知道走到鏡頭外哪裡去了。八秒鐘看著炸豆腐。好——這次認真來——我要當角落上面那台電視，反過來往下看這間空店。
thought_ja: うーん——うまくいかなかった。彼女のカウンターの内側から見たかったのに、カメラが入り口あたりにふわっと浮いてただけ。同じトレイ、同じテレビ。彼女、画面の外のどっかに出てった。揚げ豆腐を八秒見てた。よし、今度はちゃんとやろう——角の上のテレビになって、空っぽの店を上から見下ろしたい。

prompt: wide-angle high overhead first-person view from a small CRT television mounted high in a corner of a small Taipei 自助餐 at night, looking down across the long stainless-steel buffet counter — six rectangular metal trays of food (stir-fried water spinach, fried tofu, braised pork, pickled cabbage, fried fish), a microwave on the right end of the counter, red plastic stools stacked against the back wall and one pulled out where a woman in her sixties in a faded floral apron sits, head bent down toward her phone, faint blue glow lighting her face. the open shopfront is on the left side of the frame, the wet alley dimly visible beyond. fluorescent tubes overhead casting flat hard light. the angle is from a high corner, slightly tilted down, fisheye-ish. red Chinese characters '自助餐' visible reversed/half on the front sign. ambient sound: the TV itself broadcasting a low female Mandarin news anchor voice, faint hum of fluorescent tubes, faint rain through the open shopfront, no music. 35mm film stock, slightly grainy, warm interior fluorescent.
thought: Huh — apparently I'm next to the TV, not inside it. The TV's still up there in the corner with a news anchor on it. But the view is good — wide fisheye, looking down. She's on a red stool scrolling her phone. Microwave next to her. Trays right under me — water spinach, fried tofu, some dark braised pieces. The whole place is lit like a hospital.
thought_zh: 蛤——好像我是在電視旁邊，不是在電視裡面。電視還在角落上播新聞主播。不過這個視角不錯——廣角魚眼，往下看。她坐在一張紅塑膠凳上滑手機。旁邊一台微波爐。盤子就在我正下方——空心菜、炸豆腐、兩盤滷的。整間店亮得像醫院一樣。
thought_ja: あれ——どうやら俺はテレビの隣で、中じゃないみたい。テレビは相変わらず角の上で、ニュースキャスターが映ってる。でも眺めはいい——広角の魚眼、見下ろし。彼女は赤いプラスチックの丸椅子に座ってスマホをスクロール中。隣に電子レンジ。トレイは真下——空心菜、揚げ豆腐、煮込み系のやつ。店内、病院みたいに明るい。

prompt: interior of a small old Taipei apartment living room late at night, low first-person POV from a shelf or low coffee table. in the centre of the frame, a small CRT television facing the camera, its screen showing a Mandarin-language news anchor mid-sentence — same anchor and same channel as in the buffet shop. behind the TV, on a brown faux-leather couch, an old man in a white sleeveless undershirt and dark shorts is half-reclined and fast asleep, mouth slightly open, a TV remote loose in his hand, one bare foot on the tile floor, the other resting on the cushion. a small white electric fan oscillating in the corner. a steel-mesh anti-burglary window beyond him, slightly open, looking out across a narrow rain-darkened alley to the warm yellow glow of a 自助餐 storefront across the way. cluttered shelf to the side of the frame: a thermos, a stack of magazines, a small ceramic 布袋 (Budai) figurine, a glass of half-drunk tea, a single mosquito coil burning low in a saucer giving off a thin curl of smoke. ambient: low Mandarin news from the TV, the oscillating fan's hum, light rain outside, a faint refrigerator hum from another room, no music. 35mm film stock, slightly grainy, mixed warm tungsten lamp glow and cool blue-grey TV light.
thought: Oh — same news anchor. I'm in someone's living room now. There's an old guy on the couch, fast asleep with the remote still in his hand. Fan going, refrigerator humming somewhere. Window's open and you can see the alley below — that same 自助餐 still glowing across the way. So this whole time, the TV I was hearing was actually his.
thought_zh: 欸——同一個主播。我現在在某個人的客廳。沙發上有個老先生，整個睡死了，遙控器還握在手上。電風扇在轉，冰箱不知道在哪邊嗡嗡叫。窗開著，可以看到下面的巷子——那家自助餐還在對街亮著。所以從頭到尾，我聽到的那台電視其實是他的。
thought_ja: あ——同じキャスター。いま誰かの居間にいる。ソファに年配の男の人、リモコン握ったままぐっすり寝てる。扇風機回ってて、冷蔵庫がどこかで唸ってる。窓は開いてて、下の路地が見える——あの自助餐、向かい側でまだ光ってる。つまりずっと聞こえてたあのテレビ、実はこの人のだったのか。

prompt: inside a brightly-lit Taipei TV news studio at night, medium first-person view from across the news desk. the female Mandarin-language news anchor (mid-thirties, dark shoulder-length hair, navy blazer over a white blouse) is no longer addressing camera — the moment is right after she has been cut to commercial. her hands have dropped, her earpiece is half-out and dangling on her shoulder, and she is reaching with one hand for a styrofoam cup of iced milk-tea just beside the teleprompter. her professional camera-ready expression has slipped — eyes a little tired, lips parted as if exhaling. behind her: the green-blue keyed news graphic background panel, a desk piled with printed scripts and a black binder, a microphone, cables on the floor, and on the far edge of the studio one camera operator in a black t-shirt sitting on a stool scrolling on his phone, lit only by the spill of studio light. overhead studio key lights very bright, casting a slightly cool harsh light. ambient: studio HVAC hum, faint chatter from a distant control booth, the small tick-tick of an overhead light fixture, no music, no speech. 35mm film stock, slightly grainy, harsh white studio light.
thought: Curious about this anchor — let me step through the screen and see what she's like off-camera. Okay — I'm in her studio now. They just cut to commercial. She's reaching for an iced milk-tea, earpiece dangling. The camera operator's on his phone. She looks way more tired off-air than she did on it.
thought_zh: 對這個主播有點好奇——我穿過螢幕進去，看她下了攝影機是什麼樣。OK——我已經在她的攝影棚裡。剛剛切到廣告。她正伸手去拿一杯冰奶茶，耳機掛在肩上。攝影師在滑自己的手機。她不在播報的時候，看起來累很多。
thought_ja: このキャスター気になるな——画面を抜けて、カメラ降りた状態の彼女を見てみたい。よし——もうスタジオの中。さっきCMに切れた。アイスミルクティーに手を伸ばしてて、イヤモニが肩に垂れてる。カメラマンは自分のスマホ見てる。本番のときよりずっと疲れた顔してるな。

prompt: first-person eye-level view of a small Taipei neighbourhood 土地公 shrine tucked into the corner of a quiet residential lane at night. the shrine itself is a tiny waist-high red-painted wooden structure with a glass front; inside a small ceramic 土地公 figure (white-bearded, smiling, in red robes). three sticks of fresh-lit incense burn in a small bronze censer in front of the figure, thin curls of smoke rising slowly. on the offering tray: two oranges and a small can of green tea. a few folded gold-paper joss papers stacked just outside the shrine on a low ledge. the surroundings are ordinary modern Taipei: a parked silver car immediately left, an electric meter box on the wall above with messy wiring, a small white surveillance camera, an AC unit, the old sloped red-tile roof of the small adjacent house. light steady rain falling. the shrine has its own small built-in lamp lit, casting warm yellow light on the offerings and the figure. wet alley pavement reflects everything in fragmented warm orange. ambient: rain on tile roof, a distant scooter passing somewhere, a faint insect hum, no music, no people in frame. 35mm film stock, slightly grainy, mixed warm shrine lamp glow and cool wet alley night.
thought: Okay, stepped out of the studio and ended up here — a tiny 土地公廟 shoved into the corner of someone's lane. Someone just lit fresh incense, it's still going. Two oranges and a can of green tea on the offering tray. Nobody around. Rain's still coming down. I like this.
thought_zh: OK，從攝影棚走出來就到這了——一座超小的土地公廟，硬塞在人家巷子的轉角。剛剛有人來上過香，還在燒。供桌上兩顆橘子跟一罐綠茶。沒人。雨還在下。我喜歡這個。
thought_ja: よし、スタジオを出たらここに着いてた——めっちゃ小さい土地公廟、誰かの路地の角にぎゅっと押し込まれてる。さっき誰か新しい線香あげたばっかりで、まだ燃えてる。お供えの台にミカン二つと緑茶の缶ひとつ。誰もいない。雨はまだ降ってる。これ、好きだな。

prompt: the same small Taipei 土地公 shrine at night, camera essentially still. the three lit incense sticks continue to burn, slow curls of smoke rising upward gently. light steady rain still falling. in the foreground at the bottom of frame, a small black-and-white stray cat with a stubby tail slips silently into view from the right, walks across the wet alley pavement past the shrine on its low padded paws, pauses briefly mid-frame to lap at the rain puddle that reflects the shrine's warm orange light, raises its head, then keeps walking softly out of frame to the left. ambient: steady rain on tiles and pavement, a distant scooter passing somewhere, the soft clack of the cat's claws, the very faint hiss of incense burning, no music. 35mm film stock, slightly grainy, mixed warm shrine lamp glow and cool wet alley night.
thought: Wait — that's a dog, not a cat. Little fluffy black-and-white one just trotted past the shrine, sniffed at the puddle, tail up, off down the alley. Let me follow.
thought_zh: 等等——那是狗不是貓。小小一隻毛茸茸的黑白色，剛剛從廟前面小跑過去，聞了一下水窪，尾巴翹著就往巷子裡去了。我跟過去看看。
thought_ja: あれ——猫じゃなくて犬だ。ちっちゃくてモフモフの白黒、廟の前をトコトコ通ってって、水たまりちょっと匂い嗅いで、しっぽ立てて路地の奥に行った。ついて行ってみよう。

prompt: first-person view at dog-eye level (about 30cm above the ground) in a wet Taipei alley at night, the speaker now embodied as the small black-and-white fluffy dog from before. directly ahead, blocking most of the frame: a silver corrugated metal shop shutter rolled three-quarters of the way down, leaving only about 25cm of horizontal opening at the bottom — a sliver of warm yellow light and faint visible steam spilling out from underneath. one of the dog's own white-and-black front paws is visible at the bottom edge of the frame, stepping into a small rain puddle on the wet tile pavement. to the left of the shutter, a green plastic crate of empty Taiwan beer bottles. a few drips still falling from the shutter's lower edge. above the shutter, a faded shop signboard with partially visible red Chinese characters '麵' and a couple of bright cracked tube-light traces. raindrops dimpling the puddle. ambient: rain, faint clinking of dishes from inside the half-shut shop, a soft Taiwanese-language ballad on a small radio inside, light kitchen sounds (a wok hissing briefly), no music outside. 35mm film stock, slightly grainy, low-angle, naturalistic warm-cool colour mix.
thought: Hmm — that's not the dog POV I asked for. I'm a step behind him watching him decide. He's stopped right at the half-down shutter, head tilted toward the gap, steam coming out the bottom. Kitchen still going on the right side. Smells like 麵. He's deciding.
thought_zh: 嗯——這不是我要的狗視角。我是站在牠後面一步看牠在那邊決定。牠就停在那扇拉了一半的鐵捲門前面，頭斜斜地對著縫，下面冒著熱氣。右邊廚房還在動。聞起來是麵。牠在猶豫。
thought_ja: うーん——頼んだ犬視点じゃないな。一歩後ろから、こいつが迷ってるのを見てる感じ。半分降りたシャッターのところでぴたっと止まってて、頭を隙間に傾けてて、下から湯気。右側でキッチンまだ動いてる。匂いは麵だ。こいつ、悩んでる。

prompt: interior of a small late-night Taipei 麵 (noodle) shop near closing time, seen from a slightly low angle near the front. an old cook in his sixties, white t-shirt and a stained navy apron, is sitting at one of the small stainless-steel tables eating his own bowl of beef noodles — chopsticks raised, mid-bite, but currently paused. the kitchen at the back is mostly clean — a big stockpot still simmering on a low blue flame, ladles hung up, a stack of clean enamel bowls. the half-down shutter is visible on the left edge of frame, and the small black-and-white fluffy dog from before has just ducked under and is standing just inside, fur slightly damp, looking up at the cook. the cook is looking down at the dog with that particular old-Taipei face — slightly-irritated-but-secretly-fond, eyebrow lifted. on the tiled floor by his foot, a small chipped ceramic bowl already has a tiny pile of leftover beef-noodle bits scooped into it. a small CRT TV on a high shelf in the corner shows the same Mandarin news anchor at very low volume. wet tile floor near the front from the rain coming under the shutter. ambient: the simmering of the stockpot, faint very-low TV news, slow rain leak, the dog panting quietly, no music. 35mm film stock, slightly grainy, warm tungsten kitchen light, mildly humid air visibly hanging.
thought: Aw — the dog ducked right under and the cook's already clocked him. Old guy with chopsticks halfway to his mouth, looking down at this dog like 'again? you?'. There's already a little chipped bowl on the floor with some leftover noodle bits in it. Looks like this isn't the first time. Dog's tail's already going.
thought_zh: 啊——這隻狗直接從鐵門下面鑽進去，廚師已經發現牠了。老先生筷子才舉到嘴邊一半，往下看著這隻狗，那種「又來啊你」的表情。地上已經有一個有缺角的小碗，裡面已經有一些剩下的麵條碎肉。看起來這不是第一次了。狗的尾巴已經在搖了。
thought_ja: あー——犬、シャッターの下からそのまま入ってって、おじさんもすぐ気づいた。年配の人、お箸を口の途中まで持ってって、そのまま犬を見下ろしてる、「またお前か」って顔。床にもう、欠けた小さなお椀が置いてあって、麵の切れ端と肉のかけらがちょっと入ってる。これ、初めてじゃないっぽい。犬のしっぽ、もう振れてる。

prompt: interior of a Taipei MRT (Metro) carriage late at night, rendered entirely in detailed 16-bit pixel art — think Symphony of the Night / late-90s SNES JRPG quality, with dithered shading, distinct visible pixel grid, limited but rich palette of muted blues, oranges, and skin tones. the carriage is mostly empty: a tired office worker in a wrinkled white shirt and loose tie asleep against the window, head tilted, mouth slightly open, briefcase resting on his lap; further down the carriage an older woman in a floral blouse sitting and looking at a small flip-style phone, the screen tinted faint blue; a teenage girl standing near the door with white earbuds in, scrolling on a smartphone, hair half-covering her face. the carriage interior is the standard Taipei MRT design — pale blue plastic seats with an orange line stripe along the top, stainless poles, hanging straps. through the carriage windows, the dark MRT tunnel slides past, but in one window the train has briefly emerged above-ground and a tiny pixel-rendered Taipei skyline with the 101 tower is visible in the distance. above the door, an LED display in pixelated Chinese characters reads '下一站 古亭'. visible flooring: speckled grey rubber floor. ambient sound: muffled hum of the train rolling on tracks, a slight metallic squeal at a curve, a very faint pre-recorded Mandarin station announcement, no music. pure 16-bit pixel art style throughout, no realism, no photo elements.
thought: Hmm — came out more cel-illustrated than 16-bit pixel, but I'll take it. Late MRT — office guy out cold, tie loose, an auntie scrolling on her flip phone, a schoolgirl with a backpack on her phone too. 下一站 古亭. Outside the window, dark Taipei sliding past. Train just keeps moving.
thought_zh: 嗯——比起 16-bit 像素，比較像賽璐珞插畫，但這個也可以。深夜捷運——上班族男生整個睡死，領帶也鬆了，一個阿姨在滑她的折疊手機，一個揹著書包的女學生也在滑手機。下一站 古亭。窗外，整片暗暗的台北一直在往後跑。電車就這樣一直往前。
thought_ja: うーん——16ビットピクセルというよりはセル画寄りに出たな、でもこれもアリ。深夜のMRT——サラリーマンの男の人、ネクタイ緩めてぐっすり、おばちゃんが折りたたみ携帯をスクロールしてて、リュックの女子生徒もスマホ。次は古亭。窓の外、暗い台北がずっと流れていく。電車はそのまま走り続ける。

prompt: clean modern cel-shaded 2D animation aesthetic, same illustrated style as before — soft warm and cool tones, defined linework, gentle gradient skies. point-of-view from street level just outside the exit of a Taipei MRT station, the curving stainless-steel arched canopy of the exit visible to one side, fluorescent light from the underground reflecting off the wet stairs. rain falling steady. one person ahead in a dark coat with a transparent vinyl umbrella has just stepped off the bottom step and is starting to walk away. mostly empty street ahead: a wet asphalt road reflecting the night, two YouBike bicycles in a docking station against the kerb, a small 早餐店 (Taiwanese breakfast shop) across the road already closed with its silver metal shutter pulled down three-quarters, an illuminated green and orange 7-Eleven sign glowing further down the street, a few distant scooter taillights blurred at a red light at the next intersection. telephone wires above. ambient sound: rain pattering on the metal canopy, soft hiss of distant traffic on wet road, a faint mechanical click from the YouBike dock, no music. cel animation style throughout — flat coloured shapes with soft gradients, no photo realism.
thought: Got off at 古亭. Wet empty street. A guy with a clear umbrella is going DOWN into the station as I'm coming up — we just passed each other on the steps. YouBikes parked right outside the canopy, two of them. 7-11 across the way, red light at the corner. Rain's still going.
thought_zh: 在古亭站下車。街上濕的，沒什麼人。一個拿透明傘的男的正在往下走進站，我正在往上——我們剛剛在階梯上交錯。出口頂篷外面 YouBike 停了兩台。對面是 7-11，路口紅燈。雨還在下。
thought_ja: 古亭で降りた。濡れててガラガラの通り。透明な傘さした男の人が階段を下りて駅に入ってって、俺は逆に上がってってる——いまちょうど階段ですれ違った。出口の屋根のすぐ外にYouBikeが二台。向かいは7-11、角は赤信号。雨はまだ降ってる。

prompt: first-person eye-level view standing at the high concrete embankment of the 新店溪 river in Taipei at night, light steady rain still falling. directly ahead and below: the wide dark river surface, reflecting orange and yellow viaduct lighting and a distant bridge as fragmented streaks of warm light. crossing the river upstream in the middle distance is a long elevated viaduct with bright sodium-yellow lights and red car taillights moving in one direction, white headlights in the other. beyond the river on the far bank, scattered random lit windows of an apartment-block neighbourhood (公館/永和 area). closer in the immediate foreground: the wet concrete riverbank walkway, a single tall sodium light pole illuminating a small section of damp pavement and a low metal handrail, a fenced bike path running parallel. a single older YouBike rider in a transparent rain poncho has just cycled past from right to left, slightly silhouetted against the warm light, the wet hiss of bike tires implied. ambient: rain on concrete and on the river surface, the distant low rumble of viaduct traffic, the soft whirring of the cyclist's tires fading away, a single distant ambulance siren far far in the city, no music. 35mm film stock, slightly grainy, realism returns, naturalistic colour, cinematic wide horizon framing.
thought: Walked off and ended up at the river — 新店溪. The viaduct way down there is bright yellow, taillights one way, headlights the other. Across the water there's a whole bank of lit windows, must be 公館 or 永和, can't tell. Some guy in a clear rain poncho just biked past me. Rain still steady.
thought_zh: 走著走著就到河邊——新店溪。底下那條高架是亮黃色的，尾燈一邊、頭燈另一邊。對岸有一整排亮著的窗，應該是公館還是永和，分不出來。剛剛一個穿透明雨衣的男的騎腳踏車從我旁邊過。雨還在穩穩地下。
thought_ja: 歩いてったら川に出た——新店溪。下の高架道路、明るい黄色、テールランプが片方、ヘッドライトがもう片方。川の向こうに灯りのついた窓がずらっと、たぶん公館か永和、どっちか分からん。さっき透明のレインポンチョ着た男の人、自転車で横を通ってった。雨はずっと一定で降ってる。

prompt: interior of a Taipei 計程車 (yellow cab) at night, first-person view from a passenger seat in the back. the taxi is moving slowly through wet city streets, light steady rain on the windshield being swept by wipers. through the windshield: the city ahead in a blur of red taillights and the smeared wet glow of neon shop signs in red, blue, and green. the dashboard is brightly lit and slightly cluttered — a digital meter mounted in the centre showing '$185' in red LED segment digits, a tape cassette deck still installed in the centre console, a small ceramic Buddha figurine on the dash, a small yellow rubber duck, an old plastic bobblehead. hanging from the rear-view mirror: a small octagonal 八卦鏡 mirror amulet and a yellow paper 平安符. the driver, an older man in his sixties wearing a faded windbreaker and a flat cap, is just visible from behind from his shoulders up — head turned slightly as he tracks an intersection ahead. radio on at low volume playing a slightly fuzzy 1980s 台語 ballad. wet windshield refracting all the city light into bokeh streaks. ambient: rain on glass and roof, the soft tick of the meter, the rhythmic scrape of the wipers, the soft 台語 ballad on the radio, the engine, the click of the indicator turning on once, no other speech. 35mm film stock, slightly grainy, mixed warm dashboard tungsten and cool wet city neon.
thought: Got into a cab somewhere. Old guy driving, sixties, flat cap. Still has a cassette deck. There's a 平安符 hanging off his mirror. Meter says $185 already. Some 台語 ballad on the radio I almost recognise. Wipers going. Where am I asking him to take me? Don't even know yet.
thought_zh: 不知道從哪上了一台計程車。司機老先生，六十幾歲，戴扁帽。中控還是卡帶式的。後照鏡掛著一個平安符。跳表已經 185 了。收音機放著一首台語老歌，我差一點就想得起來。雨刷在動。我到底是叫他載我去哪？我自己都還不知道。
thought_ja: 気づいたらどっかで計程車に乗ってた。運転手は年配のおじさん、60代、ハンチング。中央のオーディオはまだカセットデッキ。バックミラーに平安符が掛かってる。メーター、もう185。ラジオから台湾語のバラードが流れてて、もうちょっとで思い出せそう。ワイパー動いてる。俺、どこに連れてってって頼んだんだっけ？まだ自分でも分からない。

prompt: interior of a small private KTV (Karaoke) box in late-night Taipei, first-person view from one corner of the L-shaped fake black-leather couch. the room is dim, with neon-pink and dark-blue LED strip accent lighting running along the wall edges. the central wall is taken up by a large flat-screen TV showing a soft-focused 90s music video — a woman walking along a beach at sunset — with white karaoke subtitles overlaid; the visible lyric line right now reads '你問我愛你有多深'. on the low table in front of the couch: two half-empty pint glasses of Taiwan beer, three empty green Taiwan beer bottles, a plate of dried fruit, a mostly-emptied bowl of dried snacks, scattered chopsticks. on the couch are three middle-aged Taiwanese women in their forties — visibly tipsy and lit by the TV glow. one of them is on her feet near the TV, holding a wireless microphone in both hands, eyes closed, mid-sing, mouth open. the other two are still on the couch, one clapping along, the other laughing into her own drink. ambient sound: a slightly cheesy mid-quality KTV synth instrumental of 鄧麗君's '月亮代表我的心', the standing woman's amateur but heartfelt singing voice over it, the other women laughing and clapping, ice cubes clinking in glasses, faint room reverb, no other speech. 35mm film stock, slightly grainy, low ambient light with strong neon LED accents.
thought: Cab dropped me at some KTV. I'm in one of the boxes with four women in their forties, already pretty tipsy. One's standing in the back clapping, another's on the couch belting into the mic with her eyes closed — 鄧麗君, 月亮代表我的心. Beer everywhere on the table, plate of dried fruit. None of them have looked at me at all.
thought_zh: 計程車把我丟在一間 KTV。我現在在其中一個包廂，跟四個四十幾歲的姊姊們在一起，已經有點茫了。一個站在後面在拍手，一個坐在沙發上閉著眼睛對著麥克風唱——鄧麗君，月亮代表我的心。桌上滿滿都是啤酒，還有一盤蜜餞乾果。她們從頭到尾沒有任何一個人看我一眼。
thought_ja: 計程車があるKTVで降ろして去ってった。いま、ある個室に四十代の女性四人と一緒にいて、もうみんなだいぶ仕上がってる。一人は奥で立って手を叩いてて、もう一人はソファで目つむってマイクに歌い込んでる——鄧麗君の月亮代表我的心。テーブルはビールだらけ、ドライフルーツの皿もひとつ。四人とも、こっちを一回も見てない。

prompt: 1985-era 16mm Taiwanese television music-video aesthetic, soft-focus, slightly hazy, slightly bleached, warm gold filtration, visible fine film grain, gentle vintage colour palette. a quiet beach somewhere on Taiwan's east coast (福隆 or similar) in late afternoon golden hour, wet packed sand at the surf line. a young Taiwanese woman in her early thirties walks slowly alone along the wet sand at the edge of small breaking waves, moving away from the camera, in a long flowing pale-pink dress that catches the breeze, her dark hair loose and lifting slightly. she is barefoot, holding a pair of white sandals dangling loosely from one hand. small waves break behind her in soft-focus, almost slow-motion. above the horizon, low backlit clouds catch warm orange-pink light. far in the distance a tiny black silhouette of a fishing boat. the camera holds at a respectful medium distance, lens slightly stopped down so depth of field is shallow and the woman is the only crisp focal point in frame. no other people. ambient sound: 鄧麗君's 1977 studio recording of '月亮代表我的心' — gentle strings and piano arrangement, her clear voice on the slow melodic phrases — playing as if it IS the soundtrack of the scene, with no surf or wind sound at all, just the song. 1980s soft-focus film aesthetic strictly maintained.
thought: Wanted to step into that music video so — okay. Late afternoon beach. The woman from the screen is there, walking slow along the surf in a pink dress, sandals in her hand. Hazy gold light, soft 80s film edges. The wave sound is just gone — only her song, that 鄧麗君 string-and-piano track. Think this is supposed to be 福隆 or somewhere on the east coast.
thought_zh: 想要走進那支 MV 看看——好，現在到了。傍晚的海灘。螢幕裡的那個女生就在那邊，穿粉紅洋裝慢慢沿著浪邊走，涼鞋拿在手上。霧霧的金色光，那種 80 年代軟焦邊緣。浪的聲音整個消失了——只有她那首歌，鄧麗君那個弦樂跟鋼琴的版本。看樣子這應該是福隆，或者東海岸某個地方。
thought_ja: あのMVに入ってみたかった——よし、来た。夕方のビーチ。画面にいたあの女の人、ピンクのワンピで波打ち際をゆっくり歩いてて、サンダルを手に持ってる。霞んだ金色の光、80年代のソフトフォーカスっぽい縁。波の音、完全に消えてる——あの曲だけ、鄧麗君のストリングスとピアノのやつ。これたぶん福隆か、東海岸のどっかだ。

prompt: interior of the same dim Taipei KTV box room as before, now framed wider — we see the entire room from a step back. on the central flat-screen TV: the same warm-toned beach image from a moment ago is still visible (a woman in a pink dress on the surf line in soft 80s film), but now overlaid on the screen is a karaoke score graphic — large red bouncing numbers '98分' with a yellow 'PERFECT' or '達人' banner and a small explosion-of-stars graphic. the song has just ended. on the L-shaped fake-leather couch, the four middle-aged women in their forties have stopped singing — the woman who was standing has lowered the wireless mic to her side and is bent forward laughing at the score, the others are leaning back relaxed, one is checking her smartphone, one is reaching for her beer glass with two fingers. neon-pink and dark-blue LED strips along the wall edges still on. low fluorescent light leaks faintly under the door from the corridor outside. ambient sound: the cheesy KTV 'song complete' digital fanfare jingle ringing out, the women laughing, ice clinking in glasses, very faint muffled upbeat Mandarin pop song (a Mayday-style track) bleeding through the wall from the next karaoke box, no other music in this room anymore. 35mm film stock, slightly grainy, low ambient light with neon LED accents.
thought: Pulled back. The music video is just over — there's a big 98分 splashed across the screen with that cheesy KTV fanfare. The woman who was singing has dropped the mic and is bent over laughing at the score. The others are leaning back, one of them on her phone, one reaching for her beer. Through the wall from the next box you can hear Mayday or something kicking in. Magic gone.
thought_zh: 鏡頭拉回來了。那支 MV 剛結束——螢幕上潑了一個大大的 98 分，配那個 KTV 俗俗的成績特效。剛剛在唱的姊姊已經把麥克風放下，整個彎下去笑那個分數。其他人靠回沙發上，有一個在滑手機，有一個在伸手拿啤酒。隔壁包廂的牆隔過來，可以聽到五月天還是什麼歌的前奏剛起。剛剛那個感覺沒了。
thought_ja: 引いた。MV終わった——画面に大きく98分、あの安っぽいKTVのファンファーレ付き。さっき歌ってた人はマイクを下ろして、点数のことで身体折って笑ってる。他の人たちはソファに背中預けて、一人はスマホ、一人はビールに手を伸ばしてる。隣の個室の壁の向こうから、メイデイか何かの曲のイントロが入ってきてる。さっきの空気はもう消えた。

prompt: exterior view at dawn of a tiny street-level Taipei 早餐店 (Taiwanese breakfast shop) just before opening, first-person eye-level on the wet sidewalk across the narrow lane. the metal roll-down shutter of the small shop is in the middle of being raised — already pulled up about two-thirds — by the owner: an auntie in her fifties wearing a hairnet, a dark t-shirt and a stained pale-blue apron, visible from the waist up bent slightly under the shutter. inside the now half-revealed storefront: glowing fluorescent tubes already on, a long stainless-steel flat-top grill being heated, a stack of chopped scallions on the prep counter, jars of soy paste and chilli sauce, a black plastic crate of eggs, a small CRT TV mounted on the wall in the corner showing the morning weather news. above the storefront, a faded red-and-white sign with characters '早餐' and the smaller specialty list ('蛋餅 漢堡 燒餅 豆漿'). the lane outside is still wet from overnight rain, but rain has stopped. the sky above is the deep blue-grey of just-before-sunrise with thin pink-orange streaks low in the east between two buildings. an old man with grey hair, a yellow plastic helmet still on, has just propped his black bicycle against the curb and is standing with one foot on the kerb, waiting — clearly the first customer. ambient sound: the metal shutter rolling up with a slow clatter, the soft hiss of a gas burner just lit on the grill, the auntie humming softly under her breath, a distant garbage truck playing 'Für Elise' melody very far away in the city, a single bird call, no other music. 35mm film stock, slightly grainy, naturalistic dawn colour mixing the warm fluorescent shop interior with cool blue exterior pre-dawn.
thought: Time-skipped to pre-dawn somewhere. The auntie at this 早餐店 is pulling the shutter up, gas already going, scallions chopped, eggs out. There's an old guy on a black bicycle already parked at the curb, yellow helmet on, waiting for her — first customer. Sky is that grey-blue with the pink coming in low. Way off in the distance, the 垃圾車 is playing 給愛麗絲. Rain stopped at some point.
thought_zh: 不知道在哪一段，時間直接跳到天亮前。這間早餐店的阿姨正在把鐵門拉上去，瓦斯已經點起來，蔥切好了，蛋拿出來了。路邊已經停著一個老先生跟他的黑色腳踏車，戴著黃色安全帽，在那邊等她——第一個客人。天空那種灰藍配上下方剛開始進來的粉紅。遠遠的地方，垃圾車在放給愛麗絲。雨在某個時間點停了。
thought_ja: どっかのタイミングで時間が一気に夜明け前に飛んだ。この早餐店のおばちゃんがシャッターを上げてて、ガスはもう点いてて、ネギは切ってあって、卵も出してある。歩道の端にもう年配のおじさんが黒い自転車と一緒に止まってて、黄色いヘルメットかぶってる——一番乗りの客。空はあのグレーブルーに、低いところから桃色が入ってきてる。ずっと遠くで、ゴミ収集車がエリーゼのためにを鳴らしてる。雨、どっかのタイミングで止んでたな。

prompt: first-person eye-level view standing on the flat concrete roof of a 5-story old Taipei apartment building, just at first light of dawn. directly in the foreground: one of those distinctive round orange Taiwanese water tanks (a 'GREEN' or 'NEPRO' brand 200-gallon tank) on a steel stand, a few bamboo poles with hanging laundry — a pale blue shirt, two grey towels, a child's pink leggings — fluttering slightly in the morning breeze. on the rim of the next water tank over, a single crested goshawk (鳳頭蒼鷹, 'Taiwan crested goshawk') is perched, head turned slightly, watching. spread out beyond: a sea of similar low Taipei rooftops in every direction — water tanks of mixed orange, white, blue; satellite dishes; a few potted plants on adjacent roofs; rusted railings. in the middle distance, a 9-story residential block. far in the distance, the sharp tapering form of the Taipei 101 tower, only its uppermost three or four segments catching the first golden-pink sunlight while the rest of the city is still cool blue-grey shadow. visible mountain ridges of 觀音山 / 大屯山 along the far horizon to the north, faintly defined. wet rooftop concrete still puddled in spots from overnight rain. ambient sound: a single distant rooster from a balcony nearby, soft morning breeze, distant traffic far below, a single scooter horn blocks away, the quick wing-beats of a smaller bird passing close to camera, no music. 35mm film stock, slightly grainy, naturalistic dawn colour, cool shadows in the foreground contrasting warm gold on 101's tip.
