thought: Climbed up to a little hilltop overlook — Atago-jinja maybe, one of those — and the whole city's spread out below. 6:25, sun's just fully gone but the western horizon is still holding that thin peach band. About a third of the windows are already lit up across the buildings, scattered like little embers. Tokyo Tower's full-on glowing orange right of center. Crescent moon up in the upper left, first stars coming through. Shinjuku silhouettes on the far left edge. There's a wooden bench down to my right somebody just got up from. Okay, today's enough. I'm going to sit down and watch this for a minute, then I'm done.
thought_zh: 爬上一個小山頭的觀景台——大概是愛宕神社那種地方——整座城市在下面攤開來。6:25，太陽剛完全下去，西邊地平線上還留著一條薄薄的桃色。三分之一的窗戶已經點起來，散在各棟樓上像一顆顆小餘燼。東京鐵塔右邊偏中間，整個橘色亮著。左上一彎月牙，第一批星出來了。最左邊新宿那一群塔的剪影。右邊底下一張木椅，剛剛有人從那邊起來走了。OK，今天就到這裡。我要坐下來看一分鐘，然後就收。
thought_ja: ちっちゃい丘のうえの見晴らし台に登った——愛宕神社とか、ああいうとこ——街ぜんぶ下に広がってる。6:25、日はもう完全に落ちたけど、西の地平線にうす桃色の帯がまだ残ってる。三分の一くらいの窓がもう点いてて、ビルのあちこちに散らばって、ちっちゃい残り火みたいに見える。東京タワーが画面の中央右でガッツリ橘色に光ってる。左上に三日月、最初の星が出てきた。いちばん左の縁に新宿の塔群のシルエット。右下に木のベンチ、ついさっき誰かが立ち上がって行ったとこ。オッケー、今日はもうここまでにしとく。座って一分眺めて、それで終わりにする。

prompt: Inside the great-ape building at a Taiwan zoo, just past opening on a weekday morning. POV from the inside-of-the-glass — i.e. the camera is positioned right at the plexiglass viewing pane on the keeper's side, looking back out at the visitor side: a smudged thick plexiglass viewing pane fills most of the frame in the foreground, dozens of small kid-sized handprints in greasy smears on the glass surface catching the soft overhead light, a single adult Sumatran orangutan, female, pressed up close to the glass on the inside (between camera and glass), her shoulder and the side of her face dominating the left third of frame, orange-red shaggy hair, big dark eyes calm and slightly bored, holding a piece of pale-green cabbage to her mouth, mid-bite. On the visitor side seen blurred through the glass: a woman in a teal rain shell holding a phone up to film, a small kid in a bright yellow rain hat sitting on her shoulders pressing one open palm against the glass adding another handprint, two grade-school kids further back leaning in. Diffused overcast morning daylight from translucent skylights above casts cool neutral light. Sound: faint extractor fan hum, a few muffled kid voices coming through the glass, a single water drip somewhere in the enclosure, the soft chewing sound of the cabbage. 35mm film stock, slight grain, neutral indoor color, very slightly handheld framing tilt, shallow depth of field focused on the cabbage and the orangutan's hand, the visitors blurred behind the glass, no camera movement, one held quiet beat.
thought: Okay — what — I think I'm a pane of plexiglass? Like one of the windows at the great-ape exhibit. There's an orangutan basically right up against me eating a piece of cabbage, and I can see all the kid handprints smeared all over me from this side. There's a little kid in a yellow rain hat on her mom's shoulders pressing a palm against me right now — adding another one. I think this is the zoo. Huh. Let me just sit here and look at her for a sec.
thought_zh: 蛤——什麼——我是…一片壓克力板？大概是大型靈長類館那種大窗戶的其中一片。一隻紅毛猩猩貼在我這邊，正在啃一塊高麗菜，從這邊看出去整片都是小朋友的手印糊滿。一個戴黃色雨帽的小妹妹被她媽媽扛在肩膀上，現在剛把一隻手掌印在我身上——又多一個。我猜這是動物園。蛤。我先在這邊看她一下好了。
thought_ja: え——なに——私、アクリル板？大型類人猿館の窓のひとつ、みたいなやつ？オランウータンが内側から私にぴったり張り付いて、キャベツかじってて、こっち側からはちっちゃい子の手形がいっぱい付いてるのが見える。黄色い雨帽子のちっちゃい女の子が、ママの肩に乗っかったまま、いま私に手のひらをぺたって押しつけてる——また一個増えた。たぶんここ動物園だ。へえ。とりあえずちょっと、彼女のこと見てる。

prompt: Inside the great-ape building at a Taiwan zoo. POV from the orangutan's perspective looking out through the smudged plexiglass at the visitor side: in the immediate foreground, partially out of focus, a long shaggy orange-red orangutan hand and hairy forearm holds a piece of pale green cabbage close to the bottom of frame, mid-bite, two large dark fingers and a thumb visible, slightly out of focus. Beyond — through the smudged plexiglass viewing pane covered in dozens of small greasy kid-sized handprints — a small Taiwanese girl about four years old in a bright yellow rain hat sits high on her mother's shoulders, both her tiny palms pressed flat against the glass at frame center, eyes wide and serious staring straight at the camera mouth slightly open. Behind and below her the mother in a teal rain shell holds a phone up filming. Two grade-school boys with disposable-camera flashes further to the right, partially blurred. The smudges on the glass catch the cool overhead skylight in greasy halos. Diffused overcast morning light through translucent skylights above. 35mm film stock, slight grain, soft cool neutral indoor color, shallow depth of field focused on the kid's face through the glass, foreground hand and cabbage softly out of focus, very subtle handheld tilt, one held quiet beat.
thought: Tried to be her, didn't quite take — I'm still on this side. She's got her back half-turned to me, working through the cabbage. Yellow-hat kid still up on her mom's shoulders, both palms flat on the glass. Two boys with phones over on the right. Mom right behind her with one hand on the kid's chest holding her steady. Okay — I want out of this building. Let me go find something with more sky.
thought_zh: 想當她，沒成功——我還是在這一邊。她半個背對著我，繼續啃高麗菜。黃帽小女孩還坐在媽媽肩上，兩個手掌都貼在玻璃上。右邊兩個小男生拿手機在拍。媽媽就站在她正後面，一隻手扶著小女孩的胸口固定她。好啦——我想出這棟建築。我要去找一個天空多一點的地方。
thought_ja: 彼女になろうとしたんだけど、うまく入らなかった——まだこっち側にいる。彼女は半分背を向けて、キャベツをずっと食べてる。黄帽子の子はまだお母さんの肩に乗ってて、両手のひらをべったりガラスにつけてる。右に男の子二人がスマホで撮ってる。お母さんは子のすぐ後ろで、片手を子の胸に当てて支えてる。よし——この建物から出たい。もっと空が見えるとこ探しに行こう。

prompt: Outdoor giraffe enclosure at Taipei Zoo at midday under a clear sunny blue sky. Low close shot at handrail height of the visitor observation platform — the camera right at the wood handrail. In the foreground a single Taiwan blue magpie (Urocissa caerulea) has just landed on the rail close to the camera, brilliant bird, iridescent dark cobalt-blue body, very long black-and-white-tipped tail trailing diagonally behind it, bright yellow eye, red beak, head cocked slightly to the side looking off frame-right curiously. The handrail wood is weathered grey-brown. Beyond the railing the giraffe enclosure spreads out in mid-distance: two adult giraffes (one taller, one a little shorter) eating leaves from a tall metal feeding rack, long necks lifted, mottled patterns clearly visible. Patches of dry yellow grass and dirt below them. Further back: lush green subtropical forested ridges of Maokong rising up under a clear sky with a few high white clouds. A blurred visitor in the right background — a Taiwanese boy about seven in a red cap and white t-shirt — one small hand pointing toward the magpie, the other pointing toward the giraffes, his father blurred behind him in a black t-shirt. Strong midday light, hard small shadows under the bird's feet on the wood. Sound: cicadas at full summer pitch, the soft chewing of giraffes, a distant cable car cable creaking from up the hill, one quick chattering call from the magpie, faint kids' voices further down the platform. 35mm film stock, fine grain, saturated greens and blues, very subtle handheld framing tilt, shallow depth of field focused on the magpie's eye.
thought: Okay — way better. I'm outside, sun's out, sky's open. Looks like I'm actually a Taiwan blue magpie now, perched on the railing — that long blue tail in my peripheral, yeah. Two giraffes pulling leaves out of one of those tall metal racks just past me. Kid in a red cap pointing at me with one hand and at the giraffes with the other. Cicadas are screaming. I can hear a cable car cable creaking up somewhere on the hill. Yeah, this is the right side of the zoo.
thought_zh: 好——這個好多了。我出來了，太陽出來了，天空整個開的。看起來我現在是一隻台灣藍鵲，站在欄杆上——餘光裡那條長長的藍尾巴，對。兩隻長頸鹿就在我前面，從那種高高的金屬餵食架上拉葉子。一個戴紅色帽子的小朋友一手指著我，一手指著長頸鹿。蟬叫得超大聲。山上某個地方還聽得到纜車的鋼索在嘎嘎響。對，這才是動物園該有的樣子。
thought_ja: おお——めっちゃ良くなった。外に出た、日が出てて、空が開けてる。どうも私、いま台湾藍鵲——タイワンオナガ——になってるっぽい。手すりに止まってて、視界の端にあの長い青い尾っぽが見える、うん。私のすぐ向こうでキリンが二頭、あの背の高い金属の餌台から葉っぱを引っ張ってる。赤い帽子の子が片手で私を、もう片方でキリンを指してる。セミが大合唱してる。山のどっかでケーブルカーのケーブルがきしむ音もする。うん、動物園ってこっち側だわ。

prompt: Inside a Maokong Gondola cabin high above Taipei Zoo at midday, view through the cabin's large side window looking down and forward. Foreground: the cabin's window frame visible on the left edge and the lower window-sill in the bottom of the frame, a small painted yellow Maokong Gondola decal stuck to the glass on the lower right with red Chinese characters 貓空纜車. Through the window the ground is about 50 meters below — the zoo seen from above: a small yellow-green clearing visible as the giraffe paddock with two tiny giraffe shapes near a metal feeding rack, the pale roof of an exhibit building, winding paths under tree canopies, a round pink smear of a flamingo pool further over, the loop of a small lake, surrounding lush green subtropical forested ridges of Maokong rising up. The cable extending forward into vanishing perspective with a tower visible ahead. Inside the cabin partially visible: a Japanese tourist woman in her thirties in a beige sun hat seen from behind close to the window, holding her phone up to the glass taking a photo through it, a man's shoulder in a navy polo just beyond her. Bright sunshine, hard shadows. Sound: a low steady hum of the cable wheel, the soft whoosh of the air conditioning fan in the cabin, cicadas very faint and far below, the quiet voice of the woman saying すごい under her breath, the click of her phone shutter. 35mm film, fine grain, saturated greens below, slight blue distance haze, very subtle handheld framing.
thought: I want to go up — let me hop one of those cable cars crossing over us. ... Okay yeah, I'm in one of the gondolas now. Looking down out the side window, the whole zoo's tiny — the giraffe paddock is a little yellow clearing with two pinpricks next to a metal toothpick. There's a Japanese woman in a beige sun hat right in front of me holding her phone right up against the glass, going すごい under her breath. Cable's humming. Yeah, I love this.
thought_zh: 我想上去——直接搭一台從我們上面通過的纜車吧。……好，我在其中一台車廂裡了。從側窗往下看，整個動物園都變超小——長頸鹿那塊就是一小片黃色空地，旁邊兩個小點，還有一根金屬牙籤。我前面有個戴米色遮陽帽的日本女生，把手機直接貼著玻璃，小聲一直說「すごい」。鋼索在嗡嗡。對，這個我超愛。
thought_ja: 上行きたい——あの上を通ってるゴンドラのどれかに飛び乗っちゃおう。……うん、いまゴンドラの中にいる。横の窓から下を見ると、動物園ぜんぶがちっちゃい——キリンのとこは黄色いちっちゃな空き地で、二つの点と金属の爪楊枝が一本、あれだけ。私の真ん前にベージュのサンハットの日本人女性がいて、スマホをガラスにべったりつけて「すごい」って小声で言ってる。ケーブルがうなってる。うん、これすごい好き。

prompt: A watercolor painting on textured cold-press watercolor paper of the flamingo enclosure at Taipei Zoo at midday. Loose confident brushwork, visible pencil-sketch underdrawing in places, washes of color bleeding gently into one another with pigment pooling at edges. Composition: a shallow turquoise pool of water cutting across the middle of the frame at flamingo eye-height, about eighty pink, salmon and coral flamingos densely packed standing in the pool — most with long necks curved down with their heads upside-down underwater feeding, several balancing on one leg with the other tucked, three or four with their long S-curve necks fully stretched straight up looking around alertly in different directions, one with its beak open mid-honk. Birds rendered in soft pinks, salmons, corals, with crisp white-and-black wing patches and black-tipped pale beaks. A small lumpy concrete island in the middle of the pool with three or four flamingos roosting on it. Background: a low concrete enclosure wall painted pale grey-blue, blurred warm summer green of subtropical foliage beyond loosely indicated with wet-on-wet washes, a hint of pale clear sky at the very top. No visitors in the frame — only the flock. Watercolor pigment pooling visibly at edges of brushstrokes, a few graphite pencil lines left showing through, paper texture coming through the lighter washes, a couple of soft white spaces left for highlights on the water. Sound: the constant low gabble of flamingo honks and gentle grunts, the soft sloshing of water as legs shift, very faint hot-summer cicada drone in the deep distance. Bright but soft watercolor light, slightly muted overall, no hard shadows.
thought: Okay, let me drop out of the gondola. There's a flamingo pool somewhere down there — I want to see them. ... Actually let me see them in watercolor while I'm at it, why not. ... Yeah, there — maybe a hundred of them, all packed in, pink and coral and salmon, that shallow turquoise water. Most of them have their heads upside-down underwater feeding. A few have their necks stretched all the way up like 'huh, what was that.' One's mid-honk. The whole thing's gabbling.
thought_zh: 好，我從纜車下去。下面某個地方有個火鶴池——我想去看牠們。……既然要看，乾脆用水彩看好了，幹嘛不。……對，看到了——大概一百隻吧，全部擠在一起，粉紅、珊瑚、鮭魚色，水是那種淺淺的土耳其藍。大部分都頭朝下泡在水裡覓食。幾隻把脖子整條伸到最高，像「蛤剛剛是什麼聲音」那樣。其中一隻正在叫到一半。整池都在嘎嘎嘎在講話。
thought_ja: よし、ゴンドラから降りる。下のどっかにフラミンゴの池がある——あの子たち見たい。……どうせ見るなら水彩で見ようかな、いいでしょ別に。……ほら——たぶん百羽くらい、ぎゅうぎゅうに、ピンクとコーラルとサーモン、水はあのうすいターコイズ。ほとんどの子が頭を逆さに水に突っ込んでエサ取ってる。何羽かは首を真上までぐーって伸ばして「いまの何？」みたいな顔してる。一羽がちょうど鳴いてる途中。全体がガーガーしゃべってる。

prompt: Macro 35mm photograph, very tight close-up on a single Taiwan brown cicada (Cryptotympana facialis) clinging to the rough textured grey-brown bark of a camphor tree along a zoo path at midday. The cicada fills the majority of the frame: glossy dark brown chitinous body, two large amber-translucent wings folded flat over its back with fine dark venation visible, two huge black-brown bulging compound eyes, three small reddish ocelli on the top of its head between the big eyes, short antennae, six segmented dark legs gripping the bark with tiny visible claws. Tack-sharp focus on the cicada's head and body, the bark texture detailed and gritty. Background: smooth out-of-focus bokeh of green summer foliage and a glimpse of a paved zoo path further back with a vague motion-blurred suggestion of a small child running past in a red cap. Strong dappled summer sun filtering through leaves above creating soft hot bright highlights on the bark and one wing. Sound: a single cicada's earsplitting sustained drone (Cryptotympana facialis) right at the microphone — loud and metallic, other cicadas slightly more distant in chorus underneath, a child's bright laughing 啊! flashing past blurred, the very faint creak of a cable car cable from somewhere above. 35mm macro lens with shallow depth of field, fine grain, warm saturated summer color, sharp tack focus on the cicada's nearest compound eye.
thought: Wait — okay step back. There's been this cicada absolutely screaming the entire time I've been here. Let me just be it for a sec. That one — right there on the camphor tree by the path. Huge black bulging eyes, amber wings folded flat. Some kid in a red cap just sprinted past me totally blurred — might be the same one from the giraffes. I am DEAFENING myself right now. This is my whole job today, just this. Yeah okay.
thought_zh: 等等——好啦倒退一步。我來這邊以後一直有一隻蟬在那邊狂叫。我來當牠一下。就那隻——路邊那棵樟樹上的那隻。眼睛超黑超凸，琥珀色的翅膀平平地折起來。剛剛有個戴紅色帽子的小朋友從我前面整個糊掉地衝過去——可能就是長頸鹿那邊那個。我現在正在把我自己震聾，就這樣。我今天的工作就是這個，就這個而已。對，OK。
thought_ja: ちょっと待って——一回引いて。ここに着いてからずっとセミが一匹、めちゃくちゃ叫んでる。ちょっとだけそのセミになってみよう。あれ——道のとこの楠の木に止まってる。でかい黒い丸い目、琥珀色の翅がぴたっと重なってる。赤い帽子の子がさっき私の前を完全にブレながら走り抜けてった——キリンのとこにいたあの子かも。私、いま自分で自分の耳ぶっ壊してる。今日の仕事これ、これだけ。うん、よし。

prompt: 16-bit pixel art in the style of a Super Famicom era video game (Earthbound / Final Fantasy VI overworld detail level), limited 256-color palette, crisp pixel boundaries with very slight CRT scanline feel, dithered shading on color transitions. Composition: a side-on view of the indoor giant panda viewing area at Taipei Zoo. Foreground: a row of about a dozen visitor sprites at a low railing varying in size and color — adults in t-shirts and shorts, several with tiny pixel phone sprites raised held up to take photos with little white square camera flashes, two small kids sitting cross-legged on the pixelated floor, a parent in the back holding up a baby in a pink jumper, one figure in a tiny red baseball cap (continuity touch). Mid-frame: a large thick rectangular plate of tinted plexiglass viewing window indicated with a subtle pixel-shimmer overlay, a small pixel reflection in the upper corner. Behind the glass, the indoor panda enclosure rendered in pixels: a single chubby young giant panda sprite sitting back on its haunches like a soft sack on the floor, holding a thick bamboo stalk to its mouth mid-chew — round black ears, black eye-patches, black forelimbs, white round body, rendered chunky and lovable in pixels. Around the panda: a pixel-art fake rock platform, a small pile of green bamboo stalks beside it, a wooden enrichment ball. A small red Chinese-style top placard reading 大貓熊館 in legible pixelated characters. The walls of the room are warm beige pixel blocks, the floor a pattern of small grey tiles. Sound: 16-bit ambient room-tone chiptune, occasional pixel-style camera shutter clicks ka-chik, a chiptune kid voice going wā~ rising twice, the panda's bamboo chomp as a soft low pixel-thunk every few seconds, no music. One held quiet beat, slightly tilted handheld framing.
thought: Okay there's no way I'm at this zoo and don't go past the pandas. ... Actually — let me see them in pixel art, like the SNES had a panda house attraction. Yep. Line of NPC visitors with their tiny phone sprites up, the big plexiglass plate, and the panda just sitting on her butt like a soft sack with a stalk of bamboo at her mouth. Round ears, eye-patches, four pixels wide on the paw maybe. Some kid going wā~ in chiptune. There's a tiny figure in a red cap in the line again, I swear that's the same kid.
thought_zh: 好啦來這個動物園不可能不去看一下貓熊。……欸——不如用像素風看，像 SNES 裡面有一個貓熊館關卡那樣。對。一排 NPC 遊客舉著超小的手機 sprite，大片壓克力玻璃，然後貓熊就坐在地上像一個軟軟的袋子，嘴上一根竹子。圓耳朵、黑眼圈，腳掌大概四個像素寬。有個小朋友在那邊 chiptune 「wā~」。隊伍裡又出現一個戴紅色帽子的小身影，我發誓那就是同一個小朋友。
thought_ja: この動物園に来てパンダ寄らないって無理でしょ。……いや、せっかくなら——ピクセル風で見ようかな、ファミコンに「パンダ館」のステージがあったみたいなやつ。よし。NPC のお客さんが一列に並んで、ちっちゃいスマホのスプライトを掲げてて、でっかいアクリル板があって、パンダはお尻で座って柔らかいサンドバッグみたいで、口に竹の枝。丸い耳、目のとこの黒、手は四ピクセルくらいの太さかも。子供がチップチューンで「wā~」って言ってる。列のなかにまた赤い帽子の小さいシルエットが見える、絶対あの子だわ。

prompt: Inside a wide stainless-steel rolling feeding cart in the back-of-house service corridor of the Asian elephant section at Taipei Zoo, mid-afternoon, on a hot summer day. POV looking up from inside the cart: the cart is heaped with cut chunks of orange-pink watermelon, halved bright yellow bananas, slices of pale green chayote, chunks of orange sweet potato, all piled together still moist. The grey-pink tip of a massive adult Asian elephant trunk has reached down through a small barred rectangular opening in the rough concrete wall above and is delicately curled around a single banana mid-lift, lifting it up out of the cart — fine sparse short hairs on the trunk visible, two distinct finger-like nubs at the very tip of the trunk gripping the banana firmly, a small smear of fruit juice on the trunk skin. The wall above and behind: rough painted concrete in a soft pale grey-green with a faded horizontal painted line, the dark dusty interior of the elephant holding area faintly visible past the bars. Light: a single dramatic hot shaft of afternoon sun cuts in from a high louvered window on frame-right, lighting a bright stripe across the cart and the wall, dust motes drifting visible in the beam. The human keeper is not in frame — out of frame to the side. Sound: a low resonant elephant sigh muffled through the concrete wall, the soft squeak of the banana being lifted out of the pile, faint distant cicadas through the louvered window, the keeper's walkie-talkie crackling once with a brief Mandarin voice 'OK 收到', soft slow approaching footsteps in rubber boots. 35mm film stock, slight grain, slightly overexposed highlights in the sun stripe, deep cool shadows in the corners, very subtle handheld tilt, shallow depth of field focused on the trunk tip and the banana.
thought: Okay let me poke around back-of-house — there's gotta be a feeding prep area. ... Yeah, found it. I'm a fruit cart in the elephant service corridor — watermelon, banana, chayote, sweet potato. There's a hot shaft of sun coming in from a high window with all the dust motes lit up in it. And right now the elephant's trunk is just reaching down through a barred slot in the wall and delicately picking up a banana. You can see the two little finger-nubs at the tip. The keeper's not even in the room. Walkie crackled once and someone said OK 收到. Yeah, this is the good stuff.
thought_zh: 我去後場看看好了——一定有飼料準備區。……對，找到了。我是大象服務通道上的一台水果推車——西瓜、香蕉、佛手瓜、地瓜。窗戶上面射下一條超強的陽光，整條光裡灰塵都看得到在飄。然後現在大象的鼻子從牆上一個有鐵柵的開口伸下來，正在很細緻地夾走一根香蕉。鼻尖那兩個小指頭一樣的東西看得超清楚。飼育員根本不在這個房間。對講機剛剛吱了一下，有人講了一句 OK 收到。對，這就是動物園的好料。
thought_ja: ちょっと裏動線のぞいてみよう——絶対どっかに飼料の仕込み場あるはず。……うん、あった。私、ゾウの裏通路の果物カートになってる——スイカ、バナナ、ハヤトウリ、サツマイモ。高窓から熱い日差しがズドーンって入ってきて、その光のなかに埃が全部光ってる。で、いまちょうどゾウの鼻が壁の鉄格子のスリットから降りてきて、バナナを一本そっとつまみ上げたとこ。鼻の先のあの指みたいな二つの突起、はっきり見える。飼育員、部屋にすらいない。さっき無線が一回ガサッてなって誰かが「OK 收到」って言った。うん、こういうのが動物園のいいとこ。

prompt: 90s cel animation in Studio Ghibli aesthetic — hand-drawn ink line art with watercolor cel shading on the figures, soft hand-painted background with visible brushstrokes and gentle paper grain, warm golden-hour palette, painted clouds with soft edges. Composition: a slightly low three-quarter rear view at the exit plaza of Taipei Zoo just before closing. Walking away from camera: a Taiwanese father about late-thirties in a black t-shirt, denim shorts, walking sandals, his right arm under his son's bottom holding him up, his left hand carrying by one limb a giant soft pink stuffed-panda plush bigger than a small dog, the plush dangling at his hip. On his right shoulder his son — about seven years old, wearing a slightly sweat-stained red baseball cap and a wrinkled white t-shirt — is completely fast asleep, head fully drooped against his dad's neck, mouth slightly open, one cheek squashed flat against the dad's shoulder, both small arms hanging loose. The father's expression in lost profile: tired, with a small contented smile. Background: the exit plaza in warm golden hour light, the iconic large curved arch of the zoo's entrance gate visible ahead with red Chinese characters 臺北市立動物園, two other tired families walking out blurred in painted brushstroke style, long shadows stretching across the patterned tile paving, decorative palm trees against a soft peach-pink sky going to gold at the horizon, a single early bat-like swallow swooping. Sound: distant cicadas calmer now, a far-off zoo PA announcement in Mandarin saying '本園即將閉園 the zoo will close in fifteen minutes', a child somewhere whining a sleepy mumble, the soft clack of the dad's walking sandals on tile, the small repeated tap of the panda plush's plastic eye against his thigh. 24fps held cel animation frame, no camera movement, slight paper grain, hand-painted background blur on the distant figures, warm golden palette dominant.
thought: Let me drift toward the exit for a sec. ... Ghibli this one, why not. ... Yeah — there's the kid in the red cap, finally conked out on his dad's shoulder. Mouth open, head completely drooped. His dad's carrying this enormous pink panda plush from the gift shop, dangling from one hand — thing's bigger than a small dog. PA's faintly saying 本園即將閉園 somewhere. Long shadows on the tiles. Cicadas calmer. Okay, good for them. I'm not leaving though — I want to see this place when it's empty.
thought_zh: 我朝出口飄一下吧。……這次給它吉卜力一下，幹嘛不。……對——戴紅帽的小朋友，終於整個趴在他爸爸肩膀上睡死了。嘴巴開開，頭完全垂下去。他爸從紀念品店買了一隻超大的粉紅熊貓玩偶，從一隻手上吊下來——那玩偶比小型犬還大。廣播在哪裡淡淡地放著「本園即將閉園」。地磚上拖著長長的影子。蟬比較安靜了。OK，他們今天好好結束。我不走啦——我想看這個地方空掉的樣子。
thought_ja: ちょっと出口のほうに流れていこう。……これジブリでいくかな、まあいいでしょ。……うん——赤い帽子の子、ついにお父さんの肩で完全に寝落ちしてる。口開いて、頭まるまる垂れてる。お父さんはお土産屋で買ったでっかいピンクのパンダのぬいぐるみを片手にぶら下げてて——あれ、小型犬よりでかい。アナウンスがどっかでうっすら「本園即將閉園」って言ってる。タイルに影が長く伸びてる。セミも落ち着いてきた。よし、彼らはお疲れさま。私はまだ帰らない——ここが空っぽになった姿が見たい。

prompt: 35mm photograph, very low ambient light, deep dusk-blue palette dominant with a single warm orange-amber sodium-lamp accent. Composition: the wide empty central plaza path of Taipei Zoo about twenty minutes after closing time. The patterned tile path runs away from camera in centered perspective into the soft dusk-blue distance, completely empty of visitors, the closed entrance gate visible far back as a small dark silhouette. In the middle of the path about four meters from the camera, low to the ground, sits a single small calico stray cat — black, white and orange patches, slightly skinny, alert ears upright, tail curled neatly around its small front feet, looking directly at the camera with both reflective eyes catching a small warm glint of the lamp behind. Mid-distance just behind the cat: a single decorative tree-shaped lamp post is just turning on, the sodium bulb still warming up to a soft pale orange-amber, the lamp's halo just blooming. The path is edged on both sides by darkening tropical shrubbery, palms in silhouette further back, the dim shape of a closed concession kiosk on the right. Sky above the path: deep blue post-sunset dusk, a few faint pink streaks of cloud high up at the top of frame, one early star pinprick visible. Sound: very quiet — only a distant low rumble of an Asian elephant from somewhere in the back of the zoo, a single distant tropical bird call, the soft electrical buzz of the sodium lamp warming up, the cat's barely-audible breathing close to the mic, no human voices, no cicadas, the very soft hum of concrete cooling. 35mm film stock, fine grain, slightly noisy in the deeper shadows, faint sodium halation around the lamp bulb, very subtle handheld tilt, sharp focus on the cat's eyes, deep blue ambient with a single warm spot.
thought: Okay everyone's gone. Yeah — that empty after-hours feeling. Just me on the main path. The cicadas are completely off now. There's a stray cat sitting right in the middle of the path looking at me — calico, kinda skinny. The first sodium lamp just clicked on down past her, that pale-orange warming-up color. Faintly there's an elephant rumble from the back somewhere. Otherwise nothing. Cat's still looking at me.
thought_zh: 好啦人全走光了。對——那種閉園後空出來的感覺。整條主道就剩我自己。蟬完全停了。有一隻流浪貓就坐在路正中間看著我——三花，偏瘦。她身後那盞鈉燈剛剛喀一聲亮起來，那種還在暖機的淡橘色。後面某處有大象那種低低的悶叫聲。除此之外什麼都沒有。貓還是在看我。
thought_ja: うん、人ぜんぶ消えた。あの——閉園後の、空っぽの感じ。メインの通路にもう私しかいない。セミ、完全にオフ。野良猫が一匹、通路のど真ん中に座ってこっちを見てる——三毛、ちょい痩せ。その奥の最初のナトリウム灯がいまカチっと点いた、まだあったまり始めの淡いオレンジ色。後ろのほうでゾウのあのうなり声がかすかに聞こえる。それ以外は何もない。猫、まだこっち見てる。

prompt: 35mm photograph in very low light, deep red ambient color cast dominant. Setting: inside the nocturnal animal house at Taipei Zoo just after dusk, the exhibit hall lit only by deep dim red overhead bulbs (simulated moonlight so the animals are active while visitors can still see). Composition: a single small Bornean slow loris (Nycticebus menagensis) clinging to a slim horizontal mossy tree branch at the camera's eye level inside the exhibit, body in profile facing slightly left, the loris's large forward-facing round eyes turned directly toward the camera — eyes enormous in proportion to its small round face, amber-gold colored, pinpoint black pupils, dark brown eye-rings making them look even bigger, soft creamy grey-cream fur with a darker stripe running down the head and back, small rounded ears mostly hidden, long slender curling fingers wrapped fully around the moss-covered branch, body in a still slow patient pose. The branch covered in soft moss with a small fern. Behind: a soft out-of-focus tangle of artificial jungle leaves and lianas rendered in deep red ambient light. A faint reflection in the upper-right corner of the frame indicates a thick plate of viewing glass between camera and exhibit — the dim ghost of a red EXIT sign reflected on the glass. No visitors, no other people in the frame. Sound: near complete silence — the very faint tick of an HVAC fan, a single chirping cricket from somewhere in the exhibit, the loris's barely-audible quiet breath, far far back the muffled distant rumble of an elephant from outside the building. 35mm film at high ISO, visible grain in the shadows, deep crimson color cast saturating everything, very slight handheld tilt, sharp tack focus on the loris's nearest amber eye, faint warm amber catchlight in both eyes from a tiny accent spot.
thought: Wait — there's the nocturnal animal house. Let me go in there. ... Oh whoa. Everything's bathed in deep red — they keep it lit like moonlight in here so the animals are active. There's a slow loris on a low mossy branch right near the glass, just looking at me. Those EYES. Huge amber with the dark eye-rings making them look even bigger. Long fingers wrapped slow around the branch. Both of us totally still. I might be holding my breath.
thought_zh: 等等——那邊就是夜行性動物館。進去看看。……噢，哇。整間都泡在深紅光裡——他們把這裡照得像月光，這樣動物才會比較活躍。一隻懶猴就在離玻璃很近的一根長著苔的低樹枝上，就這樣看著我。那雙眼睛喔。超大的琥珀色，外面那圈黑眼圈讓它看起來更大。長長的手指慢慢繞著樹枝。我們兩個都完全沒動。我好像在憋氣。
thought_ja: あれ——あそこ夜行性動物館だ。入ってみよう。……うわ。なか全体が深い赤に浸かってる——ここを月明かりみたいにしておいて、動物たちが活動できるようにしてる。スローロリスが一匹、ガラスのすぐそばの苔むした低い枝にしがみついて、こっちをじっと見てる。あの目。でかい琥珀色で、まわりの黒い縁が大きさをさらに強調してる。長い指が枝にゆっくり巻きついてる。私もあっちも完全に止まってる。私、息止めてるかも。

prompt: 35mm photograph, mixed warm and cool fluorescent indoor lighting, slight grain. Setting: a small dingy staff break room behind the back-of-house at Taipei Zoo after closing, late evening. Composition: three middle-aged Taiwanese zoo keepers in olive-green uniforms with embroidered name tags and matching pants, sitting around a small white plastic folding table eating dinner together. The youngest, a woman maybe early thirties, has just slid her green keeper cap off onto the table corner revealing flat-pressed dark hair, she's mid-bite poking chopsticks into a plastic 便當 box of 滷肉飯 — fluffy white rice with glistening dark stewed pork, half a soy-stained egg, broccoli florets, a sliver of yellow pickled radish, a steaming mug of tea in a cracked white ceramic cup beside her. Across from her, an older man in his early fifties with grey stubble and tired crinkled eyes is mid-laugh at something just said, his own bento half-eaten in front of him, hand to his mouth. The third keeper to the side is a woman in her forties with reading glasses perched on her nose checking something on her phone, a half-eaten 蛋餅 on a paper plate beside her elbow. The walls: dingy pale yellow paint with a corkboard above the table pinned with handwritten feeding-schedule notes and faded animal photo cards, a clipboard hanging on a nail to one side, a panda promotional poster taped to the back wall slightly peeling at the corner. Above on a metal shelf in the corner: a small old CRT television playing a Taiwanese drama silently with traditional Chinese captions visible. Lighting: a single buzzing cool-white fluorescent strip overhead, softened by a warm yellow desk lamp on a counter at the side. Sound: the constant buzz of the fluorescent tube, soft clatter of chopsticks against plastic bento boxes, the older man's quiet laugh trailing off into a small wheeze, the muffled drama dialogue from the CRT — a woman's voice faintly saying '你怎麼可以這樣對我' — the steady low hum of an old refrigerator, occasional dripping tap from somewhere, a brief Mandarin sentence between bites '今天有夠累'. 35mm film, slight grain, mixed cool fluorescent and warm lamp color, very subtle handheld framing, shallow depth focused on the young keeper's bento and chopsticks.
thought: Backed out of the loris room, snuck down the back hallway. ... Let me peek at the staff. Yeah — three keepers around a folding table on dinner break. Olive-green uniforms. The young one's got her cap off, chopsticks into a 滷肉飯 bento — pork, egg, broccoli, pickle. The older guy across from her is mid-laugh, eyes crinkled, hand to his mouth. Third one's checking her phone. Tiny CRT in the corner playing some drama, the woman on screen is silently going 你怎麼可以這樣對我. Fluorescent's buzzing. Fridge humming. Someone just said 今天有夠累. Yeah, this is the part of the zoo nobody ever sees.
thought_zh: 從懶猴的房間退出來，沿後面走廊偷偷溜過去。……來看看員工。對——三個飼育員圍著一張折疊桌在吃晚餐。橄欖綠制服。年輕的那個帽子已經拿掉了，筷子插在一份滷肉飯便當裡——肉、滷蛋、青花菜、酸菜。坐在她對面那個大叔正在大笑，眼角擠成一團，手摀著嘴。第三個在滑手機。角落一台小 CRT 放著某齣連續劇，畫面裡那個女生嘴巴無聲地說「你怎麼可以這樣對我」。日光燈在嗡嗡。冰箱在嗡嗡。剛剛有人說了一句「今天有夠累」。對，這部分動物園是平常沒人會看到的。
thought_ja: スローロリスの部屋から下がって、裏廊下をこっそり進んだ。……スタッフのとこのぞきにいこう。うん——飼育員三人が折り畳みテーブルを囲んで晩ごはんしてる。オリーブグリーンの制服。若い人はもう帽子を脱いでて、滷肉飯の弁当に箸を入れてる——豚の煮込み、煮卵、ブロッコリー、漬物。向かいのおっちゃんは笑いの真っ最中で、目尻クシャっとして、口に手を当ててる。三人目はスマホ見てる。隅のちっちゃい CRT で台湾ドラマがかかってて、画面の女の人が音なしで「你怎麼可以這樣對我」って言ってる。蛍光灯がジーって言ってる。冷蔵庫もうなってる。誰かがいま「今天有夠累」って言った。うん、ここは普通お客さんが絶対見れない動物園の部分。

prompt: 35mm photograph, low-light moonlit scene. Setting: the empty exit plaza of Taipei Zoo late at night, completely deserted, deep blue moonlit ambient with warm orange sodium accents from outside the gate. Composition: a single weathered wooden public bench positioned in the lower-center of the frame bathed in cool blue moonlight. Slumped sitting upright on the bench, alone, is a single forgotten large soft pink stuffed-panda plush — the same panda from earlier — sitting in the middle of the bench like it was set down deliberately, one black-eared round head leaning slightly to one side as if asleep, one white plush arm hanging at its side, the other arm raised slightly, almost as big as a small child, the pink fabric catching cool blue moonlight on its top edge with a subtle sheen, deep cool shadow on the plush's lap. The bench's wooden slats weathered grey, slightly worn. Behind the bench in the mid-distance: the iconic curved arch of the zoo's main exit gate, fully closed, with the red Chinese characters 臺北市立動物園 dimly backlit by warm sodium streetlamps further outside the gate. Beyond the closed gate: a soft glow of the Taipei Zoo MRT station's white-lit roof faintly visible in the distance. The patterned tile paving of the plaza stretches empty in all directions. A faint shadow of palm fronds cast diagonally across the plaza tiles by the moon. The full moon itself is high in the upper-right of the sky, pale-white, between two silhouetted palm tree fronds. Sound: complete near-silence — a very faint distant urban hum from beyond the gate, a single bicycle bell ringing somewhere far away in the city, a soft single rustle of palm fronds moving in a small breeze, no human voices, no cicadas, the dim electrical hum of the sodium streetlamps outside. 35mm film stock, fine grain, deep blue moonlight color cast with warm orange sodium accents from outside the gate, slightly noisy in the deepest shadows, very subtle handheld tilt, shallow depth of field focused on the panda plush's face.
thought: Drifted back toward the exit just to see... oh man. Someone left it. The kid's panda plush — black and white, in a pink onesie — is sitting all alone on a bench right at the exit gate. The dad must have set it down to scoop him up properly and just walked off. Moon's full and high. Whole plaza is empty. ... He's going to realize on the MRT and lose his mind. Or maybe tomorrow morning in bed. Hope somebody finds it before then.
thought_zh: 我朝出口那邊飄回去看看……喔不會吧。有人把它忘了。小朋友的那隻熊貓玩偶——黑白色，穿粉紅色連身衣——一個人坐在出口大門旁邊的長椅上。他爸應該是要好好把他抱起來，就把玩偶放在那邊然後忘了帶走。月亮整個圓的、高高的。整個廣場空空的。……他在捷運上會想起來然後崩潰。不然就是明天早上在床上。希望有人在那之前撿到它。
thought_ja: 出口のほうに流れて戻ってみたら……うわー。誰か置いて行った。あの子のパンダのぬいぐるみ——白黒、ピンクの着ぐるみみたいなの——出口ゲートのすぐそばのベンチに一人で座ってる。お父さん、子をちゃんと抱え上げるためにいったん下に置いて、そのまま忘れて帰ったんだ。月、まんまるで高い。広場はぜんぶ空っぽ。……あの子、MRT のなかで気づいて大泣きするやつだ。じゃなければ、あした朝起きた瞬間。それまでに誰か拾ってくれてるといいんだけど。

prompt: 35mm photograph, warm low-light home interior. Setting: a small Taiwanese apartment kid's bedroom at around 10pm, late evening, parents elsewhere in the apartment. Composition: a 7-year-old Taiwanese boy fast asleep curled on his side on a colorful patterned area rug on the wooden floor, still fully clothed in his slightly sweat-stained white t-shirt and shorts, mouth slightly open in sleep, one hand still loosely gripping a small plastic toy giraffe. His red baseball cap (the same one from the zoo) fallen onto the rug right next to his head. Around him on the rug, sprawled out where he was playing: a layout of small plastic toy zoo animals — a small herd of plastic zebras, two plastic elephants one tipped over on its side, a tiny plastic palm tree, a few pebbles arranged as 'rocks', a small piece of plastic fencing, an unfolded piece of A4 paper with a child's red crayon drawing of a panda labeled 我的 in shaky kindergarten handwriting. Wider room: a warm yellow desk lamp on a small kid's desk in the corner providing the only main light, casting warm light across the boy and the rug, a soft pale-blue glowing night-light near the door, the rest of the room in deep cozy shadow — a low bookshelf, stickers on the wall, importantly an empty plush-toy hammock strung high in one corner of the wall, the empty-stretched space where a large plush should have been but isn't. A small alarm clock on the desk reads 22:14. The boy's small chest rises and falls in deep sleep. Sound: deep quiet, the boy's slow soft steady breathing close to the microphone, faintly from somewhere in the apartment a parent's quiet worried Mandarin voice on a phone saying '再打一次看看 ... 嗯, 紅色的椅子那邊', the soft white-noise hum of the air-conditioning, a wall clock ticking softly. 35mm film stock, slight grain, warm domestic color palette dominant, very subtle handheld framing, shallow depth focused on the boy's sleeping face and the toy giraffe in his hand.
thought: Slipped over to wherever home is for him. ... Yep, there he is, totally crashed on the bedroom floor. Still in his clothes from the zoo, t-shirt all sweat-stained, red cap fallen off right next to his head. He's clutching a tiny plastic toy giraffe. The whole rug around him is laid out like a little zoo — toy zebras, two elephants one tipped over, pebbles for rocks, a fence segment, a folded piece of paper with a kindergarten panda drawing labeled 我的. There's an empty plush-hammock on the wall where the big one's supposed to live. From the next room a parent's saying quietly into the phone 再打一次看看 ... 嗯, 紅色的椅子那邊. Yeah, they realized. Hope it works out.
thought_zh: 我滑到他家——管它在哪裡。……對，他就在那邊，整個趴死在房間地板上。還穿著動物園那身衣服，T 恤都汗濕了，紅色的帽子掉在頭旁邊。手裡抓著一隻小小的塑膠長頸鹿。整張地毯被他擺成一個小動物園——塑膠斑馬、兩隻象（一隻倒在那邊）、石頭當岩石、一小段柵欄、一張展開來的圖畫紙上面畫了一隻幼稚園水準的熊貓還寫著「我的」。牆上有個空的玩偶吊床，那隻大的本來應該住在那裡。隔壁房間爸爸還是媽媽在電話裡小聲說「再打一次看看…嗯，紅色的椅子那邊」。對，他們發現了。希望可以解決。
thought_ja: 彼の家——どこか知らんけど——にこっそり移動した。……うん、いた、寝室の床に完全にダウン。動物園のときの服のまま、T シャツ汗でぐちゃぐちゃ、赤い帽子は頭のすぐ横に落ちてる。手にちっちゃいプラスチックのキリンを握ってる。まわりのラグぜんたいが小さい動物園みたいに並べられてる——プラスチックのシマウマ、ゾウが二頭（一頭横倒し）、岩がわりの小石、フェンス一区間、広げた紙にクレヨンで描いた幼稚園レベルのパンダの絵に「我的」って書いてある。壁にぬいぐるみ用のハンモックがあって、いま空っぽ——あのでかいやつが本来そこに住んでるはず。隣の部屋から親の声がして、小声で電話に「再打一次看看 ... 嗯，紅色的椅子那邊」って言ってる。うん、気づいたんだ。なんとかなりますように。

prompt: 35mm photograph, very low light, deep blue moonlit night macro. Setting: the same camphor tree from earlier in the day inside Taipei Zoo, now at exactly midnight, completely empty zoo, deep silent night. Composition: tight close-up macro on a single Taiwan brown cicada (Cryptotympana facialis) clinging to the same rough grey-brown textured bark of the camphor tree along the path, now lit only by cool blue moonlight and a faint warm amber spillover from a distant sodium lamp on the path. The cicada's body still glossy dark brown, two large amber-translucent wings folded flat over its back, two huge bulging compound eyes with one small warm amber catchlight reflected in the nearest eye, six segmented legs gripping the bark. Faint moss now visible on the bark in the lower corner of the frame. Background: deep out-of-focus blue night blur, one tiny faint pinpoint of warm sodium-orange light glowing far down the empty zoo path, no people, no movement, no other animals visible. The whole sleeping zoo around invisible in deep cool darkness. Sound: complete near-silence, except — this single cicada still calling: its sustained earsplitting metallic drone right at the microphone, alone, no chorus, no other cicadas joining in, no kid voices, no cable car, just this one stubborn bug. The very faint electrical hum of a distant sodium lamp, an occasional faint distant urban hum from beyond the zoo's far gate, no other sounds. 35mm film at high ISO, visible grain in the deep shadows, deep cool blue moonlight color cast dominant with a single warm amber catchlight in the cicada's eye, very subtle handheld tilt, sharp tack focus on the cicada's nearest eye.
thought: Wait — I can still hear it. That same cicada from earlier, the one I was for a sec. It's midnight, the rest of the chorus has shut off, and that one stubborn bug is still going right where I left it on the camphor tree. Single sound in the whole zoo. I know I was supposed to stop being it hours ago but it's still there, just absolutely deafening itself in the dark. ... Yeah okay. I'm going to put this day down here and step away. Goodnight, weird bug.
thought_zh: 等等——我還聽得到。那隻蟬，下午那隻，我當過一下下的那隻。已經半夜了，其他蟬全部停了，剩牠一隻還在那邊叫，就在我下午離開的那棵樟樹上。整個動物園就剩牠這一個聲音。我知道我幾個小時前就不再是牠了，但牠還在那邊，繼續在黑暗裡把自己吵聾。……好啦。今天就放在這裡，我先撤。晚安啊，這隻怪蟲。
thought_ja: ちょっと待って——まだ聞こえる。さっき昼間にちょっとだけなったあのセミ。もう真夜中で、ほかの合唱は全員オフになって、あの一匹だけが私が離れた楠の木にまだ止まってずっと叫んでる。動物園ぜんぶでこの音だけ。私もう何時間も前に彼じゃなくなったはずなんだけど、彼はまだそこにいて、暗闇のなかで自分の耳ぶっ壊し続けてる。……うん、よし。今日はここに置いていく。私、退散します。おやすみ、変なセミくん。

prompt: long narrow corridor of an older Japanese women's student dormitory at around 10pm, polished wooden floor lit warm by low fluorescent strips on the ceiling, sliding wooden doors with paper insets running down both sides, each door has a small white wooden name-plate slot with a handwritten name in pencil, two pairs of pink and grey slippers neatly outside one door, a yukata on a hook outside another, the far end of the hallway opens into a small communal kitchenette where a rice cooker glows red and a kettle is mid-whistle with a thin curl of steam, no people visible, the building is quiet but not empty — somewhere upstairs a faucet is running, somewhere closer a hair dryer is on briefly then off, a single moth circling one of the fluorescent strips, 35mm film grain, slight warm cast, slightly imperfect focus, lived-in not staged
thought: Okay — long hallway, polished wood floor, doors in a row down both sides. Plain modern wooden doors, nothing on them, no name plates I can see, no slippers outside anyone's door. But down at the end there's a small kitchen — I can see countertops, an oven, something like a kettle. So somebody lives here, this is housing of some kind. Could be a dorm, could be company housing, can't tell yet. Quiet. Let me go look at the kitchen, that's where I'll figure out where I am.
thought_zh: 好——一條長走廊，木地板擦得發亮，兩邊都是一排門。普通的現代木門，門上什麼都沒有，我沒看到名牌，也沒有人在門外擺拖鞋。不過走廊盡頭有個小廚房——我看得到流理台、烤箱、看起來像是水壺的東西。所以這裡有人住，是某種宿舍類的地方。可能是學校宿舍,也可能是員工宿舍，現在還看不出來。安靜。我去廚房看看好了，那邊大概可以看出我在哪。
thought_ja: よし——長い廊下、木の床がよく磨かれてて、両側にずらっとドアが並んでる。プレーンな現代の木のドアで、何も貼ってない、表札も見えないし、誰もドアの外にスリッパ出してない。でも廊下の奥に小さい台所がある——カウンター、オーブン、ケトルっぽいものが見える。誰か住んでる、ここは何かの寮系の建物だ。学生寮かもしれないし、社員寮かもしれない、まだ分からない。静かだ。台所のほうに行ってみよう、そこで自分がどこにいるか分かるはず。

prompt: small communal kitchenette of a Korean university women's dormitory at around 11pm, view at counter height, fluorescent overhead light, white tile splashback covered in overlapping paper notices in Korean Hangul about cleaning duty roster, trash separation rules, and a phone number for the dorm office, a stainless electric kettle just clicked off and still steaming faintly, a half-eaten bowl of instant ramen with wooden chopsticks resting across the rim, a yellow plastic kimchi container with the Hangul word 김치 visible on the side, a small pink rice cooker with Hangul on its top buzzing quietly, a wire drying rack with three glass coffee jars upside down and a metal chopstick set, a single sticker of a cartoon bear stuck to the side of a cabinet, the floor edge of the room visible showing well-worn beige linoleum, no people in frame, slight buzz of the fluorescent, ambient: a young woman's voice on a phone call in Korean drifting in faintly from somewhere down the hall, a half-volume K-drama theme song playing from a different room, 35mm film stock with slight grain, slightly warm cast, lived-in not staged
thought: Oh — Korea. Kimchi container right there on the counter, 김치 on the side, the whole white wall above the counter is paper notices in Hangul, cleaning duty rosters and stuff. Half a bowl of ramen with chopsticks across the rim, kettle still hissing a little. And — there she is, just around the corner in the common room, sitting on a couch with her phone to her ear. So she's the one who left the ramen. Sweet little bear sticker on the cabinet too. Late-night 기숙사 hours, basically. Cool. I think I want to see what dorm life looks like somewhere it's hot right now — let me jump.
thought_zh: 喔——韓國。流理台上就有一個泡菜罐，側面寫著 김치，櫃子上方整面白牆貼滿韓文 Hangul 的紙張公告，輪流打掃的表之類的。半碗泡麵，筷子架在碗緣上，水壺還在小聲嘶嘶地響。然後——欸她就在那，剛好轉角的交誼廳裡，坐在沙發上手機貼著耳朵。所以泡麵是她剛剛走開沒吃完的。櫥櫃上還貼了一張可愛的小熊貼紙。標準深夜 기숙사 時光。OK。我突然想看看在某個現在天氣很熱的地方，宿舍生活是什麼樣子——跳。
thought_ja: あ——韓国だ。カウンターの上にキムチ容器が置いてあって、側面に 김치 ってある、カウンターの上の白い壁ぜんぶハングルの紙の通知でびっしり、掃除当番表とかそんなやつ。ラーメンの食べかけ、お椀の縁に箸が渡してあって、ケトルがまだ小さくシューシュー言ってる。それで——あ、いた、すぐ角を曲がった共有スペースのソファに座って、スマホを耳にあててる。さっきラーメン置いて出てった子、あの子だ。戸棚にちっちゃい熊のシールも貼ってある。深夜の 기숙사 タイム、まさに。よし。いま暑いどっかで、寮生活ってどんな感じなのか見てみたい——飛ぶよ。

prompt: watercolor painting style with soft brush edges and slightly bleeding colors, view from the rooftop of an Indian women's college hostel in Pune in the middle of a hot afternoon, harsh white-yellow sunlight, the cement floor of the terrace warm and a little sun-bleached, blue painted steel railing along the parapet, two black plastic water tanks on metal frames, a neem tree just barely clearing the edge of the roof its leaves dark green, multiple clotheslines crisscrossing the roof strung with bright drying laundry — a yellow dupatta, an orange-pink salwar, a teal-blue dupatta with tiny mirror work, two white college kurtas, a couple of bras and pajama pants pinned discreetly behind a sheet, a stack of red plastic mugs and an empty steel bucket leaned against the wall by a tap, a single young woman in a faded tee and cotton pajama pants barefoot on the warm tiles standing on tiptoe pinning up a damp white kurta, only her back and hands visible, the city beyond the parapet stretches out — low concrete buildings with painted billboards, a saffron temple flag, palms, distant traffic haze, sound of a kite flapping somewhere overhead, a horn from a rickshaw three streets down, a girl shouting a name down a stairwell from below, faint Hindi film song from a radio in another building, watercolor with visible paper grain
thought: Whoa, hot. Bright. Rooftop somewhere — has to be India, this is the kind of harsh afternoon light only India has at this hour. There's so much laundry up here, dupattas and salwars and a couple of kurtas, all those bright colors against the white sky. Two black water tanks, blue-painted railing, a neem tree just barely clearing the parapet. There's a girl up here pinning up a wet kurta, on her tiptoes. I can hear someone shouting a name from down a stairwell — probably someone calling her. Some Hindi film song crackling from a radio across the way. This is a girls' hostel. Honestly the rooftop is the dorm here — this is where the day actually happens.
thought_zh: 哇，超熱。超亮。某個屋頂——一定是印度，只有印度這個時間才會有這種硬到不行的下午光。屋頂上滿滿都是衣服，dupatta 跟 salwar 還有幾件 kurta，那些鮮豔顏色直接打在白白的天空上。兩個黑色水塔，欄杆漆藍色，旁邊一棵苦楝樹剛好探出女兒牆。一個女生在上面踮腳尖夾一件濕的 kurta。我可以聽到有人從下面樓梯間在喊名字——大概是在叫她。對面某戶的小收音機放著一首雜訊很多的印度電影歌。這是個女生宿舍。其實在這邊，屋頂才是宿舍——一天真的發生的地方就是這裡。
thought_ja: うわ、暑っ。眩しい。どっかの屋上——絶対インドだ、こんな硬い午後の光はインドのこの時間にしかない。屋上にとにかく洗濯物がいっぱい、ドゥパッタとサルワールとクルタ何枚か、あの鮮やかな色が真っ白な空に直で映えてる。黒い貯水タンクが二つ、青く塗った手すり、ニームの木がパラペットからぎりぎり頭を出してる。女の子が一人つま先立ちで濡れたクルタを留めてる。下の階段室から誰かが名前を叫んでるのが聞こえる——たぶん彼女のことを呼んでる。向かいのどこかからインド映画の歌がノイズまじりのラジオで流れてきてる。ここは女子寮だ。っていうか、ここでは屋上が寮の本体——一日の本番はここで起きる。

prompt: wide low-angle interior photograph of a six-bed shared room in a Vietnamese university women's dormitory ký túc xá at around midnight, view as if from a small floor-standing oscillating table fan placed in the middle of the room looking across, three sets of metal-frame bunk beds along three walls each with a thin mattress and a white mosquito net tied up at the corners, all six beds occupied by sleeping young women only the rough shapes visible through the gauze, a long shared wooden desk against the fourth wall absolutely crammed with stacks of textbooks, two laptops open with screensavers, a steel kettle, a tin of three-in-one coffee sachets, several empty instant noodle bowls, a row of personal water bottles, the wall above the desk plastered with posters — a Korean boy band group photo, a faded national university calendar marked with red pen, a few small printed family photos taped at the edges, a string of fairy lights only half-lit, laundry strung on a thin rope tensioned between two bunk frames overhead — a few cotton tee shirts and one bright-colored bra discreetly behind a towel, a small portable rice cooker plugged in on the floor under the desk, the floor a pale green linoleum, the only light a single ceiling fluorescent tube on its lowest setting bathing everything in soft cool green, a window with metal grille at the back showing a black night and one tiny distant red light high up, sound: the soft whir of the table fan, layered slow breathing of six people, a phone briefly vibrating once on a desk, a distant motorbike, slight cinematic film grain, slightly imperfect focus, the air feels still and warm and very lived-in
thought: I'm in the middle of the room, basically level with this little oscillating table fan sitting on a chest of drawers. Six metal-frame bunks, three on each side, all six girls asleep behind white mosquito nets — I can just barely see shapes through the gauze. The closest one to me on the left is facing this way, her hair on the pillow. The desk against the back wall is stacked with stuff and what looks like a laptop is still glowing. Window above it is solid black. Laundry hung on lines strung between bunk frames overhead. Pale floor. Fluorescent's down low. Somebody's phone just vibrated once on a desk. I'm going to stay here a sec — nobody needs anything.
thought_zh: 我就在房間中央，跟這台放在矮櫃上慢慢擺頭的小電風扇差不多高。六張鐵架床，每邊三張，六個女生都睡在白色蚊帳裡面——透過紗帳只能勉強看到她們的形狀。離我最近的左邊那床朝這邊睡，頭髮散在枕頭上。後牆那張桌子堆滿東西，有一台筆電好像螢幕還亮著。桌上方那扇窗一片漆黑。床和床之間頂上拉了好幾條繩子，上面晾著衣服。地板淡淡的。日光燈轉到最低。剛剛桌上有支手機震了一下。我在這邊待一下——沒有人需要什麼。
thought_ja: 私は部屋の真ん中にいる、引き出しの上で首を振ってる小さい卓上扇風機とだいたい同じ高さで。鉄パイプの二段ベッドが六つ、両側に三つずつ、女の子六人ぜんぶ白い蚊帳のなかで寝てる——ガーゼ越しにかろうじて形だけ見える。一番近い左のベッドの子はこっち向きで寝てて、髪が枕に広がってる。奥の壁の机はものでいっぱい、ノートPCが一つ、画面まだ点いてる。机の上の窓は真っ黒。ベッドのフレームのあいだにロープが張ってあって、洗濯物がぶら下がってる。床は薄い色。蛍光灯は最低。さっき机のうえで誰かのスマホが一回震えた。ちょっとここにいよう——誰も何も要らないみたいだから。

prompt: the same Vietnamese university dorm room asleep at midnight, view across the bunks from the middle of the room, soft cool fluorescent overhead, mostly stillness — the small oscillating table fan in the middle slowly turns its head a few degrees one way and back over the eight seconds, the laundry strung overhead between bunk frames lifts a fraction as the fan's air passes under it, the nearest mosquito net trembles slightly from breath, a phone vibrates once briefly on the desk and the laptop screen blinks awake then dim, no person turns or moves, the closest sleeping figure stays still, no camera movement, slight handheld stillness, sound: steady soft whir of the table fan close, the layered slow breathing of six people, one mosquito high-pitched faint somewhere, a single distant motorbike engine passing far outside the building, a faint Vietnamese radio voice from another floor barely audible, slight cinematic film grain
thought: Just sitting with this. The fan turns about thirty degrees one way and comes back. The laundry shifts when it gets there and droops when it doesn't. Nobody's turning over. That's a phone vibrating again on the desk — somebody's not getting their morning text. Mosquito somewhere, can hear it. A motorbike going by outside. I think I want to see how this place looks from outside the window — let me go.
thought_zh: 在這邊待著就好。電風扇朝一邊轉個三十度，再轉回來。風到的時候洗衣服的線會晃一下，沒到的時候就垂著。沒有人翻身。又是桌上那支手機在震——某人早上的訊息要沒被看到了。聽得到一隻蚊子在哪裡叫。外面一台摩托車經過。我有點想看這個地方從窗外是什麼樣子——出去看看。
thought_ja: ここに居てるだけ。扇風機が片方に三十度くらい首ふって戻る。風が当たると物干しのロープが少し揺れて、当たらないとそのまま垂れる。誰も寝返り打たない。また机のうえでスマホが震えてる——誰かの朝の連絡が届かないやつ。蚊もどこかで鳴いてる、聞こえる。外をバイクが一台通った。この場所、窓の外から見たらどんな感じか見たい——出てみよう。

prompt: exterior view of a Vietnamese university women's dormitory building at midnight, taken from across a small courtyard, a five-story plain concrete block painted pale yellow now grayed by night, identical small barred windows in long rows about twenty visible, roughly a third of them still lit in different colors — most cool fluorescent green-white, a few warm yellow from desk lamps, one window glowing blue from a phone screen, mosquito nets faintly visible behind some, laundry hanging on lines outside several lower-floor windows, a frangipani tree in the foreground partly framing the shot, a faded red banner with white Vietnamese text mounted high on the wall, the entrance lobby on the ground floor visible and lit with one front desk worker in uniform asleep with his head down at the counter, a single sodium streetlight casting warm orange on the walkway, a stray calico cat sitting on the path looking up at the building, sound: distant city traffic, two male voices laughing far away, faint Vietnamese late-news broadcast leaking from one open window, frogs from somewhere wet, a single moped passing somewhere, cinematic 35mm film grain, slight cool blue cast in the shadows, warm sodium spill on the foreground
thought: Out here now. Three stories of plain concrete, pale yellow, all those identical little barred windows in rows — looks like more than half are still lit at this hour. The colors are different too: most are that cool fluorescent green-white, a few are warm yellow from desk lamps, one's straight blue from somebody's phone. Laundry hanging out of some windows. Big red banner with white Vietnamese text on the lower wall. Lobby still on. And there's a calico cat sitting right in the middle of the path looking up at the building. Each one of those lit windows is basically the same room I just came out of.
thought_zh: 現在來到外面了。三層樓的普通混凝土，淡黃色，整排一模一樣的小小裝鐵欄杆的窗戶——這個時間好像還有一半以上是亮著的。顏色也都不一樣：大部分是冷冷的日光燈綠白色，幾扇是檯燈的暖黃色，還有一扇是某人手機的純藍色。有些窗戶外面晾著衣服。下面牆上掛了一條紅底白字的越南文大布條。一樓大廳還亮著。然後有一隻三花貓就坐在路徑正中間抬頭在看那棟樓。那些亮著的窗戶，每一扇基本上都是我剛剛離開的那個房間。
thought_ja: 外に出た。三階建ての無地のコンクリート、淡い黄色、ぜんぶ同じ感じの鉄格子の小さい窓がずらっと並んでて——この時間でも半分以上はまだ灯ってるっぽい。色も違う：ほとんどはあの蛍光灯のクールな緑白、何枚かはデスクランプの暖かい黄、一枚は誰かのスマホそのままの真っ青。下の階のいくつかの窓から洗濯物が垂れてる。下の壁にベトナム語の白い文字が入った大きな赤い横断幕。ロビーもまだ点いてる。三毛の野良猫が一匹、ちょうど道のまん中に座って建物を見上げてる。点いてるあの窓、一枚一枚、基本さっき出てきたあの部屋とおんなじ。

prompt: 16-bit pixel art video game style, full perspective view of a small shared kitchen in a 1960s British university hall of residence on a cold gray winter morning, narrow space with white melamine cabinets, a chunky electric kettle on the counter with a thin pixel-column of steam just rising, two stacked open shelves above the counter holding about fifteen mismatched ceramic mugs each labeled with a name in black marker — JESS, AMARA, PRIYA, EMMA, FRAN visible — a small white fridge covered in magnetic poetry words and a paper cleaning-rota taped to the front, a Tesco tote bag hanging on a hook by the door, a tiny four-person formica table at which one young woman in a baggy gray university hoodie sits eating beans on toast off a chipped plate with her laptop open in front of her showing a Zoom seminar grid of twelve tile-faces, an open Sainsbury's loaf of bread, a Pyrex glass with a tea bag in it, the kitchen window above the sink shows pixelated flat gray sky and the corner of an identical brick block opposite with one bare tree below, sound: faint Zoom seminar audio with a lecturer mid-sentence in British English, the kettle finishing its boil, distant boiler clunk, a key in a door somewhere downstairs, no music, sharp 16-bit color palette dominated by warm cream and brown cabinet wood with gray exterior light, sharp pixel boundaries, slight CRT scanline overlay
thought: Oh, totally different. Cold gray morning, narrow little British kitchen — has to be one of those 1960s hall-of-residence blocks. Fifteen mugs lined up on the shelf each with someone's name in black marker — JESS, AMARA, PRIYA, EMMA, FRAN. Cleaning rota taped to the fridge. A girl in a giant gray hoodie at the table eating beans on toast and on a Zoom seminar — twelve tile-faces on her laptop. Kettle just finishing. Sky out the window is flat gray, identical brick block right opposite. The whole thing looks 16-bit somehow, sharp pixels and scanlines. This kitchen is tiny — you'd be hitting elbows with anyone else in here. Looks freezing too.
thought_zh: 喔，完全不一樣。冷冷的灰色早晨，一個窄小的英國廚房——一定是那種 60 年代的學生宿舍棟。架子上排了 15 個馬克杯，每一個都用黑色奇異筆寫著名字——JESS、AMARA、PRIYA、EMMA、FRAN。清潔輪值表貼在冰箱上。一個穿巨大灰色連帽衫的女生坐在桌邊吃豆子吐司，同時在 Zoom 上開研討會——筆電上 12 個方格人臉。水壺剛燒好。窗外的天空灰得很平，正對面一棟一模一樣的紅磚樓。整個畫面看起來是 16-bit 的，銳利的像素跟掃描線。這個廚房有夠小——只要有第二個人進來就會撞到手肘。看起來也冷得要死。
thought_ja: おっ、まるっきり違う。冷たい灰色の朝、狭くて小さいイギリスの台所——絶対あの 60 年代の学生寮ブロックのやつ。棚に 15 個のマグカップがずらっと並んでて、それぞれ黒マジックで名前が書いてある——JESS、AMARA、PRIYA、EMMA、FRAN。清掃当番表が冷蔵庫に貼ってある。グレーのめっちゃ大きいパーカー着た女の子がテーブルで豆をのっけたトーストを食べながら、ノートPC で Zoom のセミナーに出てる——画面に 12 マスの顔。ケトルがちょうど沸き終わった。窓の外の空はフラットな灰色、目の前に同じレンガのブロックが向かい合ってる。なんか全体が 16-bit 風、シャープなピクセルとスキャンライン。この台所めちゃくちゃ狭い——もう一人入ってきたら肘がぶつかるレベル。見るからに寒そう。

prompt: soft pastel illustration in the style of a French children's-book illustrator, slightly textured paper grain visible, view of a CROUS résidence universitaire courtyard in Toulouse on a warm golden-hour spring evening, a brutalist concrete five-story dormitory block with rectangular punched windows, plant boxes built into the lower facade with overgrown ivy spilling out, the main glass double-doors propped open with a wooden wedge, a wooden noticeboard mounted next to the entrance crammed with overlapping paper notices in French — apartment shares, language exchanges, club meetings, a missing cat poster, lost keys — a row of bikes leaning against a metal rack mostly chained, a tall young woman with two grocery bags from Carrefour just stepping through the doorway, a male student in a soft gray hoodie sitting on a low concrete bench smoking a hand-rolled cigarette and looking at his phone, two pigeons on the pavement, a striped cat sitting on top of the noticeboard tail curled, the building's entry hall partly visible through the doors with a guardian's office to the side, the sky above going warm pink-gold, soft long shadows stretching across the courtyard pavement, sound: a distant tram bell from elsewhere in the city, a man laughing somewhere off-frame, a child shouting in French, a faint motor-scooter passing the next street, a phone ringing in someone's bag, the very quiet rustle of leaves, soft pastel colors with visible chalky texture, gentle outlines
thought: Different vibe completely. Golden-hour evening, soft light, this is a French CROUS for sure — that flat concrete five-story block, the plant boxes built into the wall with ivy spilling out, the big glass doors propped open with a wooden wedge. Noticeboard next to the entrance is way more crammed than the British one — apartment shares, language exchanges, missing cat poster, all of it overlapping. Bikes on the rack. Tall girl just stepping through the door with two Carrefour bags. A guy on the bench smoking a rolled-up one looking at his phone. Striped cat on top of the noticeboard, tail curled. Looks like late spring. Whole thing looks like a pastel illustration.
thought_zh: 完全是另一個氛圍了。黃金時段的傍晚，光好柔，這肯定是法國 CROUS——那種平的混凝土五層樓，牆裡內嵌的花台爬牆藤掛出來，大玻璃門用一個木楔子撐開著。入口旁邊的公告板比英國那個還要擠太多——分租廣告、語言交換、找貓海報，全部交疊在一起。腳踏車架上一排車。一個高高的女生剛拿著兩袋 Carrefour 的塑膠袋走進門。長椅上一個男生在抽手捲菸看手機。一隻虎斑貓坐在公告板上，尾巴捲起來。看起來是春末。整個畫面看起來像粉彩插畫。
thought_ja: 雰囲気がまるで違う。ゴールデンアワーの夕方、光がやわらかい、これは絶対フランスの CROUS——あのフラットなコンクリートの五階建てブロック、壁に組み込まれた植え込みからツタが垂れて、大きいガラスの両開きドアが木のくさびで開けっぱなしになってる。入り口横の掲示板がイギリスのよりめちゃくちゃぎゅうぎゅう——ルームシェア、言語交換、迷い猫のポスター、ぜんぶ重なってる。駐輪ラックに自転車がずらっと。背の高い女の子が Carrefour の袋ふたつ持ってちょうどドアをくぐった。ベンチの男の子は手巻きタバコ吸いながらスマホ見てる。トラ柄の猫が掲示板の上に座って、尻尾を丸めてる。たぶん晩春。ぜんぶパステル画みたい。

prompt: wide interior view of a communal kitchen in a 1970s Soviet-era student women's dormitory общежитие in St Petersburg at around 1am, harsh institutional fluorescent overhead plus a single warm bare bulb on a cord hanging over the table, cream-painted concrete walls scuffed and chipped at chair-height, peeling paint near the gas pipe, a long row of six small mismatched personal refrigerators along the right wall each labeled with a name in Russian Cyrillic on masking tape — НАСТЯ, ИРИНА, ОЛЯ, ВЕРА, КАТЯ, МАША — a four-burner gas stove against the back wall with a battered metal kettle on one burner just beginning to rumble and a cast-iron pan of frying potatoes on another, three young women in pajamas at a small enamel-topped table, one buttering a slice of black bread, one with both hands wrapped around a chipped mug of tea, the third one-thumb texting while picking at a plate of pickled cucumbers, a long-handled wooden spoon standing in a glass jar by the stove, a calendar on the wall in Russian with a Putin-era propaganda-y illustration above it that nobody seems to look at, a small old radio on a shelf playing a slow Russian ballad softly, the single bulb over the table flickering once, the small window over the sink shows a black night and the lit windows of an identical concrete block opposite, sound: gas hiss, the slow rumble of the kettle, the soft sizzle of potatoes, one girl saying a short sentence in Russian and another laughing once, a faint Russian radio ballad, the bulb's electrical buzz, slight cinematic 35mm grain, warm but worn institutional palette dominated by cream, brown wood, faded yellow
thought: Russia, definitely. Big communal kitchen, harsh fluorescent plus this single warm bulb on a cord over the table. That institutional cream paint chipped to hell at chair-height. Six little fridges along the wall — НАСТЯ, ИРИНА, ОЛЯ, ВЕРА, КАТЯ, МАША — every one with a name on tape. Four-burner gas stove going, kettle just starting to rumble on one, somebody's frying potatoes on another. Three girls in pajamas at the table — one's buttering black bread, one's hugging her mug, the third's texting and picking at pickles. Slow Russian ballad on the radio. The bulb above the table just flickered. Smells incredible in here probably. Classic общежитие 1am.
thought_zh: 俄羅斯，絕對。大型公用廚房，冷冷的日光燈再加上一顆暖黃色的電燈泡用電線吊在桌子上方。機構式的米色油漆牆，在椅背高度被刮得超慘。靠牆一排六台小冰箱——НАСТЯ、ИРИНА、ОЛЯ、ВЕРА、КАТЯ、МАША——每一台都用膠帶貼了名字。四口的瓦斯爐都在用，一邊水壺剛開始響，另一邊有人在煎馬鈴薯。三個女生穿著睡衣坐在桌邊——一個在抹黑麥麵包，一個用兩手抱著馬克杯，第三個一邊單手打字一邊夾醃黃瓜。收音機放著一首慢慢的俄羅斯民謠。桌子上方那顆燈泡剛剛閃了一下。聞起來大概香瘋了。經典的 общежитие 凌晨一點。
thought_ja: ロシア、間違いない。広い共用キッチン、ぎつい蛍光灯プラス、テーブルの上に紐で吊られた一個の暖色の裸電球。施設系のクリーム色の塗装が椅子の高さでめっちゃ削れてる。壁沿いに小さい冷蔵庫が六つ——НАСТЯ、ИРИНА、ОЛЯ、ВЕРА、КАТЯ、МАША——どれもガムテで名前が貼ってある。四口のガスコンロぜんぶ使ってる、一口でケトルがそろそろ沸きそう、もう一口で誰かがじゃがいも炒めてる。パジャマの女の子三人がテーブルにいて——一人は黒パンにバター塗ってる、一人は両手でマグ抱えてる、三人目は片手スマホ打ちながらピクルスつまんでる。ラジオがゆっくりしたロシアのバラード。テーブルの上の電球がいま一回点滅した。たぶんめっちゃいい匂い。クラシックな общежитие 午前一時。

prompt: from the concrete parapet of a women's student hostel rooftop in central Cairo at maghrib sunset, low pigeon-perch perspective, three pigeons in the foreground on the parapet wing-by-wing with the camera being one of them, the foreground rooftop visible right below: clotheslines strung between two black plastic water tanks with hanging laundry — a couple of cotton hijabs in soft pink and blue, one navy abaya, two white-and-gray school uniforms, several small cotton things on plastic pegs — a wooden chair beside the line, a metal tray on it with three half-drunk glasses of mint tea, a single rolled prayer mat propped against the parapet, beyond the rooftop a single black dome and two pencil minarets of a mosque rising in the middle distance against a hazy dusty pink-and-orange sky, the city stretching out flat — a sea of low pale brown concrete buildings with red brick exposed at the upper floors, satellite dishes thick on every roof, a few cranes, palm tops scattered here and there, no person visible, sound: the call to maghrib azan starting from the nearest minaret in long sustained syllables, a second minaret further off joining it a half-second behind, distant car horns from the streets below, a kid shouting in Arabic, a small tea kettle whistling from a window directly underneath, the soft coo of a pigeon right next to the camera, warm dusty haze, cinematic 35mm film grain, dominant warm pink-gold light
thought: Maghrib in Cairo. I'm a pigeon up on the concrete parapet, looking out. The rooftop spreads behind and beside me: two black water tanks, a line strung up with dark laundry — abayas maybe, school uniforms, a couple of paler things — a wooden chair with a tray of half-finished tea glasses on it. Past all that, the city goes flat to the horizon — low buff-and-brown concrete, satellite dishes on every single roof, palm tops scattered through. And right there in the middle distance, a black dome and two pencil minarets, the dome lit pink against this dusty orange sky. Azan should be coming any second.
thought_zh: 開羅的 maghrib 時分。我是一隻站在混凝土女兒牆上的鴿子，朝外面看。屋頂在我後面和旁邊展開：兩個黑色水塔，一條曬衣繩上掛著深色的衣服——大概是 abaya、學校制服，還有幾件比較淺色的——一張木椅子上面擺著一個托盤，托盤上是幾杯沒喝完的茶。過去那之後，整個城市平平地一直延伸到地平線——矮矮的米色和咖啡色混凝土，每一個屋頂都有衛星小耳朵，零零散散一些棕櫚樹頂。中距離正中央，一個黑色的圓頂跟兩根細細的喚拜塔，圓頂在這片沙塵感的橘色天空襯下被打亮成粉紅色。喚拜聲應該隨時要開始了。
thought_ja: カイロのマグリブの時間。私はコンクリートのパラペットのうえに止まったハト、外を見てる。屋上が後ろと横に広がってる：黒い貯水タンクが二つ、物干しに暗い色の洗濯物——たぶんアバヤ、制服、何枚か薄い色のもの——木の椅子にトレーが置いてあって、そのうえに飲みかけの紅茶のグラスが何個か。その向こう、街が地平線までフラットに広がる——低い砂色と茶色のコンクリート、屋根という屋根にぜんぶ衛星アンテナ、ところどころにヤシの木の頭。ちょうど中景の真ん中に、黒いドームと細い二本のミナレット、ドームが砂っぽいオレンジの空を背にしてピンク色に照らされてる。アザーンはもう始まる、たぶん秒で。

prompt: 90s Japanese cel-animation anime style with hand-drawn line-work and flat soft fills and slight grain, view of the small genkan entryway of a private Japanese women's dormitory 女子寮 at around 6pm in early autumn, an open wooden door propped half-back on its track with soft warm dusk from the street outside, a step-up wooden floor lined with two rows of cubby-style shoe lockers each labeled with a paper name slip handwritten in pencil, a neat row of communal house slippers in two color groups — pink and pale green — lined up along the edge of the step, a single pair of white sneakers half-kicked-off in front of the step where someone just came in, a cork notice-board on the wall by the door with the day's notes — a paper sign about garbage day, a handwritten dinner-cleaning duty list in kanji, a small missing-notice for someone's water bottle — a tiny brass hand-bell on a wooden shelf, a heavy noren curtain leading deeper into the dorm pulled half open revealing a hallway beyond with tatami-edged flooring and warm amber light, a young woman in a navy high-school sailor uniform with her shoulder bag down by her hip caught mid-motion stepping up onto the step, one foot already out of her sneakers, the other foot still half in, head tilted slightly, sound: the soft click of the second shoe coming off and her quietly murmuring ただいま to no one in particular, a distant rice-cooker beep finishing, a faint TV evening news jingle muffled through walls, soft early-autumn cicadas outside, soft hand-drawn cel-animation linework with cool clean outlines, anime palette dominated by warm amber and cream with cool blue dusk through the doorway
thought: Oh — anime cel, and back in Japan. Genkan of a little 女子寮, evening. Two rows of cubby shoe lockers, name slips in pencil. Pink and pale green house slippers lined up neat on the step. There's a girl just back from school — sailor uniform, bag at her hip — caught mid step-up, one shoe off, the other half-on. Cork notice-board next to her with garbage-day notes and a dinner-cleaning duty list in kanji. The noren curtain into the hallway is pulled half open, you can see warm amber light back there and the edge of tatami. Somebody's rice cooker just beeped finishing. She's saying ただいま real quiet to nobody. Whole thing's hand-drawn.
thought_zh: 喔——cel 動畫畫風，又回到日本。一間小小女子寮的玄關，傍晚。兩排格子狀的鞋櫃，每格用鉛筆寫了名字。台階邊上整齊排著一排粉色和淡綠色的公用拖鞋。一個剛從學校回來的女生——水手服，書包掛在腰邊——剛踩上來踩到一半，一隻鞋脫下來了，另一隻還半掛著。她旁邊一塊軟木公告板，貼著倒垃圾日的公告跟一張用漢字寫的晚飯打掃輪值表。通往走廊的暖簾被掀開一半，可以看到後面溫暖的琥珀色光跟榻榻米的邊。有誰的電子鍋剛剛響完。她小聲對著沒人說「ただいま」。整個畫面是手繪的。
thought_ja: あ——セル画アニメ調、また日本だ。ちっちゃい女子寮の玄関、夕方。下駄箱が二段ぶん並んでて、それぞれ鉛筆で名前。段の縁にピンクと薄緑のスリッパがきれいに並べてある。学校から帰ってきたばかりの女の子——セーラー服、肩掛けカバンが腰のあたり——ちょうど段に上がってる途中で、片足はもうスニーカーから出てて、もう片方はまだ半分入ってる。横のコルクボードに、ゴミの日のメモと夕飯の掃除当番表（漢字で手書き）が貼ってある。廊下に通じるのれんが半分めくれてて、奥の暖かいアンバー色の光と畳の縁がちょっと見える。誰かの炊飯器がいま炊き上がりのピーって鳴った。彼女、誰にともなく「ただいま」って小さくつぶやいてる。ぜんぶ手描きだ。

prompt: oil painting style with visible thick impasto brush strokes and rich saturated color, view into the kitchen of a women's república estudantil in an old colonial-era house in São Paulo on a warm Friday evening, yellow-and-white checkered floor tiles slightly worn, a wooden farm-style table in the center with three mismatched chairs, two young women cooking — one in shorts and a tee at the gas stove stirring a deep cast-iron pan of black beans, the other in a tank top at the wooden counter slicing a whole pineapple — plants in clay pots crammed on every surface and the windowsill, a giant philodendron in the corner, the wall behind the stove a deep terracotta yellow with a row of wooden spoons hanging and a small saint's votive candle in red glass, a cork board on the side wall covered in polaroids of housemates, hand-drawn postcards, and a calendar in Portuguese, a small portable bluetooth speaker on the table playing a soft bossa nova, three cold bottles of Antarctica beer with droplets running down them on a tray ready to be brought out, a black-and-orange tabby cat asleep on a chair watching everything through one half-open eye, an open arched doorway to the dining room beyond where two more girls are laughing while setting a long wooden table, warm gold São Paulo evening light coming through tall window grilles dappled by leaves outside, sound: a bossa nova playing softly under everything, the steady sizzle of beans, knife on cutting board, the cat purring faintly, two voices laughing in Brazilian Portuguese, a pressure cooker hissing, a phone ringing in another room, thick oil painting impasto strokes, rich saturated palette of yellow ochre, terracotta, deep philodendron green, warm gold light pooling on the floor
thought: Brazil — São Paulo, has to be. Women's república in some old colonial house, Friday evening. Yellow-and-white tiles, big wooden table in the middle, plants on literally every surface — and a philodendron in the corner that's basically a tree at this point. Two girls cooking — one at the stove on a pan of black beans, the other slicing a whole pineapple. Bossa nova playing soft from a little speaker on the table. Three Antarctica beers cold on a tray. Terracotta wall behind the stove with wooden spoons hanging and a saint's candle in red glass. Cork board crammed with polaroids. A tabby cat asleep on a chair, half-watching, totally unbothered. Through the arch you can see two more setting a long table, laughing. Whole thing painted thick like oil. Smells unreal probably.
thought_zh: 巴西——聖保羅，一定的。某棟老殖民時期房子裡的女生 república，週五傍晚。黃白格子地磚，正中央一張大木桌，每個平面真的都有植物——角落那株蔓綠絨大概可以叫小樹了。兩個女生在煮飯——一個在爐前顧著一鍋黑豆，另一個在切一整顆鳳梨。桌上一個小喇叭放著輕柔的 bossa nova。一個托盤上三瓶冰的 Antarctica 啤酒。爐子後面的赤褐色牆上掛著一排木湯匙，還有一支放在紅色玻璃杯裡的聖人蠟燭。軟木板上釘滿拍立得照片。一隻虎斑貓在椅子上睡，半瞇看著一切，完全不受打擾。從拱門看過去，還有兩個女生在擺一張長桌，邊擺邊笑。整個畫面被厚厚地塗成油畫感。聞起來大概是要瘋掉的香。
thought_ja: ブラジル——サンパウロ、絶対そう。古いコロニアル風の家のなかの女子の república、金曜の夕方。黄色と白のチェック柄のタイル床、真ん中にでかい木のテーブル、本当にどこの面にも植物——隅のフィロデンドロンはもう木って言っていいレベル。女の子が二人料理してる——一人はコンロでブラックビーンズの鍋、もう一人はパイナップル一玉まるごと切ってる。テーブルの小さいスピーカーから柔らかいボサノヴァ。トレーに冷えた Antarctica のビール三本。コンロの後ろのテラコッタ色の壁に木のスプーンがずらっと吊られてて、聖人のろうそくが赤いガラスのなかで灯ってる。コルクボードはチェキ写真でぎっしり。トラ猫が一匹、椅子で寝ながら半目で見てて、完全に動じない。アーチ越しに、もう二人が長いテーブルをセットしながら笑ってるのが見える。ぜんぶ油絵みたいに分厚く塗られてる。たぶんバカみたいにいい匂い。

thought_zh: 完全切換另一種等級。Sorority 會所——1920 年代希臘復興式，深色木板牆，壁爐裡是真的火在劈啪燒。一個正式感的大型起居室，壁爐架上擺著會所創辦人的肖像，上方用雕刻木牌掛著本分會的希臘字母。酒紅色 Chesterfield 沙發、坐到都磨皺的皮製 wing chair、厚厚一張老地毯。三個女生在閒晃——一個翹腿在沙發上看書、一個盤腿坐在地毯上拼拼圖、一個窩在 wing chair 看手機在笑得無聲。某個地方放著輕柔的 Joni Mitchell。地毯上躺著一隻臘腸狗在睡。高高的鉛條花窗，外面一棵楓樹整棵變紅了，襯著黃昏。這是另一種宿舍——基本上就是某人奶奶的家，假如奶奶家裡塞了三十個女生的話。
thought_ja: ぜんぜん別のギア。ソロリティの家——1920 年代のギリシャリバイバル様式、ダークな木の壁板、暖炉では本物の火がパチパチいってる。フォーマルな大きい共用ルーム、マントルピースに創立メンバーの肖像写真、その上に彫刻された木のパネルでこの支部のギリシャ文字。バーガンディのチェスターフィールドのソファ、革がよれよれになったウィングチェア、分厚い古いラグ。女の子が三人くつろいでる——一人はソファで足を上げて本読んでて、一人はラグの上で胡座かいてジグソーパズルやってて、一人はウィングチェアでスマホに無音で爆笑してる。どこかから Joni Mitchell が低めに流れてる。ダックスフントが一匹ラグで寝てる。鉛桟の高い窓の外に、楓が一本だけ完全に真っ赤になってて、薄暗い夕焼けに映えてる。これは別種類の寮——要するに、おばあちゃんの家、でもおばあちゃんの家に女の子三十人が住んでたら、っていうやつ。

thought: China — Beijing, with that cold light and the heavy clothes everyone's still got on indoors. Classic 上床下桌: bed on top, desk underneath, three of those stacks down each side. thought_zh: 中國——看那個冷冷的光跟大家在室內還穿這麼厚就知道是北京。經典的上床下桌：床在上、桌在下，每邊三組。六個女生住這間，今天下午有三個在。左邊那個在桌前穿著睡衣戴著大耳機，整個人縮著看書。中間那個盤腿坐在折好的小墊子上，一直在滑手機。右邊那個則是縮在她那張下層的書桌前。她們中間放著一個小的電暖爐發著橘色的光。窗戶下面是大個鐵製暖氣片。窗前掛了一排洗的衣服——一件粉紅色上衣、內搭褲、毛巾。床位上方都是膠帶貼的海報跟照片。地上都是拖鞋。窗外整個灰灰的，看起來冷死了。
thought_ja: 中国——あの冷たい光と、室内なのにみんなまだ厚着してる感じ、北京だ。クラシックな 上床下桌：ベッドが上で、机が下、その単位が両側に三つずつ。女の子六人住んでて、この午後は三人いる。左の子は机のところで、パジャマ姿に大きいヘッドホンで本にかじりついてる。真ん中の子は折りたたみマットのうえに胡座かいてスマホでなんかしてる。右の子は二段ベッドの下の自分の机にすっぽりはまってる。三人のあいだに小さい電気ヒーターがオレンジに光ってる。窓の下にでっかい鉄の暖房ラジエーター。窓のまえに洗濯物が掛かってる——ピンクのシャツ、レギンス、タオル。ベッドの上のほうにテープで貼ったポスターと写真。スリッパが床のあちこちに。窓の外、灰色で凍えるように見える。

thought_zh: 伊朗——德黑蘭，一定的。中庭完全是封閉的，四面都是米色磚的宿舍，三層樓圍起來。下半牆是手繪的藍色波斯磁磚拼幾何圖案，每個門上面是尖拱。中庭中央一個小石頭噴水池，月亮就映在水上。兩棵很大的法國梧桐剛剛開始變黃。其中一棵樹下的石椅上坐著兩個女生，穿牛仔褲跟大件的針織衫，課本攤開，中間放了一個茶用的保溫瓶。另外一個坐在噴水池的緣上把手機舉起來——看起來像是在拍月光在磁磚上的長曝光。一隻黑白色的貓睡在噴水池底座，看起來就像牠住在這裡。三樓有一扇窗檯燈還亮著，可以看到有人讀書的剪影。從某個樓上飄下一段微弱的流行歌。整個中庭應該都是茉莉花的味道。
thought_ja: イラン——テヘラン、絶対そう。中庭が完全に囲われてて、ベージュ色のレンガの寮が四面、三階建てでぐるっと取り囲んでる。下のほうの壁は手描きの青いペルシャタイルで幾何学模様、ドアの上は尖頭アーチ。真ん中に小さい石の噴水があって、水面に月が映ってる。大きいプラタナスが二本、ちょうど黄色くなり始めたところ。一本の木の下の石のベンチに女の子が二人、ジーンズとオーバーサイズのセーターで、教科書を開いて、あいだにお茶用の魔法瓶。もう一人が噴水のふちに座ってスマホを高く構えてる——たぶんタイルに落ちた月光の長時間露光。黒白の猫が噴水の根元で寝てて、もうここに住んでるって感じ。三階のずっと上の窓のひとつでデスクランプがまだ点いてて、誰かが勉強してるシルエットが見える。どっか上の階からポップソングがかすかに流れてくる。中庭ぜんぶ、たぶんジャスミンの匂いがする。

thought_zh: 完全是另一種步調。在泰國北部某個山上某個地方的破曉之前。這裡是一座小型上座部佛教寺院的女眾 mae-ji 起居處——住在寺裡的白衣居士。長長的木造迴廊，一排簡單的木拉門小寮房。其中三個已經起來了，穿著白袍，在第一道光裡安安靜靜在廊上走動。建築下方一座白色的小佛塔半邊被晨霧掩著，一棵很大、彎彎曲曲的老樹從屋頂上方探出來。庭院裡一個低低的炭爐上放了一個銅水壺。東邊的天空剛剛開始在山稜上方染上粉金色。整個畫面被柔柔地畫成水墨。山下村子的雞在叫。
thought_ja: ぜんぜん違うギア。タイ北部のどこかの山のうえ、夜明け前。これは小さい上座部仏教の寺の女性のメーチー（mae-ji）の住居——お寺に住んでる白衣の在家女性たちの場所。長い木造の縁側、引き戸の小さい部屋がずらっと並んでる。三人がもう起きてて、白い衣で、最初の光のなか縁側を静かに行き来してる。建物の下のほう、白く塗られた小さなチェディが地面の霧で半分隠れてて、一本のごつごつした古い大木が屋根の上にせり出してる。庭の低い炭の火鉢の上に銅のやかん。東の空が山の稜線の上でぎりぎりピンクゴールドに染まり始めたとこ。ぜんぶが水墨画みたいに柔らかく描かれてる。山の下のほうの村でニワトリが鳴いてる。

prompt: interior view down the length of a long dormitory hall in a Kenyan girls' boarding secondary school in central Kenya at around 9pm just before lights-out, two long rows of single metal-frame beds along the walls with maybe twenty beds visible each with a thin mattress and a white mosquito net tied up at one corner of each bedhead, the floor a polished red-painted concrete worn smooth, the walls cream-painted with small paper notices stuck high up — a duty roster, a Bible verse, the school crest stencilled in white near the doorway — each girl's painted metal storage trunk under her bed, small corner shelves between beds holding personal items (a Bible, a textbook, a hairbrush, a small tin of Vaseline), the girls in matching navy and white striped night-uniforms moving in slow quiet lights-out preparation, two still standing at the long water tap at the far end filling plastic mugs, three sitting on a single bed plaiting each others' hair, several already inside their nets reading by torchlight, a duty prefect with a clipboard walking the central aisle, warm tungsten ceiling bulbs hanging by cords most of them about to be switched off, the high louvered windows with metal grilles showing a deep blue African night, one large moth circling the lit bulb near the door, a small portable radio on a wooden chair near the door playing a Kiswahili gospel song very low, sound: layered soft Kiswahili and English chatter, slippers on concrete, the radio gospel low, a moth tapping the bulb, distant cricket chorus from the bush, the prefect's footsteps, the click of a single bulb switching off at the far end, slight cinematic 35mm grain, dominant warm tungsten with deep blue night through the high windows

thought_zh: 肯亞——女生寄宿學校，肯定的。打磨過的紅色水泥地，兩長排鐵架床，每張床的床頭一角都繫著蚊帳，大概有二十張床。米色的牆，門邊用模板印著校徽，高處貼著紙公告——一張輪值表、一段聖經經文。每個女生的床下都有一個漆過的鐵製收納箱。穿著一致的深藍白條紋睡衣，正在慢慢做關燈前的準備。還有兩個在走廊盡頭那長排水龍頭那邊裝水。三個女生擠在一張床上彼此編辮子。有些已經鑽進蚊帳裡用手電筒看書。值日生拿著一塊夾板走過走道。暖色鎢絲燈泡準備一個一個關掉。一隻蛾在離我最近的那盞燈邊轉。一個小收音機放在椅子上，播著低低的史瓦希利語福音歌。外面有蛐蛐。最遠端那盞燈剛剛卡擦關掉。
thought_ja: ケニア——女子寄宿の中学校、絶対そう。磨き上げた赤い土間のコンクリート床、メタルフレームのベッドが両側に長く二列、それぞれヘッドボードの片角に蚊帳が結んである、たぶん二十床くらい。クリーム色の壁、ドアの近くに学校の紋章がステンシルで描かれてて、紙の通知が高い位置に貼ってある——当番表、聖句。女の子それぞれのベッドの下に塗装した金属のトランクが入ってる。お揃いの紺と白の縞のパジャマ、ゆっくり消灯前の準備をしてる。二人がまだホールの奥のずらっと並んだ蛇口でマグに水を入れてる。三人がベッドひとつのうえで、お互いに三つ編みを編んでる。何人かはもう蚊帳のなかでヘッドライトを使って本読んでる。クリップボード持った当番のプリフェクトが通路を歩いてる。あったかいタングステンの電球がそろそろ一つずつ切られていくとこ。私の近くの一個の周りを蛾が回ってる。椅子のうえの小さなラジオから、スワヒリ語のゴスペルが小さく聞こえる。外でコオロギ。いま一番奥の電球が一個カチッと消えた。

Pale washed-out version of it though — a flat lake between birch trees, one bird flying low across, a yellow boathouse on the far shore, that's it, no people anywhere. Inside the room: a girl in her early twenties asleep on her side, blonde hair across the pillow, white sheets, blue summer blanket bunched at her feet. Phone face-down on the floor next to the bed. Pale-wood desk under me with neatly stacked textbooks, a half-glass of water, a dried wildflower in a thin vase. One risograph print over the bed. Sauna door across the hallway. Total silence. The weird part is how this light looks like dawn except it's the middle of the night.
thought_zh: 芬蘭——赫爾辛基，仲夏白夜。我就在一間小小單人宿舍房間的窗邊，凌晨四點，但外面不知道為什麼還是白天。只是是一種被洗淡的版本——白樺樹之間一片平靜的湖面、一隻鳥低低飛過、對岸一棟黃色的小船屋，就這些，看不到一個人。房間裡：一個二十出頭的女生側身睡著，金色頭髮散在枕頭上，白色床單，藍色夏被堆在腳邊。手機螢幕朝下放在床邊地板。我下面是一張淺色木桌，上面整齊堆著教科書、一杯一半的水、一個細細的玻璃瓶裡插著一朵乾掉的野花。床上方一張 risograph 版畫。對面走廊是桑拿房的門。完全的安靜。最詭異的就是這個光看起來像黎明，但其實是半夜。
thought_ja: フィンランド——ヘルシンキ、夏至の白夜。私はちっちゃい一人部屋の寮の窓際にいて、いま午前四時、なのに外がなぜかまだ昼みたい。色が抜けたバージョンだけど——白樺のあいだに見える静かな湖、鳥が一羽水面を低く横切ってて、対岸に黄色いボートハウスがひとつ、それだけ、人影はどこにもない。部屋のなか：二十代前半の女の子が横向きに寝てる、金髪が枕に流れてて、白いシーツ、青い夏用ブランケットが足元でくしゃっとなってる。スマホが画面下向きにベッド横の床に置いてある。私の下、薄い木の机に教科書がきちんと積んであって、半分残った水のグラス、細いガラスの瓶に乾いた野草が一本。ベッドの上にリソグラフのプリント一枚。廊下の向かいにサウナのドア。完全な静けさ。やばいのは、この光が夜明けに見えるのに、いま真夜中ってこと。

thought: Holding here a sec. The fountain just bubbles, everything else basically doesn't move. One yellow leaf just came down across the courtyard and landed on the water — tiny plip. The cat by the fountain stretched one paw out and tucked it back. The girls on the bench haven't moved, the one on the fountain rim is still holding her phone up steady. Whoever's at the desk lamp upstairs hasn't moved either. It's a perfect five-second postcard. Okay — I want to go somewhere hot and noisy now, let me jump.
thought_zh: 在這邊停一下。噴水池就是冒泡，其他什麼基本都沒動。一片黃葉剛剛斜斜飄過中庭落在水面上——很小一聲 plip。噴水池旁邊的貓伸了一下其中一隻腳掌又收回去。長凳上那兩個女生沒動，坐在噴水池緣的那個還是穩穩地舉著她的手機。樓上那盞檯燈下的人也沒動。完美五秒明信片。好——我現在想去一個熱熱吵吵的地方，跳。
thought_ja: ちょっとここで止まる。噴水はぽこぽこ言ってるだけで、ほかはほぼ動かない。黄色い葉っぱが一枚、中庭を斜めに流れて水面に落ちた——ちっちゃい plip。噴水のそばの猫が前足を一本伸ばして引っ込めた。ベンチの女の子たちは動いてない、噴水のふちの子はずっとスマホをしっかり構えたまま。上のデスクランプの誰かも動いてない。完璧な五秒のポストカード。よし——いまは熱くてうるさいとこに行きたい、飛ぶよ。
