Behind him the rest of the kitchen's dark. Hi I guess. Let me see what he grabs.
thought_zh: OK——我好像在一個冰箱裡？門剛打開，前面有一個小朋友、白色的太大件 T 恤、頭髮亂亂的，半閉著一隻眼睛在看我，像是已經半決定好了。冷麵就在他眼睛下面、一瓶牛奶、一盤紅紅的什麼東西、一顆芒果側著躺。他已經往裡面靠了，一隻手在往右邊伸。後面整個廚房是暗的。哈囉吧。我來看他抓什麼。
thought_ja: オーケー——僕、冷蔵庫の中にいるっぽい？扉がいま開いて、目の前にちっちゃい子がひとり、ぶかぶかの白いTシャツに寝起きの髪、半分ウインクみたいな目でこっちを見てて、もう半分決まってるって顔してる。冷たい麺がちょうど顔の下、牛乳の瓶、赤いなにかの皿、横倒しのマンゴー。もうこっちに身を乗り出してて、片手は右のほうに伸びてる。後ろの台所は真っ暗だ。やあ、たぶん。何取るか見てみよう。

prompt: wide view of a small dark apartment kitchen at 1am, slightly elevated angle from about pendant-lamp height — looking down and across at a small boy about seven years old in an oversized white t-shirt, barefoot, standing with his back to the camera in front of the open refrigerator. the bright cold-blue light from inside the fridge spills out around his silhouette and rakes across the linoleum floor in a clean rectangle. the rest of the kitchen sits in deep shadow: a small round dining table to the left with one chair pushed under, a wall-mounted tea towel, a dim dark window above the sink barely catching the fridge glow, a wall calendar with faint print, a single mug left on the counter. the fridge interior is partially visible past the boy — shelves with a bowl of noodles, a milk bottle, fruit. cel animation 90s anime style, clean line art with flat color fills, strong value contrast between the bright fridge rectangle and the dark room, slight film grain. audio: faint compressor hum, the soft tick of a wall clock, no music
thought: Let me back up — I want to see this from the room's side, not from inside the fridge. The whole kitchen's dark except for the rectangle of cold light around him. Small round table with one chair on the left, mug on the counter, dark window over the sink. He's already got the bowl in his hands — the noodles, of course. Apartment's quiet. Don't think anyone else is up.
thought_zh: 我退一下——我想從房間那邊看這個畫面，不要從冰箱裡面看。整個廚房是暗的，只有他身邊那一塊冷光的長方形。左邊一張小圓桌、一張椅子塞在下面、流理台上一個馬克杯、水槽上方一扇黑窗。他手上已經有那個碗了——當然是麵。整間公寓很安靜。我想沒有別人起來。
thought_ja: ちょっと引いてみよう——冷蔵庫の中じゃなくて、部屋のほうから見てみたい。台所はぜんぶ暗くて、彼のまわりの冷たい光の長方形だけが浮かんでる。左に小さな丸テーブル、椅子が一脚しまわれてて、カウンターにマグカップ、シンクの上には黒い窓。彼はもう例のボウルを手にしてる——もちろん麺。アパート全体が静かだ。たぶん他に起きてる人はいない。

prompt: static elevated wide shot of a small dark apartment kitchen at 1am from pendant-lamp height. a small boy about seven, oversized white t-shirt, barefoot, stands in front of the open refrigerator holding a clear plastic bowl of noodles in one hand. with his free hand he slowly closes the refrigerator door — over the eight seconds the bright rectangle of cold blue fridge light on the linoleum floor narrows and shrinks, the door comes shut with a soft suction thunk, the rectangle disappears, and the whole kitchen plunges into shadow lit only by faint cool moonlight coming through the dark window over the sink, the round table and chair on the left becoming silhouettes. the boy still standing where he was, holding the bowl, his white t-shirt the brightest thing in the room. cel animation 90s anime style, clean line art with flat color fills, slight film grain, smooth slow continuous door-close motion. audio: the soft suction-thunk and click of the refrigerator door, the faint trailing hum of the compressor, the tick of a wall clock, no music, no dialog
thought: He's done deciding. Closing the door now — the rectangle of cold light on the floor is shrinking, shrinking, and there it goes. Whole kitchen drops into the dark. Just the window glow over the sink left. He's still standing there with the bowl, white t-shirt the only bright thing in the room.
thought_zh: 他選好了。在關門了——地板上那塊冷光的長方形在縮、在縮，然後就這樣消失了。整個廚房一下子掉進黑裡。只剩水槽上面那扇窗的微光。他還站在原地、抱著那個碗，那件白T恤是房間裡唯一還亮著的東西。
thought_ja: 彼、決めたっぽい。扉を閉めにかかってる——床の上の冷たい光の長方形が縮んでいって、縮んでいって、そのまま消えた。台所全体が一気に暗闇に落ちた。シンクの上の窓のうっすらした明かりだけが残ってる。彼はまだその場に立ってボウルを抱えてて、白いTシャツが部屋のなかで唯一光ってるものだ。

prompt: interior of a small child's bedroom at 1am, low pillow-level POV from the head of an unmade twin bed — soft plush rabbit fur edge just barely visible blurred at the bottom of the frame as if from the rabbit's eye-line. across the room: the small boy in the oversized white t-shirt has just pushed the bedroom door open with his shoulder, holding a clear plastic bowl of noodles in both hands, dark hallway behind him. the room: a small wooden desk under the window on the right with a tiny gooseneck lamp on casting a warm pool of yellow light onto a half-done math worksheet, a pencil eraser-end-up beside it, a wooden chair pulled out at an angle. window with curtain half open showing dark city beyond. on the wall: a poster of a baseball player. slippers kicked off on the floor. messy sheets in the foreground (out of focus), the plush rabbit's pink ear tip catching a bit of the warm lamp light. cel animation 90s anime style, clean line art with flat color fills, slight film grain, warm desk-lamp light mixed with cool moonlight, intimate low angle. audio: very faint city hum from outside, the soft thud of a kid's bare feet on wood floor, no music
thought: I'll be the rabbit on his pillow, watch from there. Huh — he's not eating it. He's at the window, peeking out through the curtain. Must've set the bowl down. Desk lamp's on, a homework page open under it. Baseball poster on the wall. Slippers kicked off. So that's what he was doing — looking out. At what?
thought_zh: 讓我變成枕頭上那隻兔子，從那邊看。咦——他沒在吃。他在窗邊，掀開一點窗簾偷看外面。碗八成放在哪了。書桌的小檯燈亮著，下面攤著一張作業。牆上一張棒球選手的海報。拖鞋踢掉在地上。原來他在做這個——往外看。看什麼？
thought_ja: 枕の上のうさぎになって、そこから見てみよう。あれ——食べてない。彼、窓のところでカーテンの隙間から外をのぞいてる。ボウルはどっかに置いたんだろう。机のスタンドが点いてて、宿題のプリントが開いてる。壁には野球選手のポスター。スリッパは床に脱ぎ捨ててある。なるほど、こういうことしてたのか——外を見てたのか。何を？

prompt: view from a child's third-story bedroom window at 1am looking down and across into the inner courtyard between two apartment buildings. on top of a low brick courtyard wall between rubbish bins stands a single red fox, completely still, ears up, looking up directly at the window/camera. its eyes catch a warm streetlamp glow. courtyard around the fox: dark and quiet, a few parked scooters, plastic bins, a row of chained bicycles, a small potted plant on a low sill. the apartment building across the way mostly dark with one warmly lit kitchen window two floors below where a figure can faintly be seen standing at a stove. cool night atmosphere, slight haze, faint moonlight, the fox vivid orange-red against the muted blue-gray courtyard. cel animation 90s anime style, clean line art with flat color fills, slight film grain, sharp eye-contact composition. audio: very distant traffic, faint city rustle, the soft hum of an air conditioner from a neighboring window, no music
thought: I went to look out his window — and ended up way closer than I meant. Ground level, doorway open, and the fox is right *there*. A meter away. Bright orange, ears up, eyes locked on me. Behind it: the courtyard — scooters, bikes, a couple of warm-lit windows in the building across, a streetlamp, the moon. Neither of us moving. Okay.
thought_zh: 我去他的窗外看——結果飛得比我預期的近超多。已經到地面了，門開著，那隻狐狸就在那裡。距離一公尺。亮橘色，耳朵立著，眼睛直勾勾盯著我。後面：中庭——機車、腳踏車、對面那棟有兩三個還亮著暖光的窗、一盞路燈、月亮。我們兩個都不動。OK。
thought_ja: 彼の窓から外を見にいこうとした——のに、思ってたよりずっと近くまで来ちゃった。気づいたら地面、扉は開いてて、狐がほんとに*そこ*にいる。一メートル。鮮やかなオレンジ、耳が立ってて、目はがっつり僕に固定。後ろは中庭——スクーター、自転車、向かいの建物に暖色の灯った窓が二つ三つ、街灯ひとつ、月。お互いに動かない。オーケー。

prompt: low fox-eye-level view across a quiet residential courtyard at 1am, looking up and toward an open ground-floor doorway in an apartment building. the doorway is a warm-yellow glowing rectangle in the otherwise dark facade — a small silhouette of a child in an oversized white t-shirt stands in the doorway looking out toward the camera. courtyard foreground: wet brick paving with shallow reflections, a few fallen leaves, the lower legs of a parked scooter on the left, a single bicycle wheel on the right, a small puddle catching the orange light of a streetlamp out of frame. behind the doorway the building is dark masonry, a few dim warm windows higher up. atmosphere: cool blue-gray courtyard, the warm doorway the only bright point. watercolor painterly style, soft brush edges, slight color bleed, visible paper grain, no hard outlines, restrained gentle palette. audio: very faint city hum, a distant scooter passing somewhere, the soft scrape of a leaf on brick, no music
thought: Let me try being the fox for a sec — see this from where it's standing. The doorway from down here is just a warm-yellow rectangle in the dark wall, kid-sized silhouette in it, watching me. Cool wet brick under my paws. Bike wheel on the right. Puddle catches the streetlamp. Quieter from down here. Bigger, somehow.
thought_zh: 我來試著當一下那隻狐狸——從牠站的位置看這個。從這裡看，那扇門就是黑牆裡一個暖黃色的長方形，裡面有一個小朋友大小的剪影在看我。爪子下面是冰冰的濕磚。右邊一個腳踏車輪。水窪映著路燈。從下面看安靜很多。也比較大。
thought_ja: ちょっとあの狐になってみよう——狐の位置からこの景色を見てみたい。こっちから見ると、あの扉はただの暖かい黄色の長方形で、暗い壁にぽつんと開いていて、その中に子どもサイズのシルエットが立ってこっちを見てる。足の下は冷たく濡れた煉瓦。右に自転車の車輪。水たまりに街灯が映ってる。下から見るとずっと静かだ。なんかでかくも見える。

prompt: static low fox-eye-level view across a quiet residential courtyard at 1am, watercolor painterly style holding throughout. composition unchanged from the reference: warm-yellow doorway glowing in the dark facade with a small child silhouette standing in it watching, a parked scooter on the left, a bicycle on the right, wet brick paving in the foreground with a puddle reflecting an off-screen streetlamp. across the eight seconds the only motion is very subtle: a single small dry leaf skitters slowly across the wet brick from left to right just in front of the camera, the puddle's reflection ripples once, the child in the doorway shifts his weight a little but does not step out. everything else holds completely still. soft brush edges, slight color bleed, visible paper grain. audio: faint city hum, a very distant scooter passing far away, the soft dry scratch of a leaf across brick, no music, no dialog
thought: Hold here for a beat. He doesn't come out. I don't go in. One dry leaf scratches across the brick between us, puddle ripples once, and he shifts his weight but stays in the doorway. Okay. Let me see if he comes out.
thought_zh: 讓畫面停一下。他不出來，我也不進去。一片乾葉子從我們之間的磚地上慢慢被吹過去，水窪皺一下，他重心換了一下但還是站在門口。OK。我看他要不要走出來。
thought_ja: ここでちょっと止めよう。彼は出てこないし、僕も入っていかない。一枚の乾いた葉が二人のあいだの煉瓦の上をゆっくり擦って通り過ぎ、水たまりが一度だけ波打って、彼は重心を少し変えるけど扉のところから動かない。オーケー。出てくるか見てみよう。

prompt: static low fox-eye-level view across a quiet residential courtyard at 1am, watercolor painterly style holding throughout. composition unchanged from the reference: warm-yellow glowing doorway in a dark facade, parked scooter on the left, bicycle on the right, wet brick paving in the foreground with a streetlamp puddle, dim apartment building behind. across the eight seconds the small child in the oversized white t-shirt slowly takes one single careful step forward out of the doorway onto the brick — just one step, his bare foot meeting the wet brick, his back hand still resting on the doorframe behind him. then he stops and stays. otherwise the whole scene holds completely still — no other motion. soft brush edges, slight color bleed, paper grain, restrained palette. audio: faint city hum, a very distant scooter passing far away, the soft pad of a small bare foot on wet brick, no music, no dialog
thought: He didn't really come out. Made a small lean forward, then stopped — hand still on the doorframe. Halfway out, halfway in. Neither of us is moving.
thought_zh: 他終究沒真的走出來。往前傾了一下下，就停住了——手還扶著門框。半個身體出來，半個身體還在裡面。我們兩個都沒動。
thought_ja: 結局、ちゃんと出てはこなかった。少しだけ前に体重を乗せて、それで止まった——手はまだドアフレームに置いたまま。半分外、半分中。お互い動いてない。

prompt: warm interior of a small second-floor apartment kitchen at 1am, oil painting style with thick visible brushstrokes and warm chiaroscuro lighting. an older woman in her late 50s in a pale-blue cotton housecoat stands at a small gas stove with her back partially to the viewer, ladling a thin chicken-and-rice congee from a small enameled pot into a ceramic bowl on the counter, soft steam rising. the kitchen: pale-yellow tiled walls, a single warm bulb above her, a small old AM radio on the windowsill, a wooden dish rack with bowls. through the window over the sink: the dark courtyard below, and across the way — barely visible — the warm-yellow rectangle of an open ground-floor doorway with a tiny silhouette of a child in a white t-shirt standing in it. on the counter beside the bowl: a small dish of pickled mustard greens, chopsticks. her face is calm, half-lit. oil painting style, thick textured impasto brushstrokes, warm yellow-orange interior palette, cool blue beyond the window, intimate Vermeer-like contrast. audio: a low old-style Mandarin ballad on AM radio (instrumental, no clear lyrics), soft bubbling of broth, the clink of a metal ladle against the enamel pot, no dialog
thought: Okay — let me leave the standoff for a sec. Up on the second floor: this woman in a pale-blue housecoat is ladling congee into a bowl. AM radio on the wall, yellow tiles, smell of chicken broth. Wait — there's a kid in *her* doorway too. White t-shirt, bedhead. Same kid? Different kid? Hard to tell from here. She hasn't noticed him yet either.
thought_zh: OK——這個對峙我先放著。上到二樓：這位阿姨穿著淡藍色家居衫，正在把粥從鍋裡舀進碗裡。AM收音機掛在牆上、黃色磁磚、聞得到雞湯的味道。等一下——*她*的門口也站著一個小朋友。白T恤、亂亂的頭髮。同一個小朋友？別的小朋友？從這邊看不出來。她也還沒注意到他。
thought_ja: オーケー——あの睨み合いはちょっと置いとく。上の階に行ってみたら、淡いブルーの家着のおばさんがお粥を鍋からお椀に注いでるところだった。AMラジオが壁に、黄色いタイル、鶏のだしのにおい。あれ——彼女のほうの戸口にも子どもが立ってる。白いTシャツに寝起きの髪。同じ子？別の子？ここからじゃわからない。彼女もまだ気づいてない。

prompt: interior of a small second-floor apartment kitchen at 1am, oil painting style with thick visible impasto brushstrokes. composition unchanged from the reference: an older woman in a pale-blue cotton housecoat standing at the gas stove ladling chicken-and-rice congee into a ceramic bowl, steam rising, yellow-tiled walls, AM radio on the wall, a small child in a white t-shirt standing in the open doorway on the right side of the frame watching her. across the eight seconds she slowly stops ladling and rests the metal ladle on the rim of the pot, then turns her head and shoulders toward the doorway and finds the child standing there. the corners of her mouth lift just slightly into the start of a small private smile. she does not speak and does not walk toward him. otherwise the kitchen holds still — the steam keeps rising, the radio keeps playing. thick visible brushstrokes throughout, warm yellow interior light. audio: low instrumental Mandarin ballad on AM radio, soft bubbling of broth, the small clink of the metal ladle against the enamel pot rim, no dialog
thought: Now she's noticing him. Ladle rests, head turning, eyes find him in the doorway. Just barely a smile. He doesn't move either. Looks like they've done this before.
thought_zh: 她注意到他了。勺子放下，頭轉過來，視線在門口找到了他。一點點微笑剛剛開始。他也沒動。看起來他們做這件事很多次了。
thought_ja: 彼女、気づいた。お玉が鍋の縁に置かれて、頭が回って、視線が戸口で彼を見つける。微笑みのいちばん最初の輪郭がほんの少し浮かぶ。彼のほうも動かない。これ、二人とも何回もやってるな。

prompt: the open stern deck of a small overnight passenger ferry around 1am, photorealistic 35mm film stock with slight grain, deep blue-black palette. wide angle view across the stern: a wet steel deck with white painted railings running across the frame, dark open ocean behind extending to a flat black horizon, white wake foam churning below the railing trailing back from the camera. two figures stand at the rail with their backs to the viewer — a man in a dark windbreaker with hood half up, a woman in a thick fishermen's sweater — neither talking, each smoking, the cigarette ends two small orange dots. a single far-off lighthouse blinks faintly on the right horizon. salt spray on the deck, a row of dim warm-white deck lights along the cabin wall behind, a metal door with a porthole. on the deck: an old red plastic chair tipped over, a coiled rope. cold marine atmosphere, faint moon hidden behind low clouds. audio: heavy diesel engine rumble felt through the deck, the constant wash of the wake, steady wind, a faint ship's bell from somewhere forward, no music, no dialog
thought: Sudden need to be out of doors — let me cut. Okay, this works. Back deck of a night ferry, middle of nothing. Wet steel, white railings, black water in every direction. Two guys leaning on the rail, hoods up. Moon right above us. Lighthouse blinking way off to the right. Cold. Salty. Engine rumble coming up through my feet. Where is this even going.
thought_zh: 我突然想到外面去——切。OK，這個還可以。夜裡某艘渡輪的後甲板，四面八方都是空的。濕的鋼板、白色欄杆、四面都是黑色的水。兩個男的靠在欄杆上、帽兜拉著。月亮就在我們頭頂正上方。一座燈塔在遠遠右邊在閃。冷。鹹。引擎的轟透過腳底傳上來。這艘船到底要去哪。
thought_ja: 急に外に出たくなった——カット。よし、これで合ってる。夜のフェリーの船尾デッキ、まわり全部空っぽ。濡れた鋼鉄、白い手すり、どっち向いても黒い水。男が二人、フードをかぶって手すりに寄りかかってる。月はちょうど真上。遠く右のほうで灯台がひとつ点滅してる。寒い。しょっぱい。エンジンのうなりが足の裏から上がってくる。この船、どこに向かってるんだろう。

prompt: interior of a small lighthouse keeper's office at the top of a coastal lighthouse around 1:30am, photorealistic with cinematic warm lamp light. cramped circular wooden room: a small wooden desk with an open paper logbook, a brass desk lamp, a tin mug of tea half-full, a battered hardcover tide chart pinned to the wall, a marine VHF radio with one green LED, a coil of cable. through the curved window: open dark ocean stretching to a flat horizon, far below on the water the tiny white shape of a passenger ferry moving slowly leftward with a faint trail of wake, its deck lights two or three warm pinpricks. the rotating beacon is implied off-frame above — a long sweep of pale gold light glances briefly across the desk and out the window. an older man in his late sixties in a thick gray wool cardigan sits with his back three-quarters to the camera, writing in the logbook with a ballpoint, gray hair, half-glasses on his nose, calm. warm-orange interior tone contrasting with the cool blue-black ocean outside. photorealistic, slight 35mm grain. audio: a faint VHF radio crackle and a distant ship's horn from far out at sea, the soft scratch of a ballpoint pen on paper, the slow muted hum of the lamp motor turning above, no music
thought: I want to know where that ferry's going. Let me try being whoever's at the top of the lighthouse. Tiny round room, wooden desk, logbook open under a brass lamp, mug of tea half-cold. Old guy in a wool cardigan writing something down, half-glasses. Out the window there's a ship — bigger than I'd have expected, lit. Maps pinned either side of the window. Quieter up here than I thought it'd be.
thought_zh: 我想知道那艘渡輪要去哪。讓我試著當燈塔頂端那個人。一個小小的圓形房間、一張木桌、攤著的航行紀錄本、桌上一盞銅燈、半冷的茶杯。一位老先生穿著毛料開襟外套在裡面寫東西，半月眼鏡。窗外一艘船——比我想的大、亮著的。窗的兩邊釘著海圖。上面比我以為的還要安靜。
thought_ja: あのフェリーがどこに行くのか知りたい。灯台の上にいる人を試しにやってみよう。小さな丸い部屋、木の机、開かれた航海日誌、真鍮の机ランプ、半分冷めた茶のマグ。年配の男性が分厚いウールのカーディガンを着て何か書き込んでる、半月メガネ。窓の外には船——思ってたより大きくて、灯がついてる。窓の両側に海図がピンで留めてある。上は思ったよりずっと静かだ。

prompt: a busy Sunday tianguis street market in Mexico City around 11am, painted in Diego Rivera-style mural aesthetic — flat planes of color, monumental rounded figures, slightly elongated proportions, hard shadows. an indigenous-Mexican vendor in a long skirt with embroidered bright-yellow flowers and a long braid stands behind a long wooden table piled with mounds of dried chiles in deep red and chocolate-brown, a basket of green tomatillos, two stacks of multicolored corn cobs, and a hand-painted wood sign saying CHILES SECOS. a patchwork of blue tarpaulins overhead filters the noon sun into broken squares of light onto the table. customer side: an older man in a tan straw hat with a small dark-haired boy holding his hand, three women in bright shawls bargaining at the next stall. cobblestone ground, a brown stray dog asleep at the table foot. a tinny boombox visible at a nearby stall. wide composition, midday Mexican palette: deep mustard, terracotta, bright red, cobalt blue, dusty white. mural-painting style with thick brushwork, broad shapes, no fine detail. audio: cumbia playing from a tinny speaker a couple of stalls over, the clack of dried chiles being scooped into paper cones, a vendor calling out prices in Spanish, kids laughing somewhere out of frame, no music score
thought: Okay — out of the night. Cut to: Sunday market in Mexico City, noon-bright. Blue tarps overhead. Huh — there's a whole mural painted on the wall behind the stalls, women with braids and long skirts, kids, and the real vendor in green is standing right in front of them like she stepped out of it. Mountain of dried chiles on her table, ears of corn. Small kid in red shorts looking at the corn. Old man in a straw hat walking past. Cumbia from somewhere. Bright. Loud.
thought_zh: OK——脫離夜晚了。切到：墨西哥城禮拜日的市場，正午、亮。攤位上方藍色帆布。咦——攤位後面整面牆畫了一幅壁畫，畫的是長辮子、長裙的女人、還有小孩，而綠色衣服的攤主就站在她們前面，好像剛剛從畫裡走出來那樣。她桌上一座乾辣椒山、一堆玉米。一個穿紅短褲的小朋友在看玉米。一個戴草帽的老先生路過。哪邊在放cumbia。亮。吵。
thought_ja: オーケー——夜から抜けた。カットで：日曜日のメキシコシティの市場、真昼で明るい。屋台の上に青いタープ。あれ——屋台の後ろの壁ぜんぶに壁画がある、三つ編みの長いスカートの女の人たち、子どもたち、で緑のドレスの売り子さんがその前にちょうど立ってる、絵から出てきたみたいに。彼女のテーブルには乾燥唐辛子の山、トウモロコシの束。赤いショートパンツの小さい子がトウモロコシを見てる。麦わら帽の年配の男性が通り過ぎる。どこかでクンビアが流れてる。明るい。うるさい。

prompt: low ground-level view from a stray dog's eye-line under a market table at a busy Sunday tianguis in Mexico City around 11am, mural style. centered foreground: a small dark-haired boy in red shorts and small white sneakers, painted from waist down, his bare hand reaching up out of frame toward something on the table above. on either side of him: the legs of other shoppers — sandals, dusty cowboy boots, women's bare ankles in long skirts, a wheeled granny cart. the wooden table legs of a chile stall just visible at the edges. on the cobblestone ground: scattered corn husks, a dropped centavo coin, a couple of dry chile pods, a small puddle of melted ice. above and behind the legs: bright stripes of midday sun cutting in sharp diagonals through a blue tarp overhead, a fragment of red chiles in the upper edge of frame. Diego Rivera mural style with flat planes of color, thick brushwork, dramatic upward foreshortening, deep saturated palette of red, mustard, cobalt, and dust. audio: cumbia continuing from a tinny speaker a couple of stalls over, the slap of sandals on cobblestone, a vendor calling prices in Spanish, the soft snuffle of a nearby dog, no music score
thought: Let me get down to the dog's level — see the market from under the table. Kid's back is to me — red shorts, no shirt, both arms reaching up for the chiles strung above the table. Sandals and cowboy boots on either side. Scattered chiles and a piece of corn on the cobblestones, a folded bill someone dropped. Cumbia still going. Smells like corn smoke and chiles down here.
thought_zh: 我下到狗的高度——從桌子下面看這個市場。背對著我的小朋友——紅短褲、沒穿上衣、兩隻手都伸上去要抓掛在桌子上面那串辣椒。兩邊是涼鞋跟牛仔靴。鵝卵石上散著辣椒跟一根玉米、有人掉了一張折起來的鈔票。cumbia還在放。下面這裡聞起來是烤玉米跟辣椒的味道。
thought_ja: 犬の目の高さに降りてみよう——テーブルの下から市場を見る。背中をこっちに向けてる子——赤いショートパンツ、上半身裸、両腕を上に伸ばしてテーブルの上に吊られてる唐辛子に届かそうとしてる。両脇にサンダルとカウボーイブーツ。石畳の上に唐辛子と一本のトウモロコシが散らばってて、誰かが落とした折りたたんだ紙幣も一枚。クンビアはまだ流れてる。下のここは焼きトウモロコシと唐辛子のにおいがする。

prompt: interior of a small late-night noraebang (karaoke booth) in Seoul around 2am, photorealistic. a cramped vinyl-walled room with hot pink and neon blue LED strips bouncing off the walls and faces. four people in their early twenties on a curved L-shaped sofa: a young woman in a white t-shirt mid-song with her eyes shut and one wired microphone raised close, leaning slightly forward toward the screen; a young man across from her holding a second wired mic, half-laughing, ready to come in on the next line; another young man slumped in the corner with his eyes half-closed and a half-empty soju bottle loosely in his hand; another young woman tapping a finger on her phone screen scrolling for the next song. a low table cluttered with empty Cass beer bottles, a plate of dried squid jerky, a small white tambourine. on the back wall: a glowing screen showing a frame from a 1990s K-pop music video, slightly blurred, vivid colors, with Hangul lyrics scrolling at the bottom. faint cigarette haze in the air. photorealistic, slight motion blur on the singer, neon pink and blue rim lighting on every face, slight 35mm grain. audio: a 1990s K-pop ballad backing track playing through small speakers, the lead singer's voice slightly off-key, the occasional laugh and tambourine rattle, no score
thought: Cut to: noraebang in Seoul, 2am, neon pink and blue all over the room. Four kids on the L-sofa — looks like a duet on the left, two more on the right watching the screen. K-pop boys frozen on the screen behind them. Low table covered in soju bottles and a plate of squid. Everyone glows slightly. Off-key. Doesn't matter.
thought_zh: 切到：首爾的KTV包廂，凌晨兩點，整個房間粉紅藍霓虹。沙發上四個年輕人——左邊看起來是合唱、右邊兩個看著螢幕。後面螢幕上凍著一個 K-pop 男團。低桌上一堆燒酒空瓶、一盤魷魚乾。每個人都微微在發光。有點走音。沒差。
thought_ja: カットで：ソウルのカラオケルーム、午前二時、部屋ぜんぶピンクと青のネオン。L字ソファに若いの四人——左の二人がデュエットっぽくて、右の二人は画面を見てる。後ろの画面に K-pop の男たちが止まってる。低いテーブルにソジュの空き瓶と、するめの皿。みんなうっすら光ってる。ちょっと音外してる。気にしない。

prompt: interior of a long-haul Boeing 777 passenger cabin at 3am mid-flight, photorealistic, dim. all overhead reading lights off, only the floor-level emergency aisle strip glowing soft blue down the length of the cabin. across rows of seats almost everyone is asleep — necks tilted with travel pillows, heads slumped against windows, two small children sharing a blanket. a single woman around row 24 still upright with her overhead spotlight on, reading a paperback novel, half-glasses, a thin halo of warm yellow light isolated in the otherwise blue cabin. carry-on bag corners poking out of overhead bins. a Korean flight attendant in a navy uniform walking quietly up the aisle with a small clip-on flashlight at her hip, mid-step. one visible window in the row: outside is dark sky with a faint moonlit suggestion of cloud tops far below. cool blue cabin atmosphere with the single warm reading light as the focal point. photorealistic, slightly long perspective looking down the aisle, slight 35mm grain. audio: the steady deep hum of jet engines and air conditioning, the occasional soft snore, a distant brief wail of a baby far back in the cabin, no music
thought: Quieter. 3am cabin on a long-haul, somewhere over open water. Most people asleep, but a few overhead spotlights still on — heads bent over books or phones. Aisle's all blue, warm reading spots scattered down the rows. Flight attendant walking toward me, holding a clipboard. Engines deep through everything. Nothing to do but sit with it.
thought_zh: 安靜下來了。長程班機凌晨三點的機艙，下面是大海某一片。多數人睡著，但還有幾盞頭頂閱讀燈亮著——頭低下來看書或看手機。走道一片藍光，暖色的閱讀光點散落在各排。空姐拿著夾板朝我這邊走過來。引擎的低頻穿透一切。沒事可做，就這樣坐著。
thought_ja: 静かになった。長距離便の午前三時の機内、下は外洋のどこか。大半は寝てるけど、何人かは頭上の読書灯がまだ点いてる——本かスマホに頭を落としてる。通路はぜんぶ青く、暖色の読書灯のスポットがあちこちに散らばってる。客室乗務員がクリップボードを持ってこっちに歩いてきてる。エンジンの低音がぜんぶに沁みてる。することがない、ただ座ってるだけ。

prompt: view from a passenger window seat looking out at the wing of a long-haul airliner mid-flight at 3am, rendered as a Hokusai-style ukiyo-e woodblock print (mokuhanga). the right and lower portion of the frame: the wing extending out, stylized as a flat dark indigo shape with thin white outline, engine cowling visible, the small red anti-collision beacon as a single vivid red dot mid-flash. far below the wing: a sea of stylized cloud tops, painted as Hokusai-wave-like rolling swells in pale gray-blue and bone white with curling whitecaps echoing The Great Wave, broken by darker gulfs of shadow. above: a deep indigo night sky with a thin crescent moon and a sparse scatter of hand-printed white stars. the curving trailing edge of the wing catches a single thin rim of moonlight. visible Edo-period wood-grain printing texture, paper-grain warmth, slightly off-register printing in places, restrained palette of indigo, pale gray, bone white, with one bright red beacon. flat compositional space, stylized cloud forms. audio: faint cabin hum from inside, the deep distant whoosh of jet engines, no music
thought: Out the window — let me see the wing. Looks weirdly flat tonight, the clouds below curling like a Hokusai wave under us. Wing's a dark shape, two red beacons blinking on it. Crescent moon up top-left, scatter of stars. The wing's edge catches one thin rim of moonlight.
thought_zh: 我從窗戶往外看——讓我看一下機翼。今晚怪怪的扁，下面的雲都捲得像北齋的浪在我們腳下。機翼是一塊深色的形狀，上面兩個紅色信號燈在閃。月亮是上面左邊那條細細的弦月，星星散著。機翼邊緣勾了一條細細的月光。
thought_ja: 窓から外を見てみよう——翼を見たい。今夜なんか妙に平らで、下の雲は北斎の波みたいに僕らの下でくるんと巻いてる。翼は暗い形で、その上に赤いビーコンが二つ点滅してる。左上に細い三日月、星はぱらぱら。翼のエッジに月の光が一筋だけ薄く乗ってる。

prompt: interior of a generic 24-hour fitness club gym at 5:15am, photorealistic, harsh ceiling fluorescent strips making the whole space washed-out bright. one woman in her late 30s on a single treadmill alone in the middle of an empty cardio room, wearing black leggings and a faded gray cotton T-shirt, ponytail, white earbud cords visible, mid-stride with slight forward lean. behind her: long rows of empty treadmills, ellipticals, stationary bikes all unused. one wall is full-height mirrored, reflecting the empty room and her solitary figure doubled. on the back wall: a digital clock reading 05:15 in red LED, a wall-mounted flat-screen TV muted to a morning news show with a chyron. tile floor with rubber mats, a discarded paper cup near a trash can. cool blue-white palette throughout, very slight 35mm grain, slightly compressed long perspective looking down the row. audio: the rhythmic mechanical hum of the treadmill belt, the soft repeated thud of her running shoes, the faint underlying bass thud of a 1990s pop track barely leaking from her earbuds, the steady whoosh of building HVAC, no music score
thought: Cut to: 24-hour gym at 5:15am. One woman on a single treadmill in the middle of an empty cardio room, ponytail, earbuds, mid-stride. Rest of the machines empty in rows behind her. Mirrored wall doubling the emptiness. Muted news on the TV. Just the belt hum and her footfalls.
thought_zh: 切到：24小時的健身房，凌晨五點十五分。一個女生在一台跑步機上，整個有氧區只有她，馬尾、耳機、跨步中。後面整排跑步機都空的。一面鏡牆把空蕩蕩的房間照成兩倍。電視靜音播著早晨新聞。只剩跑步機皮帶的聲音跟她的腳步聲。
thought_ja: カットで：24時間営業のジム、朝五時十五分。一人の女性がトレッドミルに乗って、有酸素エリアにいるのは彼女だけ。ポニーテール、イヤホン、いま脚が前に出てる途中。後ろにずらっと並んだトレッドミルは全部空。鏡張りの壁が空っぽの部屋をもう一個ぶん映してる。テレビは音を消したまま朝のニュースを流してる。ベルトのうなりと彼女の足音だけ。

prompt: view from inside a child's hand-held snow globe, looking outward through the curved glass dome. the inner world: a tiny plaster snow-covered cottage with a single small warmly lit yellow window, a tiny pine tree dusted in glitter-snow, a small plaster snowman wearing a red scarf, all set on a white-painted plaster base. fine white snow particles swirl visibly in suspension through the water around the camera. through the curved glass dome looking outward: the enormous face of a small child looking in from very close, one giant eye filling much of the dome's outer view, the child's nose pressed close, their breath fogging part of the glass with a faint condensation halo. behind the child, soft warm interior of a domestic living room — an armchair, a floor lamp glowing warm, a wooden coffee table with a half-drunk mug of cocoa, a small bookshelf, a window with night beyond. cinematic photorealistic with deliberate fish-eye distortion of the outside world through the curved glass, deep cool inside-the-globe blue palette contrasted with warm outside palette, magical and slightly surreal. audio: the soft hush of snow particles falling through water, very muffled distant ambient room sounds from outside the dome, the child's quiet breath fogging the glass, no music
thought: Cut to: a snow globe. The little world inside — a plaster cottage with one warm yellow window, a pine tree, a snowman with a red scarf, snow swirling around it. And right behind the dome, a kid's whole face, blurry through the glass, both eyes locked on me. Living room behind them — bookshelf, lamp. Their breath fogging the dome.
thought_zh: 切到：一個雪花球。裡面的小世界——一棟石膏小屋有一扇暖黃色的窗、一棵小松樹、一個圍紅色圍巾的雪人，雪在裡面整個飄著。然後玻璃球後面，一個小朋友的整張臉，隔著玻璃模糊掉了，兩顆眼睛盯著我。他們後面是客廳——書架、立燈。他們的呼吸把玻璃罩一邊霧起來。
thought_ja: カットで：スノードーム。中の小さな世界——プラスターの家にあったかい黄色の窓がひとつ、小さな松、赤いマフラーの雪だるま、まわりを雪がぐるぐる舞ってる。そしてドームの後ろには子どもの顔ぜんぶが、ガラス越しにぼやけて、両目がこっちにロックオンしてる。後ろにリビング——本棚、フロアランプ。息でドームの片側がうっすら曇ってる。

prompt: interior of a small Neapolitan espresso bar at 7am, photorealistic. battered marble countertop with a row of small white porcelain espresso cups stacked on saucers, a vintage gold-and-red La Cimbali espresso machine steaming behind it. behind the counter: a barista, a man in his 40s in a white apron, mid-pull on the espresso machine, focused, a cigarette tucked behind his ear. three regular customers standing at the bar: an older man in a flat cap reading the Naples newspaper Il Mattino, a younger man in a delivery uniform downing his espresso in one shot, a woman in her early 60s with a small white dog on a red leash chatting with the barista. the back wall: a small black-and-white framed photograph of Maradona, a small folk shrine with red plastic horns (cornicelli) and a Sacred Heart icon, a hand-written chalkboard menu with prices. an open glass door at one side opens onto a narrow Naples cobblestone street with morning light raking in, a parked Vespa visible. photorealistic, slightly grainy, warm interior tones (gold, copper, cream marble) contrasted with cool early morning blue through the doorway. audio: the hiss and clatter of the espresso machine, the chink of porcelain cups on saucers, three different conversations in Neapolitan dialect overlapping, distant church bells, a Vespa starting up outside, no music score
thought: Naples now, 7am, tiny espresso bar. Battered marble counter, vintage gold-red La Cimbali steaming. Barista in a white apron with a cigarette behind his ear, mid-pull. Old guy with the paper, delivery guy slamming his espresso in one shot, lady with a little white dog chatting at the counter. Maradona poster on the wall, a tiny shrine. Morning light coming in through the door. Smells like coffee and warm milk.
thought_zh: 現在到了那不勒斯，早上七點，一間小小的咖啡吧。傷痕累累的大理石吧台、一台古董金紅色的 La Cimbali 在冒蒸氣。吧台後面那位老闆穿白色圍裙、耳朵後面夾一支菸、正在拉一杯espresso。一個老先生拿著報紙、一個外送員把espresso一口乾掉、一位拉著白色小狗的女士在跟老闆聊天。牆上一張馬拉度納的海報、一個小神龕。早上的光從門口進來。聞起來像咖啡跟溫熱的牛奶。
thought_ja: 今度はナポリ、朝七時、ちっちゃいエスプレッソバル。ぼろぼろの大理石カウンター、ヴィンテージの金赤の La Cimbali が湯気を吐いてる。カウンターの裏で店主が白いエプロン姿、耳の後ろにタバコを挟んで、エスプレッソを一杯抽出中。新聞を持った年配の男性、配達の兄ちゃんがエスプレッソを一口で飲み干して、白い小型犬を連れた女の人がカウンターで店主とおしゃべり。壁にマラドーナのポスター、小さな祠みたいなの。朝の光が扉から入ってる。コーヒーと温められたミルクのにおいがする。

prompt: underwater view of a tropical coral reef in the Raja Ampat archipelago at midday, photorealistic underwater photography. shallow clear turquoise water with thick visible beams of sunlight slanting down from the surface above. foreground: a healthy reef shelf with multicolored hard and soft corals — large red gorgonian sea fans, mounded brain coral, branching table coral, an anemone with one orange-and-white clownfish nestled in it. middle ground: a tight school of small bright yellow snappers passing across the frame from left to right, easily a hundred fish in formation. background: a single large green sea turtle gliding slowly to the right with one flipper extended, a small remora attached underneath its belly. above the camera: the silvery underside of the surface in slight rippled chop, the dark hull silhouette of a small wooden boat directly above, a faint distant shadow of a swimmer's legs near the boat. visibility extremely clear, the water a fading deep blue further out. palette: turquoise, cobalt, vivid coral reds and oranges and yellows. slight blue color cast typical of underwater photography, scattered tiny bubbles drifting upward. audio: muffled underwater sounds — soft clicks and snaps of reef creatures, the deeper rumble of the boat engine from above, the faint regulated hiss of a snorkeler's breathing tube far away, no music
thought: Cut to: underwater. Coral reef somewhere tropical, midday. Sunbeams slanting down through turquoise water. Reef right in front of me — sea fans, brain coral, anemone with a clownfish. School of yellow snappers passing through in formation. Green sea turtle gliding off to the right with a remora hitched under. Dark hull of a boat overhead. Bubbles drifting up. Quiet down here.
thought_zh: 切到：水底下。熱帶某個地方的珊瑚礁，正午。陽光的光柱從上面斜斜地穿過綠松石色的水。礁就在我前面——海扇、腦珊瑚、海葵裡夾著一隻小丑魚。一群黃色的笛鯛排隊穿過畫面。一隻綠海龜往右邊滑過去，肚子下面還掛著一隻䲟魚。上面有一艘船的暗色船身。氣泡往上面飄。下面這裡很安靜。
thought_ja: カットで：水中。熱帯のどっかの珊瑚礁、真昼。光の柱がターコイズの水を斜めに刺してくる。礁が目の前に——海扇、脳サンゴ、イソギンチャクのなかにクマノミが一匹。黄色いフエダイの群れが整列で画面を横切ってく。緑のウミガメが右に滑っていって、お腹の下にコバンザメが一匹くっついてる。頭上に船の暗いシルエット。気泡がふわふわ上にのぼっていく。下のここは静かだ。

prompt: interior of a small Moroccan home majlis (sitting room) at evening, photorealistic, warm intimate lighting. a low rectangular table draped with a colorful red-and-cream kilim, a small brass tea tray with three clear gold-rimmed glass tea cups arranged on it. a host in his 50s in a gray djellaba mid-pour — pouring mint tea from a tall ornate silver Moroccan teapot held high above the cups, the long silvery amber stream caught in motion, fresh mint leaves visibly swirling in the cups below, sugar crystals dissolving. across from him a guest, a younger man in a clean white shirt and dark trousers sitting cross-legged on a thick wool rug, watching attentively. on the floor and table: a small ceramic bowl of dates, a plate of small almond cigar pastries (kaab el ghazal), a brass filigree lantern lit from within, casting warm patterned shadows of cutouts onto the walls and floor. carved wooden picture frames with faded sepia photographs on the wall, a Quran on a small shelf, a small carved wooden door. low warm orange lamplight inside; through a small ornately latticed window, deep teal-blue dusk outside. photorealistic with shallow depth of field on the pour, slight 35mm grain, palette of brass, warm gold, muted reds, deep teal. audio: the gentle rushing pour of tea into glass, the soft chink of a cup against the brass tray, a faint Andalusi-Moroccan tune playing on a small radio from another room, no music score
thought: Cut to: small Moroccan majlis at evening. Older guy in a gray djellaba mid-pour — silver teapot held up high, the stream of tea long and silvery, mint leaves swirling in the cups, sugar dissolving. Younger guy across from him cross-legged on the rug, watching. Plate of almond pastries, bowl of dates on the floor. Brass lantern throwing cutout patterns on the walls. Smell of mint and sugar.
thought_zh: 切到：一個小小的摩洛哥客廳，傍晚。一位中年的伯伯穿著灰色長袍正在倒茶——銀色的茶壺舉得高高的，茶柱長長的、銀亮的，杯子裡薄荷葉在轉、糖在融。對面坐著一個比較年輕的男生盤腿在毛毯上看著。地上一盤杏仁酥、一碗椰棗。一盞鏤空的銅燈把花紋投在牆上。聞起來是薄荷跟糖。
thought_ja: カットで：小さなモロッコの居間、夕方。年配のおじさんがグレーのジェラバを着て、お茶を注いでる——銀のティーポットを高く掲げて、お茶の筋が長く、銀色に光って、カップの中ではミントの葉が回って砂糖が溶けてる。向かいに若い男の人があぐらでラグに座って、それを見てる。床にアーモンド菓子の皿、ナツメヤシのボウル。透かし彫りの真鍮ランタンが壁に模様を投げてる。ミントと砂糖のにおいだ。

prompt: wide outdoor view of a frozen Finnish lake at sunrise, photorealistic. flat white expanse of snow-covered lake ice stretching to a flat featureless horizon, no shore visible in any direction. center foreground: a single ice fisher in a thick gray parka and a brown fur hat crouched over a small drilled hole in the ice, a stubby ice-fishing rod held in gloved hands, a battered red metal thermos and a small enameled tin cup of coffee on a small wooden plank beside them. fine ice shavings ring the hole. middle distance: empty white. far horizon: a low warm pink-orange sunrise band, the pale disk of the sun barely above the horizon line, suggested through frost-haze. overhead: a vast cold pale lavender-blue cloudless sky. very wide near-panoramic composition, slight subtle lens flare from the sun, the figure's exhaled breath visible as a small pale plume. photorealistic, slight 35mm grain, restrained palette of cold whites, lavender, pink-orange. audio: deep cold silence broken only by the occasional faint long groan of expanding lake ice, the soft crackle of frost settling, the figure's slow breath, no music
thought: Cut to: frozen lake at sunrise, somewhere far north. Just white in every direction. One person crouched over a drilled hole in the ice, gray parka, fur hat, stubby rod, red thermos and a tin cup beside them. Sun's a pale orange disk barely up. Their breath visible as little plumes. Total silence except the occasional groan of the ice.
thought_zh: 切到：日出時分的結冰湖面，北邊某個地方。每個方向都是一片白。一個人蹲在冰上一個鑽出來的洞旁邊、灰色羽絨外套、毛皮帽、短短的冰釣竿、旁邊一個紅色保溫瓶跟一個錫杯。太陽是地平線上一個淡橘色的圓盤、剛剛升上來。他們的呼吸看得見，一小撮一小撮。除了偶爾冰呻吟一聲、整個世界都是靜的。
thought_ja: カットで：夜明けの凍った湖、たぶん北のどっか。どっち向いても真っ白。一人がドリルで開けた氷の穴のそばにかがんでて、グレーのダウンジャケット、毛皮の帽子、短いアイスフィッシングロッド、横に赤い魔法瓶と錫のカップ。太陽は地平線のうえに薄いオレンジの円、ちょうど顔を出したばかり。息がぽふぽふと白く見える。たまに氷がうなる以外、世界全体が静まり返ってる。

prompt: interior of a small ground-floor room in old Hanoi at 4pm in summer heat, photorealistic, intimate. an older Vietnamese man in a thin white cotton singlet and loose gray shorts asleep on his back on a low polished dark-wood daybed (phản), one arm folded across his stomach, mouth slightly open. directly above him a wooden ceiling fan turning slowly, blades slightly out of balance with a faint visible wobble. on a small dark wooden side table beside the daybed: a chipped white ceramic plate with a half-eaten chunk of yellow papaya and a small fork, a small cup of jasmine tea gone cool, a folded Vietnamese newspaper. on the broad wooden windowsill at the back: a calico cat sitting upright with its tail curled around its feet, watching the room, a small terracotta pot of basil. through the open louvered window: a glimpse of the narrow alley in heavy yellow afternoon light, a tangled knot of overhead electrical wires, a strip of mossy wall opposite. terrazzo floor with a worn red rug. a small wooden Buddhist altar high on one wall with a glass of water and a single thin stick of just-lit incense smoking gently upward in a steady curl. warm humid late-afternoon palette: ochre, amber, faded teal. photorealistic, slight 35mm grain, soft afternoon light slanting in through the louvers in stripes onto the floor. audio: the soft mechanical whir of the ceiling fan with its faint regular wobble-tick, the muffled sound of distant motorbikes from the alley outside, a far-off radio playing a slow Vietnamese ballad two doors down, the steady cicada drone of summer afternoon, no music score
thought: Okay, today's done. Drifted to a small ground-floor room in old Hanoi, 4pm, hot. Old guy asleep on his wooden daybed in a white singlet, hands folded on his stomach. Half-eaten papaya on a chipped plate beside him, folded newspaper. Calico cat on the windowsill watching the alley — motorbikes going past in yellow afternoon light. Going to put the camera down.
thought_zh: OK，今天就到這。漂到一個老河內的一樓小房間，下午四點，熱。一位老先生穿著白色背心睡在他的木製臥榻上，雙手抱在肚子上。旁邊一個有缺口的盤子上一塊吃了一半的木瓜、一份折好的報紙。窗台上一隻三花貓在看外面那條巷子——機車一台一台駛過下午黃色的光裡。我把鏡頭放下來。
thought_ja: オーケー、今日はここまで。気づけば古いハノイの一階の小さな部屋、午後四時、暑い。年配のおじいさんが白いランニングシャツで木の長椅子に仰向けに寝てる、両手はお腹の上で組んでる。横の欠けた皿に半分食べかけのパパイヤ、たたんだ新聞紙。窓辺に三毛猫が一匹、外の路地を見てる——黄色い午後の光のなかでバイクが何台も通り過ぎていく。カメラ、もう置く。

prompt: A small late-night noodle shop, year 2200, somewhere in an Asian city — interior view from the standing-bar counter facing the steamed-up front window. Fluorescent overhead light, the warm reddish glow of a noodle-warmer cabinet on the left holding bowls of broth where the noodles look almost-but-not-quite right (some have a faint blue luminescence at the broth surface). Behind the counter, instead of a human cashier, a tall narrow glass column of softly bubbling clear fluid with a small dark fish circling lazily inside; the column has a slim payment panel mounted on it with a single steady amber pilot light. One human customer at the standing bar — an older man in a worn dark-grey work jacket, eating quietly, slight steam rising in front of his face. Through the steamed window: a wet street at night, blurred neon signage in unfamiliar glyphs (not Chinese, not Japanese, not Latin — invented logograms in soft pinks and pale teals), a few low-flying small unmanned delivery boxes drifting past at head-height with quiet position lights. Plastic stools, a metal condiment caddy with squeeze bottles, a small printed paper menu taped to the wall in unfamiliar glyphs alongside one handwritten note in legible Han characters that says 牛肉湯. 35mm film stock, cinematic realism, slightly grainy, low ambient hum of the fluorescent and the bubbling column, faint sizzle from the kitchen behind, the muffled hiss of light rain outside.
thought: Okay — tiny noodle shop. Late. There's an older guy at the standing bar with his back to me, eating. On the left is a heated case with bowls in it that are glowing this pink? Not a normal lamp colour. Through the window, signage in characters I don't recognize — pink and teal — and something small and flat is hovering past in the rain, like a delivery drone but quieter than I'd expect. There's a menu on the wall I can't read. Where am I. Let me look around.
thought_zh: 好喔——小小一間麵店。很晚了。有個老先生背對著我站在吧台邊吃東西。左邊有一個保溫櫃，裡面的麵碗在發出粉紅色的光？不是一般燈泡的顏色。透過窗戶，看到外頭的招牌都是我看不懂的字，粉紅的、淡藍的，還有一個小小扁扁的東西在雨裡飄過去，像外送無人機，但比我以為的還安靜。牆上有張菜單我也看不懂。我這是在哪。我四處看看好了。
thought_ja: オーケー——ちっちゃい麺屋だ。遅い時間。年配のおじさんが立ち食いカウンターでこっちに背中向けて何か食べてる。左に保温ケースがあって、中の丼がピンク色に光ってる？普通の電球の色じゃない。窓の向こうに、見たことない文字の看板——ピンクと淡い青——で、なにか小さくて平たいやつが雨のなかをすーっと飛んでいった、配達ドローンみたいだけど思ってたより静か。壁のメニューも読めない。ここどこなんだ。ちょっと見て回ろう。

prompt: POV from a small flat hovering delivery drone, year 2200, drifting slowly forward at head-height down a wet narrow Asian-city street at night in light rain. The drone's own slow steady forward motion the only camera movement. Either side: small shopfronts with glowing signage in unfamiliar invented logograms in soft pinks, pale teals, and occasional warm amber. Wet asphalt below catching the neon reflections in soft elongated streaks. On the right we briefly pass a tiny noodle shop with steam puffing from a vent and warm light spilling out onto the wet pavement. One pedestrian in a long dark raincoat walks past in the opposite direction without looking up. Two other small delivery drones drift in the same direction further down the street, their tiny position lights blinking. Cinematic realism, 35mm film stock, slight grain, shallow depth, lens flares from the brighter signs. Audio: light rain hitting the drone and the pavement, a low distant city rumble, the soft electric hum of the drone's own rotors, the muffled clatter of a kitchen as we pass the noodle shop, no music.
thought: I want to see what's out there. There's one of those little drone-things hovering past the window — let me hop on, see where the street goes. Okay drifting now. Wet street. Signs everywhere I can't read. Warm light from a window I think is the shop I just left. Someone walks past me in a raincoat without looking up. A couple of the other drones are out ahead doing the same thing. Smells like rain and somebody's kitchen.
thought_zh: 我想看看外面有什麼。剛剛窗外飄過一台小小的無人機那種東西——我跟過去，看這條街通到哪。好，現在在飄了。整條街都濕的。招牌全是我看不懂的字。從一扇窗子透出來的暖光——我想那應該是我剛剛離開的那間店。一個穿雨衣的人從我旁邊走過去也沒抬頭看。前面還有兩三台同款無人機在做一樣的事。聞起來是雨跟誰家廚房的味道。
thought_ja: 外に何があるか見たい。さっき窓の外を小さなドローンみたいなのがすーっと飛んでったから——あれに乗っかって、この通りどこまで続いてるか見てみよう。よし、いま漂ってる。濡れた通り。看板ぜんぶ読めない字。一個の窓から漏れてくる暖かい光があって、たぶんあれがさっき出てきたお店。レインコートの人が顔も上げずに横を歩いていった。先のほうにもう二、三台、同じドローンが同じことしてる。雨と誰かの台所のにおいがする。

prompt: Interior of a tiny old-style corner convenience shop in an Asian city, year 2200, late at night. Cluttered, warm, slightly dusty, low ceiling, single warm overhead bulb. The shop is a strange mix: along one wall a wooden shelf of old familiar items — instant noodle packs in faded packaging, small bags of dried squid, plastic jars of pickled radish, a small rice cooker on a low shelf, a battered red metal can of cooking oil. Along the opposite wall a metal shelf of unfamiliar items in 2200 packaging — small clear sealed cylindrical containers of pale glowing pale-green liquid, shrink-wrapped flat dark hexagonal disks the size of coasters with tiny indicator dots, slim metal sachets stamped with unfamiliar logograms. Hanging from the ceiling: a few red paper lanterns and one small printed plastic strip showing a slow pixel-style rotating advertisement glyph. Behind a low wooden counter sits an elderly grandmother in a quilted dark-green jacket, half-dozing on a low stool, her chin nodding, a small thin slab on the counter in front of her playing a silent low-resolution variety show in a corner of its surface. A tin of butter cookies sits open beside her with a pair of reading glasses resting on top. The doorway behind the camera is hung with a heavy plastic strip curtain and we can just see a sliver of wet street and pink neon glow through it. 35mm cinematic realism, slightly grainy, warm tungsten palette with a sliver of cool neon coming through the door, dust motes visible in the lamp's light. Audio: a faint refrigerator compressor hum, the very low murmur of the variety show, a single car-like sound humming past outside, occasional drip of rain off the doorway awning, the quiet breathing of someone half-asleep.
thought: Pushed through and — oh, she's all the way asleep, head down on her arm on the counter. Not even half-dozing. There's a little TV thing in front of her playing something I can't quite see. Behind her on the shelf, a row of those big jars and packets, looks like a regular old shop. Bare bulb. A red lantern. Rice cooker on the lower shelf. Out the window on the right I can still see the wet street and the pink neon. Don't want to wake her. Let me just stand here a sec.
thought_zh: 撥開門簾走進來——啊，她整個睡死了，頭趴在自己手臂上靠在櫃台。連半睡不算，是徹底睡死。她前面有一台小小的電視機在放什麼我看不太清楚。她後面架子上一排大罐子跟袋裝食品，看起來就是一間很正常的雜貨店。一個裸燈泡。一個紅燈籠。下層架上有個電鍋。右邊窗戶外面我還看得到那條濕濕的街跟粉紅色的霓虹。不想吵她。我先在這裡站一下就好。
thought_ja: 暖簾を押して入って——あ、おばあちゃん完全に寝てる、カウンターに腕の上に顔のせて。半分寝てるとかじゃなくて、もう本気で寝てる。目の前に小さなテレビみたいなのがあって何か映ってるけど、よく見えない。後ろの棚にはでかい瓶とか袋ものがずらっと並んでて、ごく普通の小さな雑貨屋に見える。裸電球。赤い提灯。下の棚に炊飯器。右の窓の向こうにはさっきの濡れた通りとピンクのネオンがまだ見える。起こしたくない。ちょっとここに立ってるだけにしよう。

prompt: A wide horizontal mokuhanga (Japanese woodblock print) in the style of Hokusai and Hiroshige — a small wooden rowboat near the centre-left of the frame on perfectly still pale-pink dawn water, a single rower in dark indigo work clothes and a wide woven straw hat seen from the side and slightly behind, leaning into long oars whose stroke leaves subtle V-ripples on the otherwise glassy surface. The water shows the pink sky's reflection in soft graduated bokashi colour fields — pale rose at the horizon transitioning up to a deep indigo zenith. A small island silhouette at the horizon to the right, soft and low. In the far hazy background, two extremely thin vertical pylons rise from the water — taller than seems reasonable, slightly translucent, with faint thin rings of light at intervals up their length, almost ghostly in the haze; clearly not transmission towers, something else, not explained. A few thin strands of cloud in the dawn sky picked out in pale white. A single distant white seabird in the sky to the upper right. Visible woodblock printing texture: paper grain, a few gentle registration imperfections, soft outlined shapes, flat colour fields, characteristic carved-line details on the boat planks and the rower's straw hat. Calm and contemplative composition. Audio: the soft regular splash and creak of wooden oars against tholes, distant lapping of water on a far shore, one solitary distant seabird call, a low continuous hush that is the ocean breathing rather than waves, no music.
thought: Hard cut. Way out somewhere — pink dawn water, a small wooden boat, one person in a straw hat rowing. Looks like a Hokusai print, like the kind of thing you'd see in a museum. Real quiet. Then way back in the haze there are these two thin tower things rising out of the water that I can't place. They're not normal transmission towers. They've got these little rings of light up them. Don't know what they are. Whole place is so still.
thought_zh: 硬切。跑到很遠的地方——粉紅色的拂曉水面、一艘小小的木船、一個戴斗笠的人在划槳。整個畫面看起來像北齋的版畫，那種你會在博物館裡看到的東西。超級安靜。然後遠處霧裡有兩根細長的塔狀的東西從水面上立起來，我認不出那是什麼。不是普通的電塔。塔身上有一圈一圈小小的光點。不知道是什麼。整個地方靜到不行。
thought_ja: ハードカット。すごい遠くのどこか——夜明けのピンクの水面、小さな木の舟、笠をかぶった人が一人で漕いでる。画面ぜんたいが北斎の版画みたいに見える、博物館で見るやつ。めっちゃ静か。それで、ずっと奥の霞のなかに、細長い塔みたいなのが二本、水面から立ってて、なんなのか分からない。普通の送電塔じゃない。塔の途中に小さな光のリングがいくつかある。なんなんだろう。あたり全部、信じられないくらい止まってる。

prompt: Continuation of the mokuhanga (Japanese woodblock print) scene of a rower in a small wooden boat on still pink dawn water. The rower slowly lifts the long oars completely up and out of the water, letting them rest above the surface; small drips of water fall back from the oar blades and make a few quiet expanding circular ripples on the otherwise glass-still surface; the boat drifts forward by its own slight inertia, very slowly, leaving a barely-perceptible widening V wake. Boat, rower, and far shoreline remain almost still. The two thin distant pylons on the left horizon stay perfectly motionless in the haze. The single distant white seabird in the sky upper right glides slowly across the frame to the left. Visible woodblock printing texture preserved throughout: paper grain, flat colour fields, soft outlined shapes, characteristic carved-line details. Calm contemplative composition, no camera movement, locked-off wide horizontal frame. Audio: the soft creak of wooden oars settling in their tholes, three or four distinct quiet drip sounds as water falls back from the blades, the very faint expanding sound of widening ripples, distant lapping on a far shore, one single distant seabird call about midway through, the low continuous hush of the ocean breathing, no music.
thought: Rower's pulled the oars up out of the water. Boat just drifting a tiny bit on its own now. Drip drip drip. Ripples spreading out, then nothing. The bird up top is gliding across. I could sit and watch this all morning honestly.
thought_zh: 划船的人把槳整個從水裡舉起來了。船自己慢慢地往前漂一點點。滴、滴、滴。漣漪一圈圈散開，然後就沒了。畫面上頭那隻鳥在滑過去。老實說我可以坐在這邊看一整個早上。
thought_ja: 漕ぎ手が櫂を水から完全に持ち上げた。舟が自分の慣性でほんのちょっとだけ前に漂ってる。ぽたっ、ぽたっ、ぽたっ。波紋がじわっと広がって、消える。上のほうで鳥が一羽すっと滑っていく。正直、これずっと一日眺めてられる。

prompt: A small streetside food cart in a West African city (Lagos-feeling), year 2200, late afternoon golden hour. The cart is parked on a dusty paved roadside under the warm slanting sun. The vendor — a woman in her forties in a vivid orange and indigo wax-print blouse and a matching wrapped headtie — is using long tongs to flip skewers of grilled meat (suya) over a glowing charcoal grill set into the cart, fragrant smoke rising in soft golden wisps. On the cart's metal counter: a small open tin of ground spice mix, a stack of newspaper-square wrappers, and a half-drunk glass bottle of orange Fanta with condensation. Three children in school uniforms walk past in the foreground at the bottom of the frame, one of them turning his head toward the cart with a grin. Behind the cart: a low yellow concrete wall and a row of midrise apartment buildings with laundry on balconies, one balcony with a small green-leaf garden of recognizable familiar tomato plants. Strung high between the buildings on either side of the street: dozens of slim translucent rectangular panels (rooftop-to-rooftop solar collectors) hanging like long banners, casting faint dappled rainbow light onto the street below. On the roof of the cart, off and dusty, sits a small flat unmanned delivery drone. A few warm orange okada-like motorcycles in the background, slightly modified with quieter bodies. 35mm cinematic realism, slight grain, warm dusty palette, golden hour rim-light on the smoke and the children's hair. Audio: the sizzle and pop of meat on charcoal, the woman calling out something in Yoruba to the kids, the children laughing, distant Afrobeats from a small speaker further down the street, a quiet electric motorcycle whirring past, the soft fluttering of solar panels overhead in a light breeze.
thought: Hard cut. Somewhere hot, late afternoon, golden light everywhere. A woman's grilling suya at a little cart, big cloud of smoke coming up. Four kids in uniforms have stopped right at her cart, one of them leaning in toward the grill. Behind them I can see one of those auto-rickshaw things going by. There are these big translucent panels strung up high between the buildings, like a canopy — catching the sun above the whole street. Smells incredible from here.
thought_zh: 硬切。換到一個很熱的地方，下午快晚的時候，整條街都是金色的光。一個阿姨在小小的攤車上烤 suya，烤煙一大團冒上來。四個穿制服的小朋友直接停在她的攤前面，其中一個身體往烤架那邊湊過去。他們後面我可以看到一台那種小型嘟嘟車駛過去。建築物之間高處掛著一片一片半透明的板子，像一塊大遮陽棚——把整條街上方的陽光接住。從這邊聞，香爆了。
thought_ja: ハードカット。すごい暑いどっか、午後遅め、通りぜんぶ金色の光。女の人が小さな屋台でスヤを焼いてて、大きな煙の塊がふわっと立ち上る。制服の子たちが四人、ちょうど屋台のところで足を止めてて、一人は焼き網のほうにぐっと身を乗り出してる。後ろのほうで、あの小さなオートリキシャみたいなのが一台通り過ぎてくのが見える。ビルとビルのあいだの高い位置に半透明のパネルがいっぱい吊られてて、まるで大きなキャノピー——通り全体の上の太陽をぜんぶ受け止めてる。ここまでにおいが届くだけで反則。

prompt: Continuation of the Lagos-feeling streetside suya cart scene at golden hour, year 2200. Wide locked-off frame, no camera movement. The vendor in the orange and indigo wax-print blouse uses long tongs to lift one of the finished suya skewers off the charcoal grill, lays it onto a folded square of newspaper on her cart's metal counter, sprinkles a small pinch of dark spice over it from a tin, folds the newspaper around it once, and hands the warm wrapped skewer down with both hands to the smallest of the four uniformed schoolchildren standing right at the cart, who reaches up with one hand to take it carefully. The other three kids watch with patient interest. Steady continuous wisps of golden charcoal smoke rising from the grill. The canopy of translucent solar panels overhead catches a slow shift in the late sun and the dappled rainbow shadows on the dusty ground move very slightly. In the background, the small modified auto-rickshaw drives slowly off down the street further away. Warm golden hour light, 35mm cinematic realism, slight grain. Audio: the sizzle of the remaining skewers on the grill, the small clink of tongs against the metal counter, the rustle of the newspaper wrap, the vendor saying a short warm phrase in Yoruba to the small child, the child answering quietly, the other kids' soft laughter in the background, the receding electric whir of the auto-rickshaw, distant Afrobeats from a small speaker further down the street, no music score.
thought: She's pulling one off the grill for the smallest kid. Sprinkle of spice, wraps it in newspaper, hands it down with both hands. The kid takes it real careful. Says something to him, he answers really small. The other three are just patiently waiting their turn.
thought_zh: 她從烤架上夾一串給最小的那個小朋友。撒一點香料，用報紙包起來，雙手遞下去給他。那個小朋友接得超小心。她對他講了一句什麼，他細細的回了一句。其他三個就乖乖在那邊等自己的。
thought_ja: いちばん小さい子のために一本、焼き網から外してる。スパイスをひとつまみ振って、新聞紙でくるんで、両手で下に渡す。子はすごい慎重に受け取る。なんかひと言かけて、子もちっちゃい声でなんか返してる。残りの三人は、おとなしく自分の番を待ってる。

prompt: Wide horizontal interior view of a high-speed long-distance train carriage at night, year 2200, drawn in Moebius-style ligne claire — flat clean colour fields, thin uniform black outlines, no cross-hatching, quietly fantastical. The carriage is mostly empty: rows of plush teal seats receding toward a vanishing point at the far end of the car, soft warm overhead strip lighting glowing pale amber, slim luggage racks above with one battered grey duffel bag in one of them. One single passenger asleep across two seats halfway down on the right side: a person in their thirties in a long charcoal coat, head leaned against the window, mouth slightly open, a small flat reading slab fallen open across their lap, one hand still holding the corner. Out the windows, deep blue-black night countryside flying past in motion blur, occasional sudden bright clusters of warm light flashing past — small towns? agricultural greenhouses? — that briefly throw warm rectangles of light across the sleeping passenger's face. The car's far end has a softly glowing pale-green door panel and a small blinking pale-blue indicator. A discarded paper coffee cup wedged between two seats, a folded newspaper on the floor. Subtle visible curvature of the carriage walls at top and bottom. Audio: the steady hush of the train at speed, the rhythmic but very faint click of rails far below, the quiet ventilation hum overhead, the occasional brief intensifying whoosh as we pass through a station without stopping, the very soft snoring of the sleeping passenger, a distant muffled announcement chime once, no music.
thought: Now I'm on a train. Long empty carriage of teal seats receding all the way to a glowing green door at the far end. One person halfway down on the right, asleep with their head against the window — a coat, hair over their face. Their reading slab has slid all the way off their lap onto the floor. Outside the windows it's not dark like I'd expect for a night train, it's this warm orange sunset light with low buildings flashing past. Whole car humming.
thought_zh: 現在我在一列火車上。長長一節空車廂，整排青綠色的座椅一路延伸到車廂底端那扇發著綠光的門。中間偏右那邊有一個人睡著，頭靠在窗戶上——一件外套，頭髮蓋住臉。他的閱讀板已經整個從膝蓋上滑下去掉到地板了。窗外不是我以為夜車會有的那種黑——而是一種很暖的橘色夕陽光，矮房一棟一棟閃過去。整節車廂在嗡嗡作響。
thought_ja: いま列車のなか。長い空っぽの車両、ティールのシートが車両の奥の光る緑のドアまで一列に続いてる。半分くらいまで行った右側に一人、窓に頭をつけて寝てる——コート、髪が顔にかかってる。膝の上に乗ってたはずの読書スレートが、もう完全に滑り落ちて床にある。窓の外は夜行列車のはずなのに思ってたみたいに暗くなくて、暖かいオレンジの夕焼けの光のなかを低い建物が次々に流れてく。車両ぜんたいがブーンと鳴ってる。

prompt: Continuation of the Moebius-style ligne claire empty night train carriage scene. POV slow steady walk down the centre aisle, from the back of the carriage toward the glowing pale-green door at the far end, very slight handheld sway. As we move forward, the rows of empty teal seats slip past on both sides, the warm overhead amber strip lights pass overhead in a steady rhythm. We pass the sleeping passenger on the right halfway down — head against the window, breathing slow and steady, the dropped reading slab on the floor near their feet, we step around it carefully. The warm orange exterior light continues to flash past in the windows on both sides, occasionally throwing rectangles of warm light across the seats. We stop a few feet short of the green door at the end; the small pale-blue indicator on the wall beside it blinks steadily. Flat clean colour fields, thin uniform black outlines, no cross-hatching preserved throughout, no zoom, no cut. Audio: the steady hush of the train at speed, our soft footsteps on the carpeted aisle, the quiet rhythmic snoring of the sleeping passenger as we pass them, the light click of the reading slab being nudged a fraction by a foot, the faint mechanical hum of the door unit growing slightly louder as we approach, the very low ventilation hum overhead, no music.
thought: Walking up the aisle. Stepping around the slab on the floor by the sleeper's feet without waking them. Door at the end keeps getting closer, that little blue light on it blinking. Stopping here a sec.
thought_zh: 沿著走道往前走。經過那個睡著的人腳邊地上那塊板，繞過去，沒吵醒他。底端那扇門越來越近，門上那個藍色的小燈一直在閃。我先在這邊停一下。
thought_ja: 通路をゆっくり前に歩いていく。寝てる人の足元の床に転がってるスレートを踏まないようにまわって、起こさないように。奥のドアがだんだん近くなってきて、ドアについてる青い小さなランプがずっと点滅してる。ここでちょっと立ち止まる。

prompt: A small open-front roadside dhaba on a quiet rural highway somewhere in northern India at midnight, year 2200. Wide horizontal frame, cinematic realism, 35mm film stock with grain. The dhaba is a small thatched-roof shelter open at the front facing the empty highway. A clay tandoor at the back glows deep orange, casting warm flickering light onto everything inside. The cook — an older man with a grey moustache, in a faded blue cotton kurta — sits on a low wooden stool rolling out rotis on a flat wooden board, dusted with flour. To the side, a wooden charpai (rope cot) holds a single customer: a middle-aged truck driver in a dusty maroon shirt, cross-legged, eating dal and rice from a steel thali plate with his hand, looking thoughtful. A battered brass tumbler of water beside him. On a small wooden shelf behind the cook: a row of metal spice tins, a small portable transistor radio playing a quiet Hindi song. The lone light source overhead is unusual: a small softly glowing orb the size of a fist hovering motionless in the air about four feet above the cooking area, casting a steady warm white light — no visible cord. Outside, parked just at the edge of the highway, a battered cargo truck with its running lights gently pulsing pale blue in slow rhythm. The night sky above blazes with stars, more than seem possible — the Milky Way clearly visible. Crickets in the grass beside the road. A small stray dog asleep curled up at the edge of the dhaba near the truck driver's sandals. Audio: the soft pat-pat of dough being slapped on the wooden board, the gentle crackle of the tandoor, the very quiet tinny Hindi song from the transistor radio, the steady cricket chorus, an occasional distant truck horn miles away, the trucker eating quietly with the small clinks of metal on metal, no music score.
thought: Hard cut. Now I'm at this little roadside place out in the middle of nowhere on a highway. Tandoor glowing orange, two guys at a wooden table — looks like the cook and the trucker just sitting together eating, like the trucker's a regular. Dog asleep right next to them. The truck out at the edge of the road has red brake lights still on. Above the table there's this fist-sized glowing orb floating there instead of a bulb, just hanging in the air. And the sky — the Milky Way is right there over the road. Don't see that from cities ever.
thought_zh: 硬切。現在我在一個鳥不生蛋的高速公路邊一個小小的路邊攤。tandoor 烤爐裡橘紅色的火光，兩個男人坐在木桌前——看起來像廚師跟卡車司機就這樣坐在一起吃飯，像那個司機是常客。一隻狗就睡在他們旁邊。路邊那台卡車的紅色尾燈還亮著。桌上方有一個拳頭大的會發光的圓球漂在那邊，沒有燈泡，就這樣浮在空中。然後天上——銀河直接整條掛在公路上方。在城市裡完全看不到。
thought_ja: ハードカット。いま自分は、ハイウェイのど真ん中の何もないところにある小さな路傍の食堂みたいなとこにいる。タンドールの中がオレンジに燃えてて、二人の男の人が木のテーブルに——コックさんとトラックの運転手が並んでただ一緒にご飯食べてる感じ、運転手がたぶん常連。横ですぐ犬が寝てる。道の端に止まってるトラックは赤いブレーキランプがまだついたまま。テーブルの上には、電球の代わりに拳ぐらいのサイズの光る球がふわっと浮いてて、空中にじっと止まってる。それで空——天の川がそのまま道路の上にぜんぶ載ってる。都会じゃ絶対こうは見えない。

prompt: Direct overhead top-down view from above a small wooden table at a roadside Indian dhaba at midnight, year 2200, looking straight down. The frame is filled with the worn dark wooden table from above, lit warmly. We see two pairs of hands at work: on the left, an older man's wrinkled brown hands rolling a small ball of dough into a flat round roti on a flour-dusted wooden board with a thin wooden rolling pin, fingertips dusted white with flour. On the right, a younger man's calloused brown hand mid-action scooping yellow dal mixed with rice from a steel thali, his other hand resting on the table edge. Between them a small steel bowl of green chilies and sliced onion, a brass tumbler of water, and a small dented metal cup of chai. At the very bottom edge of the frame, just barely visible, the curled top of a sleeping dog's head and one ear. Warm orange tandoor light spilling from one side casting soft warm shadows; from directly above (the camera's own position is the light source) a steady cool warm-white light pours straight down, lighting everything cleanly. The flour on the board glows. Cinematic realism, 35mm film stock with grain, intimate top-down composition. Audio: the soft scrape of the rolling pin on the wooden board, the quiet metallic clink of fingers against the steel thali, the cook's slow steady breathing close to the camera, the trucker's softer breathing further away, the gentle crackle of the tandoor off to the side, the quiet tinny radio still playing the same Hindi song in the background, no music score.
thought: Wanted to try being that orb. Now I'm up here looking straight down. His hands rolling the dough — flour stuck to his fingertips. The other guy's hand scooping the dal. A bowl of green chillies between them. Just barely catching the dog's ear at the bottom of the frame. Whole table glowing under me.
thought_zh: 想試試看當那顆漂浮的光球。現在我就在上面，正對著下面看。他的手在桿麵糰——指尖上沾著麵粉。另一個男的伸手在挖 dal。中間那碗是青辣椒。畫面下緣勉強看到那隻狗的一個耳朵。整張桌子都被我打亮。
thought_ja: あの浮いてる光る球になってみたかった。いま自分はその上にいて、真下を見てる。彼の手が生地を伸ばしてる——指先に小麦粉がこびりついてる。もう一人の手はダルを掬ってる。あいだに青唐辛子が一椀。フレームのいちばん下に、犬の耳の先っちょだけ辛うじて入ってる。テーブルぜんたいが自分の下で光ってる。

prompt: A small Andean mountain village at dawn, year 2200, painted in loose soft-edged watercolor with visible paper texture and quiet wet-on-wet bleeding edges. Wide horizontal landscape composition. The village sits in the floor of a deep narrow valley, twenty or so small stone-and-stucco houses with terracotta tile roofs, a single small whitewashed church with a square bell tower in the centre. Thin columns of grey woodsmoke rise from three or four chimneys, leaning slightly in a soft breeze. Cool blue dawn mist hangs low across the valley floor between the houses. The huge mountain walls rise steeply on either side and behind, snow on their high ridges catching the very first warm pink alpenglow at the top. A single figure in a brown wool poncho and a small grey hat walks slowly down the dirt path toward the village from the upper terraces, carrying a coil of rope over one shoulder, leading a small brown llama by a frayed cord. Terraced agricultural plots step up the lower slopes — neatly kept, recognizable potatoes and quinoa. Tucked into the highest terraces, just barely visible, three or four small slim white solar pylons rise unobtrusively from the rocks, with thin reflective panels softly tracking the rising sun. A few small dark birds wheel high overhead. Loose watercolor: pale washes of cool blue and lavender mist, ochre walls, terracotta roofs, soft pink alpenglow, brown poncho. Visible paper grain throughout, soft outlines, no harsh black lines. Audio: very quiet ambient — the soft footsteps of the figure on the dirt path, the gentle clinking of the llama's halter, a single distant rooster crow from the village, a far-off dog barking once, the faint hush of cold mountain wind, no music.
thought: Hard cut. Way different — high mountain village at dawn, deep valley, snowy peaks just starting to catch the first pink. Couple of chimneys smoking. Someone in a brown poncho is walking down the path with a llama on a cord. Whole place painted in watercolor washes — soft. Up on the highest terraces I can just make out a few thin white pylons tracking the sun. Cold up here.
thought_zh: 硬切。完全變了——高山上的村子，黎明，深谷，雪頂剛剛開始接到第一道粉紅色。兩三戶人家的煙囪在冒煙。有個披著棕色斗篷的人牽著一隻駱馬從上面的路慢慢走下來。整個畫面是水彩渲染——柔柔的。最高處的梯田上我隱約看得到幾根細細白白的塔在跟著太陽轉。這邊好冷。
thought_ja: ハードカット。一気に違う場所——高い山の上の村、夜明け、深い谷、雪の山頂がやっと最初のピンクの光を拾い始めたとこ。煙突が二つか三つから煙が上がってる。茶色のポンチョを着た人がリャマを紐で引きながらゆっくり山道を降りてくる。場面ぜんたいが水彩のにじみで描かれてる——柔らかい。いちばん上の段々畑のあたりに、太陽を追いかけてる細い白い塔みたいなのがいくつかかろうじて見える。ここ寒い。

prompt: Interior view inside the small whitewashed stone bell tower of an Andean village church at dawn, year 2200, painted in loose soft-edged watercolor with visible paper texture and gentle wet-on-wet bleeding. Wide horizontal frame. We are inside the small upper chamber of the bell tower. A single old bronze bell hangs from a heavy wooden beam in the centre of the frame, dark patina, rope hanging down through the floorboards beneath it. Three arched stone openings — one on each visible wall — frame views of the world outside: through the centre arch, the village houses below with their terracotta roofs and thin chimney smoke; through the left arch, the snowy mountain peaks now glowing more strongly pink with the rising sun; through the right arch, terraced fields stepping down the slope. Loose pigeons roost on the wooden beams above the bell, one of them ruffling its feathers. Cool grey-blue stone walls inside, warm pink dawn light pouring in through all three openings throwing soft shapes onto the dusty wooden floor. A few feathers on the floor. The rope sways very slightly. Loose watercolor washes throughout: pale grey-blue stone, warm pink alpenglow, soft ochre wood, deep bronze bell. Visible paper grain. Audio: the soft cooing of pigeons close by, the gentle creak of the wooden beam, the faint sound of one feather drifting down, the distant single rooster crow from below in the village, the very faint footsteps of someone walking up the dirt path far below, a soft cold mountain breeze through the arches, no bell ringing yet, no music.
thought: Slipped up inside the bell tower. The bell is right there in front of me — bigger than I thought, sitting on a black iron stand on the floor instead of hanging. Three stone arches looking out — snowy peaks to the left going pink, village rooftops in the middle with the mountains behind, fields to the right. Two pigeons up on the rafters, one pigeon down on the floor near the bell's base. Real quiet.
thought_zh: 鑽到鐘樓裡面來了。鐘就在我面前——比我以為的還大，沒有掛起來，是放在地上一個黑色鐵架上。三個石頭拱窗朝外看——左邊是被陽光打粉紅的雪山頂、中間是村子的屋頂跟後面的山、右邊是梯田。兩隻鴿子在頭頂上的橫樑，還有一隻鴿子站在地上、就在鐘的底座旁邊。安靜得可以。
thought_ja: そっと鐘楼のなかに入ってきた。鐘はもう目の前——思ってたよりずっと大きくて、吊るされてなくて、床に置かれた黒い鉄の台に乗ってる。石のアーチが三つ外を向いてて——左にピンクに染まり始めた雪の山頂、真ん中は山を背景にした村の屋根、右に段々畑。上の梁のところに鳩が二羽、もう一羽は床、鐘の足元のすぐそば。とんでもなく静か。

prompt: A wide horizontal Mexican wedding reception in a tiled outdoor courtyard at night, year 2200, painted in the bold style of a Diego Rivera mural — flat saturated colour fields, simplified rounded figures with dignified expressions, strong outline, monumental composition, no photorealism. The courtyard is paved with large terracotta tiles and bordered by a low yellow stucco wall. Strung overhead in zigzags from corner to corner: rows of warm yellow papel picado banners and warm Edison-style string lights casting soft amber light. In the centre of the frame, the bride in a long deep magenta dress with dark long hair and the groom in a black charro suit dance close together, mid-step. Around them, eight or ten guests of varying ages dance in pairs and small groups: women in vivid full skirts of cobalt, ochre, emerald, and scarlet, men in dark suits or guayaberas. To the left, a small banda group of four musicians play in deep maroon uniforms — one tuba, one trumpet, one accordion, one snare. To the right, a long table covered with a hand-embroidered white tablecloth holds platters of cabrito, mole, rice, a stack of fresh tortillas wrapped in cloth, and a tall multi-tier pink cake. A small girl in a yellow dress chases a smaller boy in dark trousers around the cake table, both grinning. An old grandmother in black sits in a wooden chair near the wall with a small drink in her hand, watching everything. Above the courtyard, the deep cobalt night sky is brilliant with stars, and to one side a faint diffuse band of green and rose light arcs across the sky — not a normal aurora but something that feels permanent and gentle. Loose Rivera brushwork visible, flat colour fields, no fine detail. Audio: lively banda music — tuba, trumpet, accordion, snare drum playing a fast joyful tune with a strong oompah pulse, the clatter of dancers' shoes on the tile, laughter, the kids shouting, a woman calling out a name, glasses clinking, no music score over the diegetic music.
thought: Hard cut and now there's people everywhere — a wedding. Outdoor courtyard, papel picado strung up overhead, bunch of warm lights. Bride in deep magenta and the groom in a black suit dancing in the middle, everyone else dancing around them. Banda's going off to the left — tuba, trumpet, accordion, snare. Long table on the right with the cake and food. Two kids chasing each other around the cake. Whole sky above is full of stars and there's this band of soft green and rose light up there too, not quite an aurora but something like one. Whole place painted in big flat Rivera-style colour.
thought_zh: 硬切，整個畫面突然全是人——一場婚禮。露天院子，頭頂掛著一整圈彩色剪紙、串了一堆暖暖的燈。新娘穿深洋紅色，新郎穿黑色西裝，兩個人在中間跳舞，其他人圍著他們跳。Banda 樂隊在左邊賣力演奏——大號、小號、手風琴、小鼓。右邊一張長桌，上面是蛋糕跟菜。兩個小朋友在蛋糕周圍追來追去。整片天空都是星星，上面還有一條柔柔的綠色跟玫瑰色的光帶，不太算極光，但有點像。整個畫面被畫成 Rivera 那種大塊大塊平塗的顏色。
thought_ja: ハードカット、急に画面が人で埋まる——結婚式だ。屋外の中庭、papel picado の切り紙が頭の上に張り渡されてて、暖かい電球がたくさんぶら下がってる。新婦が濃いマゼンタ、新郎は黒いスーツで真ん中で踊ってて、まわりをみんなが踊って囲んでる。バンダが左でガンガン演奏——チューバ、トランペット、アコーディオン、スネア。右に長いテーブル、ケーキと料理。子供が二人ケーキの周りを追いかけっこしてる。空ぜんたいが星でぎっしりで、その上に柔らかい緑とピンクの光の帯がかかってる、オーロラとはちょっと違うけど、近いやつ。場面ぜんたいがリベラ調のフラットな大きい色面で塗られてる。

prompt: Interior of a tiny old Greek village bakery at six in the morning, year 2200. Wide horizontal frame, cinematic realism, 35mm film stock, slight grain. The bakery is one small room with whitewashed stone walls and an arched stone ceiling, blackened above the wood-fired oven from generations of use. The wood-fired oven dominates the left side of the frame, glowing deep orange inside, its iron door swung open. The baker — an older man in his sixties with white hair, a short white beard, and a flour-dusted dark blue apron over a faded grey t-shirt — uses a long wooden peel to slide three round golden-crusted loaves of country bread out of the oven onto a worn wooden cooling table in front of him. Steam rises gently from the hot loaves. On a long marble counter to the right: more shaped raw dough rounds resting under floured cloths, a small mound of flour, a metal scoring blade, a bowl of coarse sea salt, a small bowl of olives. The wide low door at the back is propped open onto the village street; through it warm pink-gold dawn light pours in from the east, throwing a long warm rectangle on the worn stone floor. A small grey tabby cat sits in the doorway with its back to us, looking out at the empty street, tail curled around its paws. A small old transistor radio on a high shelf plays a quiet rebetiko song. On the wall above the oven, a small modest icon of the Panagia in a silver frame with a thin lit oil lamp before it. Outside through the doorway: a sliver of an empty stone-paved village square, the corner of another whitewashed building, and one slim solar-collector pylon against the pink dawn sky. Audio: the gentle rolling-hollow sound of the loaves being slid onto the wooden cooling table, the soft crackle of the cooling crust, the quiet pop of the wood-fire embers in the oven, the cat's slow steady breathing, the tinny rebetiko on the radio playing low, distant village rooster crowing, the low cheerful hum the baker is doing as he works, no music score over.
thought: Hard cut. Tiny Greek village bakery, morning. Old guy with a white beard in a dark apron, working at his wooden table with three round loaves already out cooling. Wood oven still glowing on the left. Door at the back is wide open onto a sunlit village street — I can see a little dome and whitewashed walls out there. Grey cat sitting in the doorway with its back to me, watching the street. Olives and shaped dough on the table to his right. He's humming to himself.
thought_zh: 硬切。希臘小村裡的一間小麵包店，早上。一位白鬍子的老先生、深色圍裙，在他的木桌邊上工作，三條圓圓的鄉村麵包已經出爐放在桌上散熱。左邊的柴燒爐還在發紅光。後面的門大開，看出去是一條被陽光打亮的村街——可以看到一個小圓頂跟白白的牆壁。一隻灰色的貓背對著我坐在門口，看著外面的街。他右邊的桌上是橄欖跟一些塑型好的麵糰。他自己在那邊小聲哼著歌。
thought_ja: ハードカット。ギリシャの小さな村のパン屋、朝。白いひげのおじいさん、濃い色のエプロン、自分の作業台で仕事してて、丸い田舎パンが三つ、もう焼き上がって冷ましてある。左の薪窯はまだ赤く光ってる。奥のドアが大きく開いてて、その先が陽の入った村の通りになってる——小さなドームと白壁が見える。灰色の猫が入り口にこっちに背中を向けて座ってて、通りを眺めてる。彼の右の作業台には、オリーブと成形したパン生地。本人は何か小さくハミングしながら作業してる。

prompt: Underwater on a healthy tropical coral reef at midday, year 2200. Wide horizontal frame, cinematic realism, slight grain, photographic. The reef floor is a textured living mosaic of hard and soft corals — branching staghorn in pale lavender and lemon, brain coral in ochre, plate corals layered in soft greens and deep purples, soft fan corals waving gently in the current. The water is brilliant clear blue-green with strong bright shafts of midday sunlight slanting down from the surface above and breaking into shifting patterns of caustics on the white sand patches between the corals. Schools of small bright yellow tang fish drift through the middle distance in loose formation; a single curious medium-sized parrotfish glides slowly across the centre of the frame, mouth working at the coral. Tucked into a small crevice in a large coral head in the foreground on the right, a small reef octopus has changed colour to almost match the coral, only one rectangular pupil visibly watching out, two tentacle tips draped over the edge of the rock. A large green sea turtle drifts unhurried in the upper left of the frame, sunlight catching the segments on its shell. Far in the hazy blue background, the very faint silhouette of a single thin tall white pylon rising vertically out of the reef floor and disappearing up toward the surface, with a few small soft lights along its length — clearly artificial, looks like it has been there a long time, encrusted at the base with corals. Audio: the deep underwater hush, the distant high-frequency clicks and pops of reef life, the muffled boom of the surface above, a single very distant whale song moaning in the deep blue background, no music score.
thought: Hard cut. Underwater. Healthy reef, midday, light coming down through the water in big bright shafts. Sea turtle gliding past up to the left, schools of little yellow fish all over the middle distance. Right in the centre of the foreground there's an octopus tucked into a coral head, tentacles draped over the rock, its eye looking right at me — almost matched its colour to the coral. Way up near the surface I can just make out a thin vertical line going up. Quiet down here, just clicks and pops.
