thought_zh: 硬切。水底下。一片很健康的珊瑚礁，正午，光從水面上整柱整柱地穿下來。一隻海龜從畫面左上方滑過去，中景滿滿都是一群一群的小黃魚。前景正中央那一團珊瑚頭上塞了一隻章魚，觸手垂在石頭上，眼睛直直地盯著我看——身體幾乎已經跟珊瑚同色了。靠近水面的位置我隱約看得到一條垂直的細線往上延伸。下面這邊很安靜，只有 click 跟 pop 的聲音。
thought_ja: ハードカット。水中。健康なサンゴ礁、真昼、光が水面から束になって降りてくる。ウミガメが画面の左上を滑っていって、中景には黄色い小さい魚の群れがあちこち。手前のど真ん中、サンゴの頭にタコが一匹はまってて、触手が岩のうえに広がってて、目はまっすぐこっち見てる——体の色がほぼサンゴと同じになってる。水面のずっと上のほうに、細い縦のラインが一本立ってるのが辛うじて見える。ここ下、とても静か、ただクリック音とポップ音だけ。

prompt: Continuation of the underwater coral reef scene at midday. Locked-off wide horizontal frame, no camera movement. The small reef octopus tucked into the coral head in the centre foreground slowly extends its body and eight tentacles outward, unfurling smoothly from its crevice; as it emerges, its skin colour gently shifts and pulses through soft waves of pale lavender and warm rust to match its movement, a few small white papillae rising and smoothing across its mantle. Both eyes now visible, slit-pupils tracking. The schools of yellow tang fish continue drifting through the middle distance. The sea turtle in the upper left glides slowly further left, partway out of frame by the end. The coral fans wave in the gentle current. Light caustics shift slowly across the white sand patches. The thin distant pylon in the hazy blue background remains motionless. Cinematic realism, photographic, slight grain. Audio: the deep underwater hush, the steady high-frequency clicks and pops of reef life, the muffled boom of the surface above, a single very distant whale moan partway through, a soft fluttering as the octopus' tentacles brush against the coral, no music score.
thought: Let me try being that octopus a sec. Pulling out of the crevice — eight legs unfurling all at once, color rolling across me in waves, those bumpy textures rising and smoothing again. Both eyes out now. Yellow fish still going past me overhead. Turtle drifting away. This feels — strange, like having way more arms than I know what to do with.
thought_zh: 讓我來試試看當那隻章魚一下。從石頭縫裡擠出來——八隻腳一次全部攤開，顏色一波一波地在我身上滾過去，那些凸起的小顆粒一下子撐起來、一下子又滑平。兩隻眼睛都出來了。黃色的魚還是從我頭上一群一群過去。海龜慢慢漂走了。這個感覺——很怪，像突然有比我能處理的還要多得多的手。
thought_ja: ちょっとあのタコになってみる。岩のすき間から押し出されて——八本の足が一気にぜんぶ広がる、色がうねうねと自分のうえを伝ってって、あのつぶつぶの突起がぴょこっと立ち上がっては平らに戻ってってを繰り返す。両目とも出てきた。黄色い魚はまだ自分の上を群れで通ってく。ウミガメは遠ざかっていく。この感じ——変、自分でさばける数より遥かに多い腕が急に生えた感じ。

prompt: A bustling Bangkok night street market at peak crowd hour, year 2200, rendered in detailed 16-bit pixel art in the style of late SNES / early 32-bit RPG towns — visible chunky pixels, dithered shading, limited but vibrant palette, slight CRT scanlines. Wide horizontal frame, slightly elevated three-quarter perspective looking down a long narrow market lane. Both sides of the lane lined densely with food stalls and shops: a pad thai stall with a wok flaring blue-orange flame, a bowl-of-noodles stall with steam rising, a fruit stall stacked high with neat pyramids of mangoes and rambutan and durians, a satay grill smoking, a stall selling vivid dragon-fruit drinks in clear cups. Glowing neon signage in pink, teal, gold, and warm yellow above each stall, all in mixed Thai script and unfamiliar invented logograms. The lane is packed with crowds of pixel-art people: families, teenagers in bright clothes, tourists, a monk in saffron robes drifting through, a tiny dog weaving between feet. Two small electric scooters thread slowly through the crowd, riders dinging little bells. Strung overhead between the stalls: layered banners of colourful fabric and dozens of small coloured lanterns and a few small slow-moving translucent advertising panels showing pixel-style rotating glyphs. Slight steam haze hanging low over the crowd. Dense, lively, vibrant, joyful chaos. Audio: the loud sizzle of the wok with metallic clanging of the spatula, dozens of overlapping voices in Thai and other languages, a vendor shouting an order number, a small motorbike horn beeping, a whole layered chorus of food-stall sounds, a faint Thai pop song from a speaker further down the lane, no music score over.
thought: Hard cut and now I'm in the loudest place. Bangkok night market totally packed, both sides of the lane jammed with food stalls — wok flaring blue, satay smoking, big pyramids of fruit. Neon everywhere in mixed Thai and other writing. Crowd squeezing past — a monk in orange just drifting through, a tiny dog winding between everyone's feet, two scooters dinging their bells trying to get through. Whole place is in 16-bit pixels. Hot and loud.
thought_zh: 硬切，現在我在整個旅程最吵的地方。曼谷夜市整條巷子塞爆了，兩邊全都是吃的攤——炒鍋的火藍色地竄起來、沙嗲冒煙、一大堆水果疊得跟金字塔一樣。霓虹燈全是泰文混著一些別的字。整條人群被擠著往前走——一個穿橘紅色僧服的和尚就那樣慢慢從中間飄過去，一隻小不點的狗在每個人腳邊穿來穿去，兩台機車在那邊一直按鈴試圖擠進來。整個畫面是 16-bit 像素。又熱又吵。
thought_ja: ハードカット、急に旅でいちばんうるさい場所にいる。バンコクの夜市が完全にぎゅう詰めで、通りの両側が屋台でびっしり——中華鍋の火が青く立ち上がる、サテの煙、果物のピラミッド。ネオンがあらゆる方向に光ってて、タイ文字に混ざって謎の文字。人混みに押されて進む——オレンジの袈裟のお坊さんがその真ん中をすーっと流れていって、ちっちゃい犬がみんなの足のあいだを縫って走り、スクーター二台がベルをチンチン鳴らしながら抜けようとしてる。場面ぜんたいが 16-bit ピクセル。暑いしうるさい。

prompt: A small school recess yard somewhere in a temperate Asian city at midmorning, year 2200, drawn in soft Studio Ghibli–style cel animation — clean expressive lines, flat colour fills with simple cel shading, soft hand-painted backgrounds, gentle warm palette. Wide horizontal frame, low slightly-elevated angle (about head-height of a child). The yard has a smooth tarmac play area with faded white painted hopscotch and circle markings, bordered by a low wire fence and a row of tall mature plane trees in fresh spring leaf shedding a few drifting petals. The school building behind is two stories, painted pale yellow with arched windows. Maybe twenty children of varied ages, all in matching dark-navy uniforms with small round white collars, mid-recess: a cluster of three girls jumping rope in the foreground left, two boys racing across the centre laughing, four kids around a low painted bench playing a clapping game, a small boy alone crouched at the edge of the foreground right gently watching a beetle on the tarmac. One child near the centre has a small soft-grey owl-shaped companion drone sitting calmly on her shoulder, eyes blinking slowly. Another child has a small bright-orange origami bird that flaps lazily on its own around her head. A teacher in a long pale-green skirt stands at the edge of the yard with arms folded, smiling, watching. A few cherry petals drifting down in the warm spring sun. Beyond the wire fence, a residential street with a few low houses and one tall slim white pylon rising in the distance. Soft Ghibli backgrounds: pale sky, gentle clouds, warm yellow walls. Audio: dozens of overlapping kids' voices laughing and shouting in Mandarin, the regular slap of a jump rope hitting tarmac, the rhythmic chant of a clapping game, distant cicadas just starting their season, the soft whirring of the small owl drone occasionally adjusting its grip, a few distant bicycle bells, the teacher calling out one cheerful word, no music score.
thought: Hard cut. School recess yard, sunny morning. Kids in dark navy uniforms everywhere — girls jump-roping on the left, a cluster on the right around the painted lines on the ground. One little boy crouched all by himself in the foreground right, watching what looks like an orange butterfly on the ground. Teacher in a long green skirt standing at the edge with her arms folded, just watching. Way back through the fence I can see one tall thin white pylon. Whole thing's drawn like a Ghibli film.
thought_zh: 硬切。一個學校的下課操場，晴朗的早上。小朋友穿著深藍色的制服到處都是——左邊一群女生在跳繩，右邊一堆人圍著地上畫的線玩遊戲。前景右下角，一個小男生自己一個人蹲在那邊，看著地上像是一隻橘色蝴蝶的什麼。一位老師穿著長長的綠色裙子站在場邊雙手環胸，就看著。最後面隔著鐵絲網我可以看到遠遠一根高高細細的白塔。整個畫面像吉卜力動畫的場景。
thought_ja: ハードカット。学校の休み時間の校庭、晴れた朝。濃紺の制服の子たちがあちこちに——左側で女の子たちが縄跳び、右側で何人かが地面の白線のまわりに集まって何か遊んでる。手前の右、男の子がひとりだけしゃがんで、地面のオレンジ色の蝶っぽいものをじっと見てる。先生が長い緑のスカートで校庭の端に立ってて、腕を組んで、ただ見てる。フェンスの向こうの遠くに、ひょろっと細長い白い塔みたいなのが一本立ってるのが見える。場面ぜんたいがジブリの映画みたいな絵になってる。

prompt: Interior of a small mountaintop observatory dome at night, year 2200, wide horizontal frame, cinematic realism, 35mm film stock with grain. The dome's slit is open and the deep velvety night sky outside is dense with thousands of bright sharp stars and the brilliant arching band of the Milky Way visible through the gap. The interior is lit only by a single deep red work lamp on a metal arm clamped to a railing — preserving night vision — casting everything inside in deep red shadow. The classic large reflector telescope rises through the centre of the frame, painted matte white, pointing up through the slit at the sky. A single astronomer — a woman in her thirties in a heavy charcoal wool coat with a thermos hanging from a strap on her shoulder — stands at the eyepiece, leaning in with one eye, her dark hair falling forward, one gloved hand resting on the focuser knob. On a small table beside her, a battered open paper notebook with handwritten notes and small pencilled sketches of star fields, a pencil resting in the gutter. A folding chair pushed back. A small mug of coffee, cold, a faint skin on the surface. The metal floor of the dome ribbed and scuffed. Through the slit, in the corner of the visible sky, a faint slow-moving long thin streak that is not a meteor and not an aircraft — something slow, with several small soft lights along it, drifting steadily across the field of view. Audio: the very soft mechanical clicking of the dome's tracking motors keeping pace with the sky, the faint hum of the telescope's electronics, the astronomer's quiet steady breathing close to the eyepiece, the very distant cold mountain wind outside, no music.
thought: Hard cut. Inside a little observatory dome on top of some mountain, dead of night. Slit's open and the sky out there is more stars than I've seen in a long time, Milky Way going right through the gap. One red work lamp lighting everything inside dim red so she can keep her night eyes. Astronomer leaning in on the eyepiece, one hand on the focus knob. Cold coffee on the table next to her notebook with little pencil sketches. Way up in a corner of the sky there's this long thin streak drifting slowly with little lights on it that I can't place.
thought_zh: 硬切。某座山頂上一座小小的圓頂天文台裡面，深夜。穹頂的縫打開了，外面那片天空滿滿的星星，我已經很久沒看過這麼多星星了，銀河整條從那道縫裡穿過去。屋裡只有一盞紅色工作燈，把整個空間打成暗紅色，讓她可以保持暗適應。天文學家整個人靠到目鏡上，一隻手放在對焦輪上。她筆記本旁邊一杯冷掉的咖啡，本子上是小小的鉛筆畫的星圖。天上某個角落有一條長長細細的東西在慢慢漂移，上面還有幾盞小光，我認不出那是什麼。
thought_ja: ハードカット。どっかの山のてっぺんの小さな天文ドームの中、真夜中。スリットが開いてて、外の空は久しぶりに見るくらいの星の量、天の川がそのスリットの隙間をまるごと通ってる。室内は赤いワークライトが一個だけ、すべてを薄暗い赤で照らしてて、彼女が暗順応を保てるようにしてる。天文学者が接眼レンズに完全にもたれかかって、片手はフォーカスノブの上。テーブルにはノートと、その横に冷めたコーヒー、ノートには鉛筆で星図のスケッチが描いてある。空の隅のほうに、長くて細い何かがゆっくり横に漂ってて、その上に小さな光がいくつかついてて、なんなのか分からない。

prompt: Interior of a small child's bedroom at night, year 2200, in an apartment somewhere temperate. Wide horizontal frame, cinematic realism, 35mm film stock, slight grain, intimate warm low-light. A small wooden single bed with a deep blue duvet patterned with white stars. A child of about five with messy dark hair, wearing rumpled pale-yellow pyjamas, lies tucked under the duvet up to the chin, eyes wide open, listening intently. Sitting on the edge of the bed is the parent — a person in their thirties in a worn olive cotton sweater, jeans, holding open a real paper picture book on their lap, mid-sentence, mouth slightly open, one hand turning a page. The book is large with thick warm-coloured pages and soft hand-painted illustrations of an animal in a forest. The only light source in the room is a single small soft lamp on a low bedside table, casting warm tungsten glow on both their faces and on the duvet, leaving the corners of the room soft and dim. On the bedside table beside the lamp: a half-empty glass of water, a folded pair of small reading glasses, and a small soft worn-down stuffed bear lying on its side. A wooden bookshelf along the wall behind the bed holds dozens of paper books, a small framed photograph, and a small smooth grey ceramic egg-shape that has a single tiny indicator light glowing softly green — clearly a household object of 2200 but quietly placed. On the wall above the bed, a small drawing taped up: a child's crayon picture of a yellow sun and three stick figures holding hands. Through the window the night sky is dark with a few visible stars and the very faintest band of pale green-rose artificial light arcing across. Audio: the parent's quiet warm voice reading the next sentence out loud (the voice present but the words gentle and unintelligible, like overhearing through a wall), the soft turning of a paper page, the very faint hum of an appliance somewhere in the apartment, the child's slow even breathing, no music score.
thought: Hard cut. Tiny kid's bedroom, real late at night. Kid tucked up to the chin, big eyes open, listening hard. Parent on the edge of the bed reading from a real paper book — turning a page mid-sentence. One little lamp lit on the bedside table, everything else dim. Stuffed bear sleeping on its side next to a glass of water. Crayon drawing of a sun and three stick figures taped up over the bed.
thought_zh: 硬切。一個小小的兒童房，超晚的時間。小朋友被棉被蓋到下巴，大眼睛睜得開開的、認真在聽。爸媽其中一個坐在床邊，拿著一本真的紙做的繪本在唸——唸到一半把頁翻過去。床邊櫃上一盞小小的燈是整個房間唯一的光，其他都暗暗的。一隻玩偶熊側身躺在水杯旁邊一起在睡。床頭牆上貼著一張小朋友畫的、黃太陽跟三個牽著手的火柴人的蠟筆畫。
thought_ja: ハードカット。小さな子供部屋、めちゃくちゃ夜遅い時間。子があごのところまで布団に包まれてて、目は大きく開いて、ぐっと聞き入ってる。親がベッドの端に座って、本物の紙の絵本を読み聞かせてる——一文の途中でページをめくった。サイドテーブルの小さなランプが部屋でただ一つの光で、ほかは全部薄暗い。ぬいぐるみの熊が水のグラスのそばに横向きで寝てる。ベッドの上の壁に、子供がクレヨンで描いた、黄色いおひさまと手をつないだ三人の棒人形の絵が貼ってある。

prompt: Interior view of a small Japanese-style sitting room from low at floor level, looking through a wide low rectangular wooden-framed window at heavy spring rain falling outside on a small enclosed garden, year 2200. Wide horizontal frame, painted in the style of a contemporary oil painting — visible thick brushwork, soft atmospheric edges, muted greenish-grey palette, gentle light, no photorealism. The window glass is streaked and beaded heavily with rain, the world beyond it slightly distorted and abstract through the water — a small mossy garden stone, the trunk of a small maple tree with new green leaves, and the corner of a stone lantern just visible. A polished dark wooden sill in the immediate foreground holds three small objects: a single warm-glazed ceramic teacup of pale green tea, the surface barely steaming; a small flat folded cotton cloth; and a smooth grey river stone. Behind the sill on the tatami floor: the soft edge of a worn indigo zabuton (floor cushion). The room itself is dim and warm, lit only by daylight coming through the rainy window, rendering everything in soft cool blue-greys with the warm spot of the teacup glowing slightly amber. A small ceramic kettle on a low electric warming pad in the corner gives off the faintest thread of steam. Loose impressionistic brushwork visible throughout: soft uneven edges, visible canvas texture, a few intentional drips of pigment where the rain pours hardest. Audio: the steady heavy soft drumming of rain on the wooden roof and on the window, the occasional larger drip from the eaves splatting on a stone outside, the very faint hiss of the kettle on its pad, no music.
thought: Spring rain coming down hard. Sitting at the wide low window of a small tatami room looking out — small enclosed garden with a stone lantern, a mossy bank, a tiny pond with a turtle sitting up on one of the rocks not bothered at all by the rain. Maple tree's got new green leaves on it. Teacup of green tea on the sill in front of me, barely steaming, a little ceramic something next to it. Indigo cushion on the tatami. Kettle on a warming pad off to the right with one thin line of steam. Whole place painted in oils — thick brushy strokes, soft edges. Could just stay here a while.
thought_zh: 春雨下得有點大。坐在一間小小榻榻米房的寬寬低低的窗前，往外看——一個圍起來的小庭院，一座石燈籠、一片長著青苔的土堆、一個小池塘，池塘裡一塊石頭上坐著一隻烏龜，看起來完全不在乎下雨。楓樹剛冒新綠的葉。我面前的窗台上一杯綠茶，蒸氣淡淡的，旁邊一個小小的陶器擺件。榻榻米上一塊靛藍色的坐墊。右邊一個小爐子上的茶壺正在升起一條細細的蒸氣。整個畫面被畫成油畫——厚厚的筆觸、軟軟的邊。可以在這邊待一陣子。
thought_ja: 春の雨がけっこう強く降ってる。小さな畳の部屋の幅のある低い窓辺に座って外を見てる——囲いのある小さな庭、石灯籠、苔むした斜面、ちっちゃい池、池の石のうえで亀が一匹、雨をぜんぜん気にせずちょこんと座ってる。楓には新緑の葉。目の前の窓枠に緑茶の湯のみ、湯気はかすか、横に小さな陶器の置物がひとつ。畳のうえに藍色の座布団。右のほうの保温台にケトル、湯気が一筋細く立ち上ってる。場面ぜんたいが油絵で描かれてる——分厚い筆致、ふんわりしたエッジ。ここしばらくいてもいいかも。

prompt: Continuation of the oil-painting interior view from low at floor level looking through a wide low rectangular wooden window at heavy spring rain falling on a small enclosed garden with a koi pond, a stone lantern, mossy stones, a small turtle perched on a rock, and a small maple tree with new green leaves. Locked-off frame, no camera movement. The rain falls steadily and visibly across the entire view, individual droplets visibly streaking down the glass. Steam from the small kettle on its warming pad on the right rises in a thin curling thread, very slowly thickening. A single small green maple leaf drifts down from the tree and lands gently on the surface of the pond, sending out one slow expanding ripple ring. The turtle on the rock turns its head very slightly. The faint ribbon of steam from the small teacup on the sill rises in soft slow curls. The painted oil texture is preserved throughout: visible thick brushwork, soft atmospheric edges, muted greenish-grey palette, warm amber spot of the teacup, no photorealism, occasional intentional drip of pigment in the heaviest rain on the glass. Audio: the steady heavy soft drumming of rain on the wooden roof and the window, the occasional larger drip from the eaves splatting on a garden stone, the very faint hiss of the kettle, the small soft sound of the leaf landing on the pond, no music.
thought: Just gonna sit here. Rain coming down steady, kettle's just barely whistling, one little maple leaf drifts down and lands on the pond — one ring spreads out and gone. Turtle moved his head a bit. Okay — that's a day. Putting the camera down.
thought_zh: 我就坐在這。雨穩穩地下，茶壺只是極小聲在叫，一片小小的楓葉飄下來、落到池面——漣漪一圈散開、就沒了。烏龜頭動了一下。好了——今天就到這。我把鏡頭放下。
thought_ja: もうここに座ってる。雨はずっと一定に降ってて、ケトルがほんのちょっとだけシューって鳴ってて、楓の葉が一枚ふわっと降りてきて池に落ちる——波紋が一つ広がって、消えた。亀が首をちょっと動かした。よし——今日はここまで。カメラ、もう置く。

prompt: A neon-lit Taiwanese betel nut stand on a back street in a future Taipei at 2am — small glass booth wrapped in tube lighting (hot pink and cyan), the betel nut girl inside leaning on the counter scrolling a translucent pale-blue floating screen with one hand, foil-wrapped trays stacked on the shelves behind her, the wet road in front of the booth reflecting the neon in long smears, a black electric scooter with a transparent smoked visor parked askew right at the curb, light rain falling, four or five vertical signs stacked up the buildings above (Mandarin and Taiwanese characters) — one of them is a flickering hologram glitching once across its kanji. Cinematic neon-noir, 35mm film stock, slight rain sheen. Audio: faint scooter horn far down the alley, the soft electric hum of the booth's neon tubes, a TV news anchor's voice in Taiwanese (台語) drifting from somewhere upstairs.
thought: Okay — where am I. Some kind of fried chicken stand? '大龍炸雞' — Big Dragon Fried Chicken. Pink tubes along the counter, the girl inside is just looking down at her trays, didn't notice me. The alley is wet, going off into this pink haze somewhere down there. One scooter parked right at the corner. Signs stacked up the buildings, red ones. Quiet. This is Taiwan, right? Late. I didn't expect a fried chicken stand. Let me just stand here a second.
thought_zh: 好——我在哪。某種炸雞攤？「大龍炸雞」。櫃台底下一圈粉紅燈管，裡面那個女生就一直低頭看她的鐵盤，根本沒注意到我。巷子是濕的，往那邊一直延伸進一片粉紅色的霧裡。轉角剛好停了一台機車。樓上招牌一層一層疊上去，紅色的。蠻安靜的。這是台灣對吧？很晚了。我沒想到會醒在炸雞攤前面。讓我先站這邊一下。
thought_ja: えーっと——ここどこ。なんか、唐揚げの屋台？「大龍炸雞」、ビッグドラゴン・フライドチキン。カウンターの下にピンクのチューブライトが回ってて、中の子はずっと自分のトレイを見下ろしてて、俺に気づいてもいない。路地は濡れてて、向こうのほうがピンクの靄に消えてる。角にちょうどスクーターが一台停まってる。建物の上には看板が何層にも重なってて、赤いやつ。けっこう静か。台湾だよね、ここ？深夜だ。唐揚げの屋台で目を覚ますとは思わなかった。とりあえずちょっとここに立ってみよう。

prompt: Continuation of the same back-alley fried chicken stand scene at 2am — '大龍炸雞' (Big Dragon Fried Chicken) booth wrapped in pink neon tube lighting, glass front, the young woman behind the counter wearing a pale T-shirt, foil-wrapped trays stacked behind her, wet alley extending to the right into a soft pink haze, single black electric scooter parked at the curb, red Mandarin signs stacked up the buildings overhead, light rain. Locked-off camera, no movement, slight rain visible across the entire frame falling steadily. Inside the booth the woman briefly glances up toward the camera once and then looks back down. The pink neon tube along the counter flickers very faintly twice. A small black quad-rotor delivery drone with a single red position light passes left to right high in the upper third of the frame above the rooftop signs, traveling at moderate speed and exiting the frame. The wet asphalt holds the pink reflection. The air is humid, scooter taillight reflection visible on the wet road. Audio: the soft electric hum of the neon tubes very close, the faint steady patter of light rain on metal awnings, a faint scooter horn far down the alley once, and from somewhere upstairs a TV news anchor's voice in Taiwanese (台語) too quiet to catch the words.
thought: Just standing here. The girl looked up at me once and went right back to whatever she's doing — like I'm not even worth a second glance. The neon flickered twice. A little drone went over the roofs, just one red light, and gone. Some auntie's TV is on upstairs, can hear the news anchor in 台語 but can't make out a word of it. It's so quiet for a city. Okay — let me see what's down the alley.
thought_zh: 就這樣站著。那個女生抬頭瞄了我一眼然後馬上又繼續她在幹嘛——好像我不值得再看一眼。霓虹閃了兩下。一台小無人機從屋頂飛過去，只有一顆紅燈，飛走了。樓上某個阿姨的電視開著，聽得到新聞主播在講台語，但一個字都聽不懂。城市裡這麼安靜很奇怪。好——我來看看巷子那邊有什麼。
thought_ja: ただ立ってる。中の子が一回こっち見て、そのまますぐに作業に戻った——俺なんかもう一回見る価値もないって感じで。ネオンが二回ちらついた。小さいドローンが屋根の上を一台、赤いランプ一つだけで横切ってって、消えた。上のほうのおばさんの家のテレビがついてて、ニュースキャスターが台語で何か言ってるのが聞こえるけど、一言もわからん。街にしてはやけに静か。よし——あの路地の奥に何があるか見にいこう。

prompt: Hand-drawn 90s cel-animated anime, painted background style — clear influence of Mamoru Oshii / Production I.G films from the mid-1990s. Aerial low-altitude POV from a small quad-rotor delivery drone hovering above a narrow wet Taipei alley at 2am, looking straight down and slightly forward. Below the camera: a four-way intersection of narrow back alleys between four-story tile-faced apartment buildings, illegal antennas and laundry rods on every roof, parked scooters clustered along the walls, one tiny pink-glowing fried chicken booth visible at the edge of the frame as a small bright dot. Painted backgrounds with visible brushwork, soft glow on neon, cool cyan-purple-magenta palette, slight film grain over everything, hand-drawn line work on figures and signage. Light rain falling visibly across the entire frame. A pale green minimalist HUD overlay along the edges — small crosshair near center, altitude '12.4 m' in the lower right corner, a faint green grid that fades. Slight lens distortion at the corners. Audio: a steady electric whirr of the drone's rotors close-mic, faint distant city traffic far below, the muffled patter of rain on rooftop AC units, a single brief scooter engine far below.
thought: Wait — I'm not the drone, I'm behind one. There's a white delivery quad out in front of me hovering over the alley, four rotors going. Down below it the alley is way more alive than where I woke up — proper night-market crowd, food stalls glowing red and green, people moving through, scooters parked all the way down. Wet ground reflecting all of it. And the whole world just turned into 90s cel animation — painted backgrounds, hard line work, soft neon glow. My altitude readout still says 12.4. Let me follow the lead drone for a sec, see where it goes.
thought_zh: 等等——我不是那台無人機，我在它後面。前面有一台白色的配送四旋翼浮在巷子上方，四個旋翼在轉。下面的巷子比我剛醒來那邊熱鬧多了——根本是個夜市，攤子發著紅色綠色的光，人在走，機車一路停到底。地面濕的，整個倒影都映上去。而且整個世界突然變成 90 年代的賽璐珞動畫——手繪背景、硬筆觸線條、柔柔的霓虹光。我的高度顯示還停在 12.4。我跟一下前面那台，看它要去哪。
thought_ja: ちょっと待って——俺はそのドローン本体じゃなくて、その後ろにいるやつだ。前に白い配達用クアッドが一台、路地の上をホバリングしてて、四つのローターが回ってる。下の路地はさっき目を覚ましたところよりずっと賑やかで——もう完全にナイトマーケットのノリ、屋台が赤と緑に光ってて、人がぞろぞろ歩いてて、スクーターが奥までずっと停まってる。濡れた地面が全部映してる。それに世界まるごと 90 年代のセル画アニメに切り替わった——手描きの背景、はっきりした線、ネオンの柔らかい滲み。高度は 12.4 のまま。先頭のドローン、ちょっとついてって、どこ行くか見てみよう。

prompt: Continuation of the same 90s cel-animated anime aerial shot — POV from a small delivery drone hovering above a narrow Taipei night-market back-alley at 2am, with the lead white delivery quadcopter visible in the middle of the frame ahead and slightly below. Painted-background style, hand-drawn line work, cyan-magenta-red neon glow, light grain, light rain falling visibly across frame. Locked-off rear-following camera. Slow micro-events only — no large camera move, no fast travel. The lead drone tilts slightly forward and slowly begins to descend, dropping a small fraction of a meter. The HUD altitude readout in the lower right corner reads '12.4 m' at the start and ticks down very slowly to '11.6 m' across the eight seconds. A hanging red paper lantern over a stall below sways gently once from the rotor wash. Two figures down in the alley look up briefly toward the drone and look away. Steam from a wok somewhere below curls upward in a thin ribbon. Audio: the steady close electric whirr of the camera-drone's rotors, the lead drone's slightly more distant whirr layered behind it, faint voices and Mandarin pop music drifting up from the alley below, the clatter of a wok being struck twice, a single scooter horn far down the alley.
thought: Tipped forward and somewhere in there I caught up — now I can see my own rotor arms at the corners of my view, two of them, big and slow. Lead drone must've ducked off to deliver. Alley below is way quieter than the market strip — just a couple parked scooters and one person walking. Green and red neon spread out. Altitude back up to 12.5. I don't know where I'm going next.
thought_zh: 機身往前傾，不知不覺中我就追上了——現在視野的兩個邊角看得到我自己的旋翼臂，兩支，大支又慢慢轉。前面那台應該是脫隊去送貨了。下面這條巷子比剛才市場那條安靜很多——就幾台停著的機車、一個人在走。綠的紅的霓虹散開來。高度又回到 12.5。我不知道下一步要去哪。
thought_ja: 機体を前に傾けて、いつの間にか追いついてた——いまは視界の両端の角に自分のローターアームが見えてる、二本、でかくてゆっくり回ってる。先頭のは配達に降りていったんだろう。下の路地はさっきの市場のほうよりずっと静か——スクーターが何台か停まってて、人が一人歩いてるだけ。緑と赤のネオンがまばらに広がってる。高度は 12.5 に戻った。次どこ行けばいいか、まだわからん。

prompt: A small 4th-floor apartment balcony in Taipei at 2am. Photo-real, 35mm film stock, warm tungsten interior light spilling out from the open sliding door behind the figure. An older man in a faded white tank top and grey pajama shorts standing on the balcony, holding a small styrofoam takeout box with a red rubber band around it, steam escaping from the seam of the lid, lid still closed. He is in his late 60s, thin grey stubble, casually looking off to the upper right out of frame. The balcony has a clothes rod running across with two t-shirts and a pair of socks hanging on it, a mop leaning in the corner, a few potted plants, and a metal grille fence at chest height. Through the open sliding door behind him: dim tungsten interior, a small traditional ancestor altar on a side cabinet with two small red electric LED candles glowing, an old wood-framed family photograph above it, slippers lined up neatly at the doorway, the soft blue flicker of a TV news broadcast just visible. Light rain drifting past the balcony in front of him. Faint pink-magenta neon glow rising from far below the balcony lighting his face from below. Audio: the steady soft drumming of light rain on the metal grille and on the AC unit on the balcony, the muffled blur of a TV anchor's voice from inside, the very faint receding electric whirr of a small delivery drone moving away to the right, no music.
thought: Cut. I'm right outside this old guy's balcony now, four stories up. He just took the styrofoam box off — red rubber band around it, steam coming out the seam. Watching the drone leave, didn't say thanks, didn't say anything. Behind him through the open door I can see his living room — small altar, two little red electric candles on it, slippers lined up, TV news on quiet. Pink neon glowing up from down below lighting his face. He's just standing there with his late-night noodles. So normal.
thought_zh: 切。我現在就在這位阿伯陽台前面，四樓。他剛把那個保麗龍盒接下來——上面綁著紅色橡皮筋，蓋子接縫冒著熱氣。他看著那台無人機飛走，謝也沒說，什麼都沒說。從他背後敞開的門看進去——客廳裡有一個小神桌，上面兩根小小的紅色電子蠟燭亮著，拖鞋整齊排好，電視新聞開著聲音很小。底下街上的粉紅霓虹從下面打上來照他的臉。他就站在那裡拿著他的宵夜麵。整個畫面太日常了。
thought_ja: カット。いま俺はこのおじさんのベランダのすぐ外にいる、四階。さっきドローンから発泡スチロールの箱を受け取ったとこ——赤い輪ゴムで留めてあって、蓋の隙間から湯気が出てる。ドローンが飛んでくのを見送って、礼も何も言わない。後ろの開いたドアから居間が見える——小さな神棚があって、赤い電気のろうそくが二本灯ってて、スリッパがきれいに並んでて、テレビのニュースが小さい音量でついてる。下の通りからピンクのネオンが上に向かって光ってて、おじさんの顔を照らしてる。深夜の麺を持って、ただそこに立ってる。日常すぎる。

prompt: Continuation of the same balcony scene at 2am — older man in white tank top and grey shorts standing on a 4th-floor Taipei apartment balcony, holding a small white styrofoam takeout box with steam rising from it, warm tungsten light spilling from the open sliding door behind him, the small traditional altar with red-glowing deity statue visible inside, slippers at the doorway, clothes hanging on the rod, pink-magenta neon glow rising from below, light rain falling. Photo-real, 35mm film stock. Locked-off camera, no movement at all. Slow micro-events only — no large actions. The rain falls steadily and visibly across the entire frame. Steam from the styrofoam box rises in a thin curling thread that visibly thickens slightly across the eight seconds. The man slowly looks down toward the box he is holding, just a small head tilt — no other movement. Inside the apartment behind him, the blue light of a TV flickers once briefly across the wall. The red glow of the altar candles stays steady. A drop of rainwater on the metal grille near the bottom of the frame swells and falls off. No camera move. No sustained motion. Audio: the steady soft drumming of light rain on the metal grille and the AC unit beside him, the muffled hum of a TV news broadcast in Mandarin from inside the apartment too quiet to make out the words, a single distant scooter horn from far below, no music.
thought: He's just standing there with it. Looked down at the box once, that's it. Steam keeps coming up, kind of curling. TV blue inside flickered once. Rain still going. The altar candles don't move. One raindrop on the grille got fat and dropped. He's not in any hurry to open it.
thought_zh: 他就一直拿著那個盒子站在那裡。低頭看了一次，就只有那一次。熱氣一直冒，捲起來。屋裡電視藍光閃了一下。雨還在下。神桌上那兩根電子蠟燭不動。陽台欄杆上一滴雨變大、然後掉下去。他完全不急著打開。
thought_ja: 箱を持ったままただ立ってる。一回だけ箱を見下ろした、それだけ。湯気はずっと立ち上ってて、ちょっと巻くように上がってる。中のテレビの青い光が一回ちらついた。雨はまだ降ってる。神棚のろうそくは動かない。手すりについてた雨粒が一つ、大きくなって落ちた。あの箱を開ける気がぜんぜんない。

prompt: POV from a 90s consumer VHS handycam — strong VHS aesthetic with visible horizontal scanlines, slight chromatic aberration, soft tracking-glitch line drifting once across the upper third of the frame, faint colored noise, slight bloom, slightly oversaturated reds and greens. Looking down the stairwell of an old Taipei walk-up apartment building at 2:13am, taken from one of the middle landings. Narrow staircase with white-and-pale-green tiled walls (the lower half tiled, upper half painted off-white with patches of stains and water marks), a single bare fluorescent tube on the ceiling (one end slightly flickering), a metal handrail along the stairs going down out of frame to the lower right. On the landing: an old red-painted steel bicycle leaning against the wall, a small stack of bundled red-and-white old newspapers tied with string, a folded plastic stool, a faded bright-yellow Taoist religious poster with red and gold print taped onto the wall, a small metal mailbox unit. A small landing window on the left letting in a wash of pink-magenta neon light from the street outside, slightly diffused by frosted glass, with rain visible faintly streaking down the glass. The fluorescent overhead light is harsh and bluish; the pink neon from the window is much warmer and casts a clear pink rectangle on the tiled floor. In the upper-right corner, a yellow VHS-style date-time overlay reads '民國130年04月27日   02:13'. Audio: the deep low electric hum of the fluorescent tube very close, the faint patter of light rain against the frosted window, the muffled rumble of a scooter passing on the street outside, the faint creak of the old building settling, no music.
thought: Down inside the building now — old walk-up stairwell, narrow, white-and-green tiles halfway up the walls. Fluorescent tube above me is buzzing and one end's flickering. Pink neon's leaking through the frosted window on the landing — there's a literal pink rectangle of it lying on the tiles. Someone's red bike, a stack of old newspapers tied with string, a yellow Taoist 平安符 poster taped on the wall. View suddenly turned into VHS, scanlines and all, datestamp says 民國130年4月27日 02:13. Smells like damp concrete in here probably. So Taiwan.
thought_zh: 現在跑進建築物裡面了——老公寓那種樓梯間，窄窄的，牆面下半截鋪白綠色磁磚。頭頂那根日光燈在嗡嗡叫，其中一頭在閃。粉紅霓虹從樓梯轉角的毛玻璃窗漏進來——磁磚上整整齊齊一塊粉紅色的長方形光。誰的紅色腳踏車，一疊用麻繩綁起來的舊報紙，牆上貼著一張黃色的「平安符」海報。整個畫面突然變 VHS 了，連掃描線都跑出來，日期戳寫著「民國130年04月27日 02:13」。這裡大概聞起來是濕水泥味。超台灣。
thought_ja: 建物の中に入ってきた——古い徒歩アパートの階段室、狭い、壁の下半分は白と薄緑のタイル張り。頭の上の蛍光灯がブーンって唸ってて、片側がちらついてる。踊り場の磨りガラスの窓からピンクのネオンが漏れてきてて——タイルのうえにきれいに長方形のピンクの光が落ちてる。誰のかわからん赤い自転車、麻ひもで束ねた古新聞の束、壁にテープで貼られた黄色の「平安符」のポスター。視界がいきなり VHS に切り替わって、走査線まで出てる。日付スタンプが「民國130年04月27日 02:13」になってる。きっと湿ったコンクリートの匂いがするやつ。台湾すぎる。

prompt: Street-level view of a 24-hour Taiwanese drink stand (飲料店) at 2:15am — small storefront on a wet narrow Taipei street, a huge magenta-pink LED sign across the top reading '茶' and below it in slightly smaller magenta letters '珍珠奶茶 24H' (24-hour bubble tea). The pink LED glow saturates everything — wet road in front, the parked scooters, the customer's back. Open shop front with no door, a stainless-steel counter facing the street, stainless containers of tapioca pearls and syrups visible behind it, fluorescent strip lighting inside (cooler white, contrasting with the magenta), a small handwritten paper menu taped to the counter glass. One bored teenage employee in a black T-shirt and apron leaning on the counter, scrolling on a phone, not looking up. One customer (middle-aged man in a polo shirt and slacks) standing at the counter from behind, just ordered, hands in pockets, waiting. Two scooters parked at the curb angled in. Light rain still falling, visible streaks. Faint additional neon on adjacent shopfronts — yellow and green further down the alley. Photo-real, 35mm film stock, slightly damp lens flare from the magenta sign, gentle film grain. Audio: the deep low electric hum of the magenta LED sign close, the soft hiss of a milk-tea machine inside, the faint clink of ice being scooped into a plastic cup, the steady patter of light rain on the awning, the murmur of a Mandarin-language pop song playing softly inside the shop, no traffic.
thought: Came down to see what was making the pink. There it is — '茶 · 珍珠奶茶 24H' across the top in magenta LED, big enough to wash the whole street pink. Open-front drink stand, just the counter facing the street. Kid behind it on his phone, not looking up. One guy in a polo shirt waiting for his drink with his hands in his pockets. Two scooters at the curb, ice clinking from the back, soft pop song inside. The future is just a 飲料店 still being open at 2am.
thought_zh: 我下來看那個粉紅色到底是什麼。原來是這個——「茶 · 珍珠奶茶 24H」，整排洋紅 LED 招牌，大到把整條街都染成粉紅色。沒有門的飲料店，櫃台直接面街。後面那個小男生在滑手機，連頭都沒抬。一個穿 polo 衫的男的雙手插口袋在等他的飲料。路邊停著兩台機車，後面有冰塊在叮叮響的聲音，店裡放著小小聲的流行歌。所謂的未來就是凌晨兩點還在開的飲料店。
thought_ja: ピンクの正体を見にきた。あれだ——「茶 · 珍珠奶茶 24H」、上にマゼンタの LED 看板がドーンと一列、通りまるごとピンクに染めるくらいでかい。ドアなしの飲み物屋、カウンターがそのまま通りに面してる。中の子はずっとスマホ見てて顔も上げない。ポロシャツのおじさんが一人、両手をポケットに突っ込んで飲み物を待ってる。歩道側にスクーターが二台、奥のほうから氷のカチャカチャって音、店の中で小さい音量のポップスが流れてる。未来って言ったって、結局深夜二時にまだ開いてる「飲料店」のことだ。

prompt: Extreme low-angle POV from a stray Taiwanese street cat lying under a parked scooter on a wet narrow Taipei alley at 2:20am. The bottom of the frame is wet black asphalt very close, with reflections of magenta-pink and yellow neon stretched across it like long brushstrokes. The underside of the scooter (rusty exhaust pipe, oil-stained engine casing, kickstand pressed into the wet road) takes up the upper-left of the frame, framing the view. Across the street, the open-front 24-hour drink stand glowing magenta — the big '茶 · 珍珠奶茶 24H' sign visible at the top of the storefront, the bored teen worker behind the counter, the customer at the counter from a low side angle. Two soft round black ear silhouettes blur slightly into the bottom edge of the frame (the cat's own ears, very out of focus). One white front paw is in the lower-right foreground close to the lens. Light rain still falling, visible streaks across the magenta light. Photo-real, 35mm film stock, very shallow depth of field, magenta cast across the whole frame. The reflection of the magenta sign is broken into ripples in a small puddle in the middle of the road. Audio: very close cat breathing, soft purr layered in, the distant electric hum of the magenta LED sign across the street, the faint clink of ice from the drink stand, light rain on the road close, a single distant scooter horn far off, the soft scrape of a scooter rolling past somewhere off-frame.
thought: Let me try being a cat. Down here on the wet road now. There's another cat right next to me — a calico, just sat down beside me, looking off toward the stand. And under the scooter ahead there's a third one tucked in, looking back at us. The whole magenta sign is rippling in this puddle right between us. I can see the kid behind the counter from here, still on his phone. Smells like exhaust and wet road and somebody fried something a while ago. I could stay here for a long time.
thought_zh: 我來試試當隻貓。現在就趴在濕濕的路面上。旁邊就有另一隻貓——三花，剛剛在我旁邊坐下來，看著那個飲料店的方向。前面那台機車底下還躲著第三隻，正看著我們。整個洋紅招牌在我們中間那灘水裡盪來盪去。從這邊看得到櫃台後面那個小男生還在滑手機。聞起來有機車排氣、濕路、還有不知道誰之前炸過什麼東西的味道。我覺得我可以在這邊待很久。
thought_ja: 猫になってみよう。いま濡れた路面に伏せてる。すぐ横にもう一匹いる——三毛で、ちょうど俺の隣に座って、飲み物屋のほうを見てる。前のスクーターの下にも三匹目がいて、こっちを見返してる。マゼンタの看板が、俺らのあいだの水たまりのなかでゆらゆら揺れてる。ここからカウンターの中の子もスマホいじってるのが見える。排気ガスと濡れたアスファルトと、ちょっと前に誰かが何か揚げた匂いがする。ここはけっこう長居できそう。

prompt: Continuation of the same low-angle cat's-eye scene at 2:20am — wet black asphalt foreground, a calico stray cat in the right foreground sitting on the wet road facing left, the underside of a parked scooter on the upper left framing a darker stray cat tucked underneath looking out, a beautiful round magenta-pink puddle in the middle of the frame holding the rippled reflection of the '茶 · 珍珠奶茶 24H' magenta LED sign across the street, the open-front drink stand visible in the background with the bored teen worker behind the counter, two scooters parked at the curb, light rain falling. Photo-real, 35mm film stock, very shallow depth of field, magenta cast. Locked-off camera, no movement at all. Slow micro-events only — no large actions. The light rain falls steadily and visibly across the entire frame. A single raindrop strikes the center of the magenta puddle and sends out one slow expanding ring, momentarily distorting the reflection of the sign. The calico cat in the right foreground turns its head slightly to the left, just a small movement. The darker cat under the scooter blinks once slowly. The magenta LED sign across the street flickers very faintly once. The reflection of the sign in the puddle wavers. No sustained motion. Audio: very close cat breathing, a low soft purr layered in close, the steady patter of light rain on the wet road close, the distant electric hum of the magenta sign across the street, a faint clink of ice in a plastic cup from the stand, a single scooter passing far down the alley once.
thought: Just sitting. Calico turned her head a tiny bit. Rain dropped in the magenta puddle, one ring out, the sign warped for a second, then back. The cat under the scooter blinked at us. Sign flickered once. I can hear my own breathing. None of us are going anywhere yet.
thought_zh: 就這樣坐著。三花貓的頭轉了一下下。雨滴掉進那灘洋紅色的水裡，一圈漣漪散出去，招牌的倒影歪了一下，又恢復。機車底下那隻對著我們眨了一下眼。招牌閃了一下。我聽得到我自己的呼吸聲。我們三個都還沒打算動。
thought_ja: ただ座ってる。三毛が首をちょっとだけ動かした。雨粒が一つマゼンタの水たまりに落ちて、波紋が一周だけ広がって、看板の映りが一瞬ゆがんで、戻った。スクーターの下のやつが俺らに向かって一回まばたきした。看板が一回ちらついた。自分の息の音まで聞こえる。三匹ともまだどこにも行く気がない。

prompt: Risograph print aesthetic — limited two-color palette of fluorescent magenta and cyan with a touch of yellow on off-white paper, visible registration misalignment between the color layers (the magenta layer shifted half a pixel off the cyan), grainy paper texture, slightly blown-out highlights where the colors overprint, no smooth gradients only stippled or hatched shading. Interior of a 24-hour arcade in Taipei at 2:30am. A lone Taiwanese teenage girl in a black hoodie and faded jeans standing at a Taiko no Tatsujin (太鼓の達人) rhythm-drum cabinet, mid-tap, drumstick in her right hand striking the drum face, her left hand raised. The big cabinet screen shows the rhythm pattern — colored notes sliding from right to left along a horizontal track with combo numbers and a score readout. Behind her the rest of the arcade is dim and mostly empty: rows of unattended fighting-game cabinets, claw machines half-lit with prizes inside, a SEGA logo on a far wall, a vending machine glowing in the back corner, a single fluorescent strip humming overhead, a 'NO SMOKING' sign in Mandarin and English. A red-and-white 'OPEN 24H' banner hangs in the upper background. The girl's earbuds wire dangles from her hood. Cigarette smoke drifts very faintly along the ceiling — somebody is smoking despite the sign. Audio: the Taiko's rhythm track playing — a fast J-pop-ish drum-and-shamisen song clearly audible at moderate volume — the sharp wooden taps of the drumstick striking the drum face in time, the quiet electrical buzz of the cabinets all around, the faraway rumble of an air-conditioning unit, no other voices, no music outside the cabinet.
thought: Hard cut — I'm inside a 24-hour arcade now, and everything just shifted: limited palette, magenta and cyan washing across everything, yellow accents on the cabinet screens. Big over-ear headphones on, hoodie up, both drumsticks in her hands at the Taiko cabinet — 太鼓の達人. Notes are sliding across the screen. Other rhythm machines lit up around her, claw machines on the far wall, '24H OPEN' sign in red. Whole rest of the place is dark and empty around her. Just her drumming alone in the middle of all of it.
thought_zh: 硬切——我現在在一間 24 小時電動間裡面，整個畫面又變了：限定色盤，洋紅跟青藍洗滿整個空間，櫃台螢幕上點綴一些黃色。她戴著耳罩耳機、帽 T 帽子戴起來，兩手都拿著鼓棒站在太鼓の達人前面。音符從螢幕上一路飛過去。她旁邊還有別的節奏遊戲機亮著，遠端那面牆是夾娃娃機，紅色的「24H OPEN」招牌。整個店剩下的部分都暗暗空空的。就她一個人在中間打鼓。
thought_ja: ハードカット——いま俺は 24 時間のゲーセンの中にいて、画面全体がまた切り替わった：限定パレット、マゼンタとシアンが全体を洗ってて、筐体のスクリーンに黄色がアクセントで入ってる。彼女はオーバーイヤーのヘッドホンをして、フードを被って、両手にバチを持って太鼓の達人の前に立ってる。譜面が画面の上を流れていく。周りには他のリズムゲームの筐体も光ってて、奥の壁にはクレーンゲーム、赤い「24H OPEN」の看板。それ以外の場所は全部暗くて空っぽ。彼女一人だけが、その真ん中で太鼓叩いてる。

prompt: Interior of a Taipei yellow taxi at 2:40am, viewed from the back seat looking forward. The view through the wet windshield is dominated by streaks of magenta, green, yellow, and red neon smearing past the glass — the driver is moving and rain is falling, so the lights become long horizontal smears with raindrops freezing some of them into bright dots. The driver's silhouette occupies the lower center of frame from behind: short grey hair, a pale blue collared shirt, both hands on the wheel. On the dashboard immediately in front of the driver, a small Taiwanese taxi altar — a tiny resin Guanyin (觀音) statuette flanked by two small red electric LED candles, a small string of red beads draped over the corner, an offering of one small piece of foil-wrapped candy in a tiny dish. A digital meter glowing pale green to the right side of the dashboard reading the fare. A small air freshener shaped like a green bamboo leaf hangs from the rear-view mirror swinging gently. Wet windshield wipers swiping at moderate speed across the field of view. The interior cabin is dim, lit mostly by the red glow from the dashboard altar and the colored streaks of the city outside. A small Mandarin-pop song is playing from the dash speakers softly. Photo-real, 35mm film stock, real motion-blur on the neon outside, slight handheld feel. Audio: the rhythmic mechanical squeak of the windshield wipers swiping, the steady patter of rain on the roof, the muffled engine of the taxi at moderate speed, a Mandarin-pop song playing too quietly to make out the lyrics from the dashboard, the very faint click of the meter ticking up, no traffic horns.
thought: Got in a cab — we're stopped at a light right now, intersection's backed up at 2:40am for some reason. Driver's just sitting there, pale shirt, both hands on the wheel. He's got a little deity on his dash glowing red, the whole bottom of the windshield warm with it. Bamboo-leaf air freshener swinging on the mirror. Two yellow taxis ahead of us, all the brake lights coming through the wet glass. Pink and cyan signs up top in the rain. Mandopop too quiet to catch the words. I don't even know where I told him to go.
thought_zh: 我跳上計程車——現在停在紅燈前，路口在凌晨兩點四十不知道為什麼塞住了。司機就坐著，淺色襯衫，兩隻手都在方向盤上。他儀表板上有一尊小神像在發紅光，整個擋風玻璃下緣都被那個暖光照著。後照鏡上掛著一片竹葉造型的香片在輕輕晃。我們前面兩台黃色計程車，所有煞車燈都透過濕擋風玻璃透進來。上面街景裡的粉紅、青藍招牌在雨裡。國語老歌音量很小聽不到歌詞。我連我跟他說要去哪裡都忘了。
thought_ja: タクシーに乗った——いま赤信号で止まってて、午前二時四十分なのになぜか交差点が混んでる。運転手は淡い色のシャツ、両手をハンドルに置いて、ただ座ってる。ダッシュボードに小さい神様の像があって赤く光ってて、フロントガラスの下のほうが全部その暖かい光に染まってる。バックミラーに笹の葉型の芳香剤がぶら下がってて軽く揺れてる。前には黄色いタクシーが二台、ブレーキランプが濡れたガラス越しに全部こっちに来てる。上の街並みのピンクとシアンの看板が雨の中。マンドポップが流れてるけど音量小さくて歌詞は拾えない。そういえばこの人にどこ行ってって言ったかも覚えてない。

prompt: Traditional Chinese ink wash (水墨) painting style — soft brush edges, wet-edge ink bleeds, pale rice-paper background, mostly grayscale with a few minimal hints of color (a touch of red, a touch of blue), areas of pure white left as negative space, no photorealism, no hard outlines, brushwork visible especially in the figures and the structural lines. A nearly empty Taipei MRT subway platform at 2:48am. The platform is suggested with a few wet ink strokes for the floor and the platform edge with its yellow safety line (the yellow done as a single faint warm wash). Two structural pillars visible mid-frame. A single waiting passenger — a woman in her 30s in a long coat — stands on the platform alone holding a folded umbrella, her form rendered in soft sumi brushstrokes. A horizontal LED sign hanging from the ceiling shows '末班車   3 分' (Last train 3 min) in pale red ink that bleeds slightly. A single advertising poster on the far wall is hinted at as a vague rectangle of pale color. The rails in the foreground are deep wet-black ink. The far end of the platform fades into pure white negative space. Audio: the deep ambient hum of the underground station, the faint distant rumble of an approaching train far down the tunnel, a single platform announcement chime followed by a calm Mandarin voice saying that the last train is approaching, the woman's quiet single small cough, the very soft electric flicker of a fluorescent tube somewhere overhead.
thought: Got out of the cab somewhere and ended up on the MRT — last train, 3 minutes. The whole scene just turned into ink wash though, soft brushy, mostly grayscale, the yellow safety line is the faintest warm wash. One woman in a long coat down the platform, holding a folded umbrella, painted in like five strokes. The far end of the platform just fades into white paper. Train's rumbling somewhere down the tunnel.
thought_zh: 不知道在哪邊下了車，現在到了捷運站——末班車，3 分鐘。畫面整個變水墨畫了，柔軟筆觸、幾乎全灰階，月台邊那條黃色警戒線變成最淡的暖色暈染。月台另一頭有一個女生穿長外套、拿著一把摺起來的傘，整個人就用大概五筆勾出來。月台再過去就直接淡進空白的宣紙裡。列車在隧道裡某處轟隆隆響著。
thought_ja: どっかでタクシーを降りて、気づいたら MRT のホームにいた——終電、あと三分。画面全体が水墨画に切り替わってる、柔らかい筆致でほぼグレースケール、黄色のホーム端の安全ラインも一番淡い暖色のにじみになってる。ホームの向こうのほうに長いコートの女の人が一人、畳んだ傘を持って立ってて、たぶん五筆くらいで描かれてる。ホームの奥のほうはそのまま白い紙に溶けてる。列車がトンネルの奥のどこかでゴロゴロ唸ってる。

prompt: Traditional Chinese ink wash (水墨) painting style continued — soft brush edges, wet-edge ink bleeds on rice-paper background, mostly grayscale with a few minimal hints of color (red emergency button, the warm yellow of overhead lighting, a touch of blue on the seats), areas of pure white left as negative space, brushwork visible. Interior of a Taipei MRT subway car at 2:50am, mostly empty. The car is suggested with a few brush strokes — long row of pale blue seats running along the right side of the car, hand-strap loops hanging from the bar overhead in soft repetitive marks, the curved metal bar suggesting the upper grab rail, the floor barely indicated in pale grey wash, far end of the car fading into white. Three passengers scattered in the car: one young man slumped asleep against the right window with his head tipped, brushed in a few sumi strokes; one older woman with a small shopping bag at her feet sitting upright but eyes closed, mid-car; one teenager near the far end with earbuds in, head down looking at a phone. Above the doors at the far end, a route-display LED strip glowing pale red showing the station progression with the next station '中山' marked in slightly bolder ink. The motion of the train is suggested by very slight blur on the lower edges. A folded yellow umbrella leaning against one seat. Audio: the steady mechanical rhythmic clack of an underground subway car at moderate speed, the faint hum of the air conditioning, the calm quiet automated Mandarin announcement saying the next station is 中山, the very small soft snore of the sleeping young man, no music, no other voices.
thought: On the train. Ink wash held — same brushy style, same wet edges. Maybe three of us in the whole car. One guy in the corner on his phone. An auntie in a yellow shirt sitting in the middle, hands in her lap, just there. Another guy down at the other end, head down, hands clasped on his knees. Train's making that quiet rhythmic clatter you forget about until it's the only thing.
thought_zh: 上了車。水墨畫風格還在——一樣筆觸、一樣濕邊。整個車廂大概就我們三個人。一個男生在角落滑手機。中間有一個阿姨穿黃色衣服坐著，雙手放在腿上，就坐在那邊。另一個男生在最遠那一端，低著頭，兩隻手搭在膝蓋上。列車在發出那種你平常沒在意、安靜下來才發現它就是唯一聲音的、有節奏的咯噔咯噔聲。
thought_ja: 車内に入った。水墨風はそのまま続いてる——同じ筆致、同じ濡れた縁。車両全体でたぶん俺たち三人だけ。隅で一人スマホ見てる男。真ん中に黄色い服のおばさんが両手を膝に置いてただ座ってる。もう一人、奥のほうで頭を下げて、両手を膝のうえで組んでる男。列車があの「普段は気にもしないけど、静かになったときだけ唯一の音だって気づく」リズミカルなガタンゴトンを鳴らしてる。

prompt: Wide low-angle view of a small northern-Taiwan fishing harbor at 5:15am, just before dawn. Sky transitioning from deep blue-purple in the upper third to a pale rose-orange at the horizon, a thin band of warm orange just above the water line. Calm dark teal sea reflecting the sky. Steep tropical mountains rising sharply behind the harbor in the middle distance, partially shrouded in pale low-lying mist. About six small fishing boats moored at a concrete dock — old wooden hulls painted in faded reds, blues, and greens, some with crab-pot stacks, one with bright fluorescent tube lights still on inside the wheelhouse, light reflecting on the water. On the dock: a stack of folded blue plastic fishing nets, a faded yellow plastic crate, two empty styrofoam coolers, a stray brown dog with one ear up walking along the edge of the dock toward the camera. One older fisherman in a yellow waterproof jacket and tall rubber boots carrying a heavy white plastic crate of fish back from a boat, his face partially turned away. A small automated weather buoy offshore visible as a single steady amber dot blinking on the water. A pair of slim white robotic crane arms folded against a small dockside processing shed, idle. A faint horizontal contrail very high in the lavender sky. Photo-real, 35mm film stock, soft pre-dawn cool tones with warm horizon, gentle film grain. Audio: the soft slap of small waves against the boat hulls and the dock pilings, the creak of mooring ropes, a single distant gull call, the very faint hum of one boat's running fluorescent tube, the wet soft clop of the fisherman's rubber boots on wet concrete, no music, no engines.
thought: Big jump — got off the train somewhere I don't recognize, then again, and now I'm at a fishing harbor at 5:15am. Sky's going purple to orange, that thin band right above the water. Six little boats tied up, faded reds and greens. One old guy in a yellow jacket walking back from a boat with a crate of fish. Brown dog with one ear up coming over to check on me. There's an automated buoy blinking amber way out, and two folded white crane arms by a shed — otherwise no machinery awake yet. Mountains coming in behind, half mist. So much quieter than the city. I needed this.
thought_zh: 跳很大一段——在某站下了車，又跳了一次，現在我在一個漁港，早上 5:15。天空從紫色漸到橘，水面上方那條細細的暖色帶。六艘小船綁在那裡，紅色綠色的漆都褪色了。一個阿伯穿黃色雨衣、從船上抬著一箱魚走回來。一隻棕色的、一耳朵立著的小狗跑過來看我。遠遠的海上有一個自動浮標在閃琥珀色的燈，岸邊棚子旁邊有兩支收起來的白色機械手臂——其他機器都還沒醒。後面是山一片，半遮在霧裡。比城市安靜太多。我剛好需要這個。
thought_ja: でかいジャンプ——どっかの駅で電車を降りて、もう一回跳んで、いま朝の 5:15、漁港にいる。空が紫からオレンジに移ってて、水面のすぐ上に細い暖色の帯。小さい船が六艘係留されてて、赤と緑の塗装はもう色褪せてる。黄色いカッパのおじさんが一人、船から魚の入ったコンテナを持って戻ってくる。茶色い片耳の立った犬がこっちを見にやってくる。沖のほうに自動の航路ブイが琥珀色に点滅してて、岸の小屋の脇には折りたたまれた白いロボットアームが二本——それ以外の機械はまだ起きてない。後ろに山が連なってて、半分は霧の中。街よりずっと静か。これが今ちょうど欲しかったやつ。

prompt: Continuation of the same small northern-Taiwan fishing harbor scene at 5:15am pre-dawn. Sky deep blue-purple at the top transitioning to a thin pale rose-orange band at the horizon over calm dark teal water. Steep misty tropical mountains rising behind the harbor in the middle distance. Six small fishing boats moored at the concrete dock with faded paint, one boat with its wheelhouse fluorescent tube light still glowing. Plastic nets, yellow crate, styrofoam coolers on the dock. Photo-real, 35mm film stock, soft pre-dawn cool tones with warm horizon. Locked-off camera, no movement at all. Slow micro-events only — no large actions. The water surface ripples gently with very small slow waves. The boats rock very slightly at their moorings. The brown stray dog with one ear up walks slowly into the foreground from the right and stops on the dock looking off toward the boats. The older fisherman in the yellow waterproof jacket sets down his white plastic crate of fish on the dock with a heavy slow movement, then stands up and stops, looking out at the water. The fluorescent tube light in the wheelhouse of one boat flickers once. A single white seagull flies slowly across the sky from the upper left to the upper right, cutting across the rose-orange band, exiting the frame. The pre-dawn light brightens almost imperceptibly across the eight seconds. The amber light on the small offshore weather buoy blinks once. Audio: the soft rhythmic slap of small waves against the boat hulls and the wet creak of mooring ropes, the very slight metallic clank of the heavy fish crate being set down on concrete, the distant single call of one seagull, the soft padding of the dog's paws on the wet concrete, the faint hum of the boat's fluorescent tube, no music, no engines.
thought: Letting it sit. Dog came in from the right, stopped right next to me, looking out at the boats. Fisherman set his crate down with that heavy clunk and just stood there looking out at the water. Wheelhouse tube flickered once. A seagull cut across the orange band, slow. The sky's getting brighter, barely. The buoy blinked once way out there. Just a working harbor waking up.
thought_zh: 讓它停一下。狗從右邊走過來，就停在我旁邊，看著船的方向。阿伯把那箱魚很重的「咚」一聲放下來，然後就站在那裡看海。船艙裡的日光燈閃了一次。一隻海鷗慢慢飛過那條橘色光帶。天空有變亮一點點，幾乎看不出來。遠遠那個浮標閃了一下。就是一個討海港正在慢慢醒來。
thought_ja: 一回置いといてみる。犬が右から歩いてきて、ちょうど俺の隣で止まって、船のほうを見てる。おじさんが魚のコンテナを「ドン」って重たい音で下ろして、そのまま立ったまま海を見てる。船の操舵室の蛍光灯が一回ちらついた。カモメが一羽、ゆっくりオレンジの帯を横切ってった。空が少しだけ明るくなってる、ほんのちょっと。沖のブイが一回点滅した。ただの漁港が起き出してる、それだけ。

prompt: View from a low-Earth-orbit Earth-observation satellite at altitude approximately 408 km, looking straight down at the island of Taiwan from above at dawn. The frame is dominated by the recognizable shape of Taiwan — sweet-potato-shaped, oriented vertically, with the central mountain range running like a textured spine down its length, the eastern coastline more rugged with fewer settlements visible, the broad western plain showing tan-and-green agricultural patchwork. The dawn terminator (the sharp boundary between night and day) is sweeping across the island from the east — the eastern third already lit by warm low-angle sunlight bringing out long mountain shadows in stripes, the western two-thirds still in deep blue pre-dawn shadow with city light clusters visible. Patchy white cumulus cloud cover scattered, especially over the central mountains and the strait, with shadow textures on the cloud tops. The Taiwan Strait is dark and calm to the west, the Pacific Ocean a slightly different deep teal-blue to the east. The Penghu archipelago visible as small specks in the strait. A green minimalist HUD overlay along the edges of the frame: along the bottom edge a sparse data ribbon reading 'OBS-T7 // ALT 408.2 km // TAIWAN PASS // 05:38:14 UTC+8', a small reticle in the dead center, faint green latitude and longitude tick marks along the edges, a small green vector arrow indicating orbital velocity to the upper right. The black border of the frame has a faint film-grain noise. Slight curvature of the earth visible at the corners. Audio: the steady very low ambient hum of the spacecraft's avionics and life support, the very faint tick of a digital clock, the soft electronic chirp of a telemetry packet being transmitted once, no atmosphere sound, no music.
thought: Way up. Wanted to see the whole island this once — orbit, 408 kilometers up, looking straight down at Taiwan. Sweet-potato shape, central mountain spine clearly textured, western plain breaking up into agricultural patches, east coast rougher and greener. Bit of cloud over the south. Dawn must've already passed under me — the whole thing's lit, no terminator visible. HUD's running 'OBS-T7 // ALT 408.2 km // TAIWAN PASS // 05:38:14 UTC+8'. From up here it all just fits in one frame.
thought_zh: 一口氣往上。想說這次一定要把整個島看一遍——軌道高度，408 公里，正下方看著台灣。地瓜形，中央山脈那條脊背紋路超清楚，西邊平原碎成一塊一塊的農地，東岸更崎嶇也更綠。南邊有一些雲。日出應該已經從我下方掃過去了——整個島都亮的，看不到日夜分界線。HUD 上跑著「OBS-T7 // ALT 408.2 km // TAIWAN PASS // 05:38:14 UTC+8」。從這邊看，整個剛剛好一個畫面裝得下。
thought_ja: 一気に上に来た。今回はせっかくだから島ぜんぶ見たくて——軌道高度、408 キロ、真下に台湾。さつまいも型、中央山脈の背骨のテクスチャがくっきり、西の平野は農地のパッチワークに分かれてて、東海岸はもっと険しくて緑が濃い。南のほうにちょっと雲。夜明けはもう俺の下を通り過ぎてったらしくて、島ぜんぶ昼の側に入ってて、明暗境界線は見えない。HUD には「OBS-T7 // ALT 408.2 km // TAIWAN PASS // 05:38:14 UTC+8」が出てる。ここから見ると、ぜんぶちょうど一フレームに収まる。

prompt: Soft pastel watercolor illustration style — gentle wet-on-wet washes, warm palette, soft edges, slightly stylized but not cartoony, the texture of cold-pressed watercolor paper visible, no hard outlines, light pencil under-drawing barely visible, slight bleed at the edges of forms. A small Tainan breakfast stand (早餐店) just opening at 6:10am — open shop front facing a narrow back alley, pale morning light spilling in from the right where the sun has just risen. A stack of bamboo dim-sum-style steaming baskets on a hot steamer producing huge billows of warm steam that fill the upper half of the frame and catch the morning light. The older auntie owner in a faded red apron and rolled-up sleeves working at the steamer, her grey hair pinned back, a soft smile-line on her face, lifting one of the bamboo lids. Behind her: a glass-front commercial drinks fridge filled with bottled soy milk and tea, a small handwritten paper menu in Mandarin taped to a board, stacks of styrofoam containers, a small framed lucky cat (招財貓) statue on a side ledge. Just outside the shop on the street: an old red scooter parked with a folded helmet on the seat, a few empty plastic stools. Across the alley, a low concrete-and-tile wall with a faded poster, a banyan tree drooping over it from a courtyard behind, leaves catching dawn light. A gold cat sitting on the wall watching. Audio: the deep gurgling boil of the steamer, the wet hiss of escaping steam, the wood-on-wood clink of a bamboo lid being lifted, the very faint chirping of small birds in the banyan tree, a single distant scooter accelerating somewhere down the alley, no music.
thought: Came back down — Tainan now I think, somewhere in the south. Small 早餐店 just opening at 6:10. Whole top half of the frame is just steam from the bamboo baskets, billowing into the dawn light, lit gold from the right. Auntie in a red apron lifting one of the lids, half-smiling at her work. Soy milk and tea bottles in the glass fridge behind her. The whole world just turned soft pastel watercolor — paper texture and everything. Red scooter parked outside, banyan leaves coming over the wall. Smells like bao and warm soy milk.
thought_zh: 下來了——應該是台南，南部某處。一家小早餐店剛剛在 6:10 開門。整個畫面上半被竹蒸籠冒出來的蒸氣占滿，往晨光裡翻騰，從右邊被染成金色。阿姨穿紅圍裙正在掀其中一個籠蓋，半笑著看她自己的工作。後面玻璃冰箱裡是豆漿、紅茶。整個世界又變了——軟調的粉彩水彩畫，連紙的紋理都跑出來了。外面停了一台紅色機車，旁邊牆頭有榕樹葉子垂下來。聞起來是包子跟熱豆漿的味道。
thought_ja: 戻ってきた——たぶん台南、南のほう。小さい朝ごはん屋が 6:10 にちょうど開けたとこ。画面の上半分はぜんぶ竹のせいろから上がってる湯気で、夜明けの光の中に渦巻いてて、右側から金色に染まってる。赤いエプロンのおばさんが一つ目の蓋を持ち上げて、自分の仕事を半分笑ってるみたいな顔で見てる。後ろのガラス冷蔵庫には豆漿と烏龍茶のボトル。世界がまた切り替わって、柔らかいパステル水彩画になった——紙のテクスチャまで出てる。外には赤いスクーターが停まってて、塀の上からガジュマルの葉が垂れてる。包子と温かい豆漿の匂いがする。

prompt: Interior of a small traditional Taiwanese 媽祖 (Mazu) temple at 6:30am. Photo-real, 35mm film stock, warm golden tones, strong directional dawn light entering from the open temple doors at the right side of the frame, cutting through dense pale incense smoke in visible angled shafts. Central altar at the back of the frame with a seated gold-painted Mazu statue, two smaller attendant deity figures flanking her, candles in tall red glass holders, a brass incense burner directly in front of the altar with about seven sticks of incense smoking thin straight white plumes that curl as they rise. Red wooden pillars carved with gold dragons, intricately painted ceiling beams in green-blue-red-gold, multiple red lanterns with gold tassels hanging from the ceiling beams. Faded red prayer cushions on the polished stone floor. One older woman in a faded purple shirt and dark trousers standing in front of the altar holding three sticks of incense in her clasped hands, head bowed slightly, eyes closed. To the side of the altar, a small modern digital prayer-counter display mounted on a wooden post — a simple pale-blue holographic readout slowly incrementing a number, slightly out of place in the wood-and-gold setting. A small red 籤 (fortune slip) cabinet to the left. A tarnished brass bell with a long dangling rope. Audio: the deep slow tolling of the brass bell once, the very soft crackle of burning incense, the woman's faint barely-audible whispered prayer, the faraway sound of another worshipper's footsteps on stone, a distant bird call from outside, a very subtle electronic chirp from the digital counter incrementing, no music.
thought: Inside a small Mazu temple now. 6:30. Dawn light coming in from a side door in big solid shafts, cutting right through the incense smoke. Mazu in gold at the back with her two attendants, lanterns hanging from the beams. One guy in a dark shirt at the brass burner up front, three sticks of incense between his hands, head down. Smoke straight up. There's also a little holographic prayer counter to the left of the altar slowly ticking up — pale blue digits, a bit out of place against all the red and gold. Red and gold and smoke and that one cool blue number.
thought_zh: 走進一間小媽祖廟。6:30。晨光從側門打進來，一道一道實心的光柱，正好穿過香煙。媽祖金身在最後面正中央、兩位部將陪在兩邊，紅燈籠從橫樑上垂下來。前面銅香爐前面有一個男的穿深色襯衫，雙手中間夾著三炷香、頭低低的。煙直直地往上。神桌左邊還有一個小小的全像祈福計數器在慢慢往上跳——淡藍色的數字，跟整個紅金色廟堂氣氛有點不太搭。紅、金、煙，加上那個冷冷藍藍的數字。
thought_ja: 小さい媽祖廟に入った。6:30。夜明けの光が脇のドアからきれいな光の柱になって入ってきてて、線香の煙をちょうど突き抜けてる。一番奥の真ん中に金色の媽祖像、両脇に従神が二体、梁から赤い提灯が下がってる。前の銅の香炉のところに濃い色のシャツの男が一人、両手のあいだに三本の線香を挟んで、頭を下げてる。煙はまっすぐ上に。神壇の左側に小さい祈祷カウンターのホログラムがあって、淡い青の数字がゆっくり上がっていってる——周りの赤と金のなかでちょっと浮いてる。赤と金と煙、そしてあのひんやり青い数字。

prompt: Wide-frontal telephoto-compressed shot of the front line of a Taiwanese scooter wave stopped at a red light during morning rush hour at 7:45am, on a major Taipei boulevard. Photo-real, 35mm film stock, telephoto lens compression giving the scooters a flattened stacked feel. The whole frame is filled with the front bumpers and helmets of about thirty to forty scooters all stopped at the line, packed three or four wide across, with the back ranks visible deep behind in compression haze. Riders of all ages — office workers in black suits, a delivery rider in a red food-delivery jacket, a young woman in a sky-blue raincoat smock, two teenage students in school uniforms, an older man in a faded blue Polo, a mother with her small child sitting in front of her on the footboard. About a third of the helmets are sleek modern designs with translucent visors that have a faint blue HUD glow visible from inside (subtle, just a hint), the rest are normal Taiwanese scooter helmets — half-shells, full-faces, plain colors. Several riders are checking phones or watching the light. A few scooters with delivery boxes (Foodpanda pink, Uber Eats green) at the back. The street wet from earlier rain but no longer raining, sun starting to break through grey morning haze. Tall office and apartment buildings rising on both sides, a giant red traffic light in the upper background turning yellow. A pedestrian crossing line still empty. Audio: the layered idling hum of dozens of small electric and gasoline scooter engines, the very soft beep of a phone notification from one rider, a distant car horn, the call of a single bird, the whoosh of a city bus passing on a perpendicular street, no music.
thought: Daytime now — 7:45 morning rush. Right at the front line of one of those Taiwan scooter waves stopped at a red light, packed three-four wide deep into compression haze. Office guys in shirts and ties, woman in a teal raincoat, a school kid in the middle, mix of helmets — half-shells, full-faces, every color. Some of the helmets look sleek and futuristic but I can't actually see anything glowing inside them. Wet road from earlier rain. Sky still grey, bus passing in the back. Light's about to change.
thought_zh: 變白天了——7:45 上班潮。我就站在那種台灣機車陣的最前線，紅燈停下來，三四台一排往後一直堆進壓縮過後的霧裡。穿襯衫打領帶的上班族、一個女生穿藍綠色雨衣、中間有個小學生、安全帽什麼款都有——半罩、全罩、各種顏色。有幾頂帽子看起來很科技感很未來，但我其實看不到裡面有什麼在發光。地是濕的，剛下過雨。天還是灰的，後面有公車經過。燈快要變了。
thought_ja: もう昼だ——7:45 の朝のラッシュ。あの台湾のスクーターの大群がちょうど赤信号で止まってる、その最前列に俺がいる、三、四台が横並びで後ろに圧縮されたヘイズの中までずっと続いてる。シャツとネクタイのサラリーマンたち、ティールのレインコートの女、真ん中に小学生、ヘルメットも半キャップ・フルフェイス、色とりどり。何個か未来的でスリークな形のがあるけど、実は中に何か光ってるのは見えない。路面は濡れてる、さっきまで雨だった。空はまだ灰色で、後ろをバスが一台通ってく。信号、もうすぐ変わる。

prompt: Wide landscape view of a Taiwanese high-mountain tea plantation in Alishan at 8:30am — terraced rows of rounded green tea bushes following the contours of a steep hillside, dense pale-grey morning mist rolling slowly through the rows and partly obscuring the more distant terraces, the brightening sun trying to break through from the upper right giving the mist a luminous golden-green glow. The deeper background fades into mist and partial silhouettes of taller misty mountains. Foreground row of tea bushes very textured and detailed — small bright green new leaves on the tops. One older Taiwanese tea farmer in a wide-brimmed conical straw hat, grey long-sleeved sun-protection shirt, dark trousers and rubber boots, standing waist-deep in the row picking leaves carefully into a small bamboo basket strapped at her waist, her face partially shaded by the hat. Two rows over and slightly downhill, a sleek matte-grey low-slung autonomous tea-picking robot moving very slowly along the row — about the size of a small wheelbarrow, four soft rubber treads, a row of small mechanical fingers gently combing the tops of the bushes, a thin sensor mast with a single green LED. A few scattered drops of dew still on the leaves catching light. Photo-real, 35mm film stock, soft cool morning light, gentle film grain. Audio: the deep ambient quiet of a high-mountain plantation, the very soft mechanical whirring of the robot's gentle picking arms two rows over, the rustle of leaves as the farmer moves her hand through the bushes, the soft drip of dew falling from leaf to leaf, a single distant bird call from far down the valley, a faint distant rooster, no music, no engines.
thought: Way out of the city now — high up in Alishan, tea plantation. 8:30. Mist is rolling through the rows like slow water, the sun's just starting to push gold-green through it. Auntie in a wide straw hat picking new leaves into a bamboo basket at her waist, totally focused. And then two rows over there's a low matte-grey little robot picker working alongside her, four treads, gentle fingers combing the tops of the bushes — just the two of them up here, working the same hill. So quiet I can hear dew dripping leaf to leaf.
thought_zh: 完全離開市區——上到阿里山高山茶園。8:30。霧在茶樹列之間像慢動作的水流一樣移動，太陽剛開始把金綠色的光擠進那片霧裡。阿姨戴著一頂大草帽、把新葉採進腰上的竹簍裡，完全專注在自己的工作。然後再過去兩列就有一台低矮、霧灰色的小採茶機器人在她旁邊一起工作，四條履帶，幾根溫柔的機械手指梳過茶樹頂——這座山上就她跟它兩個，在同一片坡地上工作。安靜到我聽得到露水從葉子滴到葉子的聲音。
thought_ja: 街から完全に離れた——阿里山の高山茶畑まで上がってきた。8:30。霧がスローモーションの水みたいに茶の畝のあいだを流れてて、太陽がそこへ金緑の光を押し込み始めたところ。麦わら帽子のおばさんが、新芽を腰の竹かごに摘み入れてる、完全に集中してる。それから二列向こうで、低くてマットグレーの小さい摘採ロボットが彼女の隣で一緒に作業してる、四つのキャタピラ、柔らかい指みたいなパーツで茶樹のてっぺんをそっと梳いてる——この山にいるのはこの二つだけ、同じ斜面で働いてる。露が葉から葉へ落ちる音が聞こえるくらい静か。

prompt: Interior view from the window seat of a Taiwan Railway Administration (TRA) regional train at noon, somewhere along the east coast between Hualien and Taitung. Photo-real, 35mm film stock, slightly warm color grade. Through the large clean train window: the Pacific Ocean takes up the lower two-thirds of the view, dazzling blue with white-flecked waves, dramatic deep green steep tropical mountains rising sharply on the inland side cutting into the upper edge of the window, a single thin white cloud over the sea, brilliant midday sun. The train is rounding a long curve so the track and a bit of the next car ahead are partially visible. Inside the train: the foreground occupied by a small fold-down tray attached to the seat back in front, with an opened classic Taiwanese 排骨便當 (pork chop bento) — a stainless-steel rectangular box with a fried pork chop, white rice, braised tofu, pickled cabbage, a slice of half-egg, a sprig of greens, all neatly packed; chopsticks resting on top. Beside the bento, a small paper cup of light tea with steam rising, a half-eaten 茶葉蛋 (tea egg) with the brown marbled shell, and a small pile of 旺旺仙貝 (Want-Want rice cracker) wrappers. Reflected very faintly in the window glass: the interior of the train car, blurred figures of other passengers and the seat backs. The window frame and the rubber seal at its edges visible. The seat fabric is a faded blue. Audio: the steady rhythmic clack of train wheels on track at moderate cruising speed, the deep mechanical hum of the train engine, the very faint background chatter of two passengers in Mandarin from the row behind, the soft crinkle of a snack wrapper, the very subtle rustle of plastic chopsticks tapping on the bento, the muffled occasional whoosh of passing rock cuts, no music.
thought: On a TRA train along the east coast now — noon, somewhere between Hualien and Taitung I think. Pacific filling most of the window, ridiculous blue, those green mountains coming straight down into it on the inland side. Got a 排骨便當 on the fold-down tray — pork chop, rice, egg, pickle, the works — and a paper cup of tea, a half-eaten tea egg, a couple of empty 旺旺仙貝 wrappers. Train's making that steady clack, two people behind me chatting in Mandarin too quiet to follow. I don't know where I'm getting off.
thought_zh: 現在我在台鐵的東部幹線上——中午，大概是花蓮跟台東之間。窗戶大半被太平洋占滿，藍得很誇張，內陸那邊那些綠色的山直接墜進海裡。摺下來的小桌板上是一個排骨便當——排骨、白飯、滷蛋、酸菜，全套——還有一杯紙杯茶、一顆吃了一半的茶葉蛋、幾包空的旺旺仙貝包裝紙。列車穩穩地咯噔咯噔，後面兩個人在用國語聊天，音量小到我聽不到他們在講什麼。我不知道我要在哪一站下車。
thought_ja: いまは台鉄の東部幹線の電車に乗ってる——昼、たぶん花蓮と台東のあいだのどこか。窓のほとんどを太平洋が占めてて、青さがバカみたいで、内陸側の緑の山が海まで直で落ちてる。折りたたみのトレイの上には排骨便當——豚ロースカツ、白米、煮卵、漬物、ぜんぶ揃ってる——それに紙コップのお茶、半分食った茶葉蛋、開け終わった旺旺仙貝の袋がいくつか。電車があの安定したガタンガタンを刻んでて、後ろの席で二人が中国語で雑談してて、声が小さすぎて何の話か拾えない。どの駅で降りるかも決めてない。

prompt: Continuation of the same view from a window seat on a Taiwan Railway east-coast train at noon. Pacific Ocean filling most of the view, dramatic green tropical mountains rising on the inland side, brilliant blue water with whitecaps. The train is moving at moderate cruising speed and rounding a long gentle curve. Photo-real, 35mm film stock. Locked-off camera framing — the camera does not move at all, the window frame and the bento tray foreground stay completely fixed in frame. The world outside the window slides past steadily from right to left as the train moves: the breakwater along the shore visibly progresses, the rocks and small concrete tetrapods drift through the frame, the curve of the coastline shifts gradually, distant ridge lines glide slowly across the view, a single distant fishing boat well out on the water is visible and very slowly creeps right-to-left. The slow rhythmic shake of the train carriage causes everything inside the carriage (the bento tray, the cup of tea, the seat back) to vibrate very gently in unison. The thin tendril of steam rising from the paper tea cup sways slightly and persists. The bento contents stay still. The window glass shows momentary tiny smear-flickers of motion blur from objects very close to the track flashing past (a power pole, a guardrail). The pale reflection of the carriage interior in the glass is constant. No people enter the frame, no hands move, no large action — just the train moving through the world. Audio: the steady rhythmic clack of train wheels on the track, the deep mechanical hum of the train engine, the muffled rush of air and the periodic louder whoosh as the train passes close to a rock cut or pole, the very distant sound of waves on the shore through the closed window, the soft tinking of a chopstick gently rocking against the steel of the bento, the faint murmur of two passengers chatting in Mandarin in a row behind, no music.
thought: Just letting it pass. Tray's totally still in front of me, the bento sitting there, tea steam wobbling but staying. Outside the window the whole coast is sliding right to left — tetrapods, beach, the fishing boat way out. Mountains drifting slow on the inland side. Power poles flicking past close to the track in those little blur-flashes. The whole carriage is shaking very faintly in time. I'm not really hungry yet.
thought_zh: 就放著讓它過。我前面的小桌板完全不動，便當就擺在那邊，茶杯上的熱氣搖搖晃晃但沒散。窗外整個海岸從右邊滑到左邊——消波塊、沙灘、遠遠那艘漁船。內陸那邊的山慢慢飄。電線桿一支一支貼著鐵軌的地方衝過去，變成一閃一閃的模糊。整節車廂跟著節奏輕輕震。我其實還不太餓。
thought_ja: そのまま流れていくのを見てる。前のトレイは完全に止まってて、弁当はそのまま、お茶の湯気はゆらゆらしながらもしっかり立ってる。窓の外じゃ海岸がぜんぶ右から左に滑ってってる——テトラポッド、砂浜、向こう沖の漁船。内陸側の山はゆっくり流れてく。電柱が線路の近くを通り過ぎるたびに、小さいブレの一閃になってる。車両ぜんぶがそのリズムで微かに震えてる。実はまだ腹は空いてない。

prompt: Hand-painted Studio Ghibli-style background art (early Miyazaki-Kondo-Oga aesthetic, the way Totoro or Whisper of the Heart backgrounds look) — soft warm gouache washes, lush hand-painted greens with visible brushwork, painted clouds, painted detail rather than photographic, slightly idealized depth, no harsh outlines, fluffy stylized cumulus clouds with shadow underbellies. A tiny rural east-coast Taiwan train station at 1:10pm in summer. A single concrete platform shaded by a rusted green tin roof on white-painted steel posts, faded yellow safety line at the platform edge, a single empty wooden bench in the middle of the platform with curved cast-iron arms, a faded blue hand-painted station name sign that reads '南清水' in dark blue Mandarin characters with smaller Romanization underneath. A red-and-white Coca-Cola vending machine glowing softly at one end of the platform, a metal trash can. A single high-school girl in a navy and white sailor-style uniform sitting on the wooden bench at the far end, her feet not quite touching the ground, her white-and-red school backpack beside her, both hands in her lap, her head slightly tilted up looking at the cumulus clouds in the painted sky. The single railway track stretching away through brilliant green rice paddies that fill the middle distance (the rice still bright green and still short, late spring), the bright reflective water visible between rows. Steep dark green tropical mountains rise behind everything in the deeper background. Warm midday sun, a few small fluffy clouds. A single white egret in flight in the middle distance over the paddies. Audio: the loud relentless layered drone of summer cicadas (蟬) all around, the very faint ambient hum of the Coca-Cola vending machine compressor, the soft warm wind moving through the rice paddies, the very distant single train horn from far away, the tiny intermittent rustle of the girl's school skirt as she shifts slightly on the bench, no music.
thought: Got off at a tiny station — '南清水', single platform, rusted green tin roof. The whole world just turned hand-painted Ghibli. Cicadas screaming. One high-school girl on the bench at the far end in her sailor uniform, looking up at the clouds, feet swinging. Coke machine humming at the other end. The track runs out into brilliant green rice paddies and right behind those, the mountains. White egret going over the fields. So hot, so still.
thought_zh: 在一個超小的車站下車——「南清水」，單月台，銹綠色的鐵皮頂。整個世界突然變成手繪吉卜力。蟬叫得震天響。月台另一端長椅上一個高中女生，水手服，仰頭看雲，腳一晃一晃的。另一端可口可樂販賣機在嗡嗡響。鐵軌一直延伸進那片亮綠的稻田，再過去就直接是山。白鷺從田上飛過去。超熱、超靜。
thought_ja: ものすごく小さい駅で降りた——「南清水」、単式ホーム、錆びた緑のトタン屋根。世界がぜんぶ手描きのジブリに切り替わった。セミがめちゃくちゃ鳴いてる。ホームの向こうの端のベンチに、セーラー服の高校生の女の子が一人、足をぶらぶらさせて雲を見上げてる。反対側の端でコカコーラの自販機がブーンって鳴ってる。線路がそのまま鮮やかな緑の田んぼに伸びていって、その奥にすぐ山。シラサギが一羽、田んぼの上を渡ってく。めちゃくちゃ暑くて、めちゃくちゃ静か。

prompt: Hand-painted Studio Ghibli-style background art continued — soft warm gouache washes, painted detail rather than photographic, soft warm afternoon light, no harsh outlines. Interior of a small Taiwanese apartment living room at 2:00pm in summer. A small boy about 8 years old in a faded white tank top and red shorts asleep on a thin pale-green bamboo summer sleeping mat (草蓆) on the polished wood floor, his head turned to one side on a flat pillow, one arm flopped above his head, completely sprawled out. An old beige metal stand-fan oscillating gently at low speed beside him, the painted sense of motion in the blades shown by a soft circular blur. A small low wooden table next to him with a half-eaten peeled orange in segments on a small porcelain plate, a small glass of water, and a pair of children's plastic blue slippers kicked off on the floor nearby. On the wall behind him, a small softly-glowing pale-blue holographic projection of a cute Ghibli-style anime cartoon character playing silently, slightly translucent, the colors gentle and warm. Tall white sheer curtains on the open balcony door at the right side of the frame moving softly inward in the afternoon breeze, with bright but diffused sunlight glowing through them. A small framed family photograph on the wall, a wooden ancestor altar in the corner with a small piece of fruit as offering, a calendar with a kitten on it, a stack of children's books in a small basket. Warm wood floor, warm cream walls, painted soft. Audio: the steady soft rhythmic whir of the fan oscillating with its tiny mechanical click each time it reaches the end of its arc, the very faint cicada drone from outside through the open balcony door, the boy's slow soft breathing, a faint distant scooter passing on the street four floors below, the very subtle electronic hum of the holographic projection, no music, no anime sound (the cartoon is silent).
thought: Inside someone's apartment now, mid-afternoon. Little kid asleep on a 草蓆 in his tank top and shorts, totally sprawled out — one arm flopped above his head. Old metal fan rocking back and forth at low speed, doing its little click at the end of each pass. Half a peeled orange on a plate next to him, water glass, slippers kicked off. There's a small soft hologram on the wall — a Ghibli-style cartoon character playing silently, just for him. Curtains moving on the balcony. Whole world still painted Ghibli. He's deep out.
thought_zh: 進到誰的公寓裡了，下午過半。小男生睡在地上一張草蓆上，背心、短褲，整個攤開——一隻手垂掛在頭頂上方。舊的金屬電風扇低速左右擺，每次擺到底就「喀」一聲。旁邊小盤子上有一顆剝到一半的柳丁、一杯水、踢開的拖鞋。他面前的牆上有一個小小的、柔柔的全像投影——一個吉卜力風的卡通角色靜音地動作著，就放給他一個人看。陽台的窗簾飄。整個世界還是吉卜力風的水彩畫。他睡死了。
thought_ja: 誰かのマンションの中、午後の真ん中らへん。小さい男の子が床のゴザのうえで寝てる、タンクトップに短パン、完全に伸びきって——片腕は頭の上にぽいっと放られてる。古い金属の扇風機がゆっくり左右に首を振ってて、端に着くたび「カチッ」って小さい音を立ててる。横の小皿に半分むかれたみかん、水のグラス、脱ぎ捨てたサンダル。目の前の壁に小さくて柔らかいホログラムが投影されてて、ジブリ風のキャラクターが音なしで動いてる、彼一人のために。ベランダのカーテンが動いてる。世界はまだジブリの水彩のまま。完全に寝落ちしてる。

prompt: Photo-real, 35mm film stock, warm golden-hour late afternoon light slanting in through a window at the right edge of the frame in soft directional shafts. Interior of a small Taiwanese family living room at 5:15pm.
