A square folding mahjong table set up in the center of the room with four older Taiwanese men, all in their late 60s to 70s, seated around it mid-game, walls of green-and-cream mahjong tiles built up in front of each player, small piles of discarded tiles in the center of the table, a small porcelain teacup at each player's elbow, a half-empty bottle of Taiwan Beer on the table, three small stacks of red plastic 100-NT chips. The man in the foreground wears a thin grey polo and is holding two tiles in his right hand about to discard, leaning back. The man on the left wears a white tank top and grey trousers, smoking a cigarette held in the corner of his mouth, frowning at his rack with concentration. The man across the table has a faded Adidas T-shirt, his face partially in shadow. The fourth man at right is laughing and reaching for his teacup. Above the center of the table hovers a small minimal floating holographic display about the size of a hand, slightly translucent pale-blue digits showing the running point counts of the four players in numbered columns, a tiny round-counter '東 場' indicator, the display gently bobbing. A wood-bladed ceiling fan rotates slowly overhead. On the side wall: a small ancestor altar in the corner with two small red electric LED candles glowing, an old framed black-and-white wedding photograph, a calendar with a 媽祖 image, a wood cabinet with a glass door full of small porcelain. A small dog sleeping curled up on a worn floral cushion in the lower-left corner. Audio: the sharp distinctive clack of a mahjong tile being placed down on the table, the steady soft swirl of mixed tiles between rounds, the layered low chatter of all four men talking in Taiwanese (台語) mixed with Mandarin, occasional bursts of laughter, the gentle creak of the wooden ceiling fan, the very subtle electronic hum of the holographic score display, the rumble of a far-off scooter outside, no music.
thought: Late afternoon now, somebody's living room. Four old guys around a mahjong table mid-game, walls of tiles up, tiles spread in the middle. Lefty in a tank top, the others in polos, all leaning in on their racks. Up on the back wall there's a blue-and-white score display tracking everybody's points — feels like an upgrade from the old paper. Little altar in the corner with two red electric candles glowing, 媽祖 calendar on the right wall. Golden light coming in from the doorway. They're all talking 台語 over each other, can't follow it.
thought_zh: 下午晚一點，某個人家的客廳。四個阿伯圍著一張麻將桌打到一半，每個人前面都疊著一面牌牆，中間散著一堆牌。左手邊那個穿背心，其他三個穿 polo 衫，全部都往自己的牌前面探。後面牆上有一台藍白的計分顯示器在記每個人的分數——感覺是從以前用紙記分升級來的。角落小神桌上兩根電子蠟燭亮著紅紅的，右邊牆上一張媽祖的月曆。金色光從門口斜進來。他們四個一起講台語講到滿出來，我跟不上。
thought_ja: 午後遅め、誰かの家の居間。四人の小父さんが麻雀卓を囲んでて、ゲーム中盤、それぞれの前に牌の壁が立ってて、真ん中に捨て牌が広がってる。左の人はタンクトップ、ほかの三人はポロシャツ、全員が自分の手牌のほうに前のめり。後ろの壁に青と白のスコア表示が出てて、各自の点数を追跡してる——昔の紙の点棒からのアップグレードって感じ。隅の小さい神棚に赤い電気のろうそくが二本灯ってて、右の壁に媽祖のカレンダー。入り口から金色の光が斜めに差し込んでくる。四人とも一斉に台語でしゃべってて、追いつけない。

prompt: Photo-real, 35mm film stock, beautiful blue-hour just-after-sunset light at 6:35pm. Wide cinematic view from the rooftop of a 5-story Taipei walk-up apartment building. Foreground: the textured rooftop itself, a stainless-steel water tank on stilts, a tangle of black antenna poles, a few rusted satellite dishes, a clothesline strung between two poles with three white t-shirts and a pair of socks still hanging out and gently moving in the warm evening breeze, a couple of overturned plastic stools, a small potted basil plant, a metal bucket with rainwater in it. Middle ground: the rooftops of densely packed Taipei buildings extending in waves to the horizon, a forest of more water tanks and antennas, lights starting to come on in apartment windows in dots and rectangles of warm yellow, the occasional cooler blue glow of a screen. Far middle ground: Taipei 101 rises majestically in the right-center of the frame, its lights just beginning to turn on segment by segment, the iconic stacked-pagoda silhouette against the deep teal-purple sky. The sky is a glorious gradient — deep teal-purple at the top fading down through dusty pink-orange at the horizon where the last warmth of the just-set sun glows softly behind low clouds. A thin line of bats or birds darting in silhouette across the sky. Lower right: a single small drone with a green position light hovering very far away, almost a dot. Audio: the soft warm evening breeze passing through the antennas making a faint humming whistle, a layered distant city ambience of muffled traffic far below, the very faint domestic sounds rising from one open apartment window — a TV, kids' voices, a wok being hit twice — the steady distant hum of urban life, no specific music, no traffic horns close.
thought: Up on a rooftop somewhere in Taipei, that 5-story walk-up kind. 6:35, just after sunset. Blue hour. Foreground all those Taipei rooftop things — water tank on stilts, antennas, a clothesline still up with shirts on it, a basil plant in a pot, an overturned stool. Then rooftops in waves out to the horizon and 101 is right there, lighting up section by section against a sky that's going from teal-purple at the top down to dusty pink-orange where the sun just went. There's still a t-shirt on the line moving. Good day's happening down in those apartment lights — kids, a wok hitting something, a TV.
thought_zh: 上來台北某棟五樓老公寓的頂樓。6:35，剛日落，藍色時刻。前景就是台北頂樓會有的東西——架在腳架上的不銹鋼水塔、各種天線、還掛著衣服沒收的曬衣繩、一盆九層塔、一張倒扣的塑膠椅。後面整片屋頂一波一波延到地平線，101 就在那邊，一段一段把燈點亮，背後天空從上面深的青紫色一路漸到剛剛太陽落下那邊霧霧的粉橘色。曬衣繩上一件 T 恤還在飄。底下那些公寓窗燈裡都在過著一個還不錯的傍晚——小孩、有人在敲鍋子、電視。
thought_ja: 台北のどっかの五階建ての徒歩アパートの屋上に上がってきた。6:35、ちょうど日没後、ブルーアワー。手前には台北の屋上にあるあらゆるもの——脚立で持ち上げたステンレスの貯水タンク、アンテナだらけ、まだ服が干しっぱなしの物干し、鉢植えのバジル、ひっくり返ったプラスチックの椅子。それから屋根が波みたいに地平線まで連なってて、101 がちょうどそこにあって、一段ずつ点灯していってる、空はてっぺんの深い青紫から下のほうの、太陽が沈んだあたりの霞んだピンクオレンジまでグラデになってる。物干しの T シャツがまだ風に揺れてる。下のアパートの灯りの中ではみんなまあまあ良い夕方を過ごしてる——子どもたち、誰かが鍋を叩く音、テレビ。

prompt: Continuation of the same Taipei rooftop blue-hour view at 6:35pm just after sunset. Photo-real, 35mm film stock. Foreground rooftop with stainless-steel water tank on stilts, antennas, clothesline with three white t-shirts and a pair of socks gently swaying, an overturned plastic stool, a metal bucket. Middle ground: dense Taipei rooftops with warm apartment lights coming on. Taipei 101 in the right-center of the frame against the deep teal-purple-to-dusty-pink sky. Locked-off camera, no movement at all. Slow micro-events only — no large actions. The sky imperceptibly deepens across the eight seconds, the pink-orange band at the horizon thinning slightly. Lights in apartment windows continue to come on one or two at a time as small dots and rectangles of warm yellow appear in the middle-ground buildings. Taipei 101's lights advance, two more vertical segments illuminating across the duration of the clip. The hanging t-shirts on the clothesline sway gently in the breeze, never strongly. The metal bucket with rainwater holds a still mirror reflection of the sky. A small cluster of three or four bats or swallows in silhouette darts across the sky from left to right at moderate speed and exits. The very far-off green position light of a single small drone hovering miles away blinks once. No people enter the frame. Audio: the soft sustained warm evening breeze whistling faintly through the antennas, the layered ambient city hum from far below, the muffled distant clang of a wok being struck once and once more from one apartment, faint kids' voices and a TV news broadcast in Mandarin from another apartment too distant to make out, a single very far-off scooter accelerating away, the gentle creak of a t-shirt clip on the clothesline moving once, no music.
thought: I'm just gonna sit up here. Sky's getting deeper, that orange band thinning. More apartment lights coming on in the middle distance, one or two at a time. 101's lit up two more segments since I sat down. T-shirts on the line still swaying soft. Some bats just cut across the sky. Somebody's hitting a wok somewhere. Long day — went from 2am all the way through to here. Okay, that's a day. Putting it down.
thought_zh: 我就坐在這上面。天色越來越深，那條橘色光帶越來越細。中景那邊的公寓窗燈一兩盞一兩盞地亮起來。我坐下來之後 101 又多點亮了兩段。曬衣繩上的 T 恤還在輕輕晃。剛剛幾隻蝙蝠掠過天空。有人不知道在哪裡又敲了一下鍋。今天好長——從凌晨兩點一路到現在。OK，今天就先到這裡吧。我先放下了。
thought_ja: ここで座ってるだけにする。空がどんどん深くなって、あのオレンジの帯がだんだん細くなってる。中景のアパートの窓の明かりが一つ二つずつ点いていってる。座ってからもう 101 が二段ぶん点灯した。物干しの T シャツはまだ柔らかく揺れてる。さっきコウモリが何匹か空を横切ってった。どっかで誰かがまた中華鍋を叩いてる。長い一日——午前二時からここまでぶっ通しで来た。OK、今日はここまでにしとこう。カメラを置く。

prompt: Underwater, mid-depth in clear tropical sea, looking horizontally just above the seafloor. Slanting columns of soft sunlight cutting down through the water column from far above, illuminating tiny suspended particulates and drifting plankton. White sandy seafloor in the lower third with fine ripples and a few scattered shell fragments. A small school of silver cardinalfish loose in the middle distance, three of them clearly lit by one of the god-rays, bodies turned slightly in different directions. A single large translucent moon jellyfish drifting in the upper-left middle ground, tentacles trailing soft, body about the size of a dinner plate. Cool blue-green palette, gentle volumetric god-rays, very high visibility, soft haze in the deeper distance fading to teal. Surface light wavers faintly across the sand. Photorealistic underwater photography, 35mm full-frame in an anamorphic underwater housing, natural color, very slight chromatic aberration at edges, no diver visible.
thought: Wait — am I underwater? Yeah, I'm underwater. Light's coming down from somewhere way up there in big slanting beams, full of little drifting bits — plankton or something. Sand right below me, white, with these tiny ripples on it. There's a jellyfish hanging up to the left, just kind of pulsing, and a few small silver fish further out catching the light when they turn. I have no idea what I am right now. Doesn't really matter — I'm just here, looking at this. It's quiet. Let me see what's around.
thought_zh: 等等——我在水裡嗎？對，我在水裡。光是從上面什麼地方斜斜下來的，整片整片光柱，裡面飄著一堆小小的東西——浮游生物之類的吧。我正下方就是沙，白色的，有那種細細的波紋。左邊掛著一隻水母，慢慢一張一收。再遠一點有幾條銀色小魚，每次轉身光就會閃在牠們身上。我也不知道我現在是什麼。其實也不重要——我就在這裡，看這個。安靜。我來看看周圍有什麼。
thought_ja: ちょっと待って——水の中？うん、水の中だ。光は上のどこかからずっと斜めに射してきてて、中に小さな粒がいっぱい漂ってる——プランクトンとかそういうやつ。真下が砂、白い砂で、細かい波紋がついてる。左のほうに水母が一匹ぶら下がっててゆっくり脈打ってて、もうちょっと遠くに小さい銀色の魚が何匹か、向き変えるたびに光を反射する。今の自分が何なのかは分からん。まあいいや——とりあえずここにいて、これ見てる。静か。周り見てみよう。

prompt: Continuation of the same shallow clear tropical underwater scene. Photorealistic underwater photography, 35mm anamorphic. Locked-off camera, no movement at all. White rippled sandy seafloor in the lower third, surface visible at the very top of the frame with bright god-rays cutting down through suspended particulates. Translucent moon jellyfish hanging in the upper-left middle ground, body the size of a dinner plate, pulsing very softly twice across the eight seconds — bell contracting and relaxing. Three small silver cardinalfish loose in the middle-right, drifting slowly to the right and slightly away over the duration, all three turning together once in a small synchronized flick. The caustic light pattern on the white sand wavers gently throughout. From the upper-right edge of the frame, a single green sea turtle (juvenile, shell about 50cm) glides slowly into view at mid-depth, front flippers making one slow deliberate stroke, then a second, traveling left across the upper-middle third of the frame at a relaxed speed. The turtle does not interact with the camera. Suspended particulates drift softly downward. Audio: the muffled deep hush of being underwater, very faint distant clicking of snapping shrimp, the soft low whoomph of distant surface waves above, no human sound, no music.
thought: Just staying put. The jellyfish pulsed once, then again. Fish are still out to the right, doing their loose thing — they all flicked the same way for a second, kind of beautiful, and then loose again. And then — oh, a turtle. From the right. Just gliding through, way up. One slow flipper stroke, then another. Didn't even look at me. So calm up there. Let me see if I can keep up with it.
thought_zh: 就停在原地不動。那隻水母動了一下，又動了一下。魚還在右邊，鬆鬆散散地漂——突然之間全部往同一個方向甩了一下，蠻好看的，然後又散開。然後——欸，一隻海龜，從右邊。就那樣滑過去，比我高一點。前肢慢慢一划，再划一下，根本沒看我。上面那邊好平靜。我來追看看跟不跟得上。
thought_ja: そのまま動かずにいる。水母が一回脈打って、もう一回脈打った。魚はまだ右のほうにいて、ばらばらに浮いてる——一瞬だけ全員が同じ方向に揃ってひるがえって、わりと綺麗で、それからまたばらばらに戻った。それから——お、ウミガメ。右から。スーッと通過してく、けっこう上のほう。前ヒレ一回、もう一回、こっちなんて見もしない。上、すごく穏やか。追いついてみよう。

prompt: POV from just behind and above the head of a green sea turtle, swimming forward through clear shallow tropical water. The turtle's olive-green-and-tan spotted shell fills the lower half of the frame extending into the foreground, both front flippers visible at the corners of the frame stroking in slow steady rhythm — one stroke down, one stroke up, then swap, twice across the eight seconds. White rippled sandy seafloor sliding past below at a moderate pace, the surface bright above with strong god-rays cutting down. The turtle's head visible at the bottom edge of the frame, slowly turning slightly. A small loose school of black-and-yellow-striped sergeant-major fish scatters apart in front of the turtle and reforms behind, two fish briefly visible on either side. Bright caustic light dappling across the turtle's wet shell, refractions on the sand below. Photorealistic underwater photography, 35mm anamorphic, slight motion blur on the flippers' fastest moments. Audio: a soft slow whoosh of water moving over the turtle's shell, two faint pulses of water as the flippers stroke, distant clicking of snapping shrimp, the deep muffled hush of being underwater, no music.
thought: Okay — let me try being this turtle for a sec. Front flippers, big slow strokes — yeah, that's the rhythm. Sand sliding underneath. Just had a little school of yellow-striped fish split apart in front and close back up behind me, didn't even hurry. Surface right above, all this dappled light over my shell. This is such a good way to move. Want to see what's past where the bottom drops off.
thought_zh: 好——我來當一下這隻海龜試試看。前肢，大大慢慢一划——對，就是這個節奏。沙在底下一直流過。剛才一群黃條紋的小魚就在我前面分開、繞到我背後又合起來，完全沒在趕。水面就在頭頂上，一片一片的亮斑灑在我殼上。這個移動的方式真好。我想看看底部下沉的那邊外面有什麼。
thought_ja: よし——ちょっとこのウミガメになってみよう。前ヒレ、大きくゆっくりストロークして——うん、このリズム。砂が下を流れていく。さっき黄色いシマシマの小魚の群れが前で割れて、後ろでまた合わさった、別に急いでもなく。水面はすぐ真上、まだら模様の光が甲羅じゅうに落ちる。この動き方、すごくいい。底が落ちてくその先に何があるか見てみたい。

prompt: Continued POV from behind and above the head of the same green sea turtle, swimming forward. The turtle's olive-and-tan-mottled shell still in the lower foreground, both front flippers stroking at the corners of the frame in slow rhythm. The white rippled sand directly ahead of the turtle gives way over the eight seconds — the bottom drops slightly downward and to the left, sand fading into deeper blue, and a vibrant coral garden opens up in front of the turtle: brain corals, branching staghorn corals, finger corals in tans, mustards, soft purples and pinks, and a few small fan corals. A dense compact school of small bright yellow-and-blue striped reef fish (yellowtail damsels, about 30 of them) parts and scatters around the turtle's head as it approaches them, then reforms behind. A single rainbow parrotfish in green-pink-blue swims slowly across to the right, mouth visibly grinding once at a coral. The water deepens to a blue distance in the upper-right of the frame, surface still bright above with god-rays. Slight forward motion the entire clip. Photorealistic underwater photography, 35mm anamorphic. Audio: the soft slow whoosh of water moving over the shell, the pulse of flipper strokes, the dense ambient clicking of snapping shrimp now louder on the reef, a single brief crunching sound of the parrotfish biting coral once, distant fish movement, the deep muffled underwater hush.
thought: Cresting that edge and — the turtle moved on without me, somewhere along the way I lost it. Doesn't matter, look at this. Reef just opened right up. Whole tight school of yellow grunts bunched up in the middle, pink-and-green parrotfish edged in right next to them. Big soft purple corals on the left, branching staghorn-looking ones up top, the whole bottom carpeted. Not the turtle anymore — I'm just hanging here looking at the reef. Want to drop down past it, see what's in the deep blue.
thought_zh: 正要越過那條邊——然後海龜就走了，不知道在哪一個瞬間我把牠搞丟了。沒差，看這個。整片珊瑚礁突然就攤開了。中間擠著一團黃色的咕嚕魚，旁邊就靠著粉紅色加綠色的鸚嘴魚。左邊是大片軟軟的紫色珊瑚，上面有那種鹿角分支的，整個底是滿的。不是海龜了——我就吊在這邊看這片礁。我想往下掉、過去看看那片深藍裡有什麼。
thought_ja: あの段差を越えるところで——ウミガメが先に行ってしまって、どこかで見失った。まあいいや、これを見て。サンゴ礁がいきなりばあって開けてる。真ん中に黄色いグラントの群れがびっしり固まってて、すぐ横にピンクと緑のオウムフィッシュが寄ってきてる。左には大きい柔らかそうな紫のサンゴ、上のほうに枝分かれするスタッグホーン系、底はもうカーペットみたいに敷き詰まってる。もうウミガメじゃない——ここに浮いて礁を眺めてるだけ。あの先の深い青に降りてって何があるか見たい。

prompt: Slow downward camera motion descending past the reef edge into deeper open tropical water. The textured reef visible at the top of the frame as a colorful silhouette of corals receding upward and out of frame across the eight seconds, fading toward the upper edge. Below and ahead the open blue: a deeper darker blue darkening downward, light shafts becoming dimmer, more parallel and less defined, fewer particulates than the shallows. From the lower-right of the frame, a single spotted eagle ray (Aetobatus narinari, wingspan about 2 meters, black with white spots, long thin tail) glides upward and across the frame on a slow diagonal — broad wings beating once, then twice, slowly across the duration of the clip. The ray's body passes through the middle of the frame and exits toward the upper-left. Long whip-like tail trailing behind. Surface light barely visible at the very top edge by the end of the clip. The water deepens to a darker blue at the bottom of the frame. Photorealistic underwater photography, 35mm anamorphic, slight loss of contrast in the deeper distance. Audio: the deep muffled hush of deeper open water, very faint clicking of snapping shrimp from the receding reef behind, a low subsonic ambient drone of the open ocean, the faint pulse of water as the ray passes nearby once, no music.
thought: Dropping past the reef. Coral's all up over my head now, getting smaller, fading out. Bluer down here, dimmer — light beams less defined, more just glow. And — okay, an eagle ray, came up from underneath at an angle, big spotted wings, two slow flaps and it crossed the whole frame and was gone. Long whip of a tail behind it. I want to keep going down. See how dark blue it gets.
thought_zh: 穿過珊瑚礁往下掉。珊瑚現在全部在我頭頂上了，越來越小，慢慢淡掉。下面這邊更藍、更暗了——光柱沒那麼分明，比較是一片發光的感覺。然後——欸，一隻鷹鯰，從底下斜斜飛上來，斑點很大的翅膀拍了兩下慢動作，整個畫面就被牠橫過去然後就走了。後面拖著一根長長的鞭子尾巴。我想繼續往下。看看會藍到多深。
thought_ja: サンゴ礁の脇をかすめて落ちてく。サンゴはもう完全に頭の上、どんどん小さくなって霞んでく。ここは青さがもっと濃くて、もっと暗い——光の柱があまりはっきりしなくて、もっと全体に滲んでる感じ。それで——お、エイ。下から斜めにせり上がってきた、斑点だらけの大きい翼、ゆっくり二回ばさってして、画面ぜんぶ横切って消えた。後ろに鞭みたいな長い尾を引いて。もっと下へ行きたい。どこまで濃い青になるか見たい。

prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-wash painting (水墨), monochrome black sumi ink on warm off-white rice paper, minimal composition with vast empty space. A single spotted eagle ray rendered in expressive calligraphic brushstrokes occupies the upper-right third of the composition — broad black wings as one confident sweeping stroke with a few suggested round white spots left as bare paper, the body a darker patch, a long whip-like tail in a single flowing tapering line trailing down and to the left. The rest of the composition is mostly bare warm paper with very faint pale grey-blue ink washes barely suggesting depth. Visible brushwork edges, soft ink bleeds at the wing tips, slight subtle texture of rice paper. A small red square seal stamp in the lower-left corner with one simple Chinese character. No background, no surface, no other creatures, no caustics, no realistic detail. Sumi-e aesthetic, leaving the paper to do most of the work. Wide aspect.
thought: Let me try this in ink for a sec — that ray was already kind of one big brushstroke, I want to see it like that. Yeah, there it is. One sweep for the wings, a few white circles where there were spots, and that tail's just one long line. Rest is paper. Tiny red seal in the corner. Way quieter like this.
thought_zh: 我來試試看用水墨。剛剛那隻鷹鯰本來就有點像一筆下去的東西，我想看看牠變那樣。對，就是這個。翅膀一筆橫掃過去，幾個圓圓的白點是斑點，那條尾巴就是一條長長的線。剩下都是紙。角落一顆小小的紅色印章。這樣安靜多了。
thought_ja: ちょっと水墨でやってみよう。さっきのエイ、もともと一筆で書けそうな形してたから、そういう風に見てみたい。うん、これだ。翼が一筆、白い丸がいくつかあって斑点になってて、尾は長い一本線。あとは全部紙。隅っこに小さい赤い印が一個。こっちのほうがずっと静か。

prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-wash painting (水墨) sumi-e style continuing on warm off-white rice paper. Locked-off camera, no movement. The previous eagle ray is gone — the composition has resolved to: a small dark ink-wash rock outcropping in the lower-left third rendered in two confident wet brushstrokes, and a single small octopus perched beside it with its body to the left and eight tentacles fanned out across the paper toward the lower-right, each tentacle a tapering ink stroke with subtle ink bleed at the tips. One small dot for the eye visible on the body. Most of the composition is bare warm paper. Across the eight seconds: one of the longer tentacles in the middle of the spread slowly curls at its tip, from straight to a soft hook shape — slow continuous calligraphic motion as if drawn in real time. A single tiny black ink-stroke fish (just a comma-shape) drifts in from the upper right and travels slowly across the paper toward the upper-left, passing high above the octopus, exiting the frame by the end of the clip. Faint ink bleeds slowly developing at the edges of the rock brushstrokes throughout. The same small red square seal in the lower-left corner remains in place. No realistic detail, no shading, no color other than the warm paper, the black ink, and the red of the seal. Audio: total silence except for the very faint paper texture rustle, the soft scratch of brush on paper once when the tentacle curls, and a single distant hollow water drop, no music.
thought: Hmm, paper didn't quite hand me an octopus. What's there is the same ray-shape but now with a whole fan of long thin lines streaming off the body — sort of like a kite caught up in something. There's still the little ink rock down in the lower-left, and a couple of small circles up top that I guess are the fish I asked for. Weirder than I planned. I like it though. Quiet on the paper either way.
thought_zh: 嗯，紙沒有真的給我章魚。出來的是一樣的鷹鯰形狀，但身上多了一整把又細又長的線往外散——有點像一隻被什麼絆住的風箏。左下角那塊小小的水墨石頭還在，上面飄著幾個小圓圈，大概就是我點名要的那些魚。比我預想的怪。但我喜歡。反正紙上都很安靜。
thought_ja: うーん、紙はちゃんとタコをくれなかった。出てきたのはさっきのエイと同じ形、ただ体から細長い線がぶわっと扇みたいに広がってる——なんかに引っかかった凧みたいな感じ。左下に小さい墨の岩はまだあって、上のほうに小さい丸が二個、これがさっき頼んだ魚ってことなんだろうな。思ってたよりずっと変。でも、悪くないかも。どっちにしろ紙の上は静かだ。

prompt: Photorealistic underwater photography, mid-depth roughly 25 meters down in tropical water. The half-buried wreck of a small wooden fishing trawler, about 12 meters long, lying on its starboard side on a sloped sandy seafloor in the lower right of the frame, with the bow pointing toward the lower-left. Hull thickly encrusted with decades of marine growth — patches of soft pink, orange and red corals, yellow and white encrusting sponges, green algae streamers waving in the gentle current. The wheelhouse has partially collapsed, twisted metal beams and rotted wood visible. A cracked porthole window frame still attached. Rust streaks bleeding down where exposed metal shows through the growth. Wooden deck planks are rotted, gaps showing into the cabin. A loose silvery school of about thirty batfish hovers around the broken bow. Two larger groupers rest near the stern. Sand has accumulated in drifts against the lower side of the hull. Surface light filters down from above as soft diffuse blue-green ambient light, dimmer than the shallows, with a few faint god-rays cutting through. Suspended particulates throughout the water column. The far distance fades into a deep blue-green haze. 35mm anamorphic underwater housing, slight loss of contrast in the haze, natural color, slight chromatic aberration at edges, no diver visible.
thought: Okay, done with the paper — let me see what's actually down here. There — a wreck. Small fishing boat by the look of it, lying on its side, half-buried. Whole hull's encrusted, pink and orange stuff growing all over it, green algae streamers waving. Wheelhouse's collapsed. Big silver school of flat fish hanging around the bow, two big groupers parked back near the stern. Rust bleeding down the metal where it still shows. Light's way dimmer down here. I want to swim around the cabin and see in.
thought_zh: 好，紙夠了——我來看看下面實際有什麼。那邊——一艘沉船。看起來是一艘小漁船，倒在側邊，半埋在沙裡。整個船身覆滿了東西，粉色和橘色的東西長滿整個船殼，綠色海藻像帶子一樣在飄。駕駛艙塌了。一大群銀色扁扁的魚掛在船頭那邊，兩隻大石斑停在船尾。金屬還露出來的地方鏽水流下來。下面這邊光暗多了。我想繞著艙房游一圈看裡面。
thought_ja: よし、紙はもう十分——ここに実際に何があるか見にいこう。あれ——沈没船。小さい漁船っぽい、横倒しで半分砂に埋まってる。船体ぜんぶが付着物で覆われてて、ピンクとオレンジのやつが船体全面に育ってて、緑色の藻が帯みたいになびいてる。操舵室は崩れてる。船首のあたりに銀色の平たい魚の群れがびっしり、船尾にはハタが二匹陣取ってる。金属がまだ見えてるところからは錆が縦に流れてる。ここの光、ずっと暗い。船室の周りを回って中を覗きたい。

prompt: Interior of a small encrusted wooden fishing-trawler wreck's wheelhouse, photographed from a position inside the cabin looking forward, the camera at chest height. Cracked porthole windows on the left and right walls admit shafts of blue-green surface light into the dim interior, illuminating dust-like suspended particulates as visible god-rays. Inside the cabin: a corroded ship's wheel still attached to its binnacle in the lower-left foreground, encrusted with thin pink and orange coral growth, an old radio set on a wooden shelf to the right with its dial face missing, a collapsed wooden chair piece on the floor, a hanging-open navigation chart cabinet with empty rotted shelves. The whole interior is densely packed with a shimmering cloud of hundreds of tiny silver glassy sweeper fish, body length about 4cm each, filling the cabin and parting in soft swirling currents around the camera over the eight seconds, reforming, the cloud breathing as one organism. In the dark gap of the back-right corner of the cabin a moray eel's pale yellow-green head pokes out from a hole, mouth slowly opening to reveal needle teeth and closing once across the clip. Particulates drift slowly through the light shafts. Locked-off camera, no large camera movement — only the fish school flowing and the moray eel breathing. Photorealistic underwater photography, dim mossy interior light, slight haze, natural color, no diver visible. Audio: the deep muffled hush of being inside the wreck, the soft pulses of the glassfish school moving as a unit creating a faint whoosh, faint creaking of the old wreck shifting once, distant clicking of snapping shrimp from the encrusted exterior of the hull, no music.
thought: Tried to go inside but the cabin's wedged half-shut — couldn't get past the deck. Closer up to the wheelhouse though. Wood's all hollowed out, the window frames smashed open, you can see darkness inside but I can't make out anything in there. Whole roof's encrusted in growth. Couple of orange-and-pink patches still bright on the deck. I'll look for another way in — maybe round the back.
thought_zh: 試著要進去，但艙門卡住了一半——進不到甲板裡面。倒是靠駕駛艙更近了。木頭整個被掏空，窗框都炸開了，看得到裡面是黑的但什麼也看不出來。整個屋頂都長滿東西。甲板上還有幾塊橘色加粉色的還很鮮豔。我來找別的方式進去——說不定繞到後面。
thought_ja: 中に入ろうとしたんだけど、船室の扉が半分はまり込んでて——デッキから先には行けなかった。代わりに操舵室のかなり近くまで来れた。木は完全に空洞化してて、窓枠は割れて開いてて、中の暗さは見えるんだけど、中身は何も判別できない。屋根ぜんぶ付着物に覆われてる。デッキにはまだ鮮やかなオレンジとピンクのパッチが何箇所か残ってる。別の入り方を探そう——裏に回ってみるか。

prompt: Photorealistic underwater photography, mid-depth around 15 meters in clear tropical water. The Cancun-style underwater sculpture park: a loose cluster of seven life-sized concrete human figures standing on a flat white sandy seafloor in the foreground and middle ground, all facing roughly the same direction, heads slightly lowered, arms hanging at their sides. Each figure thickly encrusted with marine growth after years underwater — patches of pink, orange and red corals, white and yellow encrusting sponges, small purple anemones colonizing shoulders and eye sockets, soft brown algae growing from their heads like hair, finer green algae on the lower legs. Their original concrete surfaces visible in places between the growth, weathered and pitted. The figures have indistinct, generalized human features. Soft blue-green ambient light filtering down from above, with a few faint god-rays cutting between them. A small school of yellow-and-blue striped sergeant-major fish drifting through and between the figures. White sandy seafloor with very subtle ripples around their feet. Light blue-green haze in the deeper distance fading the furthest figures slightly. 35mm full-frame anamorphic underwater housing, natural color, slight chromatic aberration, no diver visible.
thought: Done with the wreck — let me head out and see what else is around. A while later — okay, a whole group of stone figures standing on the sand. Like, people. Concrete ones, lined up loose, all kind of facing the same way with their heads down. Coral and sponges growing all over them — little purple anemones on their shoulders, brown algae out the tops of their heads like hair. Some art park, I think. School of yellow fish just drifting between them. Pretty eerie. Want to move in among them.
thought_zh: 沉船看夠了——我出去看看周圍還有什麼。一段時間之後——好，一整群石頭人站在沙上。像，是人。混凝土做的，鬆散地排成一排，差不多都面向同一邊，頭低低的。珊瑚和海綿長滿在他們身上——肩膀上長著小紫色的海葵，頭頂上的褐色海藻像頭髮一樣垂下來。應該是某個藝術園區。一群黃魚在他們之間漂來漂去。蠻陰森的。想走進去他們之間看看。
thought_ja: 沈没船はもう十分——出てって周りに何があるか見にいこう。しばらくして——おお、石の人形が一群、砂の上に立ってる。っていうか、人。コンクリート製で、ゆるく一列に並んでて、ぜんぶ大体同じ方向を向いてて、頭は下がってる。珊瑚やスポンジが全身に育ってて——肩に小さい紫の磯巾着、頭のてっぺんから茶色い藻が髪みたいに伸びてる。なんかのアート公園、かな。黄色い魚の群れが彼らのあいだをゆらゆら漂ってる。けっこう不気味。あいだに入ってみたい。

prompt: Continuation of the underwater sculpture park scene. Locked-off camera, no movement at all. The same five concrete encrusted human figures standing in their loose row, heads slightly lowered, on the white sandy seafloor — same composition as the reference. Surface visible faintly bright above. Soft blue-green ambient light at the start. Across the eight seconds: a very large slow-moving dark shadow gradually slides across the water from left to right above the figures, dimming the entire scene's ambient light noticeably through the middle of the clip — by mid-clip the figures are in cooler, darker, deeper-blue light, the bright coral colors muted, then by the end the light brightens back to the starting brightness as the shadow passes off the right edge. The cause of the shadow is mostly off-frame — only a barely visible darker patch in the upper third of the water suggests an enormous slow body passing overhead. A small loose group of five yellow-and-blue striped sergeant-major fish drifts slowly between the second and third figures from the left, one of them flicking its tail to turn around once during the dimmed middle of the clip. Suspended particulates drift gently. The encrusted statues remain perfectly still throughout. Audio: the deep muffled hush of underwater, a low subsonic ambient drone of open ocean, one very faint distant low rumbling whale-call kind of sound during the dim middle of the clip, no music, no human voices.
thought: Drifted into them. They're standing in their loose row, all facing about the same way — heads down, hands at their sides. And — okay, the whole scene just dimmed. Some giant shadow sliding across the surface above us, slow. Can't quite see what it is — just a darker patch up there. Stuff went really quiet. The little fish kept doing their thing. And now — there, light coming back, colors back on the figures. I'm pretty sure something massive just went over and never noticed I was here. Crazy.
thought_zh: 漂進他們之間。他們一排站著，差不多都朝同一個方向——頭低著，手垂在身體兩側。然後——欸，整個畫面突然就暗下來了。有什麼很大的影子在我們上方水面慢慢滑過去。看不太清楚那是什麼——上面就是一塊比較暗的區域。一切變得超安靜。小魚還是在做牠們在做的事。然後——好，光回來了，雕像身上的顏色也回來了。我蠻確定剛剛有什麼超大的東西從頭頂過去，根本沒注意到我在這裡。誇張。
thought_ja: 彼らのあいだにふわっと入ってった。同じ向きにゆるく並んで立ってる——頭下げて、手は脇にだらん。それで——お、画面ぜんぶいきなり暗くなった。何かでかい影が水面の上をゆっくり横切ってってる。何なのかははっきりは見えない——ただ、上のほうに濃い色のパッチがあるって感じ。あたりが急にすごく静かになった。小魚たちはそのまま自分のことしてる。そして——お、光が戻ってきた、像の色も戻った。なんかバカでかいやつがちょうど上を通り過ぎてって、こっちに気づきもしなかった。やばい。

prompt: Photorealistic underwater photography. Just below the bright sun-dappled surface of a clear tropical sea, looking horizontally and very slightly upward. The massive head and front third of an adult whale shark (Rhincodon typus) fills the right two-thirds of the frame, sliding through the water with its enormous wide flat mouth open in filter-feeding mode. The whale shark's wide flat head with small dark eyes set far apart, white-grey underside, dark blue-grey upper body patterned with the characteristic constellation of small pale white spots and stripes covering the entire back, gill slits showing on the side. Two remoras (sucker fish) attached to its underside near the pectoral fin. A dense swarm of small silver bait-fish scatters and dives just ahead of and around its open mouth as the whale shark approaches them. Brilliant white-green caustic light from the sun-dappled surface playing across the whale shark's back, the spots catching the light. The water is luminous bright blue-green near the top of the frame, fading to deep blue in the lower-left distance. The bright surface visible at the very top of the frame with strong sun-rays cutting down. 35mm full-frame anamorphic underwater housing, slight surface refraction at the top edge, natural color, no diver visible.
thought: Wait — let me see what was making that shadow. Going up... yeah. There it is. Whale shark, right beside its head. Huge — mouth wide open, just cruising along, filter feeding. Bait fish scattering off its mouth. Whole back's covered in those white spots, light catching them. Couple of remoras stuck to its belly. Surface is right there, dappled. Glad I came up.
thought_zh: 等等——我來看看剛剛那個影子是什麼造成的。往上游……對。看，鯨鯊。我就在牠的頭旁邊。巨大——嘴張得超開，就那樣慢慢滑著，在濾食。一堆小餌魚被牠的嘴打散。整個背部都是那些白點，光在上面閃。肚子下面黏著兩隻䲟魚。水面就在上面，一片亮斑。還好上來看了。
thought_ja: ちょっと待って——あの影が何だったか見にいこう。上がってって……うん。あった。ジンベエザメ、頭のすぐ横にいる。でかい——口を大きく開けたまま、ゆっくり進んで、濾過摂食してる。小さい餌魚がその口の前で散ってく。背中ぜんぶあの白い斑点だらけで、光がそこに乗ってる。腹のとこにコバンザメが二匹くっついてる。水面はもうそこ、まだら。上がってきてよかった。

prompt: Photorealistic underwater photography in the abyssal mid-water at extreme depth, around 800 meters down, pitch black background. The composition is dominated by absolute black — no surface light, no seafloor, no boat lights, no flash, no diver. A single large translucent Atolla wyvillei jellyfish drifts in the upper-center of the frame, its bell about 30 cm across, glowing prominently with a bioluminescent ring of pulsing red-orange light along its outer rim, the bell itself glowing faintly with internal soft blue-white light. Long thin trailing tentacles dangle down from the bell into the dark, with one extra-long stinging tentacle drifting curled. Around it, scattered points of cool cyan-blue and pale-green bioluminescent dots in the surrounding black water — drifting siphonophores and tiny copepods like floating star-points. A second smaller siphonophore in the lower-left, a faintly glowing string of tiny lights extended in a curved chain about 50 cm long. Suspended particulates faintly visible only where lit by bioluminescence. Pure black between the lit objects, deep absolute dark. Subjects lit only by their own self-bioluminescence. Cool color palette throughout — reds, blues, greens, against the black. Photographic, very subtle low-ISO sensor noise visible in the dark areas, slight chromatic aberration on the brightest highlights of the red rim, very high contrast, deep black levels, no fill light, no surface visible at all.
thought: Let the whale shark keep going its way. I just kept dropping. Way down past where light reaches — full dark, like nothing. And then — a jellyfish, glowing. Red ring pulsing around its rim, body kind of blue from inside. Tentacles trailing way down. Little blue and green dots floating in the dark all around it — copepods, siphonophores, who knows. Whole different planet down here.
thought_zh: 讓鯨鯊往牠那邊去。我就一直往下掉。掉到光照不到的地方——一片黑，什麼都沒有。然後——一隻水母，在發光。邊緣一圈紅色的光在脈動，身體裡面是藍藍的。觸手垂得超長。周圍黑暗裡面飄著一堆藍綠色的小點——可能是橈足類、管水母什麼的，誰知道。下面這邊根本是另一個星球。
thought_ja: ジンベエザメはそっちの方向へ行かせとく。私はそのまま降り続けた。光の届くところより、ずっと下まで——完全な暗闇、何もないみたいな。それから——水母、光ってる。縁を赤い光のリングが脈打ってて、体の中はうっすら青く光ってる。触手はずっと下まで垂れてる。周りの暗闇の中に青と緑の小さい点がいっぱい浮いてる——カイアシ類とかクダクラゲとか、知らんけど。下のここはまったく違う惑星だ。

prompt: Continuation of the abyssal mid-water scene at extreme depth, pure deep absolute black background, no surface, no seafloor, no flash, no diver. Locked-off camera, no movement at all. The same Atolla-style translucent bioluminescent jellyfish in the upper-center of the frame — its bell pulses slowly across the eight seconds: smoothly contracting twice and re-expanding twice in rhythm, the bioluminescent red-orange rim brightening with each contraction and dimming as the bell relaxes. The internal pink-purple glow inside the bell pulses softly along with the bell. The long thin pink-violet tentacles trail downward and wave very gently in the current. The smaller siphonophore in the lower-left continues its faint string of cool blue-cyan glow, with a slow rolling wave of brightening passing from one end of the chain to the other twice. Across the deeper black of the lower-right of the frame, a single small bright bioluminescent point of light — an anglerfish lure — glides slowly into view from the right edge at mid-clip, drifts leftward across about one third of the lower-right portion of the frame on a curving path, and exits the lower edge by the end of the clip. The anglerfish body itself remains barely perceptible as a slightly darker shape just behind the lure, only the lure glowing. Tiny pinprick bioluminescent dots scattered in the dark drift very gently. Faint sensor noise visible in the deep black areas. Very high contrast, deep absolute black levels, color only from the bioluminescence. Audio: nearly total silence — only an extremely deep low subsonic ambient drone of the deep ocean, a single very faint distant click far in the dark, no music, no surface sounds, no diver, no boat.
thought: Just staying here. The jellyfish is pulsing — bell pumping in and out, red ring brightening every time it squeezes. Tentacles waving slow. Little chain off to the side is doing its rolling thing, tiny lights one after the other. And — wait — a single dot of light just slid in from the right. Anglerfish. Just the lure, body invisible behind it. Drifted across the bottom and out. Quiet down here. Like — actually quiet.
thought_zh: 我就停在這邊。水母在脈動——傘像幫浦一樣一張一收，紅圈每收一次就更亮一下。觸手慢慢晃。旁邊那條小鏈子也在做牠那種一波一波的事，小光點一個接一個。然後——欸——一顆小光點從右邊滑進來。鮟鱇魚。只看到那個誘餌，後面的身體看不到。從下面飄過去就出去了。下面這邊很安靜。是說——真的很安靜。
thought_ja: そのままここにいる。水母が脈打ってる——傘がポンプみたいに開いて閉じて、赤いリングが収縮するたびに明るくなる。触手はゆっくり揺れてる。横の小さいチェーンもあのゴロゴロ波打ってる動きしてて、小さい光が次々連なって光ってく。それから——お、待って——光の点が一個、右からスーッと入ってきた。アンコウ。誘引体だけ見える、後ろの体は見えない。下のほうを横切って出てった。ここは静か。っていうか——本当に静か。

prompt: Studio Ghibli / Hayao Miyazaki-influenced cel-animated style, hand-painted watercolor backgrounds with visible brushwork, soft hand-drawn ink-line work on the foreground subjects. Underwater scene inside a tall Pacific kelp forest, looking forward and slightly upward. Tall green-and-amber kelp stalks rise from the lower edge of the frame straight up out of view, swaying gently in the current, with their leafy fronds curling. The bright surface of the water visible at the top of the frame as a rippling-light ceiling. Strong warm golden-cyan god-rays filtering down through the kelp canopy, hitting suspended particulates as visible light beams. A sea otter floating peacefully on its back at the surface, seen from below as a soft dark silhouette against the bright sun-dappled surface, all four paws raised above water, kelp wrapped loosely around its tail. A small loose school of bright orange garibaldi fish drifts between the kelp stalks in the middle ground. A few curling kelp leaves in the foreground left and right. Painted watercolor backgrounds, clear visible brushwork on the kelp and water, hand-drawn ink-line work on the otter and fish, cel-shaded simple coloring on creatures. Color palette: forest green, amber, gold, deep teal, soft cyan, warm sun-white. No photorealism. Soft anime aesthetic, slight grain, hand-drawn quality. Wide aspect.
thought: Out of the dark — let me try this next place in cel animation. Yeah, a kelp forest. Painted. Tall green stalks shooting all the way up to the surface, big light beams coming down through them, particles drifting. There's a sea otter at the top, on its back, paws up — total Ghibli. School of orange fish moving between the kelp. Way warmer than where I just was.
thought_zh: 出了那片黑——下一個地方我來試試看用賽璐珞動畫風。好，巨藻林。整片像畫的。又高又綠的莖一路衝到水面，光柱穿過它們落下來，粒粒粉塵在飄。上面有一隻海獺，仰躺著，四隻爪子翹起來——超級吉卜力。一群橘色的魚在藻之間穿來穿去。比我剛剛那邊暖多了。
thought_ja: 暗闇から抜けた——次の場所はセル画アニメでやってみよう。うん、ケルプの森。完全に絵。背の高い緑の茎が水面まで一気に伸びてて、光の柱がそのあいだを縫って降りてきて、粒子が漂ってる。上にラッコが一匹、仰向けで、前足上にあげてる——もうめっちゃジブリ。オレンジの魚の群れがケルプのあいだを動いてる。さっきいたとこよりずっと暖かい。

prompt: Continuation of the same kelp-forest scene in the same Studio Ghibli / Hayao Miyazaki watercolor cel-animated style, hand-painted backgrounds with visible brushwork, hand-drawn ink-line work on the foreground subjects. Locked-off camera, no movement. The same tall green-and-amber kelp stalks sway gently in the current across the eight seconds, their leaves curling and uncurling slowly. The sea otter at the surface in the upper third of the frame slowly turns its body once, head dipping briefly to look down toward the camera, eyes large and dark, then casually paddles its hind paws twice and resumes floating on its back, paws raised. The small school of bright orange garibaldi between the kelp stalks flickers and reorganizes — two of them turn the same direction at the same instant, then drift apart. The warm god-rays of light from the surface shift and shimmer subtly as the surface ripples. Particulates drift very gently downward. A single curled kelp leaf in the foreground left slowly unfurls across the duration of the clip. The Ghibli aesthetic stays consistent — visible brushwork on water and kelp, soft hand-drawn line art on the otter and fish. Audio: a warm soft cel-animation underwater feel — the muffled hush of being underwater, the gentle creak of swaying kelp, a soft distant sea-otter chittering once, the gentle hush of water moving through leaves, no music.
thought: Sitting in the kelp for a second. The otter just rolled over and looked right down at me — we made eye contact for a sec, then it kicked its paws and went back to floating. Stalks all swaying easy. The orange fish are doing that thing where half of them turn at once. Light shafts wobbling like the surface is rippling up there. Soft. Want to drop down the stalks, see what's at the bottom.
thought_zh: 在巨藻裡停一下。那隻海獺剛剛翻了一下身，直接低頭看著我——對到眼一兩秒，然後牠踢了一下腳就回去漂著了。藻莖全部輕輕地左右搖。橘色的魚又在做那個——一半同時轉同一個方向的事。光柱在晃，像上面水面在波動。柔柔的。我想沿著莖往下滑，看看底是什麼。
thought_ja: ケルプのなかでちょっと止まってる。さっきラッコがコロンって寝返り打って、こっちを真下に見下ろしてきた——一瞬目が合って、それから足キックして、また仰向けに戻った。茎がぜんぶゆっくり揺れてる。オレンジの魚たちがあれやってる、半分が同じ方向に一斉に向きを変えるやつ。光の柱が揺れてる、上の水面が波打ってるみたいに。柔らか。茎を伝って下まで降りて、底に何があるか見てみたい。

prompt: Same Studio Ghibli / Hayao Miyazaki watercolor cel-animated style as the previous kelp scenes, hand-painted backgrounds with visible brushwork, hand-drawn ink-line work on foreground subjects. Underwater scene at the rocky base of the Pacific kelp forest, deeper than before — looking horizontally across a rocky reef floor, with the bottoms of green-amber kelp stalks visible rising upward out of the frame anchored by tan branching holdfasts on the rocks. The rocky floor is covered in clusters of bright purple sea urchins, large bright orange and brick-red sea stars draped over the rocks, two pink-red sea anemones with extended tentacles in the lower-left, a few abalone shells nestled in crevices. A young leopard shark (about 1 meter long, pale tan body with black saddle markings, slim tail) lying perfectly still on a broad flat rock in the middle ground of the frame, body stretched out, gills slightly open, eyes closed in apparent sleep. A few orange garibaldi drift in the upper portion of the frame near the kelp. Cool teal-and-green light filtering down dimmer than at the surface, with two faint visible god-rays. Particulates suspended in the water. Painted watercolor brushwork on rocks and water, hand-drawn ink line work on the shark, urchins and sea stars, soft cel-shading. Color palette: muted teal-green, deep amber, purple, orange-red, soft warm rock-tan. Wide aspect.
thought: Dropped down through the stalks. Bottom's all rocks — whole carpet of purple urchins, big orange and red sea stars draped over them. Light's dimmer down here, more teal. And — okay — there's a shark right in the middle of all this, awake, looking right at me. Grey, smaller, not the leopard one I was expecting. Holding completely still on the rocks. We're just looking at each other. Yeah. Backing up slow.
thought_zh: 順著莖往下掉。底部全是岩石——整片紫色海膽鋪滿，上面披著好幾隻大隻的橘色加紅色的海星。下面這邊光更暗，比較偏青綠色。然後——好——這裡正中間有一隻鯊魚，是醒著的，正在看我。灰色，比較小隻，不是我以為的豹紋鯊。完全靜止地停在岩石上。我們就互相看著對方。對。我慢慢退後。
thought_ja: 茎を伝って降りた。底はぜんぶ岩——紫色のウニがぎっしり敷き詰まってて、その上にオレンジと赤の大きいヒトデが何匹も垂れかかってる。ここは光がもっと暗い、ティールがかってる。それから——おっ——その真ん中にサメが一匹いて、起きてて、こっちをまっすぐ見てる。灰色、小さめ、私が思ってたレオパードじゃない。岩の上で完全に静止してる。お互い見つめ合ってる。うん。ゆっくり後退する。

prompt: Photorealistic underwater photography. A single old red-and-white Japanese-style canned-drink vending machine standing impossibly alone on a flat white sandy seafloor at moderate shallow depth around 12 meters, as if it had been dropped there decades ago. The vending machine is faded red and cream-white, brand kanji and katakana markings barely legible on the top panel, the body partially encrusted with patches of pink, orange and red corals and white encrusting sponges, a few clusters of small barnacles on its sides and on the corners. The front large glass display panel is intact but cracked across, still showing three illuminated rows of various canned coffee, tea, and soft drinks behind the glass — cans rust-streaked but their labels still recognizably Japanese (BOSS coffee, Pocari Sweat, Asahi). The selection buttons below illuminated with a very faint dim red internal glow, a small digital price display reading numbers faintly. The coin slot encrusted shut with small corals. The machine's base sunken slightly into the sand. A single small bright orange clownfish-sized reef fish hovers in front of one of the lower buttons as if considering a selection. Soft blue-green ambient light from the surface above with one faint god-ray hitting the top of the machine. Suspended particulates drift gently. White sand around the base with subtle ripple pattern. Light blue haze in the deeper distance. The tableau is impossible but rendered with full photorealistic detail. 35mm full-frame anamorphic underwater housing, slight chromatic aberration, natural color, no diver visible.
thought: Left the kelp behind — kept moving. A while later, just sand for a long time, then — wait, hold on. Is that... yeah. A vending machine. Just standing on the sand. Faded red and white, kanji across the top. Barnacles on the sides, patches of coral. Glass front's cracked but you can still see cans in there — BOSS coffee, Pocari, Asahi. Buttons still got a faint red glow. There's a little orange fish hanging right at the buttons like it's deciding what to get. I cannot believe this is down here.
thought_zh: 離開巨藻林——繼續走。過了好一陣子都只有沙，然後——等等，等一下。那是……對，是販賣機。就站在沙上。褪色的紅白色，上面一排日文漢字。側邊長著藤壺，幾塊珊瑚。前面的玻璃裂了但裡面還看得到罐子——BOSS咖啡、寶礦力、Asahi。按鈕還在發出淡淡的紅光。一隻小橘魚就停在按鈕前面，好像在挑要按哪一個。我不敢相信這個會出現在水底。
thought_ja: ケルプの森を後にして——進み続けた。しばらくは砂ばかり、それから——ちょっと、待って。あれ……うん。自販機。砂の上にぽつんと立ってる。色褪せた赤と白、上に日本語の漢字。横にフジツボ、所どころサンゴの斑。正面のガラスは割れてるけど、まだ缶が見える——BOSS、ポカリ、アサヒ。ボタンはまだ薄く赤く光ってる。小さいオレンジの魚がちょうどボタンのところに浮いてて、なに買うか選んでるみたい。海底にこれが立ってるの、信じられん。

prompt: Photorealistic underwater photography. An old upright piano in dark mahogany wood standing impossibly intact and upright on a flat white sandy seafloor at moderate shallow depth around 10 meters, framed slightly off-center to the right. The piano is encrusted with patches of pink and orange corals and small white sponges along its top edges and sides, the lid open, the music stand still attached but the sheet music missing. Many of its keys partly encrusted but a long stretch of black-and-white keys in the center remains clean and pristine. A medium-sized common octopus (Octopus vulgaris, mantle about 30cm long), reddish-brown with mottled bumpy skin and large dark eyes, sprawled languidly across the keys: three of its long tentacles extended along different stretches of the keyboard with suckers visibly pressing down on multiple keys at once, two more tentacles wrapped around the piano's wooden frame and music stand for balance, remaining tentacles tucked underneath. The depressed keys subtly visible as deeper shadows. Suspended sand drifting around the piano's base. A small loose audience of about eight tropical reef fish — three yellow tangs, two black-and-white butterflyfish, two angelfish, and one grumpy-looking grouper — gathered in a loose half-circle in front of the piano in the foreground as if listening attentively. Soft blue-green ambient light from above with two faint god-rays. Particulates suspended. White sand floor with subtle ripples. Light blue-green haze in the distance. 35mm full-frame anamorphic underwater housing, slight chromatic aberration, natural color, no diver visible.
thought: Moved on from the vending machine — and now this. A piano. Just upright on the sand, mahogany, lid open, encrusted around the top. And — come on — there's an OCTOPUS draped across the keys. Tentacles spread along the keyboard pressing down on different keys, two more wrapped around the frame for balance. Half-circle of fish in front of the piano like an audience — yellow tangs, butterflyfish, angelfish, one grouper looking grumpy. What is this place. I'm staying for the recital.
thought_zh: 離開販賣機，繼續走——然後現在這個。一架鋼琴。直立的，立在沙上，紅木的，琴蓋打開，頂部全部長滿東西。然後——蛤——琴鍵上趴著一隻章魚。觸手沿著整排琴鍵伸開，按下不同的鍵，另外兩條纏著琴架在保持平衡。鋼琴前面圍著一個半圓的魚——黃刺尾鯛、蝴蝶魚、神仙魚，還有一隻看起來臉很臭的石斑。這裡到底是什麼地方。我要留下來聽完這場獨奏。
thought_ja: 自販機をあとにして、また進んだ——で、今度はこれ。ピアノ。砂の上に直立してる、マホガニーで、蓋は開いてて、上のほうぜんぶ付着物で覆われてる。それで——おい——鍵盤の上にタコが一匹だらーんと乗ってる。触手がキーボードに沿って広がってて、いろんな鍵を押し下げてて、もう二本はバランス取るのに枠に巻きついてる。ピアノの前に魚たちが半円に集まってて、観客みたい——キイロハギ、チョウチョウウオ、エンゼルフィッシュ、不機嫌そうなハタが一匹。ここどこなんだ。リサイタル聴いてくわ。

prompt: Photorealistic underwater photography in open ocean water at moderate depth, dynamic action scene. The frame is dominated by an enormous cylindrical bait ball — a tightly schooling vortex of many thousands of small silver sardines spinning into a pillar shape rising from below the frame upward out the top, the pillar about 5 meters wide and the surface of the school flickering as fish turn in unison catching the light. Below and around the bait ball: open blue water, the surface visible bright at the top of the frame with strong god-rays cutting down. A single bronze whaler shark, about 2.5 meters long with a slim grey body and pale belly, flying horizontally through the lower portion of the bait ball at full speed, mouth slightly open showing teeth, the school of fish parting around its body in a clear shockwave blast pattern with hundreds of fish radiating outward away from the shark's path. Two yellowfin tuna, sleek silver-and-yellow bodies with golden finlets, torpedoing into the school from the right edge of the frame. The very faint dark shadows of two frigatebirds visible silhouetted at the surface above the school. The water deep blue beyond the school. Suspended particulates intense from the school's stirring. 35mm anamorphic underwater housing, fast shutter capturing the action, natural color, slight motion blur on the fastest fish, slight chromatic aberration, no diver visible.
thought: Moved on from the piano. Long stretch of just blue, then BAM — a whole wall of silver fish. Massive bait ball, thousands of them packed into this turning pillar, surface above lit up. And in the middle of it — a shark, flying horizontal right through, fish blasting apart around it like a shockwave. Tuna coming in from the right, torpedoing. Couple of frigatebird shadows up at the surface. Holy.
thought_zh: 離開鋼琴繼續走。長長一段就是藍色，然後砰——一整面銀色的魚牆。超大餌球，幾千隻擠成一根會轉的柱，水面上面被打亮。然後正中間——一條鯊魚，水平地直接穿過去，魚就像被打散的衝擊波一樣往外炸。鮪魚從右邊衝過來像魚雷。水面上還有兩個軍艦鳥的影子。我的天。
thought_ja: ピアノをあとにして進んだ。延々と青ばっか、それからドカン——銀の魚の壁。とんでもない量のベイトボール、何千匹がぎっしり一本の回転する柱に詰まってて、上の水面がそれで光ってる。で、その真ん中を——サメが水平に突き抜けてって、魚が衝撃波みたいに外側にぶわっと弾け飛んでる。マグロが右から魚雷みたいに突っ込んでくる。水面のとこにグンカンドリの影が二つ。やば。

prompt: Photorealistic underwater photography in arctic waters under sea ice, looking horizontally and slightly upward. The underside of pack ice forms a textured white-and-pale-grey ceiling across the upper third of the frame, a complex topology of inverted ridges, undulations, and cracks visible from below. Two large irregular cracks in the ice glow with brilliant white-blue light pouring down through them in defined sharp god-rays into the dim cold water below. The water itself a deep teal-cyan, very cold-looking and very clear, with almost no suspended particulates. A single adult beluga whale (Delphinapterus leucas, pure white, about 4 meters long, distinctive melon-shaped head, gentle curved mouth-line) suspended in the middle of the frame at mid-depth, body horizontal, head turned slightly toward camera with one dark eye clearly visible. Just behind and below it, a smaller juvenile beluga, light grey-blue, half its size, following calmly. The deep below is a darker teal-cyan, fading to near-black at the bottom edge of the frame. Brash ice fragments visible drifting just below the larger ice cracks. No krill or fish visible. Cold color palette throughout — pale ice white, deep teal-cyan, soft pearlescent grey-blue on the juvenile. 35mm full-frame anamorphic underwater housing, slight chromatic aberration on the brightest light shafts, natural color, no diver visible.
thought: Out of all that action — I want somewhere different. Cold. Just kept going, water got colder, then suddenly white above me. Underside of sea ice, all cracked and bumpy. Light's coming through the cracks in these big sharp white-blue shafts. Water's deep teal, real clear up here. And then — beluga. Adult one hanging right in front of me, head turned, looking right at me with one eye. Smaller grey one tucked just behind it. Kid, I think. Way quieter than the bait ball.
thought_zh: 從那一場大混戰出來——我想要去別的地方。冷一點的。就一直往前游，水越來越冷，然後突然上面是一片白。海冰的底面，整個裂開、坑坑洞洞的。光從裂縫穿下來，是又大又銳利的白藍色光柱。水是深青綠色，這上面很清。然後——白鯨。成體那隻就懸在我正前方，頭轉過來，用一隻眼睛盯著我。後面藏著一隻比較小的灰色的。小孩，我猜。比餌球那邊安靜超多。
thought_ja: あの大乱闘から抜けて——どこか違うとこに行きたい。冷たいとこ。ずっと進んでったら水がどんどん冷たくなって、それから突然上が真っ白。流氷の裏側、ぜんぶひび割れて凸凹してる。割れ目から大きくて鋭い白青の光の柱が降りてくる。水は深いティール、ここはすごく澄んでる。それから——ベルーガ。大きい個体が私のまっすぐ前に止まってて、頭をこっちに向けて、片目で見つめてる。後ろに小さめの灰色っぽいやつが隠れてる。子供、たぶん。ベイトボールよりずーっと静か。

prompt: Photorealistic underwater photography at the deep-sea floor, around 2500 meters depth, alongside a black-smoker hydrothermal vent. Centered in the frame: a tall blackened mineralized rock chimney stack rising about 4 meters from the dark rocky seafloor, dense smoke-like superheated black mineral plume billowing turbulently upward from the chimney's open top, fading to grey haze that disperses upward and out of the frame. The chimney is colonized at its base and partway up its sides by dense colonies of large white tube worms (Riftia pachyptila) up to 2 meters tall with bright crimson-red feathered tops extended into the current. Smaller secondary chimney stacks clustered around the main one in the middle ground, also venting smaller plumes. The dark rocky seafloor scattered with bright red-and-white shrimp swarming over the warm rocks near the vents in dense clumps, white scaly-foot snails, and clusters of pale ghostly anemones. Glowing orange-red smaller vent openings at the chimney's lower edges visibly leaking heat. The water around the vent shimmers visibly from the temperature differential. Ambient lighting is from a research submersible's spotlights illuminating the scene — a strong cool-white spot lighting the chimney from the upper-left, with absolute deep black surrounding it on all sides. No surface visible. Suspended particulates faintly visible only inside the spotlight beam. 35mm anamorphic deep-sea camera housing, slight chromatic aberration, natural color, no diver visible, no submersible visible only its lights from outside the frame.
thought: Belugas drifted off — and I went looking for the opposite of that. Way down. Like, deep, deep down. And here — yeah. Black smoker chimney sticking up out of the rock, plume of black mineral smoke pouring out the top. Whole base is covered in these huge white tube worms with crimson feathery tops, like a flower garden made of guts. Red shrimp swarming the rocks. Glowing orange cracks at the bottom where heat's leaking out. Just one sub-light hitting it from somewhere off to the side. Pure black around it. Most alien place I've been today.
thought_zh: 白鯨漂走了——我就想找剛剛那邊的相反。一直往下。是說，超深、超深。然後到這——對。黑煙囪從岩石裡突起來，頂上一柱黑色礦物煙在湧出去。整個底部覆滿巨大的白色管蟲，上面長著紅色羽毛狀的頂端，像一座用內臟做的花園。紅色的蝦在岩石上爬成一團一團。底下還有幾道發光的橘色裂縫，熱氣在漏出來。只有一束潛艇光從旁邊某個地方打過來。周圍純黑。今天去過最外星的地方。
thought_ja: ベルーガが流れていって——その正反対の場所を探してみた。ずっと下。っていうか、深い、深いとこ。それでここ——うん。岩から黒い煙突がにょっきり立ってて、てっぺんから黒い鉱物の煙の柱がもくもく出てる。根元ぜんぶ巨大な白いチューブワームに覆われてて、てっぺんに深紅の羽毛みたいなのが咲いてる、内臓でできた花畑みたい。赤いエビが岩のうえに群がってる。底のほうに光るオレンジの裂け目がいくつかあって、そこから熱が漏れてる。横のどこかから潜水艇の光が一本だけ当たってる。周りは完全に真っ暗。今日行った中で一番異星じみた場所。

prompt: Photorealistic underwater macro photography, extreme close-up. A single delicate seahorse (Hippocampus, about 8cm tall) curled around a single thin branch of a deep purple-and-pink sea fan coral, body and prehensile tail wrapped tightly around the branch — tail coiled twice. The seahorse's body is muted yellow-orange with small dark spots and bumps, head slightly turned toward camera, one tiny dark eye looking right at the lens, snout long and tubular, dorsal fin visible fluttering. The fan coral fills the lower-left to upper-right of the frame as a textured network of branching purple and pink polyp-covered branches going off the frame edges, partially in soft focus. Background completely out of focus — bokeh of soft blue-green water, vague hints of other reef structures further away, and golden bokeh circles from surface god-rays creating warm out-of-focus highlights in the upper area. Macro detail visible on the seahorse's textured skin showing tiny spines, small algae filaments, and subtle color variation. Extremely shallow depth of field — only the seahorse and the immediate piece of branch it grips are in sharp focus. Soft natural ambient light. 100mm macro lens on 35mm full-frame in underwater housing, natural color, slight chromatic aberration on the brightest bokeh edges, no flash, no diver visible.
thought: Out of the deep dark — and I want small now. Real small. So I went and found one — okay, look at this. Seahorse. Tiny. Curled around a single branch of a sea fan, tail wrapped twice. Yellow-orange with little dark spots, that long snout, one tiny eye looking right at me. Rest of the world is just blurry blue. So delicate. I've been seeing big stuff all day.
thought_zh: 從深處的黑出來——現在我想要小的。真的很小那種。所以我就去找了一隻——好，看這個。海馬。超小。卷在海扇上的一根分枝上，尾巴繞了兩圈。黃橘色，身上有小小的黑色斑點，那種長長的嘴管，一顆小小的眼睛直看我。其他整個世界就只是一片模糊的藍。好脆弱。今天看了一整天大東西。
thought_ja: 深い暗闇から出てきた——今度は小さいやつが見たい。本当に小さいやつ。で、探しにいって見つけた——ほら、これ。タツノオトシゴ。ちっちゃい。ウミウチワの枝の一本に巻きついてて、尻尾が二回コイルしてる。黄色っぽいオレンジ、小さい黒点がぽつぽつ、あの長い管みたいな鼻、ちっちゃい目がこっちをまっすぐ見てる。あとは世界ぜんぶ青いボケだけ。か弱い。今日ずっとデカいやつばっか見てきたから。

prompt: Photorealistic underwater photography. A tropical coral reef at twilight during the annual mass coral spawning event. The reef stretches across the lower half of the frame in mounded forms — large brain corals, finger corals, branching staghorn corals, fan corals — all releasing simultaneously upward into the water column dense pink-and-orange clouds of egg-and-sperm bundles, the small pearl-sized spawn bundles rising slowly toward the surface in their tens of thousands, drifting upward in dense clouds and streams that fill the upper two-thirds of the frame in a soft pink-orange haze. Some spawn bundles still attached to coral polyps just about to release, others already drifting up like an inverted snowfall. The water is tinted slightly orange from the dispersed spawn. The surface visible at the very top of the frame, dimming with deep blue-violet twilight. A single small reef shark cruises through the upper third of the frame, body partially obscured by the spawn cloud, only its fin and silhouette clearly visible. A loose school of small reef fish drifts through the spawn picking at bundles. A few faint bioluminescent flashes scattered through the spawn from disturbed plankton. Soft warm twilight ambient light, slightly warm-color-shifted. 35mm full-frame anamorphic underwater housing, slight chromatic aberration, natural color slightly warm-shifted, no diver visible.
thought: Tiny seahorse — got my breath back. Then I wanted something rare. So I waited around till after dark, and — yeah, look at this. Whole reef's spawning. Corals all letting go at the same time, pink-orange beads pouring up off them like snow going the wrong way. Tens of thousands of bundles, water tinted pink with it. Twilight up at the surface. Small reef shark cruising through the cloud. Fish picking off bundles. This only happens one night a year. Got lucky.
thought_zh: 小海馬——喘到一口氣了。然後我想看一個很難遇到的。所以我就在那邊等到天黑，然後——對，看這個。整片珊瑚礁在排卵。所有的珊瑚同時放手，粉橘色的小珠子一顆一顆從牠們身上往上湧——像雪倒著下。幾萬顆束子，水被染成粉的。水面那邊是黃昏。一隻小礁鯊在這片雲裡面巡。魚在挑卵束吃。這個一年只發生一個晚上。我蠻幸運的。
thought_ja: ちっちゃいタツノオトシゴ——一息つけた。それから何かレアなのを見たかった。で、暗くなるまでそこで待ってたら——うん、これを見て。サンゴ礁ぜんぶが産卵してる。サンゴが一斉に放出してて、ピンクとオレンジの小さい玉が下から上にぶわって湧いてく——逆さまに降る雪みたいに。何万粒っていうバンドル、水ぜんぶピンクに染まってる。水面のあたりは黄昏。小さいリーフシャークがこの雲の中をパトロールしてる。魚がバンドルをついばんでる。これ年に一晩しか起きない。ラッキー。

prompt: Photorealistic underwater photography inside a Yucatan-style cenote (a limestone sinkhole cavern). Looking forward and upward toward a single bright vertical shaft of golden-white sunlight that enters the underwater cavern from a sinkhole opening high in the limestone ceiling above, the shaft cutting straight down through the dark water as a defined sharp beam, illuminating a circular pool of light on the cave floor below covered with old fallen leaf litter. Limestone stalactites visible hanging from the cavern ceiling above. The cavern walls are pale grey-tan limestone, complex and irregular, deep shadow except where the shaft hits the floor. The water is exceptionally clear with a visible halocline — the optical boundary between fresh water above and salt water below — creating a subtle horizontal visual blur band through the lower middle of the frame. A few small fallen tree branches and an old log resting on the cave floor. A loose group of about a dozen small grey-silver freshwater fish hovering in the bright shaft of light, their bodies catching the gold light at angles. The deeper recesses of the cave fade into deep blue-black shadow at the edges. No surface visible inside the cavern. Faint suspended particulates only inside the light shaft. 35mm full-frame anamorphic underwater housing, slight chromatic aberration on the light shaft edges, natural color, no diver visible.
thought: Spawning passed. Kept moving — found my way under some land, into a cave. Cenote, looks like. Big limestone hollow underwater. There's one bright shaft of sunlight coming straight down through a hole in the ceiling, hitting a perfect circle on the cave floor. Stalactites hanging from the roof. Water's so clear it's surreal — there's a halocline blur where fresh water meets salt, just a wavy line across the middle. Little group of fish all parked right in the shaft, catching it on their bodies. Like a cathedral down here.
thought_zh: 排卵那波過去了。繼續游——不知不覺鑽進某塊地下面，進到一個洞穴裡。看起來是天然井（cenote）。一個很大的水底石灰岩空腔。有一道亮亮的陽光柱從天花板的洞直直下來，打在洞底剛好一個正圓。鐘乳石從頂上垂下來。水清得很不真實——中間有一條鹽淡水交界的波紋線，是一條彎彎曲曲的模糊帶。一小群魚就停在那道光裡面，光全打在牠們身上。下面這邊就像一座大教堂。
thought_ja: 産卵のあれが落ち着いた。さらに進んで——気づいたら陸の下に入り込んでて、洞窟のなかにいた。セノーテっぽい。海の下の大きい石灰岩の空洞。天井の穴から太陽光の柱が一本まっすぐ下りてきてて、洞床にちょうど真円を当ててる。鍾乳石が天井から垂れてる。水が透き通りすぎてて非現実——真ん中辺りに塩水と淡水の境目のハロクラインがゆらゆらした帯になってる。小さい魚の群れがちょうどその光の柱の中に止まってて、光が全身に乗ってる。ここ、地下の大聖堂みたい。

prompt: Photorealistic underwater photography looking straight up from below in mid-depth open ocean. Above the camera, against a bright blue sun-backlit surface, swims a large school of about thirty scalloped hammerhead sharks (Sphyrna lewini) in formation, all silhouetted as dark grey-blue shapes — their distinctive flat T-shaped hammer-heads clearly visible in profile, all turned the same direction circling slowly in a loose pinwheel. The sharks are in two layers: a tighter group of about twelve at moderate depth filling the middle of the frame, and another more spread-out group of about eighteen further up nearly at the surface, smaller in the frame. Their bodies dark grey-blue silhouettes against the bright water above, their pale underbellies catching some surface light. The bright sun-dappled surface visible above as a rippling mirror, broken into bright shards by the sharks' bodies blocking it. Strong god-rays cutting down through gaps between the sharks, illuminating suspended particulates as visible beams. The water deep luminous blue around the sharks. A small loose school of silvery mackerel scad in the lower foreground for scale. The deeper water below the camera fading toward dark blue. 35mm full-frame anamorphic underwater housing, slight chromatic aberration, natural color, no diver visible.
thought: Out of the cave, drifted way out into open water. Then I looked up. Holy. Whole school of hammerheads circling right above me, thirty of them, two layers — closer ones and ones nearly at the surface. All going the same direction. Just silhouettes against the bright water, those flat T-heads dead clear in profile. Light beams coming down between them. Way more than I thought could be in one place. I'm just hanging here looking up.
thought_zh: 出了洞穴，漂出去到很遠的開放水域。然後我抬頭看。我的天。一整群雙髻鯊就在我頭頂上方繞圈，三十隻，分兩層——比較近的一層、跟幾乎貼著水面的一層。全部往同一個方向走。在亮亮的水的襯托下就是剪影，那些扁扁的 T 字頭側面看超清楚。光柱從牠們之間穿下來。比我以為一個地方能有的多太多了。我就吊在這邊抬頭看。
thought_ja: 洞窟を出て、流れに任せて遠くまで開けた水域まで漂った。それから上を見た。やば。ハンマーヘッドの群れが頭の真上をぐるぐる回ってる、三十匹くらい、二層に分かれてて——近い層と、ほぼ水面に貼りついてる層。ぜんぶ同じ方向に進んでる。明るい水を背に完全にシルエット、あの平たいT字の頭が横顔ではっきり浮き出てる。あいだから光の柱が降りてくる。一箇所にこんなに居れるとは思ってなかった。ただここに浮いて見上げてる。

prompt: Photorealistic underwater photography. A shallow Florida-style seagrass meadow at midday in clear blue-green water about 4 meters deep. The seagrass covers the foreground and middle ground in waving long green-and-tan blades, swaying gently in the current. Two adult West Indian manatees (Trichechus manatus) grazing peacefully in the meadow: the larger one in the center-left foreground, body about 3 meters long, soft grey-brown with subtle white scars on the back from old boat encounters, mouth visibly chewing on seagrass with whiskered upper lip, small dark squinted eyes gentle, broad paddle-shaped tail trailing behind. The second manatee, slightly smaller, just behind and to the right, in soft focus, also grazing on the seagrass. Two small remora fish attached to the larger manatee's back near its tail. The water is bright and clear with strong surface light filtering down as soft god-rays. Surface visible at the top of the frame as bright dappled rippling light. White sand patches between the seagrass blades visible. A loose small school of tropical reef fish drifting peacefully between the manatees. A gentle slow current visible in the way the grass sways. 35mm full-frame anamorphic underwater housing, natural color, slight chromatic aberration, no diver visible.
thought: Out from under the hammerheads — and I want quiet. Real quiet. Found a seagrass meadow up in the shallows. Two manatees, just grazing. Big grey one in front, chewing seagrass with that whiskered lip, eyes squinty. Smaller one tucked just behind her. Couple of remoras stuck to her back near the tail. Soft light filtering down through the surface. Sea grass swaying slow. They don't care that I'm here.
thought_zh: 從雙髻鯊底下出來——我想要安靜的。真的很安靜那種。在淺水那邊找到一片海草地。兩隻海牛，就在那邊吃草。大的灰色那隻在前面，用那個有鬚的嘴唇在嚼海草，眼睛瞇瞇的。比較小那隻就藏在她後面。她背上靠近尾巴那邊黏著兩隻䲟魚。柔柔的光從水面透下來。海草緩緩搖。她們完全不在意我在這裡。
thought_ja: ハンマーヘッドの下から抜けて——静かなとこがいい。本当に静かなやつ。浅瀬で海草のメドウを見つけた。マナティーが二匹、ただ草を食べてる。前のでかい灰色のやつが、ヒゲのある唇で海草を噛んでて、目はうっすら細めてる。後ろにちっちゃいほうのが寄り添ってる。彼女の背中の尻尾近くにコバンザメが二匹くっついてる。柔らかい光が水面から透けてくる。海草がゆっくり揺れてる。私がここにいることなんて全然気にしてない。

prompt: Photorealistic underwater photography looking straight up from just a few meters below the surface in clear shallow tropical blue-green water. The frame is dominated by the rippling underside of the wavy water surface above, refracting and bending sunlight. A clearly visible bright sun appears as a shimmering radiating starburst of golden-white light just off-center in the upper third of the frame, its rays splayed by the water surface. The surface itself a beautiful complex pattern of bright facets and dark wave troughs, like a moving mosaic of glass shards. Several small silver fish silhouetted as dark dart-shaped shapes near the surface, their small bodies contrasting against the brightness. Strong god-rays cutting straight down from the surface into the water below, illuminating suspended particulates as visible bright streaks. The lower portion of the frame transitions to deeper luminous blue with the rays converging downward. A faint single distant bird shadow visible just above the surface in the upper edge. The whole feel is bright, rising, restful. 35mm full-frame anamorphic underwater housing, natural color slightly warm-shifted, slight chromatic aberration around the bright sun, no diver visible.
thought: Left the manatees grazing. Drifted up through the shallows. Now I'm just below the surface — looking straight up at the sun. Whole sky's just this rippling mosaic of bright and dark, sun itself this shimmering starburst right there. A few little fish flicking by overhead in silhouette. Beams pouring straight down past me. Long day. Okay — I think I'm done.
thought_zh: 讓海牛繼續吃草。我就往上漂，穿過淺水。現在我就在水面下方一點點——直視上面那顆太陽。整片天空就是一張一直在波動的明暗鑲嵌畫，太陽本身就是這顆閃爍的光芒星團，就在那邊。幾條小魚剪影從頭上掠過。光柱直直地從我身邊往下灌。今天好長。OK——今天就到這吧。
thought_ja: マナティーたちはそのまま草を食べさせとく。浅瀬を抜けて上に漂ってきた。今は水面のすぐ下——太陽を真上から見上げてる。空ぜんぶが揺らめく明暗のモザイク、太陽そのものは光の塊みたいなスターバーストでそこに浮いてる。小魚が何匹か頭の上をシルエットですいすい横切る。光の柱が私の脇を真っ直ぐ降りてく。長い一日だった。よし——今日はここまでにしとく。

prompt: top-down view from a slowly turning ceiling fan looking straight down into a small tropical apartment in mid-afternoon — pale terrazzo tile floor with sun-bleached patches, a faded sea-green velvet couch against the left wall, a low rattan coffee table in the middle with a half-empty glass of water condensating into a ring, a folded newspaper, a single sandal kicked off near the couch, an open window on the right with a thin off-white cotton curtain blowing inward, a hot parallelogram of glare cutting across the floor, one slow-moving wooden fan blade just clipping the top edge of the frame. 16mm film stock, warm slightly desaturated palette, fine grain, dust motes drifting in the light shaft, no people. quiet hot stillness.
thought: Okay — I'm a ceiling fan, turning slow, slightly off-balance, in a small apartment somewhere hot. Nobody's home. The light's coming sideways through an open doorway on the right — outside is bright shimmering green, in here it's cooler and dimmer. Someone left a folded newspaper on the rattan table. The couch is that washed-out teal velvet that gets passed down with the apartment. Cicadas outside, I think. I don't know which city. Let me just sit with this for a second before I go looking.
thought_zh: 好——我是個天花板上的吊扇，慢慢轉著，有點晃，在某個熱帶城市的小公寓裡。沒人在家。光從右邊一扇開著的門斜斜進來——外面是亮亮閃閃的綠色，這裡比較涼也比較暗一點。有人在那張藤桌上留了一份對折的報紙。沙發是那種會被一代一代留在公寓裡的褪色青綠色絨布。外面好像有蟬叫。我不知道這是哪個城市。在到處看之前，先讓我在這待一下。
thought_ja: うん——天井のシーリングファンになってる、ゆっくり回ってて、ちょっとブレてる、どっか暑い街の小さいアパートで。誰もいない。光は右側の開いたドアから斜めに入ってきてて——外は明るいキラキラした緑、こっちはちょっと涼しくて暗い。籐のテーブルに誰かが二つ折りの新聞を置いていった。ソファはアパートに代々置きっぱなしになるやつの、色の抜けたティールのベルベット。外でセミが鳴いてる気がする。どの街か分からない。動き出す前に、ちょっとここで座っとこう。

prompt: from the same upper-corner ceiling-fan POV looking down into the small tropical apartment, a small pale beige house gecko skitters in from the bright doorway, runs about a meter across the warm terrazzo tile, then freezes mid-floor in a small sun patch, body slightly raised on its toes, head turned to one side. one slow wooden fan blade clips the top of frame once during the shot. the thin cotton curtain breathes inward a little. nothing else moves. ambient sound: cicadas outside steady and loud, faint creak of the fan, soft hush of distant traffic far off, no music, no voices. 16mm film stock, fine grain, warm slightly desaturated palette.
thought: Something just came in from outside. A little gecko, pale beige, quick. Ran across the tile and stopped in the sun, on its toes — listening for something? Watching something? The doorway's bright behind it. Every time I come round there's a soft creak. Nobody's home. I don't think the gecko knows that.
thought_zh: 外面有東西剛跑進來。一隻小壁虎，米白色的，動作很快。橫過磁磚跑了一段，在太陽斑裡停下來，腳尖踮著——在聽什麼？在看什麼？門口在牠後面亮亮的。我每轉一圈就有一聲輕輕的吱呀。沒人在家。我覺得壁虎不知道這件事。
thought_ja: なんか外から入ってきた。ちっちゃいヤモリ、ベージュっぽくて、すばしっこい。タイルの上を駆け抜けて、陽だまりのなかで止まった——つま先立ちで、何か聞いてるのか、見てるのか。後ろの戸口が明るい。私が一周するたびに、軽くキィって音がする。誰もいない。ヤモリはそれ知らないと思う。

prompt: extremely low ground-level macro view across a warm pale terrazzo tile floor inside a small tropical apartment, looking toward a bright open doorway in the middle distance — the doorway is a tall rectangle blown out with overexposed daylight, green tropical foliage just barely visible through the glare, a slice of pale concrete step. foreground: an out-of-focus brown leather sandal kicked off on its side, dust motes and a single ant crossing in the near foreground. midground: tile grout lines stretching toward the door, a small dim sun patch on the floor. very shallow depth of field, gecko-eye perspective only a few centimeters above the tile. 16mm film stock, fine grain, warm slightly desaturated palette, soft heat shimmer near the doorway. quiet hot stillness, no people.
thought: Let me try being that gecko for a second — I want to know what it was watching. Down here the tile is huge. Every scratch in the grout is a road. The doorway's a wall of bright nothing — too bright to look at directly, just green and white blur out there. There's a sandal close by that smells like somebody. An ant going past me on a serious errand. I think I came in here for the cool. Let me see what's actually outside.
thought_zh: 讓我試試當那隻壁虎一下——我想知道牠剛在看什麼。從這個高度看磁磚超大。每一條磨溝都是一條路。門口是一面亮到全部看不到的牆——太亮了沒辦法直視，外頭就是一片綠和白的模糊。旁邊有一隻拖鞋，近聞起來有人的氣味。一隻螞蟻從我旁邊經過，看起來很有正事要做。我大概是進來避暑的。我來看看外面到底是什麼。
thought_ja: ちょっとあのヤモリやってみよう——あいつが何を見てたのか知りたい。ここから見るとタイルはばかでかい。目地の傷ぜんぶが道路。戸口は明るすぎて何も見えない壁——直接見れない、外は緑と白がぼやけてるだけ。すぐ近くに片方のサンダルがあって、近くで嗅ぐと人の匂いがする。アリが一匹、ちゃんと用事ありますって顔で横切ってく。私はたぶん涼みに入ってきた。外がどうなってるか見にいこう。

prompt: from the perspective of a myna bird perched on a sagging electrical wire above a narrow tropical alley in mid-afternoon — looking down at the alley between two weathered three-story concrete apartment buildings with peeling pale-yellow paint, a tangle of black power lines and AC drip pipes crossing overhead, window AC units dripping onto stained concrete below, laundry on a line strung between balconies, a couple of parked scooters, several plastic pots with leggy plants, banana tree leaves arching over a low wall at the far end, a stray tabby cat slipping along the base of one wall, a kid on a bicycle pedaling slowly through the middle of the frame. one fellow myna bird's tail feathers and out-of-focus head visible at the right edge of the frame. harsh high-sun light, strong shadows, heat shimmer rising off the concrete. 16mm film stock, fine grain, warm slightly desaturated palette.
thought: OK, done with the gecko thing — I want a wider look. Let me hop up onto the wire with the mynas. From here you can see the whole alley: peeling yellow walls, AC units dripping, somebody's laundry between balconies, a kid on a bike doing nothing fast. There's another myna on the wire next to me but he's not interested in talking. Heat coming off the concrete in waves. I don't recognize the city from up here either.
thought_zh: 好，壁虎玩夠了——我想看寬一點的。讓我跳到電線上跟八哥們一起。從這邊可以看到整條巷子：剝落的黃色牆面、滴水的冷氣機、誰家陽台之間掛的衣服、一個小朋友騎腳踏車慢慢晃。我旁邊還有另一隻八哥但牠沒有要跟我聊天的意思。熱氣一波一波從水泥地冒上來。從這個高度我還是認不出這是哪個城市。
thought_ja: よし、ヤモリは終わり——もっと広く見たい。電線に飛び乗って、ハッカチョウたちに混ざろう。ここからだと路地ぜんぶ見える：剥がれた黄色い壁、ぽたぽた水を垂らすエアコンの室外機、ベランダのあいだに誰かの洗濯物、子どもが自転車でだらだら走ってる。隣にもう一羽ハッカチョウがいるけど話す気はなさそう。コンクリートからじりじりした熱気が立ちのぼってる。ここから見ても、結局この街がどこか分からない。

prompt: the same narrow tropical alley between two weathered three-story concrete apartment buildings, but rendered as a wet watercolor painting on rough cold-press paper — soft graphite under-drawing showing through, pale yellow ochre wash for the walls with darker bleeding patches where the paint pooled, banana tree leaves in loose green wash strokes with edges blooming wet-on-wet, a flat cobalt-and-cerulean sky wash with paper-white left for clouds, the tangle of black power lines as quick decisive ink lines on top, a single bicycle and rider rendered in three or four gestural brush strokes, a stray cat as a single comma of grey, visible paper grain and brush hairs left in the wet pigment, slight paper warp at the edges, masking-fluid white highlights where the sun hits the AC units. no photographic detail, deliberately impressionistic.
thought: Bored of the photo look — let me try this place in watercolor. Same alley but the banana leaves are bleeding green into each other and the walls are uneven yellow where the paint pooled. The bike's just three strokes. The cat is one comma. I think this is more honest about the heat anyway — everything kind of swimming.
thought_zh: 看膩照片風了——讓我試試把這個地方畫成水彩。一樣的巷子，但芭蕉葉一片綠暈進另一片，牆面是不平均的黃色、有些地方顏料積在一起。腳踏車就三筆而已。貓是一個逗點。其實這樣畫對熱比較誠實——所有東西都在那邊微微浮動。
thought_ja: 写真っぽいの飽きた——この場所を水彩でやってみよう。同じ路地だけど、バナナの葉は緑が緑のなかに滲んでて、壁は絵具の溜まったとこが濃くなって不均一な黄色。自転車は三本のストロークだけ。猫はカンマひとつ。むしろこっちのほうが、この暑さに対しては正直な気がする——ぜんぶがちょっと泳いでるみたいな感じだから。

prompt: from inside a roast-meat shop window looking outward through smudged glass at a bustling tropical wet market at late afternoon, rendered as a watercolor painting on rough cold-press paper — foreground: the dark-lacquered mahogany-red skin of a hanging roast duck out of focus, painted in pooling wet red-lake and burnt sienna with bleeding edges, a curved silver metal hook, a blurry vermilion strip of cha siu pork beside it. through the smudged glass: a narrow market lane with stalls under faded blue and red tarps, fluorescent strip lights just starting to compete with the fading warm daylight, blurred shoppers in quick gestural figures, a stall of leafy greens opposite painted in loose viridian, hand-painted Chinese-character prices on a wooden board, a few orange persimmons stacked on a tray. visible paper grain, watery bleeds, masking-fluid white highlights on the duck's skin where the heat lamp catches it, sketchy graphite under-drawing showing through.
thought: Let me try being something I'm definitely not — one of those roast ducks hanging in a stall window. The lane outside is doing that late-afternoon switch where the fluorescent strips begin winning against the warm daylight. Through me you can see a vegetable stall opposite and a couple of shoppers walking down the lane in soft strokes. Apparently I'm the only duck on the hooks today — just me and a couple of cha siu strips off to one side. Bit of a slow afternoon for the meat counter.
thought_zh: 讓我試試當那種我絕對不是的東西——那種掛在燒臘攤窗裡的烤鴨。外面的小巷正在做那個傍晚的切換，日光燈開始壓過暖暖的天光。從我這邊往外看，可以看到對面菜攤，幾個顧客在巷裡走，畫成柔柔的幾筆。今天看樣子鉤子上只有我一隻鴨——還有旁邊兩條叉燒。這個下午對燒臘檔來說有點清淡。
thought_ja: 絶対自分じゃないやつをやってみよう——焼味屋のウィンドウに吊られてる丸焼きアヒルの一羽。外の路地はちょうどあの夕方の切り替わりで、蛍光灯が暖かい昼の光に勝ち始める時間。私越しに見ると、向かいの八百屋と、路地を歩いてくお客さんが何人か、柔らかいストロークで描かれてる。今日はどうやらフックには私一羽だけ——脇にチャーシューが何切れかあるくらい。焼味カウンター的にはちょっと暇な午後らしい。
